Beta 3 reference

The following tables are generated from current menus and build metadata, including Surface Objects, category Bloom, Lighting/Visibility presets and player-state ambient. MAPGEN controls are excluded from this public client release.



How to read this reference

This is not a replacement for the cvar reference inside the client; it is its printed copy plus a map of the groups. If you know the name of a group, open this document; if you need to find an exact variable by a word, open the cvar reference in the game itself — it searches both names and descriptions.

Everything below is generated from the release's own variable description tables. It is literally the same text the client shows in the cvar browser and in the built-in console help, so the document and the game cannot disagree.

What if a variable is not here. This reference covers variables that carry a built-in description. The complete list of every registered client variable is always available in the in-game cvar reference.

How to change a value

Through the menu. The preferred way: the menu shows the accepted values and the hint.
Through the cvar reference. It shows the description, the values and the scope, and lets you reset.
Through the console. variable_name value sets a value; variable_name with no argument prints the current one.

The scope, and the file a value ends up in, are explained in the cvars and cvar browser guide.

3. The complete variable reference

This section is generated from the release description tables q2prox_cvar_info_q2prox.c and q2prox_cvar_info_q2pro.c. It is the same text the client shows in the cvar browser and in the built-in console help. Variables carrying a description: 3719.

AVFX: weather, sky, water, surfaces

Variables in this section: 1656.

VariableAccepted valuesDescription
cl_avfx0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for the Q2PRO-X Advanced Visual Effects atmospheric layer (rain, snow, ash, dust, mist + optional storm/lightning/thunder). Visual-only client-side feature; does not change server gameplay, prediction, or hit detection. Saved to mod-local Q2PRO-X config during normal play and to demo_visual config during demo playback. Default off.
cl_avfx_air_alpha_scale0.00..2.00 (1.0 = default)Alpha multiplier for the secondary air profile only (cl_avfx_air_profile). Multiplies the effective air-layer alpha; does not change the primary weather. Range 0.00..2.00.
cl_avfx_air_density_scale0.00..2.00 (1.0 = default)Density multiplier for the secondary air profile only (cl_avfx_air_profile). Multiplies the effective air-layer density; does not change the primary weather. Range 0.00..2.00.
cl_avfx_air_profile0=off / 1=ash / 2=dust / 3=mistOptional air-only profile layered OVER the primary cl_avfx_preset. 0=off, 1=ash, 2=dust, 3=mist. Air-only: it never spawns rain/snow surface effects (puddles, rings, runoff, snow material/accumulation/footprints). Has no effect when cl_avfx_preset is 0, or when it equals the primary preset (skipped to avoid double-emit). Underwater it is skipped like other local weather particles.
cl_avfx_alpha0.05..1.0 (default 0.35)Master alpha for AVFX visuals. Competitive limit clamps to 0.30 in multiplayer to keep targets readable.
cl_avfx_ash_dlight_brightness0..4 multiplier (default 1.0)Base brightness of warm ash-ember world light. The actual RGB strength is this value multiplied by that ember's final visual size, so small motes produce dim light and large coals produce stronger light. Independent from the radius control and still respects the global dynamic-light alpha/darkness settings. Live control.
cl_avfx_ash_dlight_radius0..5120 world units (default 256)Base radius of the warm light spot cast by one ash ember. The actual radius is this value multiplied by that particle's final visual scale after cl_avfx_size and per-ember size variation; the result is capped at 5120 world units. Live control. 0 removes the world-light reach without hiding the ember sprite. Very large values can light distant floors but cost more BSP lighting work.
cl_avfx_ash_dlights0=no ember dlights / 1=ember dlights (default)Master toggle for local warm world lights cast by bright ash ember particles. 1 (default) uses up to 12 stable world-space carrier embers in the active particle field. Every light follows its exact flying particle; observer position never selects or reassigns it. Radius and brightness are controlled separately and both follow each ember's final visual size. Expansion above gl_dynamic_radius 1 is compensated for these procedural micro-lights to prevent map-wide flicker; values below 1 can still shrink them. 0 keeps the ember particles themselves but skips their world light.
cl_avfx_ash_ember_fraction0..1 (menu step 0.05, default 0.4)Fraction of ash particles that are warm glowing embers vs dark motes. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the ash preset (cl_avfx_preset 3).
cl_avfx_ash_ember_glow0=Off / 1=On (default 1)Brightest embers glow like hot coals (sprite self-glow; does not light the level). Requires cl_avfx 1 and the ash preset (cl_avfx_preset 3).
cl_avfx_ash_sprites0=round ash / 1=varied fragments (default)Ash particle silhouette variety. 0 renders the legacy round ash dots. 1 gives ash particles procedural non-round masks (rectangles, triangles and fragments) so ash reads as small debris instead of identical circles.
cl_avfx_audio0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for AVFX sounds. Drives thunder, raindrop ticks, lightning impact bang, lava evaporation hiss, water-ripple plips, surface-contact step samples, and ambient loop beds (rain / wind / dust / snow / water) when matching WAV assets are present. Respects s_ambient — when global ambient sounds are off, AVFX sounds are also silent. Individual sublayers can still be gated via cl_avfx_audio_wind / _rain / _snow / _water / _thunder / _impact / _lava_steam / _rain_drops. If a WAV is absent or fails to load, that layer stays silent (no console spam).
cl_avfx_audio_impact0=no impact bang / 1=allow impact bang (default)Allow the explosion-style bang at the lightning strike point. Plays at the impact world position with normal attenuation, so distant strikes are quieter than nearby ones. Uses the standard rocket-explosion sound (weapons/rocklx1a.wav) bundled with the game — exactly the bang players hear when a rocket explodes against a surface. Gated by cl_avfx_audio master and cl_avfx_lightning_impact_scale > 0 — same conditions that decide whether the rocket-style impact visual runs.
cl_avfx_audio_lava_steam0=no evaporation hiss / 1=allow hiss (default)Allow short evaporation hiss one-shots when real rain/snow impact samples contact lava. The sound is throttled and probabilistic, so not every drop or flake is voiced. Uses q2prox/avfx/steam_hiss1..3.wav if present; missing files stay silent. This is not water audio and never uses water_murmur/water_lap samples. Visual steam is controlled separately by cl_avfx_lava_steam.
cl_avfx_audio_lava_surface_steam0=no surface melt hiss / 1=allow surface melt hiss (default)Allow softer positional hiss from surface snow/water mass melting near lava edges. Uses q2prox/avfx/steam_surface_hiss1..3.wav if present; missing files stay silent. This is separate from cl_avfx_audio_lava_steam, which is for sharp individual rain/snow particle contacts. Surface steam sound is spawned at the same world point as the soft surface steam puff.
cl_avfx_audio_meteordefault 1 / 0 or 1Audio for sky meteors / shooting stars (M1) — burnup crack when bolide disintegrates. Global low-volume oneshot (no spatial cue since meteor is at sky distance). Missing WAV silent. Default ON.
cl_avfx_audio_meteor_impactdefault 1 / 0 or 1Audio for falling impact meteors (M2) — entry hiss during descent, flyby whoosh when passing near the listener, ground/water/lava boom on impact (distant variant when far), debris layer. Missing WAVs silent. Default ON.
cl_avfx_audio_puddle_steps0=no puddle steps / 1=allow puddle steps (default)Allow wet footstep sounds when the local player walks/runs through visible AVFX puddles. Requires cl_avfx_audio and cl_avfx_audio_surface_steps. Landing splash audio also uses this gate.
cl_avfx_audio_rain0=no rain layer / 1=allow rain layer (default)Gate for the main rain ambience bed. Drives rain_light_loop / rain_loop / rain_heavy_loop and the underwater rain loop selection when matching WAV assets are present. Drop one-shot ticks and water-ripple plips run through cl_avfx_audio_rain_drops / cl_avfx_audio_water — those are independent gates. If a WAV is absent or fails to load, that layer stays silent.
cl_avfx_audio_rain_drops0=no drop ticks / 1=allow drop ticks (default)Allow close raindrop ticks (q2prox/avfx/rain_drop1..3.wav) while the rain preset and cl_avfx_rain_drops are active. Wired and active — fires sparse positional one-shots near the camera with ATTN_NORM falloff. Gated by §6.4 underwater check (camera in liquid → no drop ticks). Drop sounds never play when the rain preset is inactive.
cl_avfx_audio_snow0=no snow ambience / 1=allow snow ambience (default)Gate for the subtle winter wind ambience (snow_wind_loop.wav) at snow preset. Snow audio is intentionally soft wind under the visual layer, never loud snow noise. If the WAV is absent or fails to load, the layer stays silent.
cl_avfx_audio_snow_steps0=no snow steps / 1=allow snow steps (default)Allow snow footstep sounds on visible AVFX snow cover. Requires cl_avfx_audio and cl_avfx_audio_surface_steps. Volume starts only once snow is visibly present and grows with visible coverage; when snowdrift growth is enabled, step depth follows the grown snowdrift volume.
cl_avfx_audio_surface_steps0=no AVFX surface steps / 1=allow surface steps (default)Master gate for AVFX surface-contact step audio. Enables snow, wet-floor and puddle step layers when their own sub-gates and WAV assets are present. Visual effects such as footprints or puddle splashes are controlled by separate cvars.
cl_avfx_audio_thunder0=no thunder / 1=allow thunder (default)Allow thunder one-shots tied to storm/lightning events. When storm + lightning fire a visual flash, a thunder sample plays after a randomized 0.3..2.5 s delay. Thunder never plays without an originating lightning event.
cl_avfx_audio_volume0.0..1.0 (default 0.35)AVFX-local sound volume multiplier. Effective volume = s_volume * s_ambient_volume * cl_avfx_audio_volume * preset/level/intensity factors. Default is intentionally subtle.
cl_avfx_audio_water0=no water audio / 1=allow water audio (default)Gate for water-related AVFX audio. Drives the rain-on-water ripple plip one-shots (q2prox/avfx/water_ripple1..3.wav) when rings spawn on visible water surfaces, and the proximity-gated water_murmur_loop ambient bed near visible water. Set to 0 to silence both paths regardless of preset. If a WAV is absent or fails to load, that layer stays silent.
cl_avfx_audio_wind0=no wind layer / 1=allow wind layer (default)Gate for the wind ambience layer. Drives wind / dust / ash / mist ambient loops, the storm wind variant loop and gust one-shots when matching WAV assets are present. If a WAV is absent or fails to load, that layer stays silent.
cl_avfx_backend0=Classic / 1=Accelerated (default 0)AVFX surface/state backend. Classic keeps the legacy behaviour. Accelerated enables the modern dirty-tile/reservoir paths used by accelerated weather rendering. Requires cl_avfx 1. Accelerated is what enables the dirty-tile / reservoir data paths that cl_avfx_weather_renderer and the optimized coverage/sky caches build on.
cl_avfx_blackhole0=off (default) / 1=onMaster switch for the AVFX black hole: a configurable background body with gravitational lensing, an event-horizon shadow, a photon ring, an animated accretion disk, procedural flow strands and optional polar jets. The black hole is BEHIND the Sun, Earth, Moon and other ordinary celestial bodies, and IN FRONT OF the stars: it lenses and hides only the star background, and clouds pass in front of it. Default OFF (opt-in); at 0 the feature performs no simulation, no shader compile and no render pass at all.
cl_avfx_blackhole_animation_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Global animation multiplier for the disk, strands and jets. 0 is a real freeze, not a slow crawl: the object stops completely and the renderer reuses its cached field, so a frozen black hole costs no per-frame GPU work.
cl_avfx_blackhole_antialiasing0=Off / 1=Analytic / 2=2x (default) / 3=4xEdge antialiasing and reconstruction quality. It uses analytic edge coverage and bounded reconstruction: it does not multiply the integration budget per output sample and cannot grow the disk or the strands.
cl_avfx_blackhole_azimuthdefault 225 / range 0..359 / step 1Initial / manual azimuth in degrees. In auto-drift mode this stays the archived starting point and is never rewritten by the drift.
cl_avfx_blackhole_bloom0=off / 1=on (default)Use the black hole's emission as a bloom source. Only the emission blooms — never the lensed star background behind it, and never the event horizon, which emits nothing.
cl_avfx_blackhole_bloom_strengthdefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Scale of the black-hole bloom source.
cl_avfx_blackhole_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0..5 / step 0.05Brightness of ALL black-hole emission (disk, photon ring, strands, jets). The gravitational lensing and the event-horizon shadow are not emission and remain at 0.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_comets0=off (default) / 1=onCapture comets into the Black Hole. Needs the object-capture master (and its parents) on plus comets enabled. A captured comet's nucleus/coma follows the curved path while its single continuous streak bends after it; the whole comet contracts and fades into the core. Off by default. No effect when there are no comets on screen.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_debugdefault 0 (off) / 0=off, >0=diagnostic (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only diagnostic for Black-Hole object capture. When non-zero it prints per-event capture state (latch, trajectory phase, dissolve) and draws capture-path debug markers. Not archived, no menu row; costs nothing at 0.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_dissolvedefault 1.0 / range 0.25..3 / step 0.05Core dissolve envelope: how early and how wide the near-core shrink/fade begins. Higher values make objects shrink and fade out sooner and more gradually as they approach the dark core; lower values keep them intact until they are very close.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_impact_meteors0=off (default) / 1=onCapture FALLING impact meteors into the Black Hole. Capture is legal only while an event is still PRE-TERMINAL: a meteor that has already struck, that collides with a real wall this frame, or whose descent completes this frame is never taken retroactively and always performs its normal impact. A captured meteor is pulled off its impact route, curves and tumbles into the dark core with its tail bending after it, dissolves at the centre and retires exactly once - leaving no impact, no camera shake, no gameplay/damage bridge, no crater, steam, evaporation or afterglow, and no ordinary meteor sound. Concurrent uncaptured meteors keep their full normal behaviour. Requires the object-capture master (plus global AVFX, the matter-consumption master and a present Black Hole) and the falling-meteor system enabled; the celestial-matter parent is NOT a dependency. Off by default; while off the impact path is byte-identical to the accepted one.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_meteors0=off (default) / 1=onCapture ordinary flying sky meteors into the Black Hole. Needs the object-capture master (and its parents) on plus flying meteors enabled. A captured meteor stops burning up on its own — it follows the curved path into the core and dissolves there. Off by default. No effect when there are no flying meteors on screen.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_objects0=off (default) / 1=onObject-capture master. When on, ordinary flying sky objects that pass near the Black Hole are pulled in: they bend and spiral toward it, accelerate, shrink and fade into the dark core and dissolve once. Off by default; while off every meteor and comet keeps its exact baseline flight. Enabling it alone draws nothing extra: the matter-consumption master must also be on, at least one object child (meteors or comets) enabled, and a Black Hole must be present. The separate celestial-matter parent is not required. Falling/impact meteors are never captured.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_radiusdefault 1.0 / range 0.25..3 / step 0.05Attraction-zone reach multiplier: how close to the Black Hole an object must pass before it latches on. Larger values capture objects from farther away. Appearance/behaviour control only; it never moves the Black Hole or the objects' spawn points.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_spaceships0=off (default) / 1=onCapture the local AVFX sky spaceships into the Black Hole. A ship flying its normal route latches once without any position, heading, scale, alpha or roll snap, bends into the same shared curved path, keeps its nose aligned with its true transformed motion, then contracts and fades into the dark core and is gone exactly once. The whole ship model is captured - not particles or a sprite - and its model, skin, tint, seed and aerobatic roll are never re-rolled. Requires the object-capture master (plus global AVFX, the matter-consumption master and a present Black Hole) and sky spaceships enabled; the celestial-matter parent is NOT a dependency. Off by default; no capture work happens while off.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0.25..4 / step 0.05Capture speed: how fast a latched object is drawn into the core. Higher values shorten the spiral-in; lower values let it curve in slowly. Bounded so a moving Black Hole can never make an object immortal.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_spiraldefault 0.65 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Spiral amount: how much a captured object curls tangentially around the Black Hole instead of falling straight in. 0 = a straight bend toward the core; higher values add a visible orbital swirl before it dissolves.
cl_avfx_blackhole_cloud_occlusiondefault 1.0 / range 0..1 / step 0.01How strongly foreground clouds attenuate the black hole. Clouds are nearer than the hole, so they pass in front of it through the same transmittance the Sun/Moon disks use. 0 means clouds never hide it.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_celestials0=off (default) / 1=onCelestial parent switch: enables the celestial-body consumers (Moon dust, Earth matter and Sun plasma). Off by default; with it off no celestial matter is drawn regardless of the individual body masters.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_earth0=off (default) / 1=onEarth matter master. Tears three distinct kinds of Earth matter into the black hole — soft blue-white atmosphere/cloud wisps, compact blue-cyan water droplets and mist, and sparse brown/gray soil and rock fragments — each with its own shape, size, opacity and motion. Needs the matter-consumption master and the celestial parent on, plus a visible Earth and Black Hole. Off by default; absent/off Earth is a safe no-op.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_earth_strengthdefault 1.0 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Earth contribution to consumption strength. Scales the Earth matter independently of the global intensity and of the Moon.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_moon0=off (default) / 1=onMoon dust master. Draws pale-gray dust peeling from the Moon limb into the black hole. Needs the matter-consumption master and the celestial parent on, plus a visible Moon and Black Hole. Off by default. If the Moon is absent or off there is no effect and no work — a safe no-op.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_moon_strengthdefault 1.0 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Moon contribution to consumption strength. Scales the Moon dust independently of the global intensity.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_reflect_mirrors0=off (default) / 1=onAdditional opt-in for reflecting Black-Hole ingestion particles in mirror surfaces. Requires the mirror model-reflection parent, its Celestial bodies category, the matter-consumption master and at least one enabled ingestion body (Moon dust or Earth matter). Uses the same finished particle stream; it never runs a private simulation. Off by default.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_reflect_puddles0=off (default) / 1=onAdditional opt-in for reflecting Black-Hole ingestion particles in puddles. Requires the puddle model-reflection parent, its Celestial bodies category, the matter-consumption master and at least one enabled ingestion body (Moon dust or Earth matter). Uses the finished per-body direction maps (each gated by its own line-of-sight) and the puddle's real reflected ray. Off by default.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_reflect_water0=off (default) / 1=onAdditional opt-in for reflecting Black-Hole ingestion particles in BSP water. Requires the water model-reflection parent, its Celestial bodies category, the matter-consumption master and at least one enabled ingestion body (Moon dust or Earth matter). Uses the finished per-body direction maps (each gated by its own line-of-sight) and the water surface's real reflected ray. Off by default.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_stream_densitydefault 1.0 / range 0.10..2 / step 0.05How many matter streams are submitted per body, as a fraction of the quality budget. Appearance control only; it does not change the body or Black-Hole geometry.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_stream_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0.10..4 / step 0.05Matter travel speed toward the black hole. Appearance/animation control only; anchors stay put when the camera moves.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_stream_turbulencedefault 1.0 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Stable curl and breakup of the matter streams. Deterministic; it does not teleport anchors.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_stream_widthdefault 1.0 / range 0.25..3 / step 0.05Particle/grain width for all consumed matter. Appearance control only.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_sun0=off (default) / 1=onSun plasma master. Sheds luminous plasma from the Sun into the black hole — curled hot white-yellow filaments, compact very bright knots and soft translucent orange coronal wisps, each with its own shape, size, opacity and motion, blooming in darkness. Needs the matter-consumption master and the celestial parent on, plus a visible Sun and Black Hole. Off by default; absent/off Sun is a safe no-op.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consume_sun_strengthdefault 1.0 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Sun contribution to consumption strength. Scales the Sun plasma independently of the global intensity and of the Moon and Earth.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption0=off (default) / 1=onMatter-consumption master switch. Off by default; while off it does zero simulation, draw, shader and allocation work. Enabling it alone draws nothing: the celestial parent and at least one body master (Moon dust or Earth matter) must also be on, and the Black Hole itself must be present.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio0=off (default) / 1=onBlack Hole presence audio master. Two beds: a deep gravitational bed whose weight follows the hole's APPARENT angular size (not a fabricated world distance), and a shear/tearing layer placed as a real positional sound toward the hole, so it moves across the stereo field with azimuth and elevation as you turn. The deep bed stays non-directional on purpose - sub-bass is not localizable and its weight must not drop when you look away. Off by default; requires AVFX audio and a visible Black Hole. It is independent of the optional matter-consumption master; only capture, shear and fracture event sounds require that master. Missing WAVs are a silent no-op.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio_events0=off (default) / 1=onBounded Black Hole events: per-object capture in-draw, celestial matter shear, and three positional rock-fracture variants emitted at the actual Surface Lift detachment point. Large surface breaks aggregate through a cooldown; dust never starts a sound and the channel pool cannot be exhausted. Off by default.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio_events_volumedefault 0.80 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Volume of the Black Hole event sounds (the per-object in-draw and the celestial shear), applied before the global AVFX gain and independent of the presence-bed volume, so the events can be balanced against the bed. Each captured object gets its own in-draw voice that starts when it latches and travels with it, so simultaneous captures overlap instead of cutting each other off; the voice pool is small and fixed, which bounds a burst without exhausting sound channels.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio_focusdefault 0.30 / range 0..1 / step 0.05How strongly looking at the hole lifts the shear layer. The Black Hole remains audible behind the camera: view direction shapes the mix but can never mute it. 0 = view direction is ignored entirely.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio_volumedefault 0.70 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Black Hole presence volume, applied before the global AVFX gain. The final level is cl_avfx_audio_volume x this x the smoothed presence x the layer mix, clamped once.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_intensitydefault 1.0 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Overall consumption strength multiplier. Strength also scales continuously with the APPARENT angular size of the bodies and their angular gap — not with fake world meters — so closer/larger bodies pull harder.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_quality0=Low / 1=Balanced / 2=High (default) / 3=UltraConsumption quality: it changes the matter stream/grain BUDGETS only (Low 8 / Balanced 16 / High 24 / Ultra 40 streams per body). It never changes geometry, strength, colour or speed. All variants are real-draw prewarmed, so changing it never compiles at draw time.
cl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_reachdefault 1.0 / range 0.25..3 / step 0.05Angular interaction reach: how large the body/Black-Hole angular gap can be and still produce matter. Larger values let the effect persist when the bodies are farther apart on the sky.
cl_avfx_blackhole_debugdefault 0 (off) / bit flags (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only black-hole diagnostics: visualization flags (patch bounds, lens vectors, depth layers) AND the field readback probes that cl_avfx_info reports (disk aspect/r95/edge, probe object identity). The probes stall the frame on a GPU readback, so they are OFF unless you set this — leave it at 0 unless you are diagnosing. Not archived, not preset-owned, absent from the normal menus.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk0=off / 1=on (default)Accretion-disk master. Both the direct disk and its gravitationally lensed far-side image around the shadow are shown.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0..8 / step 0.05Disk emission in linear HDR, before the normal output transform.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_densitydefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Density / coverage of the disk material.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_detaildefault 1.0 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Detail AMPLITUDE of the turbulence. It is not a loop count and does not change the render cost: the octave budget is selected by the quality setting.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_inner_radiusdefault 1.25 / range 1.01..8 shadow radii / step 0.01Inner radius of the accretion disk, in shadow radii.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_noise_scaledefault 1.0 / range 0.05..10 / step 0.05Scale of the procedural noise pattern in the disk.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_opacitydefault 0.95 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Opacity of the disk material.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_outer_radiusdefault 5.0 / range 1.1..16 shadow radii / step 0.1Outer radius of the accretion disk, in shadow radii. If an archived value ends up at or below the inner radius the runtime corrects it effectively without rewriting your cfg text.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_pitchdefault 68 / range -90..90 deg / step 1Accretion-disk orientation: tilt in degrees. 0 is face-on; the default 68 gives the classic inclined view where the lensed far side of the disk arcs over the shadow.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_radial_falloffdefault 1.4 / range 0.1..6 / step 0.05Fade curve toward the outer edge of the disk. Higher values fade earlier.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_rolldefault 0 / range -180..180 deg / step 1Accretion-disk orientation: lean about the viewing axis, in degrees — which way the disk tips.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_rotation_speeddefault 0.35 / range -4..4 / step 0.05Signed orbital speed of the disk. Negative rotates the opposite way.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_speed_variationdefault 0.25 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Stable radial spread of the orbital speed: inner material orbits faster, like a real Keplerian disk. The spread is a stable function of radius, never random per frame.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_thicknessdefault 0.22 / range 0.01..2 / step 0.01Vertical thickness of the accretion disk.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_turbulencedefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Amount of procedural flow distortion in the disk.
cl_avfx_blackhole_disk_yawdefault 0 / range -180..180 deg / step 1Accretion-disk orientation: spin within the disk's own plane, in degrees — it sets where the flow strands start, not which way the disk faces. Orientation is world/sky-owned, so camera motion cannot change it.
cl_avfx_blackhole_doppler0=off / 1=on (default)Relativistic-style directional beaming: at inclined views the side of the disk approaching the observer brightens and the receding side dims. An artistic control, not a physical solver.
cl_avfx_blackhole_doppler_strengthdefault 0.65 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Contrast of the directional beaming.
cl_avfx_blackhole_drift_azimuth_speeddefault 0.10 / range -10..10 deg/s / step 0.01Auto-drift mode only: horizontal drift speed in degrees per second. Negative drifts the opposite way.
cl_avfx_blackhole_drift_elevation_amplitudedefault 8.0 / range 0..45 deg / step 0.5Auto-drift mode only: amplitude of the vertical oscillation in degrees. 0 keeps the elevation fixed.
cl_avfx_blackhole_drift_elevation_speeddefault 0.05 / range 0..4 Hz / step 0.01Auto-drift mode only: speed of the vertical oscillation in Hz.
cl_avfx_blackhole_elevationdefault 35 / range -90..90 / step 1Initial / manual elevation above the horizon in degrees. In auto-drift mode this stays the archived starting point and is never rewritten by the drift.
cl_avfx_blackhole_emissive_peakdefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Multiplier applied on top of the global gl_hdr_celestial_peak_scale for black-hole emission. It does not replace the global control.
cl_avfx_blackhole_godrays0=off (default) / 1=onOptional god rays radiating from the black hole itself, sourced from its own emission. Default OFF. It is an emission source only: the event horizon never cuts the sun's accepted radial god-ray field.
cl_avfx_blackhole_godrays_strengthdefault 0.50 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Scale of the black-hole god-ray source.
cl_avfx_blackhole_inner_color_bdefault 0.78 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Blue channel of the hot inner accretion disk. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_inner_color_gdefault 0.95 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Green channel of the hot inner accretion disk. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_inner_color_rdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Red channel of the hot inner accretion disk. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0..8 / step 0.05Jet emission in linear HDR, before the normal output transform.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_color_bdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Blue channel of the polar jets. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_color_gdefault 0.62 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Green channel of the polar jets. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_color_rdefault 0.32 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Red channel of the polar jets. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_densitydefault 0.70 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Optical density of the jet column: how solid the plasma reads before it fades out along its length. Low values give a thin transparent streak, high values a dense opaque beam. Brightness is a separate control.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_lengthdefault 5.0 / range 0.5..20 shadow radii / step 0.1Jet length, in shadow radii.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_pulsedefault 0.15 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Amount of jet pulsation along its length.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Speed at which the jet's turbulence pattern travels along the axis, i.e. how fast the plasma appears to stream outward. 0 freezes the pattern into a static beam.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_turbulencedefault 0.35 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Turbulence of the jet shape.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jet_widthdefault 0.16 / range 0.02..2 / step 0.01Jet width / opening angle.
cl_avfx_blackhole_jets0=off (default) / 1=onOptional polar jets along the disk axis. Default OFF. Jets obey the same foreground-body and cloud cover as the rest of the object and create no dynamic lights or gameplay effects.
cl_avfx_blackhole_lens_falloffdefault 1.5 / range 0.25..4 / step 0.05Radial falloff curve of the lens influence. Higher values concentrate the bend near the shadow.
cl_avfx_blackhole_lens_radiusdefault 3.5 / range 1..12 shadow radii / step 0.1Radius of the lens field, measured in shadow radii. Beyond it the bend converges to zero, so the patch cannot show a warp discontinuity at its edge.
cl_avfx_blackhole_lens_strengthdefault 1.0 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Strength of the background ray bend. Higher values widen the Einstein-ring-style warp around the shadow.
cl_avfx_blackhole_lensing0=off / 1=on (default)Gravitational lensing of the deep background. Only stars, the Milky Way, constellations, distant planets and the astronomical sky texture are bent. Sun/Earth/Moon, meteors, comets and sky ships are nearer and are never lensed.
cl_avfx_blackhole_outer_color_bdefault 0.04 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Blue channel of the cooler outer accretion disk. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_outer_color_gdefault 0.26 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Green channel of the cooler outer accretion disk. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_outer_color_rdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Red channel of the cooler outer accretion disk. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_photon_color_bdefault 0.55 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Blue channel of the photon ring. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_photon_color_gdefault 0.82 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Green channel of the photon ring. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_photon_color_rdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Red channel of the photon ring. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_photon_ring0=off / 1=on (default)Thin bright photon ring at the edge of the shadow, formed by strongly distorted disk images. It is emissive and participates in the configured HDR peak and bloom.
cl_avfx_blackhole_photon_ring_brightnessdefault 1.8 / range 0..8 / step 0.05Photon-ring emission in linear HDR, before the normal output transform.
cl_avfx_blackhole_photon_ring_radiusdefault 1.12 / range 1.0..2.5 shadow radii / step 0.01Photon-ring radius, measured in shadow radii. The default 1.12 places it just outside the shadow edge.
cl_avfx_blackhole_photon_ring_widthdefault 0.035 / range 0.005..0.25 / step 0.005Thickness of the photon ring: the half-width of its glow band, in the same shadow-radius units as the ring radius. Narrow values give a sharp thread of light at the shadow edge, wide values a soft halo.
cl_avfx_blackhole_position_mode0=manual (default) / 1=star sphere / 2=auto driftPosition policy. Manual keeps the archived azimuth/elevation fixed in the sky. Star sphere applies the same celestial-sphere orientation transform the stars use, and works even when the stars master is off. Auto drift adds a realtime offset on top of the archived azimuth/elevation without ever rewriting them.
cl_avfx_blackhole_precession_speeddefault 0 / range -10..10 deg/s / step 0.01Optional precession of the disk orientation in degrees per second. It is a runtime layer only: the yaw/pitch/roll cvars keep their archived values. 0 disables precession.
cl_avfx_blackhole_quality0=Low / 1=Balanced / 2=High (default) / 3=UltraFixed render-quality variant. It selects a compile-time bounded field resolution, integration-step budget and noise-octave budget: Low 192x192 analytic (no march), Balanced 320x320 / 24 steps, High 512x512 / 40 steps, Ultra 768x768 / 64 steps. Changing it never compiles a shader at draw time (all four variants are prewarmed) and never changes the object's size, thickness or average brightness. High is the recommended default; Ultra is expensive.
cl_avfx_blackhole_render_scale0=Auto (default) / 1=0.50x / 2=0.75x / 3=1.00xAdvanced override of the field texture resolution selected by the quality setting. It scales the internal field only and never changes the object's physical or angular geometry.
cl_avfx_blackhole_seeddefault 137 / range 0..9999 integerStable procedural seed for the turbulence and flow structure. Changing it reshapes the pattern; it never changes size, brightness or geometry, and it never reseeds per frame.
cl_avfx_blackhole_shadow_color_bdefault 0.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Blue channel of the event-horizon shadow tint. The default 0.00/0.00/0.00 is a pure black shadow. The shadow emits nothing: tinting it adds no bloom and no god-ray energy. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_shadow_color_gdefault 0.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Green channel of the event-horizon shadow tint. The default 0.00/0.00/0.00 is a pure black shadow. The shadow emits nothing: tinting it adds no bloom and no god-ray energy. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_shadow_color_rdefault 0.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Red channel of the event-horizon shadow tint. The default 0.00/0.00/0.00 is a pure black shadow. The shadow emits nothing: tinting it adds no bloom and no god-ray energy. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_shadow_radiusdefault 1.0 / range 0.25..3 / step 0.05Radius of the central event-horizon shadow, in shadow radii. The shadow blocks the deep background behind it; it emits nothing, so it produces no bloom, no god-ray energy and no scene light.
cl_avfx_blackhole_shadow_softnessdefault 0.02 / range 0..0.20 / step 0.005Analytic softness of the shadow limb. It is edge antialiasing only: it does not change the shadow's physical size and does not add a halo.
cl_avfx_blackhole_sizedefault 8.0 / engine range 0.1..3000.0 / menu 0.1..100.0 step 0.1Angular size multiplier of the event-horizon shadow. The menu slider goes to 100.0, while console/cfg still accept the engine range up to 3000.0 for an extreme cinematic hole. Zoom and FOV change only the projected pixel size, never the angular size.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_color_bdefault 0.12 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Blue channel of the particle / flow strands. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_color_gdefault 0.45 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Green channel of the particle / flow strands. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_color_rdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.01Red channel of the particle / flow strands. 1.00 is shader identity. Authored in linear HDR before the normal output transform, so SDR and HDR show the same colour.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_contrastdefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Contrast between the strands and the surrounding disk material.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_densitydefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Visible strand density.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_lengthdefault 0.85 / range 0.05..2 / step 0.01Tangential elongation of the strands.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0..4 / step 0.05Stream animation speed.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_speed_variationdefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Stable spread of the stream speeds across the disk radius. Deterministic, never random per frame.
cl_avfx_blackhole_stream_widthdefault 0.12 / range 0.01..1 / step 0.01Thickness of the accretion strands that spiral into the hole. Thin strands read as separate threads, thick ones merge into a continuous sheet of infalling matter.
cl_avfx_blackhole_streams0=off / 1=on (default)Visible flow strands inside the accretion disk. They are a procedural GPU density structure, not game particles: they create no dynamic lights and have no gameplay effect.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_clumps0=off (default) / 1=onLift small soil clumps that break up after they tear loose. Needs the surface-matter master. Off by default.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_densitydefault 1.0 / range 0.10..2 / step 0.05How much matter is torn loose. Appearance/rate control only; bounded by the shared hard pool.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_dust0=off (default) / 1=onLift dust and soil grains: many separate specks and loose puffs, not one ribbon. Needs the surface-matter master. Off by default.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_lift0=off (default) / 1=onSurface-matter master for tearing matter off the game level. When the Black Hole is huge and nearly overhead and open sky is visible, it lifts dust/soil, clumps and rocks from valid open world surfaces, carries them up and away toward the hole, where they shrink to a point and vanish. Off by default; while off there is zero source scan, spawn, upload or draw. Needs global AVFX, the matter-consumption master and a present Black Hole; the celestial-matter parent is not required.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_min_core_degreesdefault 6.0 / range 1..40 / step 0.5 / degreesMinimum apparent core size, in degrees, before the hole is big enough to tear surface matter loose. Below it there is no source at all.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_overhead_conedefault 35 / range 5..89 / step 1 / degreesHow far from straight overhead (world up) the Black Hole may be and still lift matter, in degrees. A side or horizon hole lifts nothing.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_rock_sizedefault 1.0 / range 0.25..3 / step 0.05Rock fragment size multiplier. Appearance only.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_rocks0=off (default) / 1=onLift rare tumbling rock fragments of varied size. No collision or damage; they are visual only. Needs the surface-matter master. Off by default.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0.25..4 / step 0.05Travel speed of the lifted matter toward the hole. The duration is bounded (12..120 s inherited from the accepted long-distance capture), so a moving hole can never make a grain immortal.
cl_avfx_blackhole_surface_turbulencedefault 1.0 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Stable curl and scatter of the lifted stream, so it reads as many separate grains and fragments rather than straight strings.
cl_avfx_blackhole_temporal_stability0=off / 1=on (default)Stable history / reprojection between frames. Reduces shimmer on a stationary camera.
cl_avfx_comet_brightnessdefault 2.65 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Comet coma and tails brightness multiplier. 2.65 (default) bright cinematic; 1.0 = baseline; up to 5.0 cinematic-bright.
cl_avfx_comet_cloud_occlusiondefault 0.30 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Cloud occlusion strength for comets and their tails. 0.30 (default) — light dimming behind cloud cells; 0 = comets ignore clouds; 1 = fully hidden.
cl_avfx_comet_color_bdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..1.00 / menu step 0.02Blue channel of the manual AVFX comet base tint. Used for newly spawned comets only when cl_avfx_comet_color_custom is 1. Stock reference 1.00.
cl_avfx_comet_color_customdefault 0 / 0=stock palette / 1=custom RGBUse cl_avfx_comet_color_r/g/b as the base tint for newly spawned AVFX comets: nucleus, coma and both components of the continuous tail. Their relative brightness, opacity and profiles remain intact. Existing comets retain their spawn colours. 0 (default) preserves the stock comet palette exactly. Full Chaos sets this to 1 when comets are selected; Reasonable leaves it unchanged. This does not enable the effect; cl_avfx_comets remains its enable toggle.
cl_avfx_comet_color_gdefault 0.85 / range 0.00..1.00 / menu step 0.02Green channel of the manual AVFX comet base tint. Used for newly spawned comets only when cl_avfx_comet_color_custom is 1. Stock reference 0.85.
cl_avfx_comet_color_rdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00 / menu step 0.02Red channel of the manual AVFX comet base tint. Used for newly spawned comets only when cl_avfx_comet_color_custom is 1. Stock reference 0.45.
cl_avfx_comet_color_variationdefault 0.00 / range 0.00..1.00 / menu step 0.02Seeded colour variation between individual newly spawned AVFX comets when custom colour is enabled. 0 (default) uses the exact base RGB; 1 gives the strongest deterministic vivid variation while retaining influence from that RGB. Full Chaos sets it to 1 when comets are selected. Existing comets are not recoloured mid-flight.
cl_avfx_comet_dust_taildefault 1 / 0 or 1Render the smooth wispy body of the single continuous comet streak. The glowing nucleus/coma remains even when this component is off. Custom RGB recolours it together with the rest of the comet. Default ON.
cl_avfx_comet_force_bloomdefault 1 / 0 or 1Forced bloom for the comet coma. Works even when gl_bloom=0. Comet-pixel-only — does NOT enable whole-scene bloom.
cl_avfx_comet_ion_taildefault 1 / 0 or 1Render the energetic sparks and filaments inside the single continuous comet streak. The glowing nucleus/coma remains even when this component is off. Custom RGB recolours it together with the rest of the comet. Default ON.
cl_avfx_comet_ratedefault 2.0 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Average comet spawn rate in events per minute. 2.0 (default) = one every 30 seconds — cinematic comet show. 0.03 = realistic naked-eye rarity (~one every 30 minutes). Each comet lingers 30 s..10 min depending on the speed cvar.
cl_avfx_comet_sizedefault 1.75 / range 0.1..5.0 / step 0.05Comet coma angular size. 1.75 (default); 1.0 = baseline; 0.5 = compact bright spot; 3.0 = large diffuse glow.
cl_avfx_comet_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0.05..5.0 / step 0.05Comet angular speed across the sky. 1.0 (default) ≈ 2 min visible arc; 0.5 = 4 min slow drift; 2.0 = 1 min fast pass.
cl_avfx_comet_tail_lengthdefault 3.0 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Length multiplier for the single continuous comet streak; scales its smooth body and energetic detail together. 3.0 (default) cinematic; 1.0 = baseline ≈ 10–13 degrees of arc; up to 5.0 for spectacular comet shows.
cl_avfx_comet_tail_widthdefault 2.35 / range 0.1..5.0 / step 0.05Width multiplier for the single continuous comet streak; scales its smooth body and energetic detail together. 2.35 (default) cinematic broad; 1.0 = baseline.
cl_avfx_cometsdefault 0 / 0 or 1Master toggle for AVFX celestial comets. Slow, rare, non-impact sky bodies with a glowing nucleus/coma and one continuous anti-sun streak composed of independently switchable smooth and energetic components. Independent of stars and weather preset. Default OFF (opt-in).
cl_avfx_competitive_limit0=no clamp / 1=clamp during multiplayer (default)When cl.maxclients > 1 and demo_visual is not active, clamps effective alpha (≤0.30), density (≤0.50), rain beams (≤64) and particles (≤96) so atmospheric effects can't compromise target visibility in real matches. Demo playback ignores this clamp.
cl_avfx_constellation_alphadefault 0.05 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Constellation line alpha. 0.05 (default) gives a very subtle guide — barely visible at night, never overpowers the actual stars. 0 hides them entirely; 1.0 paints them at full strength. Multiplied by the same day/moon/cloud fade as the stars so lines disappear during day or under thick clouds.
cl_avfx_constellation_linesdefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the constellation line overlay. Draws subtle blue-white lines connecting the named anchor stars of Big Dipper / Orion / Cassiopeia / Cygnus / Lyra / Aquila. Rendered via sky-shader angular-distance check, NOT world-space RF_BEAM — lines live on the celestial sphere with the stars. Visible only when cl_avfx_stars 1. Default ON.
cl_avfx_constellations_realdefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the real Hipparcos-ID-resolved constellation line overlay (674-segment Stellarium Western skyculture data joined through HIP IDs into unit-vector endpoints). ON (default) replaces the classic 27-segment hand-curated table with real Stellarium lines. Visible only when cl_avfx_stars 1.
cl_avfx_constellations_real_alphadefault 0.15 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Real constellation line alpha. 0.15 (default) — subtle blue-white guide; 0 = invisible; 1.0 = full strength. Multiplied by the same day/moon/cloud fade as stars so lines disappear during daylight or under dense clouds.
cl_avfx_constellations_real_countdefault 256 / range 13..674 / step 16Active real constellation segment count cap. Only applies when cl_avfx_constellations_real_mode 2 (all Western); in mode 1 (major) the count is fixed to the leading 158 segments. Default 256 covers major + some additional. Max 674 (all uploaded segments).
cl_avfx_constellations_real_modedefault 2 / 0 classic / 1 major / 2 allReal-lines mode selector. 0 — classic fallback: hand-curated 27-segment table (6 named groups). 1 — major constellations only (13: Orion / Ursa Major / Ursa Minor / Cassiopeia / Cygnus / Lyra / Scorpius / Sagittarius / Leo / Gemini / Taurus / Pegasus / Andromeda, 158 segments). 2 (default) — all 88 Western constellations up to cl_avfx_constellations_real_count cap.
cl_avfx_contact0=off / 1=on (default)Master switch for the whole Player Contact layer: blood on living opponents, sprays and fountains, stains and pools on the world, corpse leakage, BFG vaporization and weapon-specific impact marks. It is a child of the AVFX master, so cl_avfx 0 switches everything here off as well. Off means exactly zero work: no queueing, no attribution, no traces, no ticks, no particles, no marks and no shader submits.
cl_avfx_contact_blood0=off / 1=on (default)Family switch for every blood visual: model wounds, airborne spray, world stains, water response and corpse pools. Off keeps the stock Quake II blood; it does not hide flesh hits.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_alpha0.00..1.00 / 0.92 defaultBase opacity of every blood visual before age and lighting are applied.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_amount0.00..3.00 / 1.00 defaultGlobal multiplier on how much blood a contact produces. It scales the emission, not the size of a single droplet.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_b0.00..1.00Blue channel of the blood colour. The same colour is used for model wounds, airborne blood and world stains; lighting may darken it but never replaces it.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_corpse0=off / 1=on (default)Wound-fed leakage and a growing pool under a body, released only when death is actually proven. A disappearance on its own is never treated as a death, so no phantom pool appears.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_corpse_flow0.00..3.00 / 1.00 defaultHow fast the stored blood leaves a proven corpse and feeds its pool.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_corpse_lifetime0..600 seconds / 120 defaultHow long a corpse pool and its leak stay. 0 disables corpse pools entirely.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_drag0.10..3.00 / 1.00 defaultHow quickly airborne blood loses speed. Higher values make short, heavy spatter; lower values make long filaments.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_g0.00..1.00Green channel of the blood colour. The same colour is used for model wounds, airborne blood and world stains; lighting may darken it but never replaces it.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_gravity0.00..3.00 / 1.00 defaultHow strongly airborne blood falls. 0.00 leaves it floating along its initial direction.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model0=off / 1=on (default)Irregular wounds projected onto the opponent's model at the real hit point. They follow the animation instead of sliding, and expire on their own lifetime or when the model changes.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_lifetime0..600 seconds / 45 defaultHow long a wound stays on a living model. 0 disables model wounds entirely and purges the ones already there.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection0=off (default) / 1=onColoured local model reflections clipped to actual horizontal blood footprints. At least one category below must be enabled.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_actors0=off (default) / 1=onAllow players and monsters to reflect in blood pools.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_armor0=off (default) / 1=onAllow armor to reflect in blood pools.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_items0=off (default) / 1=onAllow items to reflect in blood pools.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_projectiles0=off (default) / 1=onAllow projectiles and rail beam to reflect in blood pools.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_quality0=Performance / 1=Medium / 2=Quality (default) / 3=Ultra / 4=ExtraControls receiver population and distance before model replay work.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_strength0.00..1.00 / 0.65 defaultOpacity of coloured model reflections in blood.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_weapons0=off (default) / 1=onAllow pickup weapons to reflect in blood pools.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_r0.00..1.00Red channel of the blood colour. The same colour is used for model wounds, airborne blood and world stains; lighting may darken it but never replaces it.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_reflection_distort0.00..1.00 / 0.00 defaultOptional moving-liquid distortion shared by blood SSR and model reflection.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_reflection_distort_speed0.00..5.00 / 1.00 defaultTravel speed of reflection ripples; 0 freezes their animation.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_scene_reflection0=off (default) / 1=onReal screen-space reflection in horizontal blood sheets. Blood owns one SSR layer on BSP and Surface Materials; on AVFX puddles or water it inherits the existing liquid reflection to prevent a duplicate pass.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_scene_reflection_quality0=Low / 1=Medium (default) / 2=High / 3=UltraSSR march precision. Higher values are crisper and cost more GPU time.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_scene_reflection_strength0.00..1.00 / 0.55 defaultStrength of the world/static SSR contribution in blood.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_size0.25..3.00 / 1.00 defaultScales droplets, wounds and stains together.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_spray0=off / 1=on (default)Ballistic blood in the air: droplets, filaments and mist thrown from the wound. Sustained fire builds a repeated fountain and it decays naturally after you release the trigger.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_spread0.10..3.00 / 1.00 defaultAngular width of the spray around the impact direction.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_surface0=off / 1=on (default)Splashes, stains and running drips on real floors and walls, clipped to the actual surface so nothing hangs over an edge or runs through a wall.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_surface_lifetime0..600 seconds / 90 defaultHow long a blood stain stays on the world. 0 disables persistent stains and purges the ones already there.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_sustained0.00..3.00 / 1.00 defaultHow much continuous fire on the same target builds the fountain. 0.00 makes every hit independent.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_velocity0.25..3.00 / 1.00 defaultInitial speed of the blood leaving the wound. Higher values throw it farther before gravity and drag take over.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_viscosity0.10..3.00 / 1.00 defaultHow thickly blood spreads and runs on a surface. Higher values keep it tight and slow; lower values let it spread wide and thin.
cl_avfx_contact_blood_water0=off / 1=on (default)Blood reaching real BSP water spreads as a short-lived dye film on the animated liquid surface; blood reaching an existing AVFX puddle stays inside its real boundary and ripples it.
cl_avfx_contact_debris0=off / 1=on (default)Physical chips and fragments thrown from the real impact surface. The amount and size remain weapon-specific below.
cl_avfx_contact_debris_amount0.00..3.00 / 1.00 defaultGlobal multiplier for every weapon's debris count.
cl_avfx_contact_debris_gravity0.00..3.00 / 1.00 defaultGravity multiplier for surface fragments.
cl_avfx_contact_debris_lifetime0.10..5.00 seconds / 1.20 defaultHow long airborne surface fragments remain visible.
cl_avfx_contact_debris_size0.25..3.00 / 1.00 defaultGlobal multiplier for fragment size, independent from count.
cl_avfx_contact_debug0=off (default) / 1=on for this session / 2=verbose / 3=+surface pass without depth test / 4=+pass tint: magenta=reflection lift, green=pigment, cyan=woundsSession-only Player Contact tracing. Costs exactly zero while off: no probe, counter, timer or print runs. Never written to any cfg or preset, so it is off again after a restart.
cl_avfx_contact_decal_alpha0.00..1.00 / 0.95 defaultBase opacity of every weapon impact mark.
cl_avfx_contact_decal_lifetime0..900 seconds / 120 defaultHow long a weapon impact mark stays. 0 disables persistent marks and purges the ones already there; the transient stock impact feedback is kept either way.
cl_avfx_contact_decal_roughness0.00..2.00 / 1.00 defaultHow strongly a mark takes on the surface it landed on. Higher values deepen the difference between a dry wall, wet stone and metal.
cl_avfx_contact_decal_size0.25..3.00 / 1.00 defaultGlobal multiplier on the size of every weapon impact mark.
cl_avfx_contact_decals0=off / 1=on (default)Weapon- and material-specific impact marks on world surfaces: punctures, pellet clusters, plasma char, rail grooves and blast soot. Each mark is clipped to the real surface and never crosses an edge or a wall.
cl_avfx_contact_distance256..8192 world units / 2048 defaultContacts farther than this from the camera are not submitted for drawing. Lower values keep a busy fight cheap without changing what actually happened.
cl_avfx_contact_lod0.25..2.00 / 1.00 defaultScales the AMOUNT of everything the layer emits, inside the hard caps. Below 1.00 it thins satellites, smoke lobes and collision probes first, and the immediate hit feedback last.
cl_avfx_contact_max_collision_probes0..512 / 192 defaultHow many representative droplet trajectories may be traced against the world each frame. Untraced droplets render as satellites of a traced one.
cl_avfx_contact_max_debris0..1024 / 512 defaultHard cap on airborne surface fragments across all weapon impacts.
cl_avfx_contact_max_decals0..1536 / 512 defaultHard cap on weapon impact marks present in the world.
cl_avfx_contact_max_droplets0..2048 / 768 defaultHard cap on visible blood droplets. The active quality tier may lower it further; it can never raise it.
cl_avfx_contact_max_model_marks0..256 / 96 defaultHard cap on animated wounds across every target at once.
cl_avfx_contact_max_surface_blood0..1024 / 384 defaultHard cap on blood stains, drips and pools present in the world.
cl_avfx_contact_max_targets1..64 / 32 defaultHow many opponents keep their own wound, burst and reservoir state at once. The least recently hit target is dropped first.
cl_avfx_contact_max_vapor0..512 / 128 defaultHard cap on vaporization residue, smoke and shimmer records.
cl_avfx_contact_profile0=off (default) / 1=on for this sessionSession-only Player Contact timing. Measures the simulation and submission cost of this layer. Costs exactly zero while off and is never written to any cfg or preset.
cl_avfx_contact_quality0=Low / 1=Basic / 2=High (default) / 3=ExtraDetail and per-frame budget of the contact layer. Each tier carries its own immutable ceilings on droplets, collision probes, model marks, world blood, impact marks and vapor; your own caps below can only lower them, never raise them.
cl_avfx_contact_vapor_heat_haze0=off / 1=on (default)Short-lived air distortion over a vaporized body. It is optional by backend capability: where the renderer cannot provide it, the rest of the vaporization is unchanged and nothing is substituted.
cl_avfx_contact_vapor_residue0.00..3.00 / 1.00 defaultHow much scorched residue a vaporizing hit leaves on the target and the nearest valid surface.
cl_avfx_contact_vapor_residue_lifetime0..600 seconds / 6 defaultHow long vaporization residue stays. 0 disables it.
cl_avfx_contact_vapor_smoke0.00..3.00 / 1.00 defaultHow many smoke lobes rise from a vaporized target.
cl_avfx_contact_vapor_smoke_height0.25..3.00 / 1.00 defaultHow high the smoke climbs above the body volume.
cl_avfx_contact_vapor_smoke_lifetime0..60 seconds / 2 defaultHow long each smoke lobe lives. 0 disables the smoke.
cl_avfx_contact_vaporize0=off / 1=on (default)Family switch for weapon-configured vaporization: a confident hit leaves scorched residue, layered smoke and heat. This is an additional visual family and never disables blood; each weapon's live and corpse blood coefficients decide that independently. The body-shaped vapor release needs proven death.
cl_avfx_contact_weapon_bfg_corpse_blood0.00..4.00 / 0 = no corpse pool for this weaponHow much blood a BFG10K kill stores for the corpse: the leak from the wounds and the pool that grows under the body once death is proven.
cl_avfx_contact_weapon_bfg_debris0.00..4.00 / 0 = no surface debrisAmount of physical surface fragments thrown by a BFG10K impact. 0 disables only debris for this weapon; the impact mark is independent.
cl_avfx_contact_weapon_bfg_debris_size0.25..4.00Size multiplier for surface fragments thrown by a BFG10K impact.
cl_avfx_contact_weapon_bfg_decal0.00..4.00 / 0 = no surface mark for this weaponSize and weight of the mark a BFG10K impact leaves on a wall, a floor or another world surface.
cl_avfx_contact_weapon_bfg_enable0=off / 1=on (default)Master switch for every Player Contact effect caused by the BFG10K. Off leaves the stock Quake II effect for that weapon untouched.
cl_avfx_contact_weapon_bfg_live_blood0.00..4.00 / 0 = no live blood for this weaponHow much blood a BFG10K hit puts on a LIVING opponent: the spray, the wound on the model and the stain it leaves on the world. 0 disables only the blood for this weapon.
cl_avfx_contact_weapon_bfg_vaporize0=off / 1=add vaporizationAdd vaporization for the BFG10K: scorched residue, layered smoke and heat alongside any blood configured for this weapon. Only the BFG uses vaporization by default.
