cl_avfx_coverage_update_hz5..120 Hz (default 30)How often the accelerated backend rebuilds the dirty regions of the snow coverage atlas, in rebuilds per second. Lower values spend less CPU on atlas maintenance at the cost of slower reaction to changes; the animated fill ramp in the shader keeps the result visually smooth between rebuilds. Forced rebuilds (cvar change, preset, map load, backend switch) bypass the cadence entirely. Accelerated backend only (cl_avfx_backend 1); the Classic backend ignores this cvar entirely.
cl_avfx_cpu_affinity0=leave placement to the OS / 1=pin workers to cores (default)Pin AVFX worker threads to specific CPU cores instead of leaving placement to the OS scheduler. Latched: the value is applied when the worker pool is created, so a change takes effect on the next pool re-initialisation (map change or restart), not immediately.
cl_avfx_cpu_ecores0=performance cores only / 1=efficiency cores allowed (default)Allow AVFX worker threads to be placed on efficiency cores on hybrid CPUs. Turning this off keeps AVFX work on performance cores only, which raises throughput per worker but leaves fewer cores for the rest of the client. Latched together with cl_avfx_cpu_affinity.
cl_avfx_cpu_workers-1=auto from core layout (default) / 0=no pool, inline / 1..N=explicit worker countSize of the AVFX background worker pool that runs particle, field and receiver jobs off the main thread. -1 lets Q2PRO-X pick a size from the detected core layout; 0 disables the pool and runs every AVFX job inline on the client thread, which is the slowest but most predictable setting. The pool is re-initialised on the next frame after the value changes, so it can be tuned live without a restart.
cl_avfx_demo0=disable during demos / 1=allow during demos (default)Allow AVFX during .dm2 / .mvd2 demo playback. When enabled, the cvars are saved to baseq2/q2pro-x/demo_visual/q2pro-x.demo.cfg and restored from there on next playback.
cl_avfx_density0.0..1.0 (default 0.35)Manual density slider for the active preset. Combined with cl_avfx_weather_level to compute effective density. Higher values use more of the per-quality budget; competitive limit caps the effective value at 0.50 in multiplayer.
cl_avfx_dust_color_b0..1 (menu step 0.02, default 0.68)Dust base color, blue channel. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the dust preset (cl_avfx_preset 4).
cl_avfx_dust_color_g0..1 (menu step 0.02, default 0.7)Dust base color, green channel. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the dust preset (cl_avfx_preset 4).
cl_avfx_dust_color_r0..1 (menu step 0.02, default 0.7)Dust base color, red channel. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the dust preset (cl_avfx_preset 4).
cl_avfx_dust_color_variation0..1 (menu step 0.05, default 0.25)Per-particle color spread around the dust base color. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the dust preset (cl_avfx_preset 4).
cl_avfx_dust_shapes0=Off / 1=On (default 1)Give dust varied speck/crumb/mote silhouettes instead of round dots. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the dust preset (cl_avfx_preset 4).
cl_avfx_dust_size_variation0..1 (menu step 0.05, default 0.6)How much dust particle size varies around the base size. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the dust preset (cl_avfx_preset 4).
cl_avfx_earth0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for the AVFX Earth disk in the sky. Independent from the sun and moon. Earth is rendered in the sky shader as a cloud-aware blue-marble planet with horizon fade and day/night phase shading, drawn alongside the Moon / Sun / Stars. Default OFF (opt-in). When master is 0, the disk is fully suppressed.
cl_avfx_earth_azimuthdefault 205 / range 0..359 / step 1 / degreesEarth azimuth in degrees (manual mode only). Same convention as sun: 0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west. Default 205 ~ south-southwest.
cl_avfx_earth_brightnessdefault 0.85 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Earth disk brightness multiplier. 0.85 (default) keeps the tuned Earth visible in dark AVFX scenes. Up to 5.0 for a cinematic super-bright Earth. 0 disables disk emission.
cl_avfx_earth_cloud_occlusiondefault 0.75 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Cloud occlusion strength on the Earth disk. 0 = Earth ignores clouds; 0.75 (default) = the sky's clouds pass in front of Earth according to the AVFX cloud field while preserving tuned visibility.
cl_avfx_earth_color_bdefault 1.00 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Earth color: blue channel. 1.00 (default). See cl_avfx_earth_color_r.
cl_avfx_earth_color_gdefault 1.00 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Earth color: green channel. 1.00 (default). See cl_avfx_earth_color_r.
cl_avfx_earth_color_rdefault 1.00 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Earth color: red channel. 1.00 (default = shader identity). Parallel to the sun and moon color controls. Tints the visible Earth disk and its local halo. 1.00/1.00/1.00 leaves the blue-marble texture unshifted.
cl_avfx_earth_dark_side_visibilitydefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.01Visibility of the Earth body on the unlit night side of the phase. Uses a smooth nonlinear curve: 1.0 (default) keeps the accepted dark disk and faint surface texture; 0.0 fully removes the unlit body, including its star mask. Low values grow gently instead of popping in.
cl_avfx_earth_edge_smooth_insetdefault 0.00 / range 0.00..0.30 / step 0.01 / applies liveOptional smoothing inset from the Earth limb, as a fraction of Earth radius. 0 (default) disables smoothing and keeps a sharp edge with crisp surface detail. Higher values create a wider clean soft band and can intentionally blur edge details.
cl_avfx_earth_elevationdefault 36 / range -90..90 / step 1 / degreesEarth elevation above horizon in degrees (manual mode only). Default 36 ~ moderately high in the sky. Near the horizon Earth fades out via the horizon envelope.
cl_avfx_earth_halo_alphadefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Earth local sky-shader halo opacity multiplier. 1.0 keeps the previous tuned halo visibility. 0 makes the halo fully transparent. This multiplies halo brightness and does not affect the Earth disk.
cl_avfx_earth_halo_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Earth local sky-shader halo brightness multiplier. 1.0 keeps the previous tuned halo intensity. 0 removes halo light. Values above 1.0 strengthen the glow.
cl_avfx_earth_halo_phase_shape0=legacy round halo / 1=phase-shaped halo (default)Mask the local Earth halo by the Earth phase shape. 1 (default) makes partial-phase halos follow the same curved day/night terminator as the visible Earth disk. 0 restores the legacy round halo.
cl_avfx_earth_halo_sizedefault 1.0 / range 0.0..4.0 / step 0.01Earth local sky-shader halo radius multiplier (atmosphere glow). 1.0 keeps the previous tuned halo around the Earth disk. 0 fully removes the local halo. Values above 1.0 broaden the glow without changing the Earth disk size.
cl_avfx_earth_hd_texture0=4K (default) / 1=8K / 2=16K / applies liveEarth surface texture resolution for the AVFX Earth disk. 0 (default) uses the 4K blue-marble texture; 1 switches the same spherical/equirectangular Earth mapping to 8K; 2 uses 16K. 16K needs a native (non-ANGLE) GL backend; unsupported levels fall back 16K->8K->4K. Applies live on a loaded map and preserves the current Earth orientation, phase, halo and clouds.
cl_avfx_earth_modedefault 0 (manual) / range 0..2 / 0=manual 1=opposite_sun 2=cycle/clockEarth position mode. 0 (default) = manual — use cl_avfx_earth_azimuth / cl_avfx_earth_elevation. 1 = opposite sun — Earth mirrors the sun's direction. 2 = cycle/clock — follow the sun's time mode but offset by 12 hours so Earth rises as the sun sets.
cl_avfx_earth_phasedefault 1.00 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Earth phase 0..1 (day/night terminator). 0 = night side facing you (lit part invisible; dark body visibility is controlled by cl_avfx_earth_dark_side_visibility); 0.5 = half lit; 1.0 (default) = fully lit day side of the disk. The sky shader lights a virtual Earth sphere, so partial phases use a curved terminator instead of a straight cut.
cl_avfx_earth_rotation_modedefault 0 (manual) / range 0..1 / 0=manual 1=realtime_autoEarth body rotation mode. 0 (default) = manual — fixed yaw/pitch/roll offsets from the sliders below. 1 = realtime auto — the yaw/pitch/roll speeds below are integrated over time (never writes the cvars). Default rotation is identity, so the accepted Earth look is unchanged.
cl_avfx_earth_rotation_pitchdefault 0 / range -180..180 / step 1 / degreesEarth pitch (poles up/down) in degrees. Lets you inspect the top/bottom of the disk. 0 (default) keeps the accepted orientation.
cl_avfx_earth_rotation_pitch_speeddefault 0.00 / range -10.0..10.0 / step 0.01 / deg/sEarth auto pitch speed in degrees per second (realtime auto mode). 0.00 (default) = no pitch drift; negative tilts the opposite direction.
cl_avfx_earth_rotation_rolldefault 0 / range -180..180 / step 1 / degreesEarth roll (disk rolls on screen) in degrees. 0 (default) keeps the accepted orientation.
cl_avfx_earth_rotation_roll_speeddefault 0.00 / range -10.0..10.0 / step 0.01 / deg/sEarth auto roll speed in degrees per second (realtime auto mode). 0.00 (default) = no roll drift; negative rolls the opposite direction.
cl_avfx_earth_rotation_yawdefault 0 / range -360..360 / step 1 / degreesEarth yaw (longitude spin) in degrees. Manual-mode fixed offset; also the starting angle in realtime auto. 0 (default) keeps the accepted orientation.
cl_avfx_earth_rotation_yaw_speeddefault 0.05 / range -10.0..10.0 / step 0.01 / deg/sEarth auto yaw speed in degrees per second (realtime auto mode). 0.05 (default) is a slow drift; negative spins the opposite direction; 0 freezes yaw.
cl_avfx_earth_sizedefault 1.95 / engine range 0.1..3000.0 / menu 0.1..100.0 step 0.15Earth disk angular size multiplier. 1.95 (default) gives a prominent in-game blue-marble; the menu slider goes up to 100.0, while console/cfg still accept the engine range up to 3000.0 for an extreme cinematic enlarged Earth.
cl_avfx_earth_sky_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.01How strongly Earth brightness lifts the surrounding sky. 1.0 (default) preserves the accepted look. 0.0 keeps the Earth disk bright but leaves the sky much darker, which is useful for a bright Earth + dark sky + visible stars. Does NOT change Earth disk brightness or the local Earth halo.
cl_avfx_earth_smooth1=smooth mip/aniso (default) / 0=sharp GL_LINEAR / applies liveSmooth the AVFX Earth disk texture with mipmap / trilinear / anisotropic filtering. 1 (default) keeps the Earth smooth with no shimmer while it rotates. 0 disables smoothing and samples the texture at plain GL_LINEAR (no mipmaps, no anisotropy), so a non-rotating Earth looks crisp and sharp. Applies live and does not reload the Earth texture.
cl_avfx_flashlight0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for the AVFX player flashlight. When ON, the active local view casts a directional cone light that brightens nearby BSP/entity surfaces (engine dlight) and AVFX celestial-aware materials (snow, water, puddles, instanced snowflakes, snow material stamps, secondary CPU emitters) within the configured range and cone. Combines with lightning local surface illumination via max() — the stronger local light wins; no over-saturation. Off by default (opt-in). Visual-only — no protocol/server/gameplay changes; in multiplayer the flashlight is local-render only. Works in deathmatch 0/1, coop and demo playback.
cl_avfx_flashlight_angledefault 79 / range 5..90 / step 1 / degFull cone angle in degrees. 79 (default) is the accepted tuned wide flashlight cone; lower values produce a tight spotlight; higher values up to 90 give a flood light. Acts together with softness to control how sharply the cone edge falls off.
cl_avfx_flashlight_battery0=off (default) / 1=onVisual battery simulation toggle. When OFF (default) the flashlight runs indefinitely. When ON, the intensity envelope drains over the configured cl_avfx_flashlight_battery_minutes and the final 20% dims toward zero so the player gets a visible warning. Re-enabling the flashlight after drain resets the timer. Visual only — no item pickup / no gameplay resource / no server state.
cl_avfx_flashlight_battery_minutesdefault 10 / range 1..60 / step 1 / minBattery life in minutes when cl_avfx_flashlight_battery is on. 10 (default) is a reasonable single-section duration. Lower for arcade tension; higher for chill ambience.
cl_avfx_flashlight_beamdefault 0 / reserved / v2RESERVED v2 — beam haze visuals are not implemented in this landing (Codex Q-FL4 binding answer 2026-05-24). When the visible volumetric / haze beam is added in a future landing it will be gated on this cvar; for now the cvar is exposed for preset/tuning completeness and has no visible effect.
cl_avfx_flashlight_color_bdefault 0.4 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Blue component of the flashlight tint. See cl_avfx_flashlight_color_r for usage. Lower B + higher R/G = warmer; higher B = cooler.
cl_avfx_flashlight_color_gdefault 0.45 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Green component of the flashlight tint. See cl_avfx_flashlight_color_r for usage.
cl_avfx_flashlight_color_rdefault 0.45 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Red component of the flashlight tint. 0.45 (default) with G=0.45 / B=0.40 is the accepted neutral-warm tuned color.
cl_avfx_flashlight_dlight0=off / 1=on (default)Sub-toggle for the engine dlight component of the flashlight. When ON (default) the engine adds a local dynamic light anchored slightly forward from the camera so nearby BSP/entity surfaces and lit-by-engine props receive direct illumination. When OFF, only the shader cone boost on AVFX celestial-aware materials runs — far AVFX snow/water still brightens, but ordinary walls do not.
cl_avfx_flashlight_flickerdefault 0.05 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Brightness flicker amount. 0.05 (default) = very subtle living light. 0 = perfectly stable beam. Up to 1.0 = strong horror-movie flicker driven by deterministic time-based noise (no per-client RNG differences). Cosmetic; intended for ambience scenes.
cl_avfx_flashlight_intensitydefault 1.5 / range 0..5 / step 0.05Flashlight final intensity envelope. 1.5 (default) is the PO-accepted tuned brightness for night AVFX scenes. 0.0 = off. Up to 5.0 widens the effective hotspot but the per-fragment boost is still clamped to 1.0 (no material overbright). Combined with surface alpha, battery and flicker envelopes.
cl_avfx_flashlight_rangedefault 960 / range 64..2048 / step 32 / wuMaximum range of the flashlight cone in world units. 960 (default) is the accepted tuned indoor/outdoor compromise. Lower values shrink to a close-range work-light; higher values up to 2048 wu cover open outdoor scenes. Engine dlight radius scales with this cvar so the near-surface bright pool also grows.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_biasdefault 0.009 / range 0..0.05 / step 0.001Depth compare bias. Subtracted from receiver depth before comparing against the stored caster depth (Codex Q-FLS8: lit when receiver_depth - bias <= stored_caster_depth). Too low → self-shadow acne. Too high → peter-panning. Default 0.009 is the accepted tuned value for current flashlight shadows. Constant bias for v1; slope-aware bias deferred.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_debugdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=map / 2=visibility / 3=projection (diagnostic, current session only)Flashlight shadow diagnostic mode. 0=off. 1 prints / reports shadow-map stats. 2 overlays red/green visibility so occluded and lit fragments are obvious. 3 shows projection diagnosis colors. Tuning / debugging only; keep 0 for normal play.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_focus_downdefault 4 / range 0..192 / step 4 / wuOptional downward aim offset for the shadow-map light only. 4 (default) is the accepted subtle floor-bias. 0 aims the shadow map at the same crosshair target as the visible cone. Higher values pull the shadow projection downward, which can help tune floor-cast silhouettes without changing the visible flashlight spot.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_itemsdefault 1 / 0=item shadows off / 1=item shadows on (default)Allow item / pickup model entities to cast flashlight shadows. When OFF, weapon pickups, ammo, health and armor packs in the flashlight cone do not contribute to the shadow map (other classes — monsters, players — still cast per their own toggles). Default ON.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_max_castersdefault 61 / range 0..64 / step 1Maximum number of entities that can cast a flashlight shadow per frame. Caster pool is bounded — the renderer collects all visible candidates inside the flashlight cone, sorts by priority (beam distance, viewer distance, bounding size, entity index tie-breaker), then truncates to this cap. Lower values = lower GPU cost; higher values = more entities can cast shadows simultaneously. Hard limit 64.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_monstersdefault 1 / 0=monster shadows off / 1=monster shadows on (default)Allow monster entities (NPCs) to cast flashlight shadows. When OFF, monsters in the flashlight cone do not contribute to the shadow map. Default ON — monster shadows are typically the most visually rewarding part of the feature.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_offset_forwarddefault -4 / range -64..64 / step 1 / wuForward/back offset of the flashlight shadow-map light source from the camera, in world units. Negative values put the shadow source slightly behind the eye, approximating a shoulder/weapon-mounted flashlight; positive values push it forward.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_offset_rightdefault 16 / range -64..64 / step 1 / wuHorizontal offset of the flashlight shadow-map light source from the camera, in world units. Positive values move the shadow source to the player's right while the visible flashlight cone still follows the crosshair. This separates the shadow caster light from the eye and helps produce readable silhouettes instead of eye-aligned flat shadows.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_offset_updefault 10 / range -64..64 / step 1 / wuVertical offset of the flashlight shadow-map light source from the camera, in world units. Positive values lift the shadow source above the eye, which usually gives more natural floor/wall silhouettes for weapon and item models.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_playersdefault 1 / 0=player shadows off / 1=player shadows on (default)Allow other player entities to cast flashlight shadows. When OFF, remote players (DM/coop) do not contribute to the shadow map even if inside the flashlight cone. The LOCAL player camera-space model (first-person view weapon) is always excluded — that's not the same as another player's third-person model. Default ON.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_qualitydefault 2 / 0..3 / Low/Medium/High/UltraShadow map quality / resolution tier. 0=Low 512×512 (cheapest, blocky edges). 1=Medium 1024×1024. 2=High 1536×1536 (default; accepted tuned quality). 3=Ultra 2048×2048. Backend caps the tier at GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE; on backends where 2048 FBO is incomplete the renderer falls back one step and reports the effective resolution in cl_avfx_info.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_softnessdefault 0.4 / range 0..1 / step 0.05PCF (Percentage Closer Filtering) kernel width scale, in shadow-map texels. 0.0 = hardest edges. 0.4 (default) = accepted soft but still readable edges. 1.0 = widest soft edges. Actual sample count follows cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_quality: Low=4 taps, Medium=9 taps, High/Ultra=16 taps. Cosmetic — does not change the shadow silhouette, only edge softness.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadow_strengthdefault 0.85 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Visibility scalar — controls how dark fully-occluded fragments get. 0.0 = shadows fully transparent (effectively disabled). 0.85 (default) = accepted strong but still readable shadows. 1.0 = maximum visibility — fully shadowed fragments lose the entire flashlight contribution. Never affects the base scene brightness; only the flashlight boost is multiplied by visibility.
cl_avfx_flashlight_shadowsdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for AVFX player flashlight dynamic GPU shadows. When ON, the renderer builds an RGBA8 packed-depth shadow map from the flashlight POV every frame and the common BSP world fragment shader samples it to darken the flashlight contribution on shadowed walls/floors/ceilings. Default ON as part of the accepted flashlight preset, but it has no cost or visible effect while the master cl_avfx_flashlight remains OFF by default. Shadows modulate ONLY the flashlight boost; the base scene brightness is never darkened.
cl_avfx_flashlight_softnessdefault 0 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Softness of the cone edge. 0 (default) = crisp tuned cone; higher values soften the edge, and 1.0 makes the whole cone smoothly fade from center to edge. Cosmetic — does not affect cone angle or range.
cl_avfx_flashlight_surface_alphadefault 0.22 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Surface light alpha / opacity for the flashlight contribution. Applied after cone shape, range falloff, battery and flicker are evaluated, so lowering it softens the final material blend without changing cone size or hotspot shape. Use this when the flashlight washes out nearby walls or models while cl_avfx_flashlight_intensity is already tuned for range.
cl_avfx_freeze_tracedefault 0 / 0=off, >0=trace (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: traces/holds an AVFX frame for inspection. 0=off. Not archived, no menu; zero cost at 0.
cl_avfx_global_disable0=respect per-mod AVFX settings (default) / 1=force AVFX effectively off in every modGlobal master override that forces the Q2PRO-X Advanced Visual Effects layer effectively off in every mod. Unlike the per-mod cl_avfx master (mod-local / demo_visual scope), this is a single global switch saved to the global Q2PRO-X config (baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg). 0 (default) leaves AVFX to each mod's local cl_avfx value and presets. 1 makes AVFX effectively off everywhere (emit, update, render, audio, sky/stars/celestial, water/snow/reflection) regardless of the local cl_avfx value. It never rewrites any local cl_avfx or preset value — set it back to 0 and each mod's existing AVFX settings return unchanged. Effective AVFX state = cl_avfx on AND this override off; cl_avfx_info reports raw cl_avfx, this override, and the resulting effective state.
cl_avfx_height128..2048 (default 512)Vertical height (in world units) of the camera-local weather volume. Effects spawn above and cycle through this column.
cl_avfx_lava_steam0=off / 1=visual contact steam on lava (default)Visual steam puffs when real rain/snow impact samples hit lava and soft surface-melt puffs where snow mass evaporates near lava edges. 1 (default) keeps steam contact-driven and capped so the screen is not flooded. Skipped while the camera is inside water/lava/slime. Requires cl_avfx_world 1 and the rain or snow AVFX preset. Sharp particle-contact audio is controlled by cl_avfx_audio_lava_steam; soft surface-melt audio is controlled by cl_avfx_audio_lava_surface_steam.
cl_avfx_lava_steam_alpha0..1 (menu step 0.05, default 1)Steam opacity (0 = invisible, 1 = normal); applies immediately to all puffs. --live. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_lava_steam 1.
cl_avfx_lava_steam_density0..2 (default 0.5)Spawn density multiplier for rain/snow contact steam on lava, 0..2. 0 disables spawning without clearing existing short-lived puffs; 0.5 is subtle default, 1.0+ is denser cinematic steam. Effective spawn rate also follows AVFX weather density.
cl_avfx_lava_steam_edge_radius0..96 wu (default 60)Small edge-catch radius for lava steam in world units, 0..96. When a real sky-exposed rain/snow impact lands near lava but the exact trace point misses the lava surface, nearby lava within this radius may still emit throttled steam/hiss. This preserves rim realism at sky holes without restoring autonomous lava scanning. 0 disables the edge catch.
cl_avfx_lava_steam_height8..256 wu (default 64)Maximum visual rise height for lava steam puffs in world units, 8..256. Higher values let puffs climb farther before fading.
cl_avfx_lava_steam_size0.1..2 (menu step 0.05, default 0.4)Steam puff diameter multiplier; applies to newly spawned puffs, not ones already floating. --live. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_lava_steam 1.
cl_avfx_lava_steam_speed8..160 wu/sec (default 40)Upward movement speed for lava steam puffs in world units per second, 8..160. Visual-only; does not affect gameplay or physics.
cl_avfx_lightning0=no flashes / 1=allow flashes (default)Allow visual lightning events when storm is enabled. The first safe implementation uses a brief bright dlight (~110 ms flash) near the view origin so combat visibility is not disturbed. Disable to keep storm audio behaviour without on-screen flashes.
cl_avfx_lightning_bloom0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for lightning bloom halo around the realistic bolt: broad halo / overexposed light mass. Implementation uses priority-banded additive halo layers (Codex Q2 Option B); inner layers are priority 3, outer layers priority 4 — outer layers skip first under RF_BEAM budget pressure. Halo intensity follows the bolt brightness envelope (rises with leader, peaks at peak_ratio, decays with the bolt) plus a continuous smoothstep afterglow tail when cl_avfx_lightning_bloom_afterglow > 0. With cl_avfx_lightning_bloom_force_post enabled, AVFX lightning halo can use its own post-bloom path (downsample/blur/composite) even when global gl_bloom is disabled — RF_AVFX_FORCE_BLOOM beam batches keep the bloom MRT attachment alive via the AVFX keep-alive signal. When this master is 0, the accepted core + cl_avfx_lightning_glow corona remain intact.
cl_avfx_lightning_bloom_afterglowdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00 / step 0.05Afterglow tail as a fraction of bolt duration. 0 = no tail (bloom dies with the bolt); 0.55 (default) ≈ 20% extra tail; up to 1.0 = a luminous afterimage of the same length as the bolt itself. The tail uses a smoothstep continuous envelope — no visual discontinuity at duration_ms (Codex Q7 continuous binding). During the tail the halo is capped at 40% of peak intensity so it reads as fading afterimage rather than a second flash. The slot stays alive for max(arc_tail_ms, duration_ms × bloom_afterglow) so halos can survive past the bolt.
cl_avfx_lightning_bloom_force_post0=off (legacy additive halo) / 1=on (default — true post-bloom when gl_bloom 0)Renderer-forced lightning bloom post-pass. When 1 (default) AND global gl_bloom is 0 AND lightning visual system is active, the bloom MRT attachment + downsample/blur/composite stay alive even though gl_bloom is off, and RF_AVFX_FORCE_BLOOM-flagged halo beam batches write into the MRT so AVFX lightning halo gets true post-process glow independent of global bloom. When gl_bloom is already 1 this is a no-op increment (existing global bloom path handles lightning halo as before; no double-bloom). When 0, behavior reverts to legacy additive halo only (the halo reads as bloom only with gl_bloom 1). Does NOT mutate gl_bloom; does NOT make non-AVFX-lightning geometry bloom; keep-alive is per cvar state (toggling cvar/preset triggers FBO rebuild) not per strike (no rebuild flicker between strikes).
cl_avfx_lightning_bloom_intensitydefault 5 / range 0.00..5.00 / step 0.05Bloom halo overall intensity multiplier. 0 disables the halo (master still on; useful to A/B with cl_avfx_lightning_bloom 0). 5 (default) baseline visible halo. Up to 5.0 for cinematic overexposed storms. Intensity is multiplied per layer by the layer falloff so outer layers stay subordinate to inner ones.
cl_avfx_lightning_bloom_layersdefault 4 / range 1..5 / step 1Number of additive halo layers around the bolt. 1 = single thin halo; 4 (default) = three concentric layers (good readable bloom mass); up to 5 for rich overexposed glow. Each additional layer increases visual richness but also RF_BEAM consumption against the per-frame budget (Q2PROX_LIGHTNING_BEAM_BUDGET = 256). Inner half of the layers are priority 3; outer half priority 4 — outer layers are skipped first under budget pressure to keep the bolt readable.
cl_avfx_lightning_bloom_radiusdefault 2.9 / range 0.25..4.00 / step 0.05Bloom halo radius / width multiplier. 0.25 = thin halo close to the bolt; 2.9 (default) baseline broad halo; up to 4.0 = wide overexposed mass that bleeds far from the bolt. The accepted glow corona (cl_avfx_lightning_glow) is unaffected — bloom layers sit OUTSIDE the glow corona. Halo width also scales with the bolt width envelope so leader-phase halos are narrower than peak-phase halos.
cl_avfx_lightning_branch_decaydefault 0.62 / range 0.35..0.85 / step 0.01Per-level decay of width, brightness, length, and fork count. Applied multiplicatively: at each child level the parent's parameters are multiplied by this value. 0.35 = rapid attenuation (deep levels barely visible); 0.62 (default) baseline; 0.85 = slow attenuation (deep levels nearly as bright as their parent). The same decay value gates the per-parent fork count formula via pow(decay, level-1), so deeper levels naturally produce fewer forks with no extra cvar.
cl_avfx_lightning_branch_densitydefault 1 / range 0.00..3.00 / step 0.05Branch arc density. The strike generator picks 0-2 branch arcs per strike randomly; this cvar scales how many of those generated branches are emitted as visible beams. 0 disables branches entirely. 1 (default) emits all generated branches. Higher values clamp to the generated count. Branches appear later in the leader phase (life >= leader_ratio) and fade faster than the main bolt during decay (Codex Q7).
cl_avfx_lightning_branch_forkingdefault 1 / range 0.00..3.00 / step 0.05Child fork amount multiplier for level 2+ branches. Codex Q5 separated semantics — this knob does NOT replace cl_avfx_lightning_branch_density (which still controls level-1 branch emission count). 0 disables child forks entirely (level-1 branches only, even if branch_levels >= 2). 1 (default) baseline tree; up to 3.0 = many child forks. Per-parent fork count = clamp(round(2.0 × forking × decay^(level-1)), 0, 5). Combined with high branch_levels values, this drives the visual richness of the multi-level tree.
cl_avfx_lightning_branch_levelsdefault 3 / range 0..4 / step 1Maximum branch hierarchy depth. 0 = trunk only, no branches at all (even if cl_avfx_lightning_branch_density > 0). 3 (default) = level-1 branches only (foundation primary branches controlled by branch_density; tree-from-trunk topology with per-branch width/brightness decay — close to reference lightning look). 2..4 = recursive child branches up to that depth. Deeper levels are short-lived and dimmer per cl_avfx_lightning_branch_decay. Child branches are generated stateless deterministic per-frame from (strike.seed, level, parent_idx, fork_idx) — no per-strike storage. Hard cap 64 branches per strike (Q2PROX_LIGHTNING_BRANCH_HARD_CAP). NOTE: setting this above 1 produces a busier visual that may not match the reference photo; PO smoke 2026-05-22 lowered the default to 1 for clean reference-matching look.
cl_avfx_lightning_branch_spreaddefault 1.95 / range 0.25..3.00 / step 0.05Lateral spread / length multiplier for child branches. Modulates how far each child travels away from its parent. 0.25 = tight tree near the trunk (child branches stay close to parent); 1.95 (default) baseline; up to 3.0 = wide far-reaching branches that extend significantly past the bolt's main visible reach. Combined with high branch_levels and branch_forking this creates dramatic stormy spread; at low values the tree stays compact and electric-arc-like.
cl_avfx_lightning_cloud_illum0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for AVFX lightning localized cloud illumination. When an active realistic lightning strike fires, the cloud layer near the bolt's sky-side anchor (s->verts[0][0]) brightens unevenly via a central glow blob + N-1 irregular satellite blobs. Positions seeded per-strike (constant across the strike's lifetime); only intensity changes over time. Implementation uses a dedicated AVFX_OVERLAY_CLOUD_ILLUM overlay kind (additive blend, no cull, no puddle/snow shader bits) — NOT a renderer sky-shader rewrite. Per-strike viewer visibility trace (cl.refdef.vieworg → anchor against MASK_SOLID) skips strikes occluded by ceiling/walls so closed rooms do not show cloud glow through solid geometry. Bloom MRT participation: when global gl_bloom is enabled OR AVFX force-post keep-alive holds the bloom attachment alive, cloud blobs write to the MRT and get post-process amplification (same condition the bolt halo + beam batches use). When master is 0 OR cl_avfx OR storm/lightning effective state is off OR cl_avfx_lightning_realistic is 0, cloud illumination is fully suppressed. Visual-only — never affects gameplay damage, scoring, or protocol.
cl_avfx_lightning_cloud_illum_afterglowdefault 1 / range 0.00..1.00 / step 0.05Cloud illumination afterglow tail as a fraction of bolt duration. 0 = no tail (glow dies with the bolt); 1 (default) ≈ 30% extra restrained tail; up to 1.0 = full bolt-length luminous afterimage on the cloud layer. The tail uses the bloom-factor smoothstep envelope scaled by this cvar — when 0 the tail is fully suppressed even if the bloom afterglow itself is non-zero. Default 0.3 is intentionally restrained so cloud glow does not linger too long.
cl_avfx_lightning_cloud_illum_blobsdefault 7 / range 1..9 / step 1Number of cloud illumination blobs per active strike. 1 = single central glow (clean simple look); 7 (default) = central + 4 irregular satellites (matches reference storm photos); up to 9 for rich uneven illumination. Bounded by per-frame Q2PROX_LIGHTNING_CLOUD_ILLUM_BUDGET = 48 blobs/frame; with 8 concurrent strikes × 9 blobs the budget caps at 48 — diagnostic skipped_budget counter shows when this triggers.
cl_avfx_lightning_cloud_illum_intensitydefault 5 / range 0.00..5.00 / step 0.05Cloud illumination overall intensity multiplier. 0 disables (master still on; useful to A/B with cl_avfx_lightning_cloud_illum 0). 5 (default) baseline visible glow. Up to 5.0 for cinematic overexposed storms. Intensity is multiplied per blob by its satellite-index alpha falloff so deeper satellites stay subordinate to the central blob.
cl_avfx_lightning_cloud_illum_radiusdefault 1.55 / range 0.25..4.00 / step 0.05Cloud illumination radius / blob size multiplier. 0.25 = compact glow tight near the bolt source; 1.55 (default) baseline visible cloud light; up to 4.0 = wide diffuse glow that bleeds across the sky. Affects both central blob diameter (320..420 wu base) and satellite blob diameters (120..260 wu base) and satellite XY offset distance (120..360 wu base). Larger radius = wider spread + larger individual blobs.
cl_avfx_lightning_duration0.1..10.0 (default 1.8)Bolt visible duration multiplier. 1.8 (default) keeps the baseline ~180 ms flash window; 10.0 holds the bolt on screen up to ~1.8 s; 0.1 collapses it to a quick ~30 ms flicker. The screen-flash envelope (fade-in / sustain / fade-out) scales proportionally so short bolts feel sharp and long bolts feel like sustained discharge.
cl_avfx_lightning_frequency0.1..100.0 (default 8.1; effective cadence floors at ~0.30 s)Lightning rate multiplier independent from cl_avfx_storm_density. 8.1 (default) keeps the baseline cadence; 0.1 stretches the mean interval ~10× (rare distant flickers). Higher values make storms denser, but the effective mean interval is FLOORED at ~0.30 s (~3.3 strikes/s) — values 4..100 all produce roughly the same maximum cadence at the floor. The 4..100 headroom is for combining with low storm_density / future tuning, not literal Nx baseline. Strikes that fail visibility / sky-cell checks reschedule on the same frequency-scaled retry curve.
cl_avfx_lightning_glowdefault 5 / range 0.00..5.00 / step 0.05Outer-glow intensity around the inner core. The glow is rendered as a wider blue/violet beam underneath the white core for an electric-corona look. 0 disables the glow pass entirely (saves ~half the per-strike RF_BEAM count). 5 (default) gives a strong visible halo. Higher values exaggerate the bloom contribution.
cl_avfx_lightning_impact_dlight0=no impact dlight / 1=impact dlight (default)Toggle for the warm dlight added at the lightning impact point. 1 (default) keeps the rocket-style warm orange dlight (auto-halved on SURF_WARP surfaces). 0 disables the impact dlight entirely — useful on maps where lots of bright impacts wash out water / glass / metal hue. Bolt geometry, per-vertex bolt dlights, explosion particles, smoke flash and screen flash are unaffected.
cl_avfx_lightning_impact_scale0..5 (default 5)Lightning impact size multiplier. 5 (default) reproduces the rocket-impact baseline (2 explosion bursts at the strike point + smoke flash + 600-intensity warm dlight). 5.0 maxes the strike out to 10 explosion bursts spread across a ~160-unit radius, multiple smoke flashes and a 3000-intensity dlight — the bolt feels like it tore a crater. 0 disables the impact effect entirely (bolt geometry + screen flash still fire normally). Reuses the existing rocket gameplay visuals (CL_ExplosionParticles + CL_SmokeAndFlash) so it always matches the engine's rocket explosion look. Strikes that land on SURF_WARP surfaces (water / lava / slime) automatically get a halved burst count and dlight intensity to avoid tinting nearby water.
cl_avfx_lightning_leader_ratiodefault 0.31 / range 0.05..0.60 / step 0.01Leader-phase fraction of total strike duration (cl_avfx_lightning_duration). Until life > leader_ratio the bolt is thin and dim, propagating top-to-bottom from the sky. Smaller values feel near-instantaneous; larger values stretch the visible descent. Clamped to 0.05..0.60. Must be less than cl_avfx_lightning_peak_ratio - 0.05; if not, the engine clamps internally.
cl_avfx_lightning_local_surface_falloffdefault 1 / range 0.25..4 / step 0.05Curve shape control for how the boost falls off with distance from the strike impact. 1 (default) gives a standard smoothstep falloff (soft hotspot ramp to zero at radius edge). Lower values (e.g. 0.5) widen / soften the hotspot so a larger area brightens uniformly. Higher values (e.g. 2.0) tighten the hotspot to a sharp contact glow that fades quickly with distance. Cosmetic tuning — does not affect strike timing or damage.
cl_avfx_lightning_local_surface_light0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for the local lightning surface illumination effect. When ON (default), areas around realistic AVFX lightning strikes brighten celestial-dimmed AVFX materials/effects (snow, water, puddles, rings, foam, runoff, dust, splashes) toward zenith daylight. Built on the accepted P1i realistic strike state (impact origin + brightness envelope) so the boost follows the bolt's natural rise/peak/decay. Spatial and bounded — far materials remain at their celestial night value, only the area within cl_avfx_lightning_local_surface_radius reacts. VISUAL-ONLY: does not change lightning damage / damage radius / monster wraps / breakable damage. Requires cl_avfx 1 + realistic lightning + active storm.
cl_avfx_lightning_local_surface_radiusdefault 800 / range 64..4096 / step 64Radius in world units around each lightning strike impact within which celestial-dimmed AVFX materials brighten toward daylight. 800 (default) roughly matches the accepted lightning damage-radius scale but is independent — this is purely visual. At the strike center the boost reaches 1.0 (max daylight); with distance from the impact the boost falls off smoothly back to the normal celestial night value.
cl_avfx_lightning_local_surface_strengthdefault 1 / range 0..2 / step 0.05How strongly the local lightning boost pushes celestial-dimmed materials toward maximum daylight. 1 (default) means a peak-brightness strike CENTER reaches the accepted daytime / zenith look on snow + water + secondary effects; the per-fragment boost is clamped to 1.0 so the strength cvar widens the effective hotspot but does NOT create material overbright. 0 = no boost (off equivalent via strength). Up to 2.0 = wider hotspot reaches max boost over a larger area.
cl_avfx_lightning_monster_arc_intensitydefault 2 / range 0.00..3.00 / step 0.05Brightness / dlight intensity multiplier for the monster wrap arcs. 2 (default); higher brightens both the arcs and the cool blue glow dlight. 0 disables visual emission even when the master is on.
cl_avfx_lightning_monster_arcs0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for monster electric wraps. When a monster is damaged by AVFX lightning (cl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage 1 + lightning hits in radius), the client renders short-lived electric arcs orbiting the monster's bbox center for 1.5..3.5 s + a cool blue-white dlight on the monster (glow). Visual-only — never adds damage, never alters scoring. Requires cl_avfx_lightning_realistic 1 and local SP / DM-training (game-side cue gated to local SP).
cl_avfx_lightning_monster_corpse_fx0=no corpse fx / 1=corpse fx (default)When a monster dies FROM lightning damage, emit a brief warm fire-flash dlight at the corpse + a small dim cool dlight fading over ~6 s as a 'scorch mark' cue. Visual only — never adds damage. Default on. Set to 0 to skip the corpse FX (wrap arcs during the hit still fire).
cl_avfx_lightning_peak_ratiodefault 0.8 / range 0.10..0.80 / step 0.01Peak-timing fraction of total strike duration. Bolt brightness/thickness reach maximum at this point; screen flash alpha peaks at the same moment (Codex binding). After peak, the bolt fades and thins until total lifetime expires. Clamped to 0.10..0.80 and to >= leader_ratio + 0.05.
cl_avfx_lightning_realistic0=legacy constant-brightness / 1=realistic envelope (default)Master toggle for the realistic lightning lifecycle: dim/thin leader from sky, brightness/thickness peak in sync with the screen flash, smooth fade-out. Default 1 (realistic on). Set to 0 to restore the old constant-brightness visual behavior for comparison; gameplay damage path (cl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage*) is unaffected. Total lifetime remains controlled by cl_avfx_lightning_duration. Per-strike envelope uses cl_avfx_lightning_leader_ratio + cl_avfx_lightning_peak_ratio. Performance is bounded by an internal RF_BEAM/frame cap (96 entities across all active lightning visuals).
cl_avfx_lightning_screen_flash0=tint off / 1=tint on (default)Toggle for the fullscreen blue-white tint that paints over the screen during a lightning strike. 0 (default) shows the tint when the player has open sky overhead AND the bolt is in line-of-sight; 0 keeps the bolt and impact effect but skips the tint entirely — useful for users who find the per-strike screen wash distracting. Bolt geometry, the per-vertex dlights along the bolt path and the rocket-style impact at the strike point are all unaffected.
cl_avfx_lightning_sky_flash0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for AVFX lightning broad sky flash / sheet lightning. Brightens the WHOLE visible sky during a lightning strike — sheet-lightning style — separate from cl_avfx_lightning_screen_flash (fullscreen camera tint) and from cl_avfx_lightning_cloud_illum (localized blobs at strike source). When cl_avfx_lightning_realistic 1, the flash scalar comes from the strongest active strike's brightness envelope (q2prox_strike_brightness during bolt lifetime + restrained bloom-factor tail scaled by cl_avfx_lightning_sky_flash_afterglow). When realistic 0, fallback uses the legacy 30/60 ms window driven by avfx_lightning_flash_ms / _peak. Sky-pixel only — applied inside GLS_AVFX_SKY shader path, so closed indoor rooms without visible sky do not receive the flash (no fullscreen rectangle over walls/items/weapons). When this master is 0, the scalar is 0 regardless of envelope source. Effective gate: master AND cl_avfx AND avfx_should_emit AND storm/lightning effective state.
cl_avfx_lightning_sky_flash_afterglowdefault 0.25 / range 0.00..1.00 / step 0.05Sky flash afterglow tail as a fraction of bolt duration. 0 = no tail (sky flash dies with the bolt); 0.25 (default) ≈ 25% extra restrained tail; up to 1.0 = bolt-length sky afterglow. The tail uses the bloom-factor smoothstep envelope scaled by this cvar — when 0 the tail is fully suppressed even if the bolt's bloom afterglow itself is non-zero. Default 0.25 is intentionally restrained so sky brightening does not linger long after the bolt fades; sky flash is meant to read as a momentary sheet-lightning pulse, not a slow sustained glow.
cl_avfx_lightning_sky_flash_coveragedefault 1.15 / range 0.25..4.00 / step 0.05Sky flash coverage / spatial spread. Controls how broadly the flash spreads across the sky dome (separate from intensity which controls brightness). 0.25 = tight bright zone clustered toward zenith (compact dramatic flash); 1.15 (default) baseline; up to 4.0 = wide flat brightening across the whole sky dome (uniform sheet of light). Internally maps to the shader's spread exponent pow(zen, 1/coverage). At low coverage the brightest zone is near the top of the sky; at high coverage even horizon-low pixels brighten significantly.
cl_avfx_lightning_sky_flash_intensitydefault 2 / range 0.00..5.00 / step 0.05Sky flash intensity multiplier — controls BRIGHTNESS of the broad sky flash. 0 disables the flash (master still on; useful to A/B with cl_avfx_lightning_sky_flash 0). 2 (default) baseline visible sheet-lightning brightening. Up to 5.0 for cinematic overexposed storm flashes. Final scalar is intensity × envelope, clamped to 1.0 — diagnostic cl_avfx_info shows clamped=N counter when the cap triggers under heavy lightning cadence.
cl_avfx_lightning_sky_flash_tintdefault 0.65 / range 0.00..1.00 / step 0.05Sky flash color tint — shifts the additive flash color from cool white-blue (0.0) toward violet-blue (1.0). 0.0 = (0.65, 0.72, 0.85) — neutral storm white with slight blue bias; 1.0 = (0.55, 0.45, 0.95) — cinematic violet-blue. 0.65 (default) is a gentle storm-blue bias. Affects only the sky flash's tint; does NOT affect cloud illumination or screen flash colors.
cl_avfx_lightning_surface_arc_densitydefault 1.65 / range 0.00..3.00 / step 0.05Arc count / branch density multiplier. Base is 5 arcs per strike at 1.0; the engine clamps the effective count to 1..8 arcs per strike so the per-frame RF_BEAM budget is not exhausted by a single very dense strike. 0 disables surface arcs entirely. Higher values up to 3.0 are clamped to the per-strike cap. Combined with the master toggle and arc_intensity.
cl_avfx_lightning_surface_arc_intensitydefault 2.6 / range 0.00..3.00 / step 0.05Arc brightness / alpha multiplier on top of the bolt brightness envelope. The final arc alpha is strike_brightness * intensity * 0.85. Default 1.0 gives baseline visibility; values up to 3.0 brighten arcs (clamped to RF_BEAM alpha 1.0); 0 disables arcs even when the master is on.
cl_avfx_lightning_surface_arc_radiusdefault 160 / range 16..256 / step 8 / wuMaximum crawl radius of surface arcs around the impact point, in world units. Arcs start at the impact and grow outward to this radius during the strike's leader/peak phase, then retract during decay. Default 96 wu is a comfortable room-corner spread. Lower values keep arcs tight around the strike; higher values spread them further across floors/walls/ceilings.
cl_avfx_lightning_surface_arc_widthdefault 0.35 / range 0.25..4.00 / step 0.05Arc width multiplier (per segment). 0.35 (default) baseline ~3 pixels equivalent; up to 4.0 thickens the arcs. Internally clamped to 1..12 pixels per segment. Combined with the bolt brightness envelope this determines how prominent the arcs read against the impacted surface.
cl_avfx_lightning_surface_arcs0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for decorative crawling electric arcs at the lightning impact point. When enabled, every committed AVFX strike with a real surface impact spawns short-lived electric arcs that radiate outward from the impact along the struck surface. Synchronized with the bolt brightness envelope (strongest at strike peak, fade with decay). Visual-only — never adds damage, never alters scoring, never triggers the P1h gameplay damage bridge. Requires cl_avfx_lightning_realistic 1; when realistic mode is off, surface arcs are also suppressed (legacy fallback).
cl_avfx_lightning_water_react0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for AVFX lightning water reactions. When lightning strikes real BSP water (CONTENTS_WATER), transparent water, or a visible AVFX puddle, spawn steam plumes, splash particles, and concentric rings at the impact point. Secondary smaller bursts also fire wherever the surface arcs crawl over wet samples. Visual / audio only — never adds gameplay damage. Off-surface (dry floor/wall) strikes are no-ops.
cl_avfx_lightning_water_react_amountdefault 2.7 / range 0.00..3.00 / step 0.05Overall intensity multiplier for the lightning water reaction effects. Default 1.0; 0 effectively disables emission even when the master is on. Values above 1.0 spawn more steam puffs, larger splash bursts, and brighter rings. Range 0..3.
cl_avfx_lightning_water_react_radiusdefault 152 / range 16..256 / step 1 / wuEffect radius in world units for the water rings (and visual spread). Default 96 = baseline; 16..256. Wet detection itself is point-based and delegated to the existing weapon-impact-on-water helper, so this knob controls how far rings spread on the visible surface, not the probe range. Note: real BSP-water rings inherit this size via avfx_spawn_ripple_burst_fx; puddle-ring scaling matches.
cl_avfx_lightning_water_rings0=off / 1=on (default)Sub-toggle for the water rings (ripples) effect within lightning water reactions. Default on. Real BSP water uses the avfx_spawn_ripple_burst_fx path (matches rain/weapon ripples); visible AVFX puddles use the shared puddle-ring overlay pool.
cl_avfx_lightning_water_splashes0=off / 1=on (default)Sub-toggle for the splash-particle effect within lightning water reactions. Default on. The splash particles are spawned via CL_ParticleEffect using the same water palette byte as weapon-impact splashes so they read consistently with the rest of AVFX water effects.
cl_avfx_lightning_water_steam0=off / 1=on (default)Sub-toggle for the steam / vapor plume effect within lightning water reactions. When master cl_avfx_lightning_water_react is on, this controls whether the steam family fires; the other water effects (splashes, rings) are independent. Default on.
cl_avfx_lightning_widthdefault 0.15 / range 0.01..1.50 / step 0.01Bolt width multiplier — single user knob controlling thickness of ALL lightning structures: trunk core, glow corona, L1 branches (with per-index taper), surface electric arcs, bloom halo layers. Default 0.15 gives a thin photo-realistic bolt (PO follow-up 2026-05-22 lowered from 1.0). Range 0.01..1.5 — minimum is a barely-visible filament; maximum is significantly thicker than baseline. Step 0.01 for fine tuning at the low end. Has no effect when cl_avfx_lightning_realistic 0.
cl_avfx_meteor_brightnessdefault 5.0 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Meteor head brightness multiplier. 5.0 (default) bright cinematic streaks; 1.0 = classic dim shooting star; 0 = invisible.
cl_avfx_meteor_burnup_chancedefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Probability that a meteor burns up before reaching the horizon (early extinction). 0 = every meteor crosses the full sky; 1.0 (default) = all extinguish before horizon.
cl_avfx_meteor_cloud_occlusiondefault 0.8 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Cloud occlusion strength. 0 = meteors ignore clouds; 0.8 (default) meteors dim significantly behind cloud cells; 1.0 = fully hidden by clouds.
cl_avfx_meteor_color_bdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00 / menu step 0.02Blue channel of the manual AVFX sky-meteor base tint. Used for newly spawned sky meteors only when cl_avfx_meteor_color_custom is 1. Stock reference 0.45.
cl_avfx_meteor_color_customdefault 0 / 0=stock palette / 1=custom RGBUse cl_avfx_meteor_color_r/g/b as the base tint for newly spawned AVFX sky meteors / shooting stars, including their luminous heads, streaks, persistent trains and fragmentation. Meteors already in flight retain their spawn colour. 0 (default) preserves the stock warm-gold palette exactly. Full Chaos sets this to 1 when sky meteors are selected; Reasonable leaves it unchanged. This does not enable the effect; cl_avfx_meteors remains its enable toggle.
cl_avfx_meteor_color_gdefault 0.82 / range 0.00..1.00 / menu step 0.02Green channel of the manual AVFX sky-meteor base tint. Used for newly spawned sky meteors only when cl_avfx_meteor_color_custom is 1. Stock reference 0.82.
cl_avfx_meteor_color_rdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..1.00 / menu step 0.02Red channel of the manual AVFX sky-meteor base tint. Used for newly spawned sky meteors only when cl_avfx_meteor_color_custom is 1. Stock reference 1.00.
cl_avfx_meteor_color_variationdefault 0.00 / range 0.00..1.00 / menu step 0.02Seeded colour variation between individual newly spawned AVFX sky meteors when custom colour is enabled. 0 (default) uses the exact base RGB; 1 gives the strongest deterministic vivid variation while retaining influence from that RGB. Full Chaos sets it to 1 when sky meteors are selected. Existing meteors are not recoloured mid-flight.
cl_avfx_meteor_force_bloomdefault 1 / 0 or 1Forced bloom for meteor heads. Works even when gl_bloom=0. Meteor-pixel-only: does NOT enable whole-scene bloom.
cl_avfx_meteor_fragmentationdefault 0.2 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Probability that a meteor fragments mid-flight into smaller streaks. 0 = none; 0.2 (default) occasional break-up; 1.0 = every meteor fragments.
cl_avfx_meteor_impactdefault 0 / 0 or 1Master toggle for AVFX impact meteors. Vertical-descent meteors that fall from sky level down to ground / water / lava surfaces near the player and explode on contact. Strictly separate pool from sky burn-up meteors above. Default OFF (opt-in).
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_brightnessdefault 1.45 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Head light brightness multiplier across the full descent. 1.45 (default) bright readable head; up to 3.0 cinematic; 0 invisible.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_color_bdefault 0.30 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.02Blue channel of the manual impact-meteor tint. Used when cl_avfx_meteor_impact_color_custom is 1; sampled once for each newly spawned meteor.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_color_customdefault 0 / 0 or 1Use the manual RGB tint for newly spawned impact-meteor plasma, heated head edge, tails, smoke, hot shatter and local glow. The dark rock body keeps its natural material. Off preserves the accepted seeded stock palette exactly. Full Chaos sets this to 1 when impact meteors are selected; Reasonable leaves it unchanged. Meteors already in flight keep their spawn colour.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_color_gdefault 0.65 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.02Green channel of the manual impact-meteor tint. Used when cl_avfx_meteor_impact_color_custom is 1; sampled once for each newly spawned meteor.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_color_rdefault 1.00 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.02Red channel of the manual impact-meteor tint. Used when cl_avfx_meteor_impact_color_custom is 1; sampled once for each newly spawned meteor.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_color_variationdefault 0.00 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.02Seeded colour variation between individual newly spawned impact meteors. 0 keeps the exact manual RGB; 1 applies the strongest deterministic vivid variation while retaining influence from that base RGB and adding no RNG draw. Full Chaos enables variation; Reasonable keeps the default 0.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_descent_secondsdefault 3.0 / range 1.0..120.0 / step 1.0Descent duration in seconds — how long a meteor takes from sky-level appearance to surface impact. 3 (default) fast cinematic; up to 60 for slow 'minute-long' descents; 120 max.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_force_bloomdefault 1 / 0 or 1Forced bloom for impact meteor heads + impact flash. Works even when gl_bloom=0. Impact-pixel-only: does NOT enable whole-scene bloom.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_ground_glow_secondsdefault 14.0 / range 0.0..60.0 / step 0.5Duration in seconds of the persistent warm ground glow registered into the shared lightning local-surface light pool after impact. 14.0 (default) long readable afterglow; 5.0 = original baseline.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_intensitydefault 2.55 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Final impact flash intensity multiplier. 2.55 (default) strong cinematic flash; 1.00 = baseline; up to 5.0 nuclear; 0 disables the flash without disabling the spawn.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_puddle_evapdefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for rain-puddle evaporation around impact meteor landings. Spawns a BFG-style alpha-suppression halo (separate pool from BFG evaps so weapon halos aren't starved) + a strong ring of steam puffs around the evap boundary. Does NOT mutate the puddle pool — alpha is suppressed for ~6–18 s while the surface 'dries', then ramps back. Default ON.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_puddle_evap_radiusdefault 400 / range 0..2048 / step 16Puddle evaporation halo radius in world units around the impact. 400 (default) ≈ small-room-sized dry zone; up to 2048 for huge boulders. Scaled by per-meteor radius_scale; lifetime auto-scales 6..18 s with effective radius.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_radiusdefault 1664 / range 64..8192 / step 64World-units radius around the player within which targets are selected. 1664 (default) — wide play area. Smaller = closer impacts; larger = wider field.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_ratedefault 60 / range 0.0..60.0 / step 0.5Average impact meteor spawn rate (events per minute). 0 = none; 60 (default) ≈ one per second dense rain; lower = quieter sky.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shakedefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for client-only camera shake when an impact meteor lands nearby. Distance-falloff damped envelope (pitch + roll), independent of server playerstate. Default ON.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shake_maxdefault 1.5 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Hard angular clamp in degrees for the combined pitch + roll shake delta per axis. 1.5 (default) caps aim disruption; up to 5.0 for unrestrained shake; 0 effectively disables.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shake_radiusdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Camera shake falloff radius multiplier. 1.0 (default) ≈ 1200 wu felt zone; lower = only very close impacts shake camera; higher = wider felt area.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shake_strengthdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Camera shake amplitude multiplier. 1.0 (default) baseline ≈ 1° peak at zero distance; up to 3.0 for strong cinematic shake; 0 disables without changing the master toggle.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shatterdefault 1 / 0 or 1Spawn dark rocky shatter fragments at impact. Chunks fly outward + upward, fall under gravity, fade over ~1 s. Freefall + fade only — no secondary BSP contact events. Default ON.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shatter_densitydefault 3.55 / range 0.0..4.0 / step 0.05Shatter chunk count multiplier. 3.55 (default) ≈ 24 × radius_scale × size × this chunks per impact, capped at 120. Higher = denser debris cloud; 0 disables shatter without changing the toggle.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shimmerdefault 1 / 0 or 1Heat-shimmer atmospheric refraction (air distortion) around falling impact-meteor heads. Default ON. Requires impact meteors (cl_avfx_meteor_impact).
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shimmer_radiusdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Heat-shimmer screen-space ellipsoid radius multiplier. 1.0 (default) baseline; higher widens the distorted area around each bolide.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_shimmer_strengthdefault 0.5 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Heat-shimmer distortion strength multiplier. 0.5 (default) subtle haze; 1.0 = baseline; higher for stronger refraction.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_sizedefault 0.40 / range 0.10..3.00 / step 0.05Head size multiplier — scales the visible glow radius growth as the meteor descends. 0.40 (default) compact bolide; 1.00 = baseline; up to 3.0 huge boulder.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_taildefault 1 / 0 or 1Spawn trailing fire/ember particles behind the descending bolide head. World-space (not camera-attached). Default ON.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_tail_densitydefault 3.00 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Tail particle density multiplier. 3.00 (default) ≈ 16 particles/frame at 60 fps × radius_scale × this; 1.00 = baseline. Higher = thicker volumetric plasma trail; 0 disables the tail without changing the toggle.
cl_avfx_meteor_impact_water_steamdefault 1 / 0 or 1Spawn steam puffs when an impact meteor hits water (uses the existing AVFX lava-steam puff system on water targets). Default ON.
cl_avfx_meteor_ratedefault 60 / range 0.0..60.0 / step 0.5Average meteor spawn rate (events per minute). 0 = none; 60 (default) ≈ one per second dense shower; lower = sparser sky.
cl_avfx_meteor_sizedefault 1.5 / range 0.1..5.0 / step 0.05Meteor angular size multiplier. 1.5 (default) baseline cinematic head; 0.5 = compact bolide; up to 5.0 for fat streaks.
cl_avfx_meteor_speeddefault 0.55 / range 0.1..5.0 / step 0.05Meteor angular speed multiplier. 0.55 (default) slow drift across sky; 1.0 = baseline; up to 5.0 = streak in a blink.
cl_avfx_meteor_trail_lengthdefault 3.35 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Trail length multiplier. 0 = head only; 3.35 (default) long cinematic tails; up to 5.0 for very long trails.
cl_avfx_meteor_train_timedefault 6.75 / range 0.0..15.0 / step 0.25Persistent train afterglow time in seconds. 0 = no afterglow; 6.75 (default) long-lived glowing train; up to 15 = very long smoke trail.
cl_avfx_meteorsdefault 0 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the AVFX meteor / shooting-star layer. Streaks fall across the sky with optional trails, fragmentation, cloud occlusion and forced bloom. Default OFF (opt-in).
cl_avfx_meteors_cometsdefault 0 / 0 or 1Menu-wide master gate for all celestial meteors and comets. When off, sky meteors, impact meteors and comets are suppressed and their live pools are cleared, but their individual cvars are not changed. Default OFF.
cl_avfx_mist_billows0=Sprites / 1=Billows / 2=Billows + sprites (default 1)Mist style: sprites = legacy wisps; billows = volumetric rolling smoke. Billows+sprites = both layers at once. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the mist preset (cl_avfx_preset 5).
cl_avfx_mist_color_b0..1 (menu step 0.02, default 0.92)Mist base color, blue channel. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the mist preset (cl_avfx_preset 5).
cl_avfx_mist_color_g0..1 (menu step 0.02, default 0.88)Mist base color, green channel. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the mist preset (cl_avfx_preset 5).
cl_avfx_mist_color_r0..1 (menu step 0.02, default 0.86)Mist base color, red channel. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the mist preset (cl_avfx_preset 5).
cl_avfx_mist_color_variation0..1 (menu step 0.05, default 0.2)Per-particle color spread around the mist base color. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the mist preset (cl_avfx_preset 5).
cl_avfx_mist_embers0=Off / 1=On (default 1)Warm ember/spark sub-layer drifting through the billowing smoke. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the mist preset (cl_avfx_preset 5) with a billow mode active (cl_avfx_mist_billows 1 or 2).
cl_avfx_mist_shapes0=Off / 1=On (default 1)Wisp-mode only: give mist soft haze/wisp shapes with soft edges instead of round dots. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the mist preset (cl_avfx_preset 5), and applies only in wisp mode (cl_avfx_mist_billows 0).
cl_avfx_mist_size_variation0..1 (menu step 0.05, default 0.45)How much mist particle size varies around the base size. Requires cl_avfx 1 and the mist preset (cl_avfx_preset 5).
cl_avfx_moon0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for the AVFX moon disk in the sky. Independent from the sun. The moon is rendered in the sky shader as a cloud-aware cratered disk with horizon fade and phase shading. When master is 0, the disk is fully suppressed.
cl_avfx_moon_azimuthdefault 172 / range 0..359 / step 1 / degreesMoon azimuth in degrees (manual mode only). Same convention as sun: 0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west. Default 172 ≈ south.
cl_avfx_moon_brightnessdefault 0.85 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Moon disk brightness multiplier. 0.85 (default) keeps the tuned moon visible in dark AVFX scenes. Up to 5.0 for a cinematic super-bright moon. 0 disables disk emission.
cl_avfx_moon_cloud_occlusiondefault 0.75 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Cloud occlusion strength on the moon disk. 0 = moon ignores clouds; 0.75 (default) = clouds dim the moon disk according to the AVFX cloud field while preserving tuned visibility.
cl_avfx_moon_color_bdefault 1.00 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Moon color: blue channel. 1.00 (default) classic cool moonlight. See cl_avfx_moon_color_r.
cl_avfx_moon_color_gdefault 0.86 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Moon color: green channel. 0.86 (default). See cl_avfx_moon_color_r.
cl_avfx_moon_color_rdefault 0.78 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Moon color: red channel. 0.78 (default). Parallel to the sun color controls. Tints the visible moon disk/halo AND moon-driven scene lighting — world surfaces, entities, snow/water/particle celestial response, and volumetric cloud/fog moon scatter. Brightness stays on the moon brightness/world/entity sliders. Default 0.78/0.86/1.00 reproduces the previously hardcoded cool moon.
cl_avfx_moon_dark_side_visibilitydefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.01Visibility of the moon body on the unlit side of the phase. Uses a smooth nonlinear curve: 1.0 (default) keeps the accepted dark disk and faint surface texture; 0.0 fully removes the unlit body, including its star mask. Low values grow gently instead of popping in.
cl_avfx_moon_edge_smooth_insetdefault 0.00 / range 0.00..0.30 / step 0.01 / applies liveOptional smoothing inset from the moon limb / phase terminator, as a fraction of moon radius. 0 (default) disables smoothing and keeps crater detail sharp. Higher values create a wider clean soft band and can intentionally blur edge details.
cl_avfx_moon_elevationdefault 36 / range -90..90 / step 1 / degreesMoon elevation above horizon in degrees (manual mode only). Default 36 ≈ moderately high night moon. Below -3° the moon fades out via horizon envelope.
cl_avfx_moon_entity_lightdefault 2.25 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Moon contribution to entity ambient (monsters, players, items, models). 2.25 (default) = same tuned balance as world; 0 = entity ambient unaffected by moon; up to 3.0 for cinematic moon-lit characters at night.
cl_avfx_moon_halo_alphadefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Moon local sky-shader halo opacity multiplier. 1.0 keeps the previous tuned halo visibility. 0 makes the halo fully transparent. This multiplies halo brightness and does not affect the moon disk.
cl_avfx_moon_halo_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Moon local sky-shader halo brightness multiplier. 1.0 keeps the previous tuned halo intensity. 0 removes halo light. Values above 1.0 strengthen the glow.
cl_avfx_moon_halo_phase_shape0=legacy round halo / 1=phase-shaped halo (default)Mask the local moon halo by the moon phase shape. 1 (default) makes crescent / half moon halos follow the same curved terminator as the visible moon disk. 0 restores the legacy round halo.
cl_avfx_moon_halo_sizedefault 1.0 / range 0.0..4.0 / step 0.01Moon local sky-shader halo radius multiplier. 1.0 keeps the previous tuned halo around the moon disk. 0 fully removes the local halo. Values above 1.0 broaden the glow without changing the moon disk size.
cl_avfx_moon_hd_texture0=off (default) / 1=8K HD texture / applies liveUse the 8K moon albedo texture for the AVFX moon disk. 0 (default) keeps the accepted 2K LROC texture; 1 switches the same spherical/equirectangular moon mapping to q2pro-x/data/moon/hd8k.jpg. Applies live on a loaded map and preserves the current moon orientation, phase, halo and lighting.
cl_avfx_moon_indoor_leakdefault 1 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Fraction of moonlight that leaks into indoor / closed spaces. 1.0 (default) = indoor spaces receive the same celestial moon lighting as outdoor view; 0 = no moonlight leaks indoors. Smoothed ~300 ms transition based on view-side sky exposure.
cl_avfx_moon_lighting0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for AVFX moon scene lighting. When on, the moon's position and cool blue-white tint contribute a runtime light layer to world surfaces and entity ambient at night, with strength controlled by cl_avfx_moon_world_light / cl_avfx_moon_entity_light. Fades with phase, cloud cover, and view-side sky exposure (~300 ms smoothed). 0 = moon disk still draws but level lighting is unaffected.
cl_avfx_moon_modedefault 0 (manual) / range 0..2 / 0=manual 1=opposite_sun 2=cycle/clockMoon position mode. 0 (default) = manual — use cl_avfx_moon_azimuth / cl_avfx_moon_elevation. 1 = opposite sun — moon mirrors the sun's direction (real-world default for full moon). 2 = cycle/clock — follow the sun's time mode but offset by 12 hours so moon rises as sun sets.
cl_avfx_moon_phasedefault 0.30 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Moon phase 0..1. 0 = new moon (lit part invisible; dark body visibility is controlled by cl_avfx_moon_dark_side_visibility); 0.25 = crescent moon; 0.5 = half moon; 0.75 = gibbous moon; 1.0 = full moon. 0.30 (default) gives a visible crescent / young moon with the accepted curved terminator. The sky shader lights a virtual moon sphere, so crescents use a curved terminator instead of a straight cut.
cl_avfx_moon_phase_edge_rays0=clean tight phase edge (default) / 1=ray fringe / applies liveTextured ray-like fringe on the illuminated moon phase edge. 0 (default) keeps a clean tight phase edge without blurring crater detail. 1 restores the stylized rays/hairs on enlarged crescent moons.
cl_avfx_moon_rotation_modedefault 0 (manual) / range 0..1 / 0=manual 1=realtime_autoMoon body rotation mode. 0 (default) = manual — fixed yaw/pitch/roll offsets from the sliders below. 1 = realtime auto — the yaw/pitch/roll speeds below are integrated over time (never writes the cvars). Default rotation is identity, so the accepted moon look is unchanged.
cl_avfx_moon_rotation_pitchdefault 0 / range -180..180 / step 1 / degreesMoon pitch (poles up/down) in degrees. Lets you inspect the top/bottom of the disk. 0 (default) keeps the accepted orientation.
cl_avfx_moon_rotation_pitch_speeddefault 0.00 / range -10.0..10.0 / step 0.01 / deg/sMoon auto pitch speed in degrees per second (realtime auto mode). 0.00 (default) = no pitch drift; negative tilts the opposite direction.
cl_avfx_moon_rotation_rolldefault 0 / range -180..180 / step 1 / degreesMoon roll (disk rolls on screen) in degrees. 0 (default) keeps the accepted orientation.
cl_avfx_moon_rotation_roll_speeddefault 0.00 / range -10.0..10.0 / step 0.01 / deg/sMoon auto roll speed in degrees per second (realtime auto mode). 0.00 (default) = no roll drift; negative rolls the opposite direction.
cl_avfx_moon_rotation_yawdefault 0 / range -360..360 / step 1 / degreesMoon yaw (longitude spin) in degrees. Manual-mode fixed offset; also the starting angle in realtime auto. 0 (default) keeps the accepted orientation.
cl_avfx_moon_rotation_yaw_speeddefault 0.02 / range -10.0..10.0 / step 0.01 / deg/sMoon auto yaw speed in degrees per second (realtime auto mode). 0.02 (default) is a slow drift; negative spins the opposite direction; 0 freezes yaw.
cl_avfx_moon_sizedefault 1.95 / engine range 0.1..3000.0 / menu 0.1..100.0 step 0.15Moon disk angular size multiplier. 1.95 (default) ≈ slightly wider than real moon for visibility in-game; menu slider goes up to 100.0, while console/cfg still accept the engine range up to 3000.0 for extreme cinematic enlarged moon. It also scales moon scene lighting through a normalized, bounded area factor (size/1.95)^2 clamped to [0.05, 4.0], equal to 1.0 at the default size. This is an ADDITIONAL factor on top of moon phase — cl_avfx_moon_phase still reduces light for a cropped moon. Gated by cl_avfx_moon_lighting.
cl_avfx_moon_sky_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.01How strongly moon brightness lifts the surrounding sky. 1.0 (default) preserves the accepted look. 0.0 keeps the moon disk bright but leaves the sky much darker, which is useful for bright moon + dark sky + visible stars. Does NOT change moon disk brightness, local moon halo, or moon world/entity lighting.
cl_avfx_moon_smooth1=smooth mip/aniso (default) / 0=sharp GL_LINEAR / applies liveSmooth the AVFX moon disk texture with mipmap / trilinear / anisotropic filtering. 1 (default) keeps the moon smooth with no shimmer while it rotates. 0 disables smoothing and samples the texture at plain GL_LINEAR (no mipmaps, no anisotropy), so a non-rotating moon looks crisp and sharp. Applies live and does not reload the moon texture.
cl_avfx_moon_world_lightdefault 2.25 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Moon contribution to world / level surfaces. 2.25 (default) = tuned bright moonlight for night readability; 0 = no moon world tint; up to 3.0 if you want a cinematic super-bright lunar landscape. Same shader hook as cl_avfx_sun_world_light. Multiplied by phase, altitude, cloud_T, and the indoor-leak gate.
cl_avfx_mr_mask_debugdefault 0 / 0=off 1=mask 2=mask no-depth 3=stencil probe (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: AVFX mirror reflection mask/stencil visualization. 0=off; 1=show the receiver mask; 2=same ignoring depth; 3=stencil-bit probe. Not archived, no menu; zero cost at 0.
cl_avfx_multiplayer0=disable in multiplayer / 1=allow in multiplayer (default)Allow AVFX during real multiplayer matches (cl.maxclients > 1). Off completely disables AVFX in multiplayer regardless of master toggle. Demo playback uses cl_avfx_demo instead of this gate.
cl_avfx_no_contact_debugdefault 0 / 0=off, >0=diagnostic (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: prints AVFX surface no-contact (rejected-contact) diagnostics. 0=off. Not archived, no menu; zero cost at 0.
cl_avfx_overlay_path0=legacy billboard / 1=flat overlay (default)flat AVFX surface overlay primitive. 1 (default) — puddles and snow caps render as world-space alpha quads on the surface plane (lying flat on the floor / table top; correct silhouette from any view angle). 0 — legacy billboard particles (always-camera-facing round patches). Falls back to the billboard path automatically if the overlay queue ever overflows. Lives outside the entity_t / particle_t budgets, so storm / lightning / gameplay rendering is never impacted.
cl_avfx_particle_lightning_debris_enable0=stop future particles of this family / 1=emit (default)Lightning impact debris: The warm debris bursts at a lightning strike point. The smoke flash, surface arcs and water reaction are separate controls. Emit this family. Off stops only future particles of this exact family, before they are allocated or submitted; particles already in the air finish normally, and nothing else about the event changes. The broad Particles master and the legacy per-effect switches still apply on top. This is an ordinary AVFX setting: it belongs to ordinary AVFX presets, does not follow the standard-particle colour master, and never changes the global standard particle settings or the Player Contact domain.
cl_avfx_particle_lightning_water_droplets_enable0=stop future particles of this family / 1=emit (default)Lightning water droplets: The blue droplets thrown up where lightning hits or crawls across real BSP water and visible AVFX puddles. Weapon-water droplets are a separate family and are never changed by this control. Emit this family. cl_avfx_particle_multiplier0.2..100.0 (default 1.0)Particle count multiplier for snow / ash / dust / mist plus the close raindrop layer. 1.0 (default) keeps the cell-based baseline. 0.2 (×0.2) thins each preset to 5× fewer particles by tightening the per-cell density gate. 100.0 (×100) keeps the same gate and emits up to 100 sub-particles per fired cell with unique sub-seeded offsets, so even the densest snowstorm / dust haze reads as proper whiteout. Per-frame total is still capped by quality budget × multiplier so MAX_PARTICLES is respected; the rain preset's main RF_BEAM streaks are unaffected (use cl_avfx_density / cl_avfx_weather_level for those).

cl_avfx_planet_jupiter_latdefault 0 / range -10..+10 / step 0.1Jupiter ecliptic latitude (degrees, -10..+10). Default 0.
cl_avfx_planet_jupiter_londefault 34 / range 0..360 / step 1Jupiter ecliptic longitude (degrees, 0..360). Default 34 is approximate J2000.0 epoch.
cl_avfx_planet_mars_latdefault 0 / range -10..+10 / step 0.1Mars ecliptic latitude (degrees, -10..+10). Default 0.
cl_avfx_planet_mars_londefault 336 / range 0..360 / step 1Mars ecliptic longitude (degrees, 0..360). Default 336 is approximate J2000.0 epoch.
cl_avfx_planet_mercury_latdefault 0 / range -10..+10 / step 0.1Mercury ecliptic latitude (degrees, -10..+10). Default 0 (planet sits on ecliptic plane).
cl_avfx_planet_mercury_londefault 252 / range 0..360 / step 1Mercury ecliptic longitude (degrees, 0..360). Default 252 is approximate J2000.0 epoch. Dial to current real Mercury position using any astronomy reference (timeanddate.com / stellarium / etc.) for visible sky correctness.
cl_avfx_planet_reflection_debugdefault 0 (off) / 0=off, >0=diagnostic (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only diagnostic for AVFX planet/celestial reflections in puddles and water. When non-zero it exposes reflection receiver and visibility counts in the cl_avfx_info line. Not archived, no menu row; costs nothing at 0.
cl_avfx_planet_saturn_latdefault 0 / range -10..+10 / step 0.1Saturn ecliptic latitude (degrees, -10..+10). Default 0.
cl_avfx_planet_saturn_londefault 49 / range 0..360 / step 1Saturn ecliptic longitude (degrees, 0..360). Default 49 is approximate J2000.0 epoch.
cl_avfx_planet_venus_latdefault 0 / range -10..+10 / step 0.1Venus ecliptic latitude (degrees, -10..+10). Default 0.
cl_avfx_planet_venus_londefault 181 / range 0..360 / step 1Venus ecliptic longitude (degrees, 0..360). Default 181 is approximate J2000.0 epoch.
cl_avfx_planetsdefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the AVFX planets layer (Venus + Mars). Rendered as brighter star-like points NOT as sun-like disks. Fixed sky positions for this phase (no ephemeris). Visible when cl_avfx_stars 1. Default ON.
cl_avfx_planets_brightnessdefault 1.95 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Global brightness multiplier for planets. 1.95 (default). Planets have their own per-planet intensity clamp (max 0.85, higher than catalog stars at 0.55) so they always read as the brightest sky points.
cl_avfx_planets_glow_alphadefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Forced glow opacity multiplier for planets. 1.0 (default) keeps the previous opacity; 0 makes the glow fully transparent. Does not change the planet point itself.
cl_avfx_planets_glow_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Forced glow brightness multiplier for planets. 1.0 (default) keeps the previous glow strength; 0 removes glow contribution; higher values make the halo brighter. Planet point brightness is still controlled by cl_avfx_planets_brightness.
cl_avfx_planets_glow_sizedefault 1.0 / range 0.0..4.0 / step 0.01Forced glow radius multiplier for planet bloom/halo. 1.0 (default) keeps the previous planet glow footprint; 0 removes the planet glow; higher values spread the glow wider without changing the compact planet point itself.
cl_avfx_planets_position_modedefault 1 / 1 manual eclipticPlanet position source selector. 1 (default) — manual ecliptic longitude/latitude (per-planet _lon / _lat cvars). Other values are reserved for future date-driven ephemeris and manual RA/Dec modes (not yet implemented).
cl_avfx_planets_realdefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the real planet ecliptic placement path. ON (default) renders 5 planets (Mercury / Venus / Mars / Jupiter / Saturn) at user-controllable real ecliptic longitudes (per-planet cl_avfx_planet_*_lon / _lat cvars). OFF reverts to the classic 2-planet fallback (Venus + Mars hand-curated synthetic positions). Position source is selected by cl_avfx_planets_position_mode.
cl_avfx_planets_sizedefault 0.45 / range 0.01..4.0 / step 0.01Global visual size multiplier for all planet point glows. 0.01 is a star-sized point; 0.45 (default) gives compact bright pin-points; up to 4.0 is available for stylized larger glows. One slider scales every visible planet together.
