Rings still mark snow contacts, but this cvar controls how often longer-lived pale surface patches appear. 0.0 disables the visible patches and effectively mutes the contact sampling; 0.45 (default) gives sparse natural patches; 1.0 is a dense/debug look.
cl_avfx_snow_water_patch_drift_speed0..16 wu/s (default 4)Drift speed for snow melt patches on water in world units per second. 0 keeps patches almost pinned to the hit point; 4 (default) gives subtle movement; 16 is visibly fast and useful for storm/wind testing.
cl_avfx_snow_water_patch_lifetime1..100 sec (default 10)Lifetime for drifting snow melt specks on water, in seconds. Specks fade in, drift a little with wind/current, then fade out; nearby hits can refresh/merge them. 10 (default) keeps the previous timing; range 1..100 gives 10x shorter to 10x longer persistence.
cl_avfx_snow_water_patch_size0.01..4.0 (default 0.20)Size multiplier for snow specks / melt patches on water. 0.20 is the default and is 5x smaller than the first T2 test build. Range is 0.01..4.0: 0.01 is 20x smaller than the default, 4.0 is 20x larger than the default. Also lightly scales the contact ripple so tiny snow does not create oversized water rings.
cl_avfx_spaceshipsdefault 0 / 0 or 1Master toggle for AVFX sky spaceships: client-only decorative flybys of stock baseq2 Quake II ships (Strogg / Viper / Big Viper) that enter from beyond the horizon, cross the sky on long deterministic routes and fade into the distance. These are long sky flybys, NOT base1 scripted loops. Render-only: no gameplay, hitboxes, collision or network state. Independent of stars and weather preset. Default OFF (opt-in).
cl_avfx_spaceships_altitudedefault 1.0 / range 0.25..4.0 / step 0.05Far-shell distance / apparent altitude multiplier. 1.0 (default). Higher = ships feel farther away and shrink more slowly. This is not a map height in world units.
cl_avfx_spaceships_arc_heightdefault 0.55 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Route apex bias. 0 = low horizon traffic, 1 = high overhead arcs. 0.55 (default). Render-only.
cl_avfx_spaceships_color_bdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.05Manual tint blue channel, used only when color_mode = 3 (Manual RGB). 1.0 (default). Render-only.
cl_avfx_spaceships_color_gdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.05Manual tint green channel, used only when color_mode = 3 (Manual RGB). 1.0 (default). Render-only.
cl_avfx_spaceships_color_modedefault 0 / 0 stock, 1 random, 2 palette, 3 manual RGBPer-ship color styling. 0 = stock model colors, no tint. 1 = subtle deterministic random tint per ship (like monster variants). 2 = cinematic palette per ship. 3 = manual RGB tint for all ships (color_r/g/b). Color variation is render-only and does not affect gameplay; applied via entity color, no new shader.
cl_avfx_spaceships_color_rdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.05Manual tint red channel, used only when color_mode = 3 (Manual RGB). 1.0 (default). Render-only.
cl_avfx_spaceships_color_strengthdefault 30 / range 0..100 / step 1Color tint strength (percent). 30 (default). 0 = neutral even when color_mode is non-zero; 100 = strongest stylized tint. Render-only.
cl_avfx_spaceships_countdefault 3 / range 1..100 / step 1Target maximum simultaneously active ship events. 3 (default), up to 100. Render-only and does not affect gameplay, hitboxes, collision or network state; high counts are heavier to render; low-quality / competitive-limited paths may cap it lower and report that in cl_avfx_info.
cl_avfx_spaceships_horizon_clipdefault 0 / 0 full sphere, 1 upper sky onlySky coverage, mirrors cl_avfx_stars_horizon_clip. 0 (default) = full celestial sphere: ships fly the whole sky above AND below the horizon (so they stay visible under floating levels and do not fade/melt at the horizon; below-horizon ships are still hidden by real geometry via the sky-stencil world sub-pass). 1 = clip to the upper sky only (classic above-horizon arcs that fade near the horizon).
cl_avfx_spaceships_min_durationdefault 18.0 / range 8.0..90.0 / step 1.0Lower clamp for full flyby duration (seconds) after route length, average speed and per-event speed deviation are applied. 18.0 (default). Keeps high speed from collapsing flybys into short base1-like scenes — routes stay long sky flybys.
cl_avfx_spaceships_modeldefault 0 / 0 mixed, 1 Strogg, 2 Viper, 3 Big ViperWhich stock baseq2 ship model to fly. 0 = mixed stock fleet (deterministic mix of all present models). 1 = Strogg (models/ships/strogg1). 2 = Viper (models/ships/viper). 3 = Big Viper (models/ships/bigviper). Uses stock ship models only — no new assets.
cl_avfx_spaceships_ratedefault 2.0 / range 0.0..100.0 / step 0.5Average ship spawn rate in events per minute. 2.0 (default), up to 100. 0 = no new flybys while existing ships finish their route. Decorative render-only pacing; does not affect gameplay.
cl_avfx_spaceships_rolldefault 0 / 0 or 1Master toggle for aerobatic 360 barrel rolls: a rolling ship performs full turns around its length axis mid-flight (cockpit dips, continues, returns) while its flight path is unchanged. Render-only, per-event stable. Default OFF.
cl_avfx_spaceships_roll_chancedefault 0.35 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Fraction of ships that perform aerobatic rolls (when the roll master is on). 0.35 (default). Higher = more ships roll. Decided once per event at spawn (stable).
cl_avfx_spaceships_roll_frequencydefault 1.5 / range 0.0..8.0 / step 0.5Average number of full 360 rolls a rolling ship performs across its flight. 1.5 (default). 0 = none. Render-only.
cl_avfx_spaceships_roll_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0.1..8.0 / step 0.1Roll rate: how fast one full 360 roll completes. 1.0 (default) is about 2 seconds per roll; higher = snappier. Phase-continuous ease-in/ease-out. Render-only.
cl_avfx_spaceships_scaledefault 2.0 / range 0.25..20.0 / step 0.05Base model scale multiplier before distance / perspective shrink. 2.0 (default). Render-only.
cl_avfx_spaceships_size_variationdefault 0.45 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Per-event size variation around the base scale. 0.45 (default). 0 = every ship uses exactly cl_avfx_spaceships_scale; 1 = broad variation (clamped so ships never become unreadably tiny or near-world huge). Render-only and does not affect hitboxes or collision.
cl_avfx_spaceships_sounddefault 1 / 0 or 1AVFX sound master for the spaceship flyby sound. 1 (default). 0 = completely silent ships. Ship sound is optional and can be disabled completely; local-only decorative, one controlled one-shot near closest approach, missing WAVs play silent.
cl_avfx_spaceships_sound_volumedefault 0.35 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Spaceship flyby sound volume. 0.35 (default). 0 = silent (equivalent to sound master off for playback). Optional; kept restrained so rare flybys add atmosphere without constant hum.
cl_avfx_spaceships_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0.25..40.0 / step 0.25Average flight-speed multiplier. 1.0 (default), up to 40 (10x the old max). Higher = faster / shorter flybys. Render-only. At very high speed also lower cl_avfx_spaceships_min_duration — that floor otherwise caps how fast ships can cross (the floor is scaled down with speed but the base value still limits extreme settings).
cl_avfx_spaceships_speed_variationdefault 0.35 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Per-event speed deviation around the average. 0.35 (default). 0 = every ship uses exactly cl_avfx_spaceships_speed; 1 = broad spread. Render-only and does not affect gameplay, hitboxes, collision or network state.
cl_avfx_spaceships_weavedefault 0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Course weave amount. 0 (default) = ships fly the straight sky arc. Higher = ships weave and wander off the arc with smooth lateral + vertical drift (banking into the turns). Render-only; the underlying route stays deterministic and camera-independent.
cl_avfx_spaceships_weave_frequencydefault 2.0 / range 0.25..8.0 / step 0.25How many weave wiggles occur across a full flight. 2.0 (default). Only matters when cl_avfx_spaceships_weave > 0. Render-only.
cl_avfx_speed0.1..4.0 (default 1.0)Speed multiplier for fall / drift speed of all preset elements. Combined with cl_avfx_weather_level. Affects rain streak length, drop cycle period and snow/ash/dust/mist drift.
cl_avfx_starsdefault 0 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the AVFX celestial stars layer. When enabled, the sky shader renders a real-data star catalog (~50 brightest named stars + constellation anchors for Orion / Big Dipper / Cassiopeia / Cygnus / Lyra / Aquila / Taurus / Pleiades / Scorpius / Sagittarius / Pegasus / Andromeda) plus an extra faint background field. Stars respect cloud occlusion and fade in daylight / under full moon. Default OFF (opt-in).
cl_avfx_stars_auto_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0..10 / step 0.1Multiplier on the auto-rotation rate when cl_avfx_stars_orientation_mode is 1 (sidereal) or 2 (AVFX day-cycle). 1.0 (default) = realistic real-time-like sweep (one 360° per sidereal day in mode 1, or per AVFX day in mode 2). Higher = faster, lower = slower; 0 freezes the auto contribution but keeps manual yaw/pitch/roll active.
cl_avfx_stars_auto_timedefault 0 / range -86400..+86400 sec / step 60Static phase seed added to the auto-rotation accumulator, in seconds. Lets you set a deterministic starting orientation for a particular map / demo without waiting for the auto-rotation to drift into the right phase. Mode 1: shifts the sidereal day phase. Mode 2: shifts the AVFX day phase. Mode 0: unused (no auto rotation).
cl_avfx_stars_background_modedefault 2 / 0 dense background / 1 real catalog / 2 real catalog + dense backgroundSelects the background star source. 0 - dense stable background. 1 - real catalog point stars only. 2 (default) - real catalog + dense background. The real-catalog high-count path is intentionally deferred to a dedicated point/instanced draw pass; the dense background keeps the sky visually rich on the stable shader path.
cl_avfx_stars_bg_godrays0=Off / 1=On (default 0)Allow procedural background stars to emit Sun God Rays streaks. OFF default: background stars stay visible, but do not create streaks. Requires cl_avfx 1, an active star pass and God Rays (cl_avfx_sun_godrays 1). With the toggle off that star class is routed around the radial blur instead of feeding it, so the stars stay visible but emit no streaks.
cl_avfx_stars_bloomdefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the AVFX stars + planets forced bloom path. Adds a star-pixel-only postprocess glow to bright catalog stars + Venus + Mars. Works even when global gl_bloom 0 via a separate keep-alive flag that holds the bloom MRT alive. Star-pixel-only by construction — does NOT silently enable whole-scene bloom. Visible only when cl_avfx_stars 1.
cl_avfx_stars_bloom_blur_iterations1..32 iterations (default 8)Number of blur iterations the bloom post pass runs while the star/planet bloom source is alive. This is a direct performance knob: fewer iterations restore frame budget, more iterations give a wider, softer halo around bright catalog stars. It only applies while the star post pass is actually alive, so a background-only star sky is unaffected.
cl_avfx_stars_bloom_intensitydefault 1.10 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Stars bloom intensity multiplier. 1.10 (default) tuned for natural glow on Sirius / Vega / Venus / Mars without over-blooming. Multiplied with the per-star (emissive - threshold) excess to compute the actual bloom MRT contribution.
cl_avfx_stars_bloom_thresholddefault 0.10 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Emissive threshold for the stars bloom contribution. 0.10 (default) — catalog stars / planets whose emissive (intensity × brightness × fade) exceeds this value contribute to bloom; the brightest extra background points can also contribute. At default settings this lets the top-magnitude catalog stars (Sirius / Vega / Capella / Rigel / Procyon / etc.) plus Venus and Mars bloom. Higher = only the brightest few; lower = many stars contribute. Milky Way haze does not bloom directly.
cl_avfx_stars_brightnessdefault 3.0 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Global brightness multiplier for all stars (catalog + extra background). 3.0 (default) gives the accepted dense night sky; lower for a subtle field.
cl_avfx_stars_cloud_occlusiondefault 0.35 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Cloud occlusion strength for stars. 0 = stars ignore clouds entirely; 0.35 (default) = clouds dim stars with substantial residual leak through thin cloud cells.
cl_avfx_stars_colorfuldefault 0 / 0=accepted white look / 1=rare colour accents + subset twinkleMaster toggle for the colourful accent-star feature. OFF (default) keeps the accepted white / cold blue-white star look. ON tints a rare deterministic subset of stars with a fixed cinematic palette (cold/blue-white, electric blue, cyan, violet, magenta, ember red, warm amber — no green/acid/rainbow) and lets that subset slowly twinkle. Pure shader-side: no extra pass, texture, CPU rebuild, or per-star animation; selection is deterministic from stable star identity so colours never move with the camera or mouse. Independent from the internal cl_avfx_stars_twinkle_strength stabilization knob.
cl_avfx_stars_colorful_fractiondefault 0.08 / range 0..0.50Fraction of star points eligible to receive an accent tint when cl_avfx_stars_colorful is ON. Default 0.08 (~8%%). Colours are sparse and unevenly distributed (warm red/amber and magenta are rarer than blue/violet); white / cold-blue stars stay the majority. Faint background stars can be selected too but read dim, so visible accents concentrate on the brighter stars.
cl_avfx_stars_colorful_intensitydefault 1.00 / range 0..2Saturation / emissive weight of the coloured accent stars only. Default 1.00 leaves accents at palette strength. Higher boosts the emissive of coloured stars; this never globally brightens ordinary white stars.
cl_avfx_stars_colorful_twinkledefault 0.75 / range 0..1 / 0=static colours, no pulseHow strongly the eligible coloured stars (and any white stars selected by cl_avfx_stars_white_twinkle_fraction) pulse. Default 0.75. 0 disables the subset twinkle while keeping the colours static. Twinkle changes brightness / bloom only — never position, colour selection, or palette index.
cl_avfx_stars_colorful_twinkle_floordefault 0.04 / range 0..0.50Minimum brightness a twinkling star reaches at the dimmest point of its cycle, as a fraction of full. Default 0.04 lets stars fade almost to invisible without hard popping. Raise toward 0.5 to keep twinkling stars always clearly visible.
cl_avfx_stars_colorful_twinkle_secondsdefault 4.00 / range 1..12Base full dim->bright->dim twinkle cycle length in seconds (before the speed multiplier). Default 4.00 makes the change visibly gradual and cinematic, not a fast sparkle.
cl_avfx_stars_colorful_twinkle_speeddefault 1.00 / range 0.05..4Multiplier on the seconds-based twinkle cycle. The effective cycle length is cl_avfx_stars_colorful_twinkle_seconds / this speed. Default 1.00. Higher = faster pulse, lower = slower. Each star keeps a slightly different per-star frequency and phase so the field does not pulse in unison.
cl_avfx_stars_day_fadedefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Daylight fade strength for stars. 0 = stars stay equally visible at noon; 1.0 (default) = strong fade driven by the sun's sky-altitude — stars only really emerge from sunset through dawn.
cl_avfx_stars_horizon_clipdefault 0 / values 0,1Star sky extent. 0 (default) = full celestial sphere: stars, Milky Way, constellations and planets cover the whole sky including below the mathematical horizon (the right look when an AVFX sky hides the map's own sky texture). 1 = clip at the horizon: sky objects below the world horizon are culled, so on maps with a real below-horizon SURF_SKY (e.g. cor_ffa_d) shown with the map sky (cl_avfx_sky 0) the stars do not paint over the mountains.
cl_avfx_stars_milky_waydefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the procedural Milky Way band along the galactic plane. Visible when cl_avfx_stars 1. Default ON — enabling stars gives the intended look immediately.
cl_avfx_stars_milky_way_brightnessdefault 1.25 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Milky Way band brightness multiplier. 1.25 (default) gives a clearly visible cosmic glow; lower for subtle hint; up to 3.0 for cinematic bright sky. Obeys the same day/moon/cloud fade as the stars.
cl_avfx_stars_milky_way_contrastdefault 0.40 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.05Milky Way noise contrast — controls the visibility of dust lanes vs cosmic glow patches. 0.40 (default); 0 = flat featureless band; higher = more pronounced dappled structure with darker dust lanes and brighter glow concentrations.
cl_avfx_stars_milky_way_widthdefault 0.70 / range 0.05..2.0 / step 0.05Milky Way angular band thickness (in radians of galactic latitude width). 0.70 (default); lower = thin tight band concentrated on the galactic plane; higher = wider diffuse glow spreading toward higher galactic latitudes.
cl_avfx_stars_moon_fadedefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Full-moon fade strength for stars. 0 = full moon does not dim stars; 1.0 (default) = full moon high in the sky reduces faint-star visibility by up to ~40% (realistic moonlight washout). Scaled by current moon phase and altitude — new moon or low moon does little.
cl_avfx_stars_orientation_modedefault 0 / 0 manual / 1 sidereal auto / 2 AVFX day-cycle autoCelestial sphere orientation source for the dedicated stars pass. 0 (default) = fixed/manual — uses cl_avfx_stars_yaw / _pitch / _roll directly. 1 = auto sidereal-like rotation around the celestial axis, yaw advanced by realtime × cl_avfx_stars_auto_speed (one 360° sweep per real sidereal day at speed 1.0). 2 = auto linked to the AVFX day cycle (same clock that drives sun/moon), one 360° sweep per AVFX day at speed 1.0. Both auto modes are smooth (not step-based) and add their contribution on top of the manual yaw/pitch/roll, so manual + auto can co-exist.
cl_avfx_stars_pitchdefault 0 / range -90..+90 deg / step 1Manual pitch offset (tilt above/below the celestial equator) for the dedicated stars pass, in degrees. Live. 90 = pole-up, -90 = pole-down, 0 = equator on the horizon.
cl_avfx_stars_proceduraldefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Density of the extra faint background star field drawn ON TOP of the catalog stars. 0 = catalog only (sparse named stars on black); 1.0 (default) = dense extra background. Has no effect on catalog star visibility — it only adds the filler layer.
cl_avfx_stars_procedural_bright_taildefault 0 / 0=uniformly dim background (recommended) / 1=allow 5% bright tailAllow a rare-bright tail (~5% of generated background stars) in the procedural background layer. OFF (default) keeps every generated star inside the uniformly dim RGB 0.025..0.080 range so the background layer never has a star bright enough to compete visually with the real catalog. ON adds a 5% chance per generated star to land in a brighter RGB 0.15..0.25 range (so the sky gets a few bright background dots — more dramatic but they can sit close enough to real catalog stars that the bright catalog's bloom halo overlaps them). Toggle for users who want a richer dynamic-range sky but accept the overlap.
cl_avfx_stars_procedural_countdefault 12000 / range 0..20000 / step 250Total count of faint procedural background stars rendered through the dedicated AVFX stars geometry pass (2026-05-31 architecture). Generated by a deterministic spherical-Fibonacci distribution on the celestial sphere — no grid, no pole streaks, no meridian seams, identical placement every launch. These stars are intentionally faint (Vmag 5.0..7.5) and never feed forced bloom — only bright real-catalog stars and planets bloom. Set to 0 to render only the real catalog layer. Hard upper cap is 20000 (deeper than naked-eye limit; PO machine handles it easily because the dedicated pass is one instanced draw, not a per-pixel loop).
cl_avfx_stars_procedural_largedefault 0 / 0=small dots only (recommended) / 1=allow up to 2x larger soft spritesAllow large soft sprites in the procedural background layer. OFF (default) caps the per-star size variance to a small range so every procedural background star renders as a small dot regardless of cl_avfx_stars_size. ON unlocks the full 0.6..2.0 size variance so ~half the procedural background gets larger soft sprites — looks like a sky with a few bigger stars in the background, but those larger sprites can overlap the angular position of bright real catalog stars at the same screen area. Recommended OFF when real catalog is enabled.
cl_avfx_stars_real_bright_sizedefault 0.0 / range 0.0..4.0 / step 0.05Extra apparent-magnitude diameter multiplier for the brightest real catalog stars. 0.0 (default) keeps the accepted compact sizing. Higher values make stars with low/negative visual magnitude (Sirius, Canopus, Vega, Rigel, Betelgeuse-class anchors) visibly larger than ordinary catalog stars while leaving the faint procedural background unchanged.
cl_avfx_stars_real_brightnessdefault 3.00 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Real catalog point-star brightness multiplier (separate from cl_avfx_stars_brightness which controls the full star layer). 3.0 (default) — accepted brightness level matching the classic catalog look. Decrease for dimmer recognizable stars.
cl_avfx_stars_real_catalogdefault 1 / 0 or 1Master toggle for the real catalog point-star path. ON (default) renders the real Hipparcos-anchored bright stars catalog as crisp point splats at proper RA/Dec coordinates — same crisp angular evaluation as the classic-tier catalog, with a much larger star count. OFF reverts to the classic fallback path (hand-curated 56 bright anchors + 27 hand-curated constellation segments + built-in background). Visible only when cl_avfx_stars 1. No texture sampling — stars are evaluated per-pixel against catalog directional data.
cl_avfx_stars_real_colordefault 1 / 0 or 1When ON (default), real catalog stars use spectral B-V bucketed RGB tints from the catalog (cool blue O/B / white A / yellow-white F / yellow G / orange K / red M). When OFF, all stars render as pure white. The accepted Hertzsprung-Russell spectral classification is the source of the tint — Sirius white, Betelgeuse red, Rigel blue-white, etc.
cl_avfx_stars_real_countdefault 1625 / range 64..2048 / step 16Requested active star count from the real catalog. The current fragment-shader path is internally capped to the brightest 256 stars for performance; a future point/instanced pass should lift this to the full catalog without sky-pixel cost.
cl_avfx_stars_real_godrays0=Off / 1=On (default 0)Allow real catalog stars to emit Sun God Rays streaks. OFF default: stars stay visible, but do not create streaks. Requires cl_avfx 1, an active star pass and God Rays (cl_avfx_sun_godrays 1). With the toggle off that star class is routed around the radial blur instead of feeding it, so the stars stay visible but emit no streaks.
cl_avfx_stars_real_sizedefault 0.05 / range 0.05..4.0 / step 0.05Angular size multiplier for real catalog point stars. 0.05 (default) renders each star at the same sub-pixel size as the classic catalog stars so the layers visually line up when blended (background_mode 2). Higher for slightly softer larger pin-points (still point-like — not blobs).
cl_avfx_stars_rolldefault 0 / range -180..+180 deg / step 1Manual roll offset (rotation about the view-forward axis) for the dedicated stars pass, in degrees. Live. Mostly a stylistic knob — real astronomy doesn't roll the sky.
cl_avfx_stars_sizedefault 0.20 / range 0.05..4.0 / step 0.05Visual size multiplier for star disks. 0.20 (default) gives tight pin-point stars; 0.05 = extremely tight sub-pixel stars; up to 4.0 for soft larger disks. Magnitudes still drive the per-star size variation underneath.
cl_avfx_stars_sync_debugdefault 0 / 0=off, >0=diagnostic (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: AVFX star-field synchronization diagnostic. 0=off. Not archived, no menu; zero cost at 0.
cl_avfx_stars_twinkle_strengthdefault 0.0 / range 0..1 / 0=no twinkle (stable), 1=legacy 6%% modulationAmplitude multiplier for the real-catalog star twinkle (per-star deterministic sin oscillation). Codex round-5 (2026-06-01) binding: default 0.0 for the temporal stabilization pass after PO reported real stars appearing/disappearing during camera motion. At 1.0 reaches the legacy 0.06 amplitude (~6%% peak modulation). Applies only to bright catalog stars (bloom_w > 0). Internal — no menu row in this landing.
cl_avfx_stars_white_twinkle_fractiondefault 0.00 / range 0..0.50Fraction of ordinary (non-coloured) white / cold stars that also twinkle, using the same smooth deterministic model as the coloured subset. Default 0.00 because the main intent is for the rare coloured stars to pulse. Independent from cl_avfx_stars_colorful_fraction; pulse strength still comes from cl_avfx_stars_colorful_twinkle.
cl_avfx_stars_yawdefault 0 / range -360..+360 deg / step 1Manual yaw offset (azimuth around the celestial axis) for the dedicated stars pass, in degrees. Live — changes apply immediately without map reload. Added to the auto-rotation contribution when cl_avfx_stars_orientation_mode is 1 or 2.
cl_avfx_static_sky_cell16..128 world units (default 48)Cell size, in world units, of the static whole-map sky-exposure cache the accelerated backend builds at map load. Smaller cells reject non-sky areas more precisely but cost more traces during the build; larger cells build faster and reject more coarsely. Changing the value triggers a single-frame rebuild. Accelerated backend only (cl_avfx_backend 1); the Classic backend ignores this cvar entirely.
cl_avfx_storm0=no storm (default) / 1=storm enabled (rain preset only)Optional storm event layer for the rain preset. When enabled with cl_avfx_preset=1 and cl_avfx_lightning=1, schedules rare lightning flashes and (if audio is on) thunder one-shots. Inactive for any other preset.
cl_avfx_storm_density0.0..1.0 (default 0.65)Lightning/thunder event frequency baseline. Mean inter-strike interval is 30s..3s as the value grows from 0 to 1; per-strike jitter is ±50%. Multiplied by cl_avfx_lightning_frequency for the final cadence. Thunder volume also gets a small bias from this value.
cl_avfx_sun0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for AVFX sun disk in the sky. When enabled, a visible sun disk renders at the configured direction with cloud-aware dimming and horizon fade. Disk is rendered inside the AVFX sky fragment shader (sky-pixel only — no fullscreen draw indoors). Time mode (manual / day-cycle / real-clock) controls position. Scope of is the disk + position + cloud occlusion + diagnostic; world/entity lighting physics and god rays / sun shafts are separate later landings. When master is 0, the disk is fully suppressed and there is no shader cost.
cl_avfx_sun_arc_apex1..89 degrees (default 72)Peak elevation the sun reaches at local noon, in degrees above the horizon. Low values give a long low winter-like arc with permanently long shadows; high values give a steep summer arc with a short shadow at noon. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_sun 1 in a cycle/clock sun mode.
cl_avfx_sun_arc_yaw0..360 degrees (default 90 = +Y axis)Compass direction of sunrise, in degrees, for the moving-sun modes. It rotates the whole day arc around the vertical axis, so it decides which side of the map the sun rises on and which way shadows sweep. Requires cl_avfx 1 + cl_avfx_sun 1 in a cycle/clock sun mode; the manual sun mode uses explicit azimuth/elevation instead.
cl_avfx_sun_azimuthdefault 235 / range 0..359 / step 1 / degreesSun azimuth in degrees. Manual mode uses it as the exact disk azimuth; Day Cycle / Real Clock use it as the sunrise side of the sun arc. 0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west. Default 235 = accepted tuned manual direction.
cl_avfx_sun_brightnessdefault 0.50 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Sun disk brightness multiplier. 0.50 (default) baseline; up to 5.0 for cinematic overexposed sun; 0 disables disk emission but the body still affects later lighting phases.
cl_avfx_sun_cloud_occlusiondefault 0.90 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Cloud occlusion strength on the sun disk. 0 = sun ignores clouds (always at full brightness when above horizon); 0.90 (default) = clouds strongly dim the sun disk according to the AVFX cloud field while preserving readable glow through gaps.
cl_avfx_sun_color_bdefault 0.78 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Sun disk color: blue channel. 0.78 (default) classic warm sunlight (RGB 1.00 / 0.92 / 0.78 ≈ sunny warm).
cl_avfx_sun_color_gdefault 0.92 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Sun disk color: green channel. 0.92 (default) gentle warm bias.
cl_avfx_sun_color_rdefault 1 / range 0.0..2.0 / step 0.01Sun disk color: red channel. 1 (default) baseline warm. Lower for cooler/whiter sun, higher for warmer/yellower-redder.
cl_avfx_sun_day_lengthdefault 1440 / range 0.5..1440.0 minutes / step 0.5Day cycle length in minutes — how long a full 24h day takes when cl_avfx_sun_mode = 1 (Day Cycle). 1440 (default) = real-time 24h day; lower values create accelerated cinematic cycles.
cl_avfx_sun_elevationdefault -34 / range -90..90 / step 1 / degreesSun elevation control. Manual mode uses it as the exact disk elevation above horizon. Day Cycle / Real Clock use it as the steepness of the stable maximum-Q2-BSP sky semicircle: 6:00/18:00 stay at horizon, 12:00 reaches the true visible sky top / zenith. The cycle is not fitted to the current map AABB.
cl_avfx_sun_entity_lightdefault 3 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Sun contribution to entity ambient (monsters, players, items, models). 3 (default) = same strength as world light; 0 = entity ambient unaffected by sun; up to 3.0 for cinematic exaggerated sunlit characters. Added to the entity light point AFTER dynamic lights and BEFORE doublelight scaling.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for AVFX celestial god rays / sun shafts. Screen-space radial blur post-process from the sun's projected screen position (GPU Gems 3 Ch. 13 style). Independent from gl_bloom — sun shafts render even when global bloom is disabled. OFF (default) keeps the accepted AVFX scene unchanged; ON adds soft radial light streaks that visually trail from the sun through the rendered scene, fading smoothly as the sun moves behind the camera, drops below horizon, hides behind walls (no scene luma → no rays), or is fully covered by clouds. Requires cl_avfx 1 and cl_avfx_sun 1.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_cloud_beamsdefault 1 / range 0..1Master toggle for cloud SUNBEAMS — light shafts that break through the gaps between the visible volumetric clouds, layered on top of the base god rays. 0 = off (base god rays unchanged); 1 (default) = on. Needs cl_avfx + cl_avfx_sun + cl_avfx_sun_godrays + cl_avfx_volclouds and an AVFX sky (cl_avfx_sky 1 or 2). No effect on the map sky (cl_avfx_sky 0).
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_cloud_beams_gap_powerdefault 1.45 / range 0.2..4 / step 0.05Gap selectivity. Higher values make beams come only through clearer gaps; lower values let beams through thinner cloud too. 1.45 (default).
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_cloud_beams_intensitydefault 1.45 / range 0..3 / step 0.05Artistic brightness multiplier for the cloud sunbeams ONLY (the base god rays are unaffected). 0 = no beams; 1.45 (default) = balanced shafts; up to 3.0 = strong.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_cloud_beams_presencedefault 0.40 / range 0..1 / step 0.05How much nearby cloud mass is required before a clear gap becomes a visible shaft. Higher values suppress beams in nearly clear sky (so you get shafts through BROKEN cloud, not generic clear-sky streaks). 0.40 (default).
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_cloud_beams_softnessdefault 0.45 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Width of the cloud-presence ramp. Higher values make the shafts broader and softer. 0.45 (default).
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_cloud_maskdefault 0.90 / range 0..1 / step 0.05How strongly clouds mask the god rays. 0 = clouds do not affect rays (always visible regardless of cloud cover); 0.90 (default) attenuates rays via the accepted smoothed cloud transmittance while keeping them visible through light overcast.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_decaydefault 0.91 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Per-sample falloff multiplier along the radial ray (GPU Gems formula). 0.91 (default) gives smooth gradual fade; lower values fade faster (tighter rays); 1.0 = no decay (rays extend uniformly across all samples — usually too bright).
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_densitydefault 0.85 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Sample spacing / density along each radial-blur direction. 0.85 (default) gives the accepted long sun-shaft reach; lower values produce tighter rays close to the sun; higher values produce longer streaks across the screen. Combined with the sample count (cl_avfx_sun_godrays_samples) it determines how far rays extend from the sun.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_downscaledefault 2 / range 1..4 / integerRender scale factor for the god-rays radial-blur pass. 1 = full resolution (maximum quality, highest cost); 2 (default) = half resolution (recommended balance); 4 = quarter resolution (cheapest, may look blocky at high sample counts). This landing composes the rays inside the existing post-process resolve so this reserves a future explicit downscale control — current implementation always runs at scene resolution. Range preserved for forward compatibility.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_exposuredefault 0.15 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Final exposure multiplier on the accumulated radial-blur result (GPU Gems formula). 0.15 (default) keeps the accepted rays readable without washing out the scene; higher values produce stronger overexposed-style rays.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_intensitydefault 1.45 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Overall god rays intensity multiplier. 1.45 (default) gives the accepted strong sun-shaft strength when the sun is visible; 0 = invisible; up to 2.0 = cinematic strong rays. Multiplied by the final visibility envelope (horizon × front × screen × cloud × sun brightness), so this is the artistic knob on top of physically-emergent ray strength.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_samplesdefault 51 / range 8..96 / integerNumber of radial-blur sample taps from each fragment toward the sun's screen position. 51 (default) is the tuned quality/cost point; higher counts produce smoother continuous streaks; lower counts produce visibly banded rays but cost less. GPU cost is roughly linear in samples × screen pixels.
cl_avfx_sun_godrays_weightdefault 0.55 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Per-sample brightness weight (GPU Gems formula). 0.55 (default) gives natural tuned ray strength; higher values brighten each sample's contribution; lower values weaken.
cl_avfx_sun_halo_alphadefault 1.0 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Sun local sky-shader halo opacity multiplier. 1.0 keeps the previous tuned halo visibility. 0 makes the halo fully transparent. This multiplies halo brightness and does not affect the sun disk.
cl_avfx_sun_halo_brightnessdefault 1.0 / range 0.0..5.0 / step 0.05Sun local sky-shader halo brightness multiplier. 1.0 keeps the previous tuned halo intensity. 0 removes halo light. Values above 1.0 strengthen the glow.
cl_avfx_sun_halo_sizedefault 1.0 / range 0.0..4.0 / step 0.01Sun local sky-shader halo radius multiplier. 1.0 keeps the previous tuned corona around the sun disk. 0 fully removes the local halo/glow. Values above 1.0 broaden the glow without changing the sun disk size.
cl_avfx_sun_indoor_leakdefault 0.90 / range 0.0..1.0 / step 0.05Fraction of sun light that leaks into indoor / closed spaces. 0.90 (default) keeps interiors influenced by the celestial state without fully flattening them. 0 = no sun light leaks indoors; outdoor surfaces still receive normal sun light. 1 = indoor spaces receive the same celestial lighting as outdoor view. The gate uses the smoothed sky_exposure (~300 ms low-pass) so doorway transitions don't pop.
cl_avfx_sun_lighting0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for AVFX sun scene lighting. When on, the sun's position drives a runtime tint × intensity multiplier on world surfaces and an additive ambient delta for entities. Stronger at noon, warmer at sunrise/sunset, gated by cloud cover and by view-side sky exposure (~300 ms smoothed). 0 = sun disk still draws but level lighting is unchanged from baseline.
cl_avfx_sun_lighting_multiplier1..20 (default 5)Amplifies the SUN contribution to AVFX precipitation/water surfaces ONLY — water surfaces, puddles, runoff, rain streaks, snow and snowflakes — NOT world/sky lighting (those are tuned by cl_avfx_sun_world_light / cl_avfx_sun_brightness). Lets those surfaces stay bright at a sky-safe (low) sun brightness instead of over-darkening when cl_avfx_sun_lighting is on (PO Bugs/66). 1 = previous behavior, 5 = default, up to 20. No effect when cl_avfx_sun_lighting is off.
cl_avfx_sun_modedefault 0 (manual) / range 0..2 / 0=manual 1=cycle 2=real-clockSun position time mode. 0 = manual — use cl_avfx_sun_azimuth / cl_avfx_sun_elevation cvars verbatim (good for screenshots and tests). 1 = day cycle — 24h day passes in cl_avfx_sun_day_length minutes; cl_avfx_sun_time sets the starting hour. 2 = real local clock — sun position follows system time-of-day. Codex Q6 binding.
cl_avfx_sun_sizedefault 0.55 / range 0.1..5.0 / step 0.05Sun disk angular size multiplier. 0.55 (default) gives a visible tuned disk with glow; up to 5.0 for cinematic exaggerated sun; 0.1 = tiny pinpoint. Now ALSO scales sun scene lighting: a normalized, bounded area factor (size/0.55)^2 clamped to [0.05, 4.0], equal to 1.0 at the default size so the accepted default look is unchanged. A bigger sun lights world/snow/water/entities/sky more; a smaller sun dims them. The visible disk geometry and brightness are unchanged (scene illumination only, gated by cl_avfx_sun_lighting).
cl_avfx_sun_timedefault 8.75 / range 0.0..24.0 / step 0.25Hour of day 0..24 used by Day Cycle mode as the starting hour. Also used as a static value when mode = Manual but the user wants to specify by time-of-day rather than azimuth/elevation. 12 = noon (sun near peak elevation in default model).
cl_avfx_sun_world_lightdefault 2.60 / range 0.0..3.0 / step 0.05Sun contribution to world / level surfaces. 2.60 (default) = strong tuned sunlight on outdoor surfaces; 0 = no world tint from sun; up to 3.0 for cinematic bright daylight. Applied as a fragment-shader multiply after lightmap contribution and before fog. Gated by cl_avfx_sun_indoor_leak when the player is in a closed space.
cl_avfx_surface_fernsdefault 0 / 0..1 / step 1An independent Surface Objects category. Requires its master; Grass and Surface Materials are not required.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_color_bdefault 0.045 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base blue channel before scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_color_gdefault 0.28 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base green channel before scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_color_rdefault 0.12 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base red channel before scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_densitydefault 0.6 / 0.05..4 / step 0.05Fixed map population density. A change rebuilds placement once.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_diversitydefault 1 / 0..1 / step 0.01Varies fern crown, frond lengths, curvature, orientation and pinnate leaf shapes. 0 uniform plants; 1 full stable variety.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_dynamic_lightdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of objects to engine dynamic lights.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_celestialdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onMakes ferns follow the live AVFX sun/moon/cloud-transmittance state. Uses ferns-specific strength, floor and night tint rather than snow tuning.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_celestial_min_brightnessdefault 0.04 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Celestial brightness floor at a dark or moonless night. This is applied before local lights brighten individual fragments.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_celestial_night_tintdefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Amount of muted cool-green tint applied as sun/moon illumination approaches darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_celestial_strengthdefault 1.20 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Strength of sun and moon illumination on ferns after cloud attenuation.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_dynamicdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables engine dynamic lights on ferns: blaster bolts, muzzle flashes, rockets, explosions and similar gameplay sources.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_dynamic_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of dynamic-light colour transferred to ferns (red blaster, green BFG, orange explosion, etc.).
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_emissivedefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables the same AVFX map-emissive and spawn/teleporter-marker source families used by snow surfaces.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_emissive_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of emissive-source colour transferred to ferns.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_emissive_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of ferns to AVFX emissive source families.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_flashlightdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables per-fragment ferns response to the actual AVFX player flashlight cone.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_flashlight_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass brightness response to the flashlight cone; flashlight colour is preserved.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_lightningdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables ferns response to the shared bounded lightning-local pool, including meteor-impact illumination registered in that pool.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_lightning_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass response strength for local lightning strikes and meteor-impact lights.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_local_liftdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Common response multiplier for flashlight, lightning/meteor, dynamic and emissive local sources. It controls how strongly those sources restore visible daytime ferns in darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_light_min_brightnessdefault 0.02 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Absolute static-light floor before celestial/local lighting. Low values keep unlit night ferns dark; this is not an emissive term.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_lightingdefault 1 / 0=legacy static only / 1=responsive lightingMaster for responsive ferns lighting. 1 uses cached BSP light plus live sun/moon, flashlight, lightning/meteor, engine dynamic and AVFX emissive sources. 0 restores the previous static-only ferns shading.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_qualitydefault 3 / 0..3 / step 1Leaf curve detail. Plant positions and visibility do not depend on this setting.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_roughnessdefault 0.7 / 0.15..1 / step 0.01Leaf surface roughness; higher values soften highlights.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_seeddefault 0 / 0..16777215 / step 1Deterministic placement seed. Camera motion never changes the arrangement.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_shadow_strengthdefault 0 / 0..1 / step 0.01Strength of the contact shadow and additional flashlight shadow. Uses the wind-deformed geometry. The flashlight casts onto scene surfaces only inside its beam, with flashlight shadows enabled. Zero skips both shadow passes for this category.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_sizedefault 24 / 8..64 / step 1Plant scale in world units. Plants must fit their supporting surfaces.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_static_lightdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Multiplier for the per-cell cached BSP/static light sampled when the objects inventory is built.
cl_avfx_surface_ferns_winddefault 0.4 / 0..1 / step 0.01Continuous branch and leaf motion with fixed roots.
cl_avfx_surface_grass0=off (default) / 1=onEnable instanced grass over eligible flat and gently sloped static world surfaces. Requires the Surface Objects master (cl_avfx_surface_objects) to be on as well. Off by default; purely a client-side visual with no effect on gameplay, collision or the server.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_antialiasingdefault 3 / 0=off / 1=2x 2=3x 3=4x 4=5x 5=6x 6=7x 7=8xGrass geometry antialiasing quality. 0 uses one raster sample. Levels 1..7 accumulate 2..8 fixed sub-pixel samples of the original vertical blade geometry inside each frame. No level replaces distant blades with flat coverage. Default 3 = 4x.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_cell_sizedefault 128 / range 4..512 / step 4 / wuWorld-space size of a grass placement cell in world units. Smaller cells give finer placement granularity and more even coverage; larger cells are cheaper to manage. Changing this rebuilds the grass cell grid — it is a topology setting rather than a live cosmetic tweak.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_bdefault 0.18 / range 0..2 / step 0.02Base grass colour, blue channel in linear space. See cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_r for how the three channels combine. Raising blue cools the tint toward teal; 0.18 (default) keeps a warm natural green.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_gdefault 0.55 / range 0..2 / step 0.02Base grass colour, green channel in linear space. See cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_r for how the three channels combine. 0.55 (default) is the dominant channel of the natural green.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_rdefault 0.30 / range 0..2 / step 0.02Base grass colour, red channel in linear space. Combined with the green and blue channels it sets the overall blade tint before per-blade colour variation. 0.30 (default) with G=0.55 / B=0.18 gives a natural green.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_color_variationdefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Per-blade random spread of colour around the base grass colour. 0 paints every blade the exact base colour; 1.0 gives the widest natural mottling of lighter and darker blades. 0.35 (default) is a natural-looking variation.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_densitydefault 1.0 / range 0.05..20.0 / step 0.05Blade density multiplier applied on top of the quality profile. Higher values grow more blades per grass cell for a lusher lawn; lower values thin it out. 1.0 (default) keeps the density chosen by the quality tier.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_distancedefault 1400 / range 128..8192 / step 32 / wuGrass draw distance in world units, before the quality multiplier. Applies only with Distance LOD enabled. With LOD off, this value does not limit grass visibility. Larger values show grass further away when LOD is on; default 1400.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_heightdefault 22 / range 1..128 / step 1 / wuBase grass blade height in world units. 22 (default) is an ankle-to-shin height that reads well on most maps; lower values give a mown lawn, higher values give tall meadow grass. Per-blade random variation is added on top via cl_avfx_surface_grass_height_variation.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_height_variationdefault 0.45 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Per-blade random spread of blade height around the base height. 0 makes every blade exactly the base height for a uniform trimmed look; 1.0 gives the widest natural mix of short and tall blades. 0.45 (default) is a natural-looking spread.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_maxdefault 24 / range 1..64 / step 1Maximum number of actors that can influence the grass in a single frame. Actors beyond this count do not bend grass that frame; the nearest actors are prioritised. The effective limit is also capped by the quality profile. 24 (default) covers busy scenes.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_monsters0=off / 1=on (default)Nearby grounded monsters part the grass they walk through. Active in local single-player and DM-training only — never during demo playback or remote multiplayer. On by default; requires the interaction master to be on.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_player0=off / 1=on (default)Local player parts nearby grass as they move through it. Enabled by default and allowed both in local play and in permitted multiplayer AVFX modes. Requires the interaction master (cl_avfx_surface_grass_interaction) to be on.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_players0=off (default) / 1=onVisible other player models part nearby grass. This is a local visual only and is off by default; it is forced off under the multiplayer competitive limit. It uses only client entities visible in the current frame, so grass never reacts to players hidden behind walls.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_radiusdefault 42 / range 8..192 / step 2 / wuRadius around each actor, in world units, inside which grass bends away from them. Larger values clear a wider path through the grass; 42 (default) roughly matches a player's body footprint.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_recoverydefault 1.5 / range 0.05..10 / step 0.05 / secRecovery time constant, in seconds, for grass springing back upright after an actor moves away. Lower values snap back almost instantly; 1.5 (default) is a soft natural settle; up to 10 leaves a long-lasting trampled trail behind moving actors.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interact_strengthdefault 0.70 / range 0..2 / step 0.05How strongly actors bend the grass they are near. 0 leaves grass upright even inside the interaction radius; 0.70 (default) gives a clear natural push; up to 2.0 flattens blades hard around the actor.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_interaction0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for grass bending and parting around actors. When on (default), moving actors push nearby blades aside and the blades spring back afterwards. When off, grass ignores all actors and only the wind model animates it. The per-source sub-toggles below have no effect while this master is off.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_celestialdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onMakes grass follow the live AVFX sun/moon/cloud-transmittance state. Uses grass-specific strength, floor and night tint rather than snow tuning.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_celestial_min_brightnessdefault 0.04 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Celestial brightness floor at a dark or moonless night. This is applied before local lights brighten individual fragments.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_celestial_night_tintdefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Amount of muted cool-green tint applied as sun/moon illumination approaches darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_celestial_strengthdefault 1.20 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Strength of sun and moon illumination on grass after cloud attenuation.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_dynamicdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables engine dynamic lights on grass: blaster bolts, muzzle flashes, rockets, explosions and similar gameplay sources.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_dynamic_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of dynamic-light colour transferred to grass (red blaster, green BFG, orange explosion, etc.).
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_dynamic_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of grass to engine dynamic lights.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_emissivedefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables the same AVFX map-emissive and spawn/teleporter-marker source families used by snow surfaces.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_emissive_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of emissive-source colour transferred to grass.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_emissive_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of grass to AVFX emissive source families.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_flashlightdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables per-fragment grass response to the actual AVFX player flashlight cone.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_flashlight_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass brightness response to the flashlight cone; flashlight colour is preserved.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_lightningdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables grass response to the shared bounded lightning-local pool, including meteor-impact illumination registered in that pool.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_lightning_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass response strength for local lightning strikes and meteor-impact lights.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_local_liftdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Common response multiplier for flashlight, lightning/meteor, dynamic and emissive local sources. It controls how strongly those sources restore visible daytime grass in darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_min_brightnessdefault 0.02 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Absolute static-light floor before celestial/local lighting. Low values keep unlit night grass dark; this is not an emissive term.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_light_static_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Multiplier for the per-cell cached BSP/static light sampled when the grass inventory is built.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_lightingdefault 1 / 0=legacy static only / 1=responsive lightingMaster for responsive grass lighting. 1 uses cached BSP light plus live sun/moon, flashlight, lightning/meteor, engine dynamic and AVFX emissive sources. 0 restores the previous static-only grass shading.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_lod0=off / 1=on (default)Distance level-of-detail. On (default) enables the draw-distance limit and reduces distant grass density. Off disables every distance-based visibility and density reduction: even a low stored draw distance cannot remove far grass. PVS visibility and the instance cap remain active. The competitive budget does not override this switch.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_max_instancesdefault 24000 / range 1024..8000000Hard cap on actual rendered grass cards per frame. Ultra permits up to 8,000,000 blades. Card count per placement depends on quality and density, never FOV or zoom. With LOD off, the budget selects a fixed population across the entire map; hidden cells retain their share so moving between rooms cannot replace visible grass. With LOD on, the budget is shared by the current visible cells.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_outdoor_only0=off / 1=on (default)When on (default), grass grows only on cells that are open to the sky, giving natural outdoor lawns. When off, grass is allowed on every eligible AVFX floor including enclosed indoor rooms. This is a topology setting — changing it re-evaluates surface eligibility.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_qualitydefault 1 / 0=Performance 1=Balanced 2=High 3=UltraGrass quality profile. 0 = Performance, 1 = Balanced (default), 2 = High, 3 = Ultra. Higher tiers grow denser grass with a richer blade mesh, extend the draw distance, and raise the interaction budget — at higher CPU and GPU cost. Ultra is the visual reference tier.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_shadow_strengthdefault 0 / 0..1 / step 0.01Strength of the contact shadow and additional flashlight shadow. Uses the wind-deformed geometry. The flashlight casts onto scene surfaces only inside its beam, with flashlight shadows enabled. Zero skips both shadow passes for this category.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_slope_maxdefault 65 / range 0..75 / step 1 / degMaximum surface slope, in degrees, that is allowed to grow grass. 0 restricts grass to perfectly flat floors; values up to 75 degrees let grass climb steep ramps and banks. This is a topology setting — changing it re-evaluates which surfaces qualify.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_widthdefault 3.0 / range 0.25..16 / step 0.25 / wuGrass blade width in world units. 3.0 (default) is a balanced blade thickness; narrower blades look wispy and fine, wider blades read as broad-leaf grass and fill coverage with fewer instances.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind0=off / 1=on (default)Master toggle for grass wind sway. When on (default), blades bend and ripple under the wind model. This works independently of any weather preset, so grass can sway with weather turned off. Turn it off for perfectly still grass.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind_angledefault 0 / range 0..359 / step 1 / degWind direction in degrees, controlling which way the grass leans. 0 (default) is the reference direction; the value sweeps a full circle so you can align the sway with a map's prevailing wind or its skybox.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind_speeddefault 1.0 / range 0..8 / step 0.1Wind oscillation rate — how quickly the sway cycles back and forth. 0 freezes the sway at a static bend; 1.0 (default) is a natural pace; up to 8.0 gives a fast, nervous flutter.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind_strengthdefault 0.55 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Wind sway strength — how far the blade tips bend away from vertical. 0 holds blades upright even with wind on; 0.55 (default) is a gentle natural breeze; up to 2.0 drives a strong storm-blown bend.
cl_avfx_surface_grass_wind_turbulencedefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05High-frequency turbulence layered on top of the base sway, breaking up the uniform motion with small chaotic flutters. 0 gives a clean single-frequency sway; 1.0 is the most turbulent. 0.35 (default) is natural. The effect is automatically reduced on lower quality tiers.
cl_avfx_surface_ivydefault 0 / 0..1 / step 1An independent Surface Objects category. Requires its master; Grass and Surface Materials are not required.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_clumpingdefault 0 / 0..1 / step 0.010: separate vines; 1: dense six-vine colonies only, with no isolated twigs. Fewer crowns balance the extra branches.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_color_bdefault 0.045 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base blue channel before scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_color_gdefault 0.28 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base green channel before scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_color_rdefault 0.12 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base red channel before scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_densitydefault 0.6 / 0.05..4 / step 0.05Fixed map population density. A change rebuilds placement once.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_diversitydefault 1 / 0..1 / step 0.01Varies branching, leaf shapes and runner lengths; some runners grow several times longer. 0 uses one uniform structure, 1 full variety. Stable until settings change.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_dynamic_lightdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of objects to engine dynamic lights.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_celestialdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onMakes ivy follow the live AVFX sun/moon/cloud-transmittance state. Uses ivy-specific strength, floor and night tint rather than snow tuning.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_celestial_min_brightnessdefault 0.04 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Celestial brightness floor at a dark or moonless night. This is applied before local lights brighten individual fragments.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_celestial_night_tintdefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Amount of muted cool-green tint applied as sun/moon illumination approaches darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_celestial_strengthdefault 1.20 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Strength of sun and moon illumination on ivy after cloud attenuation.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_dynamicdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables engine dynamic lights on ivy: blaster bolts, muzzle flashes, rockets, explosions and similar gameplay sources.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_dynamic_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of dynamic-light colour transferred to ivy (red blaster, green BFG, orange explosion, etc.).
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_emissivedefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables the same AVFX map-emissive and spawn/teleporter-marker source families used by snow surfaces.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_emissive_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of emissive-source colour transferred to ivy.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_emissive_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of ivy to AVFX emissive source families.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_flashlightdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables per-fragment ivy response to the actual AVFX player flashlight cone.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_flashlight_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass brightness response to the flashlight cone; flashlight colour is preserved.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_lightningdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables ivy response to the shared bounded lightning-local pool, including meteor-impact illumination registered in that pool.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_lightning_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass response strength for local lightning strikes and meteor-impact lights.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_local_liftdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Common response multiplier for flashlight, lightning/meteor, dynamic and emissive local sources. It controls how strongly those sources restore visible daytime ivy in darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_light_min_brightnessdefault 0.02 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Absolute static-light floor before celestial/local lighting. Low values keep unlit night ivy dark; this is not an emissive term.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_lightingdefault 1 / 0=legacy static only / 1=responsive lightingMaster for responsive ivy lighting. 1 uses cached BSP light plus live sun/moon, flashlight, lightning/meteor, engine dynamic and AVFX emissive sources. 0 restores the previous static-only ivy shading.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_qualitydefault 3 / 0..3 / step 1Leaf curve detail. Plant positions and visibility do not depend on this setting.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_roughnessdefault 0.7 / 0.15..1 / step 0.01Leaf surface roughness; higher values soften highlights.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_seeddefault 0 / 0..16777215 / step 1Deterministic placement seed. Camera motion never changes the arrangement.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_shadow_strengthdefault 0 / 0..1 / step 0.01Strength of the contact shadow and additional flashlight shadow. Uses the wind-deformed geometry. The flashlight casts onto scene surfaces only inside its beam, with flashlight shadows enabled. Zero skips both shadow passes for this category.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_sizedefault 24 / 8..64 / step 1Plant scale in world units. Plants must fit their supporting surfaces.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_static_lightdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Multiplier for the per-cell cached BSP/static light sampled when the objects inventory is built.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_top_biasdefault 0 / 0..1 / step 0.01Smoothly confines roots to the top of each connected wall: 0 all heights, 1 upper 12%. Long runners can hang below their roots.
cl_avfx_surface_ivy_winddefault 0.4 / 0..1 / step 0.01Continuous branch and leaf motion with fixed roots.
cl_avfx_surface_leavesdefault 0 / 0..1 / step 1Independent Surface Objects category; requires only the common master. Decorative geometry, no collision.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_clumpingdefault 0.5 / 0..1 / step 0.010 separate objects; 1 multi-object clusters. Cluster count decreases to balance added geometry.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_color_bdefault 0.055 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base color channel before material variation and scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_color_gdefault 0.20 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base color channel before material variation and scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_color_rdefault 0.38 / 0..1 / step 0.01Base color channel before material variation and scene lighting.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_color_variationdefault 0.5 / 0..1Smooth per-leaf hue variation from the chosen RGB; zero keeps its hue, one includes autumn, green and bluish shades.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_densitydefault 0.6 / 0.05..4 / step 0.05Stable map population. Placement rebuilds once when settings change, never when the camera moves.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_diversitydefault 1 / 0..1 / step 0.010 one structure; 1 varied silhouettes, proportions and orientations. Camera-independent.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_dynamic_lightdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of objects to engine dynamic lights.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_fall_amountdefault 10 / 1..100 / step 1Falling leaf quantity only: 10% by default, 1% minimum, 100% restores the original population. Ground litter is unchanged.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_fall_speeddefault 24 / 4..160Average downward speed in world units per second; individual leaves flutter, rotate and drift at different rates.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_fallingdefault 0 / 0/1Adds falling leaves where the full flight path is clear. Outdoor only applies to ground and flying leaves together. Off skips flight draws; ground placement is unchanged.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_celestialdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onMakes leaves follow the live AVFX sun/moon/cloud-transmittance state. Uses leaves-specific strength, floor and night tint rather than snow tuning.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_celestial_min_brightnessdefault 0.04 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Celestial brightness floor at a dark or moonless night. This is applied before local lights brighten individual fragments.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_celestial_night_tintdefault 0.35 / range 0..1 / step 0.05Amount of muted cool-green tint applied as sun/moon illumination approaches darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_celestial_strengthdefault 1.20 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Strength of sun and moon illumination on leaves after cloud attenuation.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_dynamicdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables engine dynamic lights on leaves: blaster bolts, muzzle flashes, rockets, explosions and similar gameplay sources.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_dynamic_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of dynamic-light colour transferred to leaves (red blaster, green BFG, orange explosion, etc.).
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_emissivedefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables the same AVFX map-emissive and spawn/teleporter-marker source families used by snow surfaces.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_emissive_colordefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Amount of emissive-source colour transferred to leaves.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_emissive_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Brightness response of leaves to AVFX emissive source families.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_flashlightdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables per-fragment leaves response to the actual AVFX player flashlight cone.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_flashlight_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass brightness response to the flashlight cone; flashlight colour is preserved.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_lightningdefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onEnables leaves response to the shared bounded lightning-local pool, including meteor-impact illumination registered in that pool.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_lightning_strengthdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Grass response strength for local lightning strikes and meteor-impact lights.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_local_liftdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Common response multiplier for flashlight, lightning/meteor, dynamic and emissive local sources. It controls how strongly those sources restore visible daytime leaves in darkness.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_light_min_brightnessdefault 0.02 / range 0..1 / step 0.01Absolute static-light floor before celestial/local lighting. Low values keep unlit night leaves dark; this is not an emissive term.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_lightingdefault 1 / 0=legacy static only / 1=responsive lightingMaster for responsive leaves lighting. 1 uses cached BSP light plus live sun/moon, flashlight, lightning/meteor, engine dynamic and AVFX emissive sources. 0 restores the previous static-only leaves shading.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_outdoor_onlydefault 1 / 0/1Leaves only on supports open to the sky, including falling leaves. Off also allows indoor supports; flight still requires a clear path.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_qualitydefault 3 / 0..3 / step 1Mesh detail. Fixed object positions and visibility never depend on quality.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_roughnessdefault 0.8 / 0.15..1 / step 0.01Higher values soften specular highlights.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_seeddefault 0 / 0..16777215 / step 1Stable placement seed; changes the arrangement on the map.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_sizedefault 8 / 2..16 / step 1Cluster size in world units. The complete footprint must fit its support, clear of openings and water.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_size_spreaddefault 0.5 / 0..1 / step 0.01Botanical size variation: 0 equal base size, 1 ranges from 65 to 125 percent; no boulder-sized leaves.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_static_lightdefault 1.00 / range 0..2 / step 0.05Multiplier for the per-cell cached BSP/static light sampled when the objects inventory is built.
cl_avfx_surface_leaves_winddefault 0.25 / 0..1 / step 0.01Restrained flutter of curled leaf tips; support points stay fixed.
cl_avfx_surface_materials0=off (default) / 1=onMaster toggle for AVFX Surface Materials — optional compatible material and wildlife layers over eligible static-world walls and floors that preserve the map's original texture and lighting. Off by default; client-only, with no gameplay, collision or server effect. Effective only when cl_avfx is also on.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brickdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onBrick family master: irregular masonry with real bump and parallax relief coating eligible static world walls and floors. The original BSP texture and lightmap stay underneath according to coverage and blend; map geometry, collision and gameplay never change. Off by default; with it off the family does no work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_alphadefault 0.78 / range 0.00..1.00Overall blend of the masonry into the original surface. 0 is a real no-op: the family stops sampling entirely.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_chippingdefault 0.25 / range 0.00..1.00Amount of broken corners and face fragments. A chip removes material: it changes the height and the material response, not merely the tint.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_color_variationdefault 0.25 / range 0.00..1.00Restrained material variation between individual bricks. It is stable per brick and never turns the wall into a multicolour pattern; it does not alter blend or coverage.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_coveragedefault 0.85 / range 0.00..1.00How much of the eligible surface is coated. At 1 the whole surface is masonry; below 1 broad irregular islands of the original texture stay exposed. It is a macro mask evaluated before any relief work, never random deletion of individual bricks.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_coverage_softnessdefault 0.25 / range 0.01..1.00Feather of the coated-area boundary only. It never changes brick or joint width.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onCoat eligible floors and gentle slopes. Independent of the wall lane, and floors ignore the wall band controls entirely.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_geometrydefault 0 / range 0.00..1.00Real geometric brick relief on tessellated world surfaces. Shading relief (bump and parallax) can never change a silhouette; this moves vertices, so bricks physically stand out of the wall and the edge of a wall stops being a straight line. It requires hardware tessellation and grows only outward from the authored surface, never behind it; collision is not affected. 0 is off and does no work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_irregularitydefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00Bounded stable variation of course drift, per-brick length and joint edges. It is deterministic in the world: it never depends on time, camera or quality.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_mortar_depthdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00How deeply the joint is recessed below the brick faces, within the overall relief. Independent of joint width.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_mortar_widthdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..1.00Width of the mortar joint between bricks. Independent of joint depth.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_reliefdefault 0.60 / range 0.00..1.00Overall strength of the visual bump and parallax relief: height, tangent normal response and parallax scale together. Faces stand proud of the joints and chips recess as the view angle changes. This is shading and UV offset only — no map geometry, collision, silhouette or depth is touched. Exactly 0 takes the cheap non-relief path and reports zero parallax steps.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_scaledefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Physical size of a brick and its course. Small = fine masonry; large = massive blocks. It does not change which world region selects which profile.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_bdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Blue multiplier over the resolved brick palette. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_gdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Green multiplier over the resolved brick palette. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_rdefault 1.00 / range 0.00..3.00Red multiplier over the resolved brick palette. 1 is neutral.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_variantdefault 0 / 0=Auto / 1..6 fixed profileMasonry appearance. 0 = Auto: broad stable world regions choose the profile and at most two neighbouring profiles meet in a soft boundary, blended into ONE course grid rather than two overlaid grids. 1 clean masonry; 2 aged uneven; 3 exposed under plaster; 4 dark industrial; 5 pale masonry; 6 damp chipped relief. Profiles differ in brick size, bond, joint width and depth, irregularity and relief calibration, not only in colour.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_distributiondefault 0 / 0=uniform, 1=bottom-up bandHow the masonry is spread over a wall. 0 = uniform over the whole surface. 1 = a bottom-up band, as if the wall is faced from its base. Floors are unaffected by this setting.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_fadedefault 0.18 / range 0.01..1.00Smooth width of the band boundary. The boundary is always broken by world noise, so it never reads as a straight horizontal line.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_heightdefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00How far the coated band reaches up the wall. Ignored when the distribution is uniform and on floors.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onCoat eligible vertical and steep wall surfaces. Independent of the floor lane.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_coverings_orderdefault 0 / 0=Floor layer below Wall layer, 1=Wall layer below Floor layerWhich of the two Surface Coverings layers lies underneath when both cover the same face. It moves only these two relative to each other and never against the other material families; it is a uniform, so switching it compiles nothing.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracksdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onCracks family master: hairline, branching, network, chipped and deep fractures worn into eligible static world walls and floors. It is damage in the existing material, not black lines drawn on top, and it never changes collision or gameplay. Off by default; with it off the family does no work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_alphadefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00Overall blend of the damage into the original surface. 0 is a real no-op: the family stops sampling entirely.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_branchingdefault 0.50 / range 0.00..1.00How strongly secondary branches grow off the primary crack. It does not add new independent systems.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_cavity_darknessdefault 0.65 / range 0.00..1.00How dark the inside of the cavity becomes. It only dims the already lit substrate, never paints flat black and never emits light or bloom; at 0 the relief and the chipped rim remain.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_chippingdefault 0.30 / range 0.00..1.00Amount of broken and spalled rim around the cracks, with fragments of exposed substrate. It is tied to the crack itself, not a broad dirt overlay.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_densitydefault 0.32 / range 0.00..1.00How much of the surface carries crack systems. Low values leave broad intact areas, which is what keeps damage believable. 0 disables sampling like alpha 0.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_depthdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00Bounded cavity and micro-relief response: how deep the damage reads under the scene light. Geometry, collision and depth buffer are never touched.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_edge_softnessdefault 0.20 / range 0.00..1.00Width of the anti-aliased transition at the crack rim. It softens the edge, and at its default it never erases fine hairline cracks.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_floorsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onDamage eligible floors and gentle slopes. Independent of the wall lane, and floors ignore the wall band controls entirely.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_scaledefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00World size of a damage system. Small = many small local systems; large = few sweeping fractures. It never changes the line width.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_variantdefault 0 / 0=Auto / 1..6 fixed profileDamage appearance. 0 = Auto: broad stable world regions choose the profile and at most two neighbouring profiles meet in a soft boundary. 1 hairline cracks; 2 branching structural; 3 dry crack network; 4 chipped surface; 5 deep fractured; 6 irregular mixed damage. Profiles differ in centreline topology, branch angles, gap scale and rim geometry, not only in threshold or colour.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_wall_distributiondefault 0 / 0=uniform, 1=bottom-up bandHow damage is spread over a wall. 0 = uniform over the whole surface. 1 = a bottom-up band, as if the wall is worn from its base. Floors are unaffected by this setting.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_wall_fadedefault 0.18 / range 0.01..1.00Smooth width of the damage-band boundary. The boundary is always broken by world noise, so it never reads as a straight horizontal line.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_wall_heightdefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00How far the damage band reaches up the wall. Ignored when the distribution is uniform.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_wallsdefault 1 / 0=off, 1=onDamage eligible vertical and steep wall surfaces. Independent of the floor lane.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_cracks_widthdefault 0.45 / range 0.00..2.00Width of the crack around its own centreline. It expands or contracts the same cracks without changing where they run or how they branch.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlersdefault 0 / 0=off, 1=onWildlife family master: insects, tadpoles, snails and Snakes living on eligible static world surfaces along stable world routes. A local visual layer only - it never changes server gameplay, networking, demos or map files. Off by default; with it off the family does no work.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_alphadefault 0.85 / range 0.00..1.00How strongly the creatures show over the original surface. 0 is a real no-op: no route maths and no texture samples.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_audio_fliesdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onPositional buzzing around Snake remains after corpse flies arrive. Different carcasses use independent voices and sound variants.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_audio_flies_volumedefault 0.42 / range 0.00..1.00Corpse-fly buzz volume before the global AVFX audio volume.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_audio_hissdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onPositional Snake hiss. A one-shot starts only when a Snake opens its mouth and shoots its tongue. Independent Snakes may hiss at the same time.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_audio_hiss_volumedefault 0.70 / range 0.00..1.00Snake hiss volume before the global AVFX audio volume.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blooddefault 1 / 0=off / 1=onSpread local visual blood from a Snake cut point over its supporting surface or puddle.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blood_alphadefault 0.82 / range 0.00..1.00Peak opacity of Snake blood.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blood_persistencedefault 1.00 / range 0.10..4.00Lifetime multiplier for Snake blood.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blood_sizedefault 1.00 / range 0.25..4.00Final blood spread size; puddles use a wider contour-clipped film.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_blood_spread_speeddefault 1.00 / range 0.10..4.00Speed at which blood expands from the cut point.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_clusteringdefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00How much the creatures gather into local groups instead of spreading evenly. It shifts group density smoothly and never makes them blink in and out.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_color_variationdefault 0.35 / range 0.00..1.00How much individual creatures differ in colour. At 0 every creature of a species shares one tone; higher values spread their tone so a wall is not a row of identical clones. The spread is stable per creature, so one crawler keeps its colour for its whole life.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contact_lavadefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onLet lava destroy local decorative wildlife. This is cosmetic and does not affect server gameplay.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contact_lightningdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onLet AVFX lightning strikes destroy nearby local decorative wildlife.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contact_meteorsdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onLet falling meteor impacts destroy nearby local decorative wildlife.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contact_weaponsdefault 0 / 0=off / 1=onLet local weapon impacts destroy wildlife. The affected area follows weapon power. No server damage, score or networking is changed.
cl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contrastdefault 0.55 / range 0.00..1.00How hard the creatures read against the surface they walk on.
