Network God and Ping Adaptation

Variables in this section: 63.

VariableAccepted valuesDescription
cl_network_god_auto_autoport0=deny (default) / 1=allowAutomatic permission: allow scheduling the existing fast RTT port probe for the NEXT connection. It never starts a live-session port scan and never runs during a match.
cl_network_god_auto_confirmed0=not confirmed (default) / 1=permissions confirmedRecords that you have seen and accepted the Automatic permission list. Automatic mode refuses to start until this is set, and only the permission dialog sets it — that is why editing a config alone can never arm automation. Open Network God, Permissions, and use Review and enable Automatic to grant it.
cl_network_god_auto_guardian0=deny (default) / 1=allowAutomatic permission: allow bounded connection recovery after an exact, confident link failure. The Guardian's own limits still apply, and its forbidden reasons — a kick, a ban, a password refusal, your own disconnect, a local stall — are never overridden.
cl_network_god_auto_jitter_shield0=deny (default) / 1=allowAutomatic permission: allow the remote presentation buffer to be sized automatically. It never exceeds cl_network_god_jitter_max_ms and never touches your own player.
cl_network_god_auto_laghax0=deny / 1=allow (default)Automatic permission: allow the accepted adaptive Laghax mode to be enabled for the session while prediction corrections grow. The change is session-only — your own cl_laghax value returns on disconnect or when the mode leaves Automatic — unless you explicitly keep it.
cl_network_god_auto_packetdup0=deny / 1=allow (default)Automatic permission: allow Q2PRO command redundancy (cl_packetdup) to be raised inside the protocol bounds, and only on exact evidence that commands are being lost. Session-only like every other automatic change.
cl_network_god_auto_rebaseline0=keep the old window / 1=restart measurements (default)When a critical LOCAL network setting really changes, or the player runs net_restart, discard the entire older measurement window and learn the connection again. This prevents a socket transition, packet-schedule change, ping adaptation change or prediction-model change from being misdiagnosed as a real network incident. Server commands and ordinary network fluctuations never trigger it.
cl_network_god_cooldown_sec5 .. 300 seconds, default 30Minimum pause between two applied changes, in seconds. It prevents oscillation: after an action is applied and verified, nothing new may be applied until this time has passed.
cl_network_god_debug0=off (default) / 1=log Network God events to console (diagnostic, current session only)Event-based diagnostic logging for Network God: mode changes, connection generations, governor transitions and transport attach/detach. Never prints per packet. 0 = off (default) and costs nothing; the complete current state is always available on demand through network_god_info.
cl_network_god_guardian0=off (default) / 1=onConnection Guardian master. Attempts a bounded reconnection to the SAME server when the connection goes silent while the game itself is still running normally. It never reacts to a kick, a ban, a password refusal, your own disconnect, demo playback, a local freeze, an armed Network Lab or a running port scan, and an explicit refusal stops it for that incident for good. Requires Network God to be on.
cl_network_god_guardian_attempts1 .. 10, default 3Maximum recovery attempts for one incident. After the last one the guardian stops and reports why instead of looping.
cl_network_god_guardian_backoff_ms250 .. 10000 ms, default 1000Pause before the first recovery attempt, in milliseconds. Each further attempt doubles it up to a hard internal cap, so a server that stays down is not hammered.
cl_network_god_guardian_debug0=off (default) / 1=log guardian events to console (diagnostic, current session only)Log Connection Guardian incidents to the console: the measured silence, the threshold that was used, every refusal reason and every attempt. Never prints per packet.
cl_network_god_guardian_silence_ms0 = derive a safe threshold (default), otherwise 1000 .. 30000 msHow long the server must be silent before recovery may start, in milliseconds. 0 derives a safe threshold from the measured server rate and your round-trip time, which is the recommended setting. A non-zero value below 1000 is raised to 1000 so a single lost burst can never trigger a reconnect.
cl_network_god_history_sec30 .. 600 seconds, default 180How much recent history the incident timeline and the reports keep, in seconds. It bounds what is displayed and exported; it does not change how the connection is measured.
cl_network_god_hud0=off (default) / 1=status strip / 2=text / 3=strip + textThe optional in-game Network God status. 0 = off (default): no layout and no drawing at all. 1 = the status strip, a chain of seven circles showing the current stage of the control cycle. 2 = one or two localized text lines. 3 = both. The two presentations are independent; neither requires the other. With Network God itself off, an enabled status draws only a static OFF state and starts nothing.
cl_network_god_hud_alpha0.2 .. 1.0, default 0.90Opacity of the status. The state colours keep their meaning at every value, and every state also carries its own glyph.
cl_network_god_hud_anchor0..8: 0=top left, 1=top center, 2=top right, 3=middle left, 4=middle, 5=middle right, 6=bottom left, 7=bottom center, 8=bottom right (default)Screen corner or edge the status is attached to. The offsets are counted from this anchor, so changing the anchor moves the status without losing your fine positioning.
cl_network_god_hud_auto_hide0=always show / 1=auto-hide when healthy (default)Automatically hide the Network God status after the connection check completes without a problem. A new connection, net_restart, a changed critical client network setting, or a newly detected warning/problem reveals it immediately. Routine periodic background scans do not reopen a settled healthy status. When a real problem clears, a fresh hide delay starts. Opening the Network God overlay or HUD edit mode keeps the status visible for comparison.
cl_network_god_hud_auto_hide_sec1 .. 60 seconds, default 5How many seconds a completed healthy connection result remains visible before automatic hiding. The delay restarts after an explicit connection/rebaseline trigger or after a recovered real problem. Warnings and errors remain visible; routine background collection does not reopen an already hidden healthy status.
cl_network_god_hud_labels0=glyphs only / 1=stage captions (default)Write a short stage name under every circle of the status strip (LINK, OBSRV, DIAG, PLAN, APPLY, VERIFY, GUARD), coloured by that stage's state. The glyphs mean: '-' waiting, '>' working, '+' fine or verified, '!' attention, 'x' trouble or rollback, and a purple 'S' marks synthetic Lab evidence. With captions off only the compact glyph strip remains. The full legend is always available on the overlay's Help tab.
cl_network_god_hud_motion0=static / 1=reduced / 2=smooth (default)How the status animates. Static removes the pulse and the smoothing while keeping every glyph, colour and value. Animation is presentation only: it can never change how often the connection is analysed, and packet arrival can never make the strip blink.
cl_network_god_hud_orientation0=horizontal (default) / 1=verticalDraw the status strip as a horizontal row or a vertical column. A narrow layout is the usual reason to choose the vertical form.
cl_network_god_hud_palette0=default / 1=high contrast / 2=colour-vision-safeColour palette of the status. Colour is never the only carrier of meaning — every state also has a stable glyph — so all three palettes convey exactly the same information.
cl_network_god_hud_scale0.5 .. 2.0, default 1.0Size of the status strip, its glyphs and the text line, independent of scr_scale and of every other overlay.
cl_network_god_hud_text_detail0=compact (default) / 1=detailedCompact is one localized line: mode, health, real and effective ping, observation progress and whether the evidence is real or synthetic. Detailed adds a second line with confidence, the governor state, the active override and the presentation buffer.
cl_network_god_hud_xbounded screen offset, default 0Horizontal shift of the status from its anchor. Dragging in edit mode writes the same value. The status is kept inside the visible area whatever the value is, at any aspect ratio, resolution or UI scale.
cl_network_god_hud_ybounded screen offset, default 0Vertical shift of the status from its anchor, with the same safe-area clamping as the horizontal one.
cl_network_god_jitter_debug0=off (default) / 1=log jitter shield events to console (diagnostic, current session only)Log Jitter Shield transitions to the console: buffer changes and the safe snaps taken on a teleport, a respawn, a model change or entity reuse. Never prints per packet or per entity.
cl_network_god_jitter_fixed_ms0 .. 200 ms, default 20The presentation buffer used in Fixed mode, in milliseconds. 0 shows other players exactly as the accepted interpolation does.
cl_network_god_jitter_max_ms0 .. 200 ms, default 60Hard ceiling for the buffer, in milliseconds. It caps the automatic sizing and is also the ceiling the Automatic permission may never exceed.
cl_network_god_jitter_mode0=auto (default) / 1=fixedAuto sizes the presentation buffer from the measured spread of packet arrival and keeps it within the maximum. Fixed always uses cl_network_god_jitter_fixed_ms.
cl_network_god_jitter_percentile90, 95 (default) or 99Which part of the measured arrival spread the automatic buffer aims to cover. A higher percentile is smoother and slightly later.
cl_network_god_jitter_shield0=off (default) / 1=onJitter Shield master. Shows other players a few milliseconds later so uneven packet arrival cannot tear their movement apart. It only affects how remote players are DRAWN: your own player, view, weapon, aim, hit registration, the commands you send and the frames you receive are untouched, and it never extrapolates a player into the future. Requires Network God to be on.
cl_network_god_local_off0=work on local servers too / 1=stay silent on local servers (default)Do not run Network God on a LOCAL server. Single player (a local server with deathmatch 0) is always excluded regardless of this value: there is no network path to diagnose there. With this on, a local deathmatch server behaves exactly like mode 0 - no facts, no diagnosis, no surfaces - and your chosen mode returns the moment you join a real server.
cl_network_god_mode0=off (default) / 1=diagnosis / 2=guided / 3=automaticNetwork God master. 0 = off (default): no measurement, no analysis, no queue, no override and no extra work of any kind — the client behaves exactly as it did without the feature. 1 = Diagnosis: measure and explain only; nothing is ever changed. 2 = Guided: propose one change at a time and wait for your explicit confirmation in the overlay. 3 = Automatic: apply only the changes you permitted under Permissions, verify each one against the measured result and revert it if it did not help. Automatic cannot start without its one-time permission confirmation, so editing a config alone never arms it.
cl_network_god_observe_sec5 .. 120 seconds, default 20Minimum time a connection must be observed before any change may be proposed, in seconds. A minimum number of valid samples is required as well, so a quiet connection simply waits longer instead of acting on thin evidence. The OBSERVE node on the status strip fills against exactly this window.
cl_network_god_overlay0=closed (default) / 1=openWhether the interactive Network God overlay is open. It follows the overlay itself, so it is normally toggled by the network_god_toggle command, its bound key or the menu rather than typed directly.
cl_network_god_overlay_alpha0.2 .. 1.0, default 0.92Background opacity of the overlay window. Text keeps full contrast at every value.
cl_network_god_overlay_h0 = default height, otherwise a bounded heightRemembered height of the overlay window; 0 means the default height for the current resolution.
cl_network_god_overlay_hints0=no hover hints / 1=hover hints (default)Hover hints inside the Network God overlay: pointing the mouse at any metric pops a detailed localized explanation of what that number means and why it matters. On by default — the dashboard is designed to be readable by someone who has never seen it before. Off leaves the bare values for players who already know them.
cl_network_god_overlay_local_off0=show the surfaces on local servers / 1=hide them (default)Hide the Network God overlay and status strip on a local server while the feature itself keeps measuring. Independent of cl_network_god_local_off, which silences the whole feature.
cl_network_god_overlay_scale0.5 .. 2.0, default 1.0Text and interface scale of the overlay window only, independent of scr_scale and of every other overlay.
cl_network_god_overlay_w0 = default width, otherwise a bounded widthRemembered width of the overlay window, written when you finish resizing it. 0 means the default width for the current resolution.
cl_network_god_overlay_x-1 = centred (default), otherwise a screen coordinateRemembered horizontal position of the overlay window. It is written when you finish dragging the window; -1 means centred. The window is clamped to the visible area on every frame, so a stale value can never hide it off-screen.
cl_network_god_overlay_y-1 = centred (default), otherwise a screen coordinateRemembered vertical position of the overlay window; -1 means centred. Same clamping as the horizontal position.
cl_network_god_policy0=cautious (default) / 1=balanced / 2=responsiveHow eagerly Network God proposes a change. Cautious needs stronger evidence and waits longer; Responsive reacts sooner. The policy shifts thresholds only — it never widens what may be changed, so a responsive policy has exactly the same permissions as a cautious one.
cl_network_god_report_include_server0=redacted pseudonym (default) / 1=literal server addressPut the literal server address into copied and saved reports. Off writes a stable pseudonym instead, so the same server stays recognisable across reports without publishing its address.
cl_network_god_traffic_app_scan0=off (default) / 1=look for possible application sourcesOptional application-source analysis for the continuous traffic monitor. It stays idle unless continuous monitoring is on and sustained receive or transmit pressure was already measured. Then a sleeping worker may check whether Steam, a known torrent client or Windows Update owns an open network endpoint. This is only a possible source, never exact per-process byte attribution. Off (default) performs no process, service or endpoint scan.
cl_network_god_traffic_monitor0=off (default) / 1=continuous monitoringOptional continuous background-traffic monitor for long live matches. It measures receive and transmit across routed physical Internet carriers, including a VPN's physical underlay, subtracts the client's physical datagrams and requires sustained load before warning. Route-less hardware devices are excluded. Application discovery is controlled separately. It never captures content, closes an app or changes another program. Off (default) performs no repeated traffic sampling.
cl_network_god_traffic_rx_kbps64 .. 65536 KiB/s, default 1024Sustained non-game receive threshold in KiB/s. The value is derived from routed physical-carrier byte deltas after the client's own physical inbound datagrams are subtracted; it is an approximate contention signal, not ISP bandwidth.
cl_network_god_traffic_sustain_sec5 .. 60 seconds, default 10How long the receive or transmit threshold must remain exceeded before it becomes a warning. Short background bursts are ignored; an active warning also clears with hysteresis so it does not flicker.
cl_network_god_traffic_tx_kbps16 .. 65536 KiB/s, default 256Sustained non-game transmit threshold in KiB/s. Upload is tracked separately because a saturated upstream often raises latency and loss before a large downstream does.
cl_ping_adapt_auto_source0=range (default) / 1=playersWhere Automatic mode gets its target. 0 = Range: if your real ping is below cl_ping_adapt_range_min_ms, one target is chosen at random inside the configured band and then held stable for the whole session — it is not rerolled per packet or per evaluation. 1 = Players: follow the active opposing roster (OpenTDM: the other team, one player in duel and the mean in TDM; OpenFFA: the mean of all other active players). Spectators and you are always excluded. Range works on any mod; Players needs an exact roster adapter and otherwise adds nothing.
cl_ping_adapt_check_interval_ms250 .. 10000 ms, default 1000How often Automatic mode recomputes its target and refreshes the opposing roster, in milliseconds. Server status probes are coalesced and never sent faster than once per second, so a shorter interval simply reuses the newest sample instead of adding traffic. Peer pings older than max(5000, 3 x interval) are treated as stale and adaptation falls back to zero added delay.
cl_ping_adapt_debug0=off (default) / 1=log ping adaptation events to console (diagnostic, current session only)Event-based diagnostic logging for Ping adaptation: mode transitions, target changes, roster invalidations, capacity fail-open and connection-generation resets. Never prints per packet. 0 = off (default) and costs nothing; the full current state is always available on demand through the ping_adapt_info command.
cl_ping_adapt_manual_ms0 .. 1000 ms, default 30Absolute target ping for Manual mode, in milliseconds. The client injects max(0, target - real RTT); it can never make a link faster, so a target below your real ping simply adds nothing and the state reads baseline limited. The automatic cap cl_ping_adapt_max_ms deliberately does NOT apply here — a manual target is your explicit instruction.
cl_ping_adapt_max_ms1 .. 1000 ms, default 200Hard ceiling on the final target ping in Automatic mode, in milliseconds. It applies to both automatic sources (Range and Players) and never to Manual. If the computed target exceeds it the target is clamped and ping_adapt_info reports it as capped.
cl_ping_adapt_min_difference_ms0 .. 500 ms, default 15Minimum gap that must exist between your real ping and the opposing reference ping before Automatic/Players adapts at all. Adaptation runs only while real < (opponent - this value); otherwise nothing is added. Example: opponent 40 and a minimum difference of 15 means a real ping of 30 is left alone, while a real ping of 10 is adapted.
cl_ping_adapt_mode0=off (default) / 1=manual / 2=automaticPing adaptation master. 0 = off (default): no send adapter, no queue, no probes, no roster scans and no added latency at all. 1 = Manual: hold an absolute target ping of cl_ping_adapt_manual_ms. 2 = Automatic: pick the target from cl_ping_adapt_auto_source (a configured range, or the active opposing players on OpenTDM / OpenFFA). The target is ABSOLUTE, never added on top of your real ping: with a real 10 ms and a target of 30 the client injects about 20 ms, and if your real ping is already 40 nothing is added. Latency is produced by FIFO-delaying complete outgoing datagrams, so no packet is dropped, reordered or rewritten.
cl_ping_adapt_offset_ms-200 .. 200 ms, default 0Signed offset applied to the opposing players' reference ping in Automatic/Players mode: the target is (opponent ping + offset), then capped by cl_ping_adapt_max_ms. Negative values aim below the opponent, positive values above. Example: opponent 40, offset -10 gives a target of 30.
cl_ping_adapt_range_max_ms0 .. 1000 ms, default 30Upper bound of the Automatic/Range band, in milliseconds. Both bounds are additionally capped by cl_ping_adapt_max_ms; if that cap is below the configured minimum, the effective choice collapses to the cap.
cl_ping_adapt_range_min_ms0 .. 1000 ms, default 20Lower bound of the Automatic/Range band, in milliseconds. Range adapts only while your real ping is BELOW this value; at or above it nothing is added, because latency cannot be removed. If minimum and maximum are entered reversed they are normalized (swapped) deterministically and ping_adapt_info shows the effective pair.

Network, prediction and LagHax

Variables in this section: 98.

VariableAccepted valuesDescription
cl_async0=run synchronous, like original Quake 2 does / 1=run asynchronous / 2=run asynchronous, sync rendering to GPU (experimental, requires OpenGL 3.2 or higher)Controls rendering frame rate and physics frame rate separation. Default value is 1. Influence of cl_async on client framerates is summarized in the table below.
cl_fixedmove0=native command clock / 1=fixed 10 ms movement command tickNormalize the movement command clock to 10 ms ticks so input command timing is independent of rendering frame rate. Reduces movement-feel variance on high-fps and variable-fps setups; recommended for consistent strafing.
cl_fixedmove_debug0=no prints / 1=per-frame fixedmove timing prints (diagnostic, current session only)Print the finalized fixedmove command timing on each frame (accumulator, tick count, pending ms). Helpful for verifying that fixedmove is actually producing 10 ms ticks under a given fps setup.
cl_fixedmove_wait_debug0=no prints / 1=interesting events only / 2=verbose (every sub-cmd) (diagnostic, current session only)Diagnostic prints for the cl_fixedmove_wait_mode path: wait count before/after decrement, queued command-buffer size, drain flag, current upmove, and in_up held flag. Level 1 only prints sub-cmds where the wait counter was non-zero or the queue had pending commands (silent baseline so the console doesn't flood at 200 prints/sec). Level 2 is verbose — print every sub-cmd including idle.
cl_fixedmove_wait_mode0=legacy outer-frame wait / 1=fixedmove-aware 10 ms wait for cmd_buffer (default)Make the gameplay command-buffer wait advance on each 10 ms fixedmove tick instead of once per outer render frame, so movement aliases like double-jump (alias +2j "+moveup; wait; wait; wait; -moveup; wait; wait; wait; +moveup") keep their +moveup / -moveup edges on the 10 ms movement clock regardless of FPS. Default 1 — recommended together with cl_fixedmove (which is already the Q2PRO-X default movement clock). Only takes effect when cl_fixedmove is 1, cl_movement_feel_mode is NOT 1, and the client is in active gameplay; otherwise behaves like the legacy outer-frame wait. Set to 0 only for legacy outer-frame wait timing.
cl_http_blocking_timeout0..60HTTP blocking-op timeout (sec)
cl_http_debug0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)print HTTP download diagnostics
cl_http_default_urlurlDefault download URL to use when server doesnt provide one. Client will fall back to UDP downloading as soon as 404 is returned from default repository. Default value is "".
cl_http_downloads0/1Enables HTTP downloads, if server advertises download URL. Default value is 1 (enabled).
cl_http_filelists0/1When a first file is about to be downloaded from HTTP server, send a filelist request, and download any additional files specified in the filelist. Filelists provide a pushing mechanism for server operator to make sure all clients download complete set of data for the particular mod, instead of requesting files one-by-one. Default value is 1 (request filelists).
cl_http_insecure0/1Disable checking of server certificate when using HTTPS. Default value is 0.
cl_http_max_connections1..16Maximum number of simultaneous connections to the HTTP server. Default value is 2.

cl_laghax0=off (no smoothing) / 1=fixed window (cl_laghax_maxms) / 2=adaptive (stress-weighted window)Laghax mode: adaptive smoothing of prediction-error corrections so small authority-vs-local deltas are blended over time instead of snapping. 0 disables laghax entirely (legacy snap-to-server behaviour). 1 uses a fixed window controlled by cl_laghax_maxms. 2 is adaptive mode — the smoothing window varies with ping / jitter / loss / debt / gap stress per the weighting cvars.
cl_laghax_debt_weight0..1 (weight)Contribution of prediction debt (accumulated uncorrected error) to the adaptive stress function. Higher weight = more aggressive smoothing when the error backlog grows.
cl_laghax_debug0=no prints / 1=per-server-frame stats (diagnostic, current session only)Print laghax smoothing statistics on every server frame (current window, stress terms, applied error, blended output). Noisy — use only when tuning weights or investigating a specific case.
cl_laghax_gap_weight0..1 (weight)Contribution of authority-gap signal (delay between expected and actual authoritative frame) to the adaptive stress function.
cl_laghax_hud0=hide HUD / 1=show HUDDraw the real-time laghax HUD overlay in the top-right corner (or wherever you dragged it via laghax_hud_edit). Shows current mode, window size, stress terms, and optionally enabled-predict / physics-mode rows.
cl_laghax_hud_alpha0..1Opacity of the laghax HUD background and text. Independent from scr_alpha: laghax HUD uses its own opacity policy. If OLED UI breathing is enabled, the final alpha is modulated only by SCR_OledGetUiAlpha().
cl_laghax_hud_auto_hide0=HUD always visible / 1=auto-hide when unchangedHide the laghax HUD automatically when nothing changes for cl_laghax_hud_auto_hide_sec seconds: the network side of the stress model stays green and no predict switches on or off. A non-green network reading or a predict change (a user toggle or the automatic ping gate) shows it again. Prediction-error spikes (e.g. riding lifts) are deliberately NOT triggers.
cl_laghax_hud_auto_hide_sec1..60 secondsHow many seconds without changes before the laghax HUD hides (used only when cl_laghax_hud_auto_hide is 1). Any trigger shows the HUD again and restarts the countdown.
cl_laghax_hud_hide_deathmatch00=always honour cl_laghax_hud / 1=auto-hide HUD in deathmatch 0 (default)Visibility policy for the laghax HUD widget. When on (default), the on-screen widget auto-hides in deathmatch 0 contexts (single-player, coop, local maps) where a ping/jitter indicator is usually irrelevant. This affects ONLY the drawn widget; cl_laghax smoothing itself is unchanged. To see the HUD in single-player despite the default, turn this off.
cl_laghax_hud_hide_demo0=always honour cl_laghax_hud / 1=auto-hide HUD during demo playback (default)Visibility policy for the laghax HUD widget during demo playback (.dm2 and .mvd2). When on (default), the widget auto-hides while a demo is playing. This affects ONLY the drawn widget; cl_laghax smoothing itself is unchanged. The same toggle is mirrored on the Demo Player settings page for convenience — it's the same cvar, not a separate setting.
cl_laghax_hud_hide_local0=always show / 1=hide while a local server runs (default)Auto-hide the laghax HUD while a local server is running - your own sandbox does not need the widget. Affects the WIDGET only: cl_laghax smoothing keeps working exactly as configured.
cl_laghax_hud_pillarbox_workspace0=HUD clamped to content rect / 1=allow placement in pillarbox barsAllow the laghax HUD to be placed into the pillarbox side bars (the aspect-fit free area outside the content rect). When on, positions in the bars are accepted. When off, the HUD is clamped to the content rect.
cl_laghax_hud_scale0.5 .. 2.0, default 1.0Text-size multiplier for the laghax HUD widget only, independent of scr_scale and of every other overlay. 1.0 is the historical size; below 1.0 shrinks it, above 1.0 enlarges it. The widget frame, the error bar and the settings gear scale with the text, and the drag / hit-test area follows, so moving the HUD keeps working at any size.
cl_laghax_hud_show_physics_params0=no physics row / 1=show physics rowAdd a compact row to the laghax HUD showing the current movement feel mode, step smoothing mode (always visible including the q2pro default), plus legacy predict and fixedmove flags when effective.
cl_laghax_hud_show_ping_adapt0=hide the ping adaptation rows / 1=show them (default)Add the Ping adaptation rows to the laghax HUD: real ping, adapted ping, the delay actually being added, the configured mode with an explicit ON/OFF and its reason, the countdown to the next evaluation, and the opposing peer count and mean in Players mode. On by default. The rows appear only while Ping adaptation itself is enabled (cl_ping_adapt_mode is not 0), so leaving this on costs nothing if you never use the feature.
cl_laghax_hud_show_predict_params0=no predicts row / 1=show predicts rowAdd a compact row to the laghax HUD listing the weapon and player predicts that are currently enabled and effective. Updates live when you toggle a predict cvar in another menu.
cl_laghax_hud_show_predict_runtime0=no runtime row / 1=show runtime rows (diagnostic, current session only)Diagnostic HUD toggle. Adds live runtime rows to the laghax HUD that visualise the internal state of the weapon predictor (ghost layer): ammo admission counters, weapon switch gate, predicted gun animation frame, rocket and hyperblaster handoff/suppress counters, and muzzle-flash suppress counters for chaingun / machinegun / hyperblaster. When enabled and nothing is active, shows a compact rt: idle line. Does NOT affect weapon prediction behaviour — pure read-only visualisation of ghost bookkeeping.
cl_laghax_hud_xany int (signed)Laghax HUD X position in HUD-pixel coordinates. Positive = offset from left edge; negative = offset from right edge. Set automatically by laghax_hud_edit drag; edit manually for scripted layouts.
cl_laghax_hud_yany int (signed)Laghax HUD Y position in HUD-pixel coordinates. Positive = offset from top edge; negative = offset from bottom edge. Usually driven by laghax_hud_edit.
cl_laghax_jitter_weight0..1 (weight)Contribution of ping jitter (variance) to the adaptive stress function. Higher weight = bigger smoothing window when the connection is jittery.
cl_laghax_loss_weight0..1 (weight)Contribution of packet loss / disturbance / drops to the adaptive stress function. Higher weight = more smoothing when packets are being dropped.
cl_laghax_maxms0..150 (milliseconds)Hard safety cap for the smoothing window in milliseconds — no matter how high the adaptive stress gets, the window will not exceed this value. Protects against pathological cases with very high ping or stuck correction state.
cl_laghax_maxwindow0..120 (milliseconds)Adaptive-mode target cap before the hard clamp kicks in. Controls the ceiling of the adaptive stress function; cl_laghax_maxms is the final safety clamp on top.
cl_laghax_minerror0..8 (quake units)Errors below this threshold (in quake-world units) snap instantly instead of being smoothed. Prevents laghax from chasing sub-pixel noise.
cl_laghax_ping_weight0..1 (weight)Contribution of ping to the adaptive stress function. Higher weight = bigger smoothing window under higher ping. Part of the weighted sum that determines the adaptive window.
cl_maxfps0..1000Specifies client physics frame rate if cl_async 1 or 2 is used. Otherwise, limits both rendering and physics frame rates. Default value is 60.
cl_net_clientport_autoprobe0=off (default) / 1=pre-connect challenge-RTT probe / 2=live-session scan (XQ3E-exact)Client UDP source-port auto-selection. Three modes. 0 = off (default). 1 = bounded pre-connect probe: opens independent probe sockets, fires getchallenge in parallel, scores each by reply RTT, picks the winner, then enters the real connect. Fast and safe but the metric is challenge RTT, NOT the gameplay ping the HUD shows. 2 = XQ3E-exact live-session scan (Q2PRO-X adaptation of XQ3E's x_net_port_renew machine): on ca_active, scans a fixed 20 candidate slots — slot 0 = current port, slots 1..19 = XQ3E's random formula (rand%320)*(rand%100)+10000. For each slot, it rebinds NS_CLIENT, drops the first 5 post-switch server frames (XQ3E skipSnaps), averages the next 16 per-snapshot RTTs (the closest Q2 analog of XQ3E's snapshot->ping), and moves on. On 2 s of no-progress the slot's port is REPLACED with a fresh XQ3E random draw and retried — not skipped. After all 20 slots settle, the lowest-average port wins. Deliberately intrusive: the gameplay socket rebinds up to 20 times and the player feels jitter until the scan finishes. qport preserves the session across rebinds. cl_net_clientport_autoprobe_ports is mode-1 only; mode 2 is always 20 slots. cl_net_clientport_autoprobe_time is a safety watchdog only for mode 2 — it does NOT trim the candidate set. connect_autoport <server> forces a one-shot mode-1 probe regardless of this cvar.
cl_net_clientport_autoprobe_indicator0=off / 1=show (default)On-screen blinking AUTO-PORT SCAN indicator while mode 2 (XQ3E-like live-session scan) is actively running. 0 = off. 1 = show (default). The indicator appears only during mode-2 scanning and disappears on finish, abort, or disconnect. Has no effect on mode 1 which runs before the real connect and is not long enough to benefit from an overlay.
cl_net_clientport_autoprobe_ports2 .. 60, default 6 (mode 1 only; mode 2 is fixed at 20 XQ3E slots)Mode-1 candidate count. Does NOT apply to mode 2 — mode 2 always scans 20 XQ3E slots. In mode 1 this is split into ~1/3 OS-ephemeral PORT_ANY probes and ~2/3 explicit spread-out random high ports in [10000, 30000]. Clamped to [2, 60]. Default 6 is conservative; mode 1 is fast and parallel, so wider sweeps (up to 60) do not meaningfully slow it down.
cl_net_clientport_autoprobe_settle_ms0 .. 10000 ms, default 0 (XQ3E-exact)Optional pre-scan grace window before mode 2 applies its first slot, in milliseconds. Default 0 = XQ3E-exact (no pre-scan delay; XQ3E relies on its 5-skip-samples post-switch rule to drop early noise). Range [0, 10000]. Raise this only if your target mod has unusually slow precache and you observe the first mode-2 slot landing inside a precache stall; most users should leave it at 0. Counts inside cl_net_clientport_autoprobe_time.
cl_net_clientport_autoprobe_time0.1 .. 180 seconds, default 2.5 (mode 2 realistically needs 60..180)Overall safety watchdog for the probe/scan, in seconds. Hard upper bound — the run will not exceed this. Mode 1 (pre-connect challenge-RTT) is parallel and usually finishes in a fraction of the budget as soon as replies arrive; the ceiling mostly protects against a silent server. Mode 2 (XQ3E-exact live-session scan) attempts the FULL 20-slot scan regardless of this value — the watchdog only fires as an abort ceiling if the whole scan takes longer than allowed, in which case the best-scored slot so far is applied. The cvar does NOT trim mode-2 breadth; a small value just means the scan may be cut short. A realistic full 20-slot mode-2 run wants ~60..180 s depending on ping / server snapshot rate; values below ~30 s emit a console warning at arm time. Default 2.5 s is sized for mode 1; mode 2 users should raise it.
cl_net_clientport_autoprobe_verbose0=off (default) / 1=print autoport progress to console (diagnostic, current session only)Controls whether the autoport probe/scan prints progress lines to the console. 0 = off (default): mode 1 and mode 2 still run exactly the same, just silently. 1 = on: every 'autoport:' status line is printed — start banner, candidate switches, per-candidate samples, winner, abort/fallback. Use this when you want to see what the probe actually did; leave it off for a clean console during normal play.
cl_network_lab_allow_remote0=local servers only (default) / 1=may ask on a real serverAllow the lab to ASK to be armed while you are on a real server. It only permits the question — arming still requires your explicit confirmation, and the lab never arms itself. On a local server no permission is needed.
cl_network_lab_bandwidth_kbps0 = unlimited (default), otherwise 8 .. 100000 kbit/sSynthetic bandwidth cap for the selected direction, in kilobits per second. 0 leaves the rate unlimited. Pacing is bounded and never blocks the game loop.
cl_network_lab_burst_mean1 .. 32 packets, default 3Average length of one loss burst, in packets. Used only by the Burst loss model.
cl_network_lab_debug0=off (default) / 1=log network lab events to console (diagnostic, current session only)Log Network Lab transitions to the console: arming, stopping, queue limits and fail-open. Never prints per packet.
cl_network_lab_delay_ms0 .. 1000 ms, default 0Base synthetic delay added in the selected direction, in milliseconds. It is clearly reported as artificial and is excluded from the real measured baseline.
cl_network_lab_direction0=outgoing / 1=incoming / 2=both (default)Which direction the synthetic impairment is applied to. Outgoing affects the datagrams you send, Incoming the ones you receive, Both applies the configured impairment to each direction independently.
cl_network_lab_jitter_distribution0=uniform (default) / 1=normal / 2=long tailShape of the synthetic delay variation. Uniform spreads it evenly, Normal concentrates it around the base value, Long tail produces rare large spikes like a loaded link.
cl_network_lab_jitter_ms0 .. 500 ms, default 0How much the synthetic delay varies around its base value, in milliseconds.
cl_network_lab_loss_model0=independent (default) / 1=burstIndependent drops single packets at random. Burst drops several consecutive packets, which is how a genuinely bad link usually behaves and is the harder case for prediction.
cl_network_lab_loss_pct0 .. 50 %, default 0Share of packets dropped on purpose, in percent. Synthetic loss is counted separately from real loss and never becomes part of the real baseline.
cl_network_lab_reorder_pct0 .. 50 %, default 0Share of packets delivered out of order, in percent. A reordered packet is delayed, never duplicated and never corrupted.
cl_network_lab_reorder_window2 .. 8 packets, default 2How far a packet may be moved out of its place, in packets.
cl_network_lab_seed0 = pick and show a session seed, otherwise 1 .. 2147483647, default 1The repeat code (seed) the impairment generator unrolls its randomness from. Two runs with the same code get exactly the same impairment for the same traffic, so results compare fairly. 0 picks a random code once per session and shows it in network_lab_info.
cl_packetdup0..5Number of backup movement commands client includes in each new packet, directly impacts upload rate. Unless connected using Q2PRO protocol, hardcoded value of 2 backups per packet is used. Default value is 1.
cl_predict0/1client-side player prediction
cl_predict_blaster0=no blaster prediction / 1=predict blaster muzzle (default)Predict blaster projectile and muzzle feedback. Fires a predicted muzzle + sound on attack; the authoritative blaster bolt from the server still flies, so this mostly eliminates the audible muzzle delay.
cl_predict_chaingun0=no chaingun prediction / 1=predict chaingun local fire (default)Predict chaingun local fire feedback with ramp-up-aware shot counts (1 shot for ticks 1-5, 2 shots for 6-10, 3 shots for 11+). Server MZ_CHAINGUN1/2/3 events suppressed via cg_mz_suppress_count. Covers both wall impacts and flesh hits.
cl_predict_debug0=production (dedup, silent) / 1=show both predicted and server streams / 2=show both + verbose prints / 3=suppression ON + diagnostic prints (diagnostic, current session only)Weapon-predict diagnostics level. 0 is production (predicted and server streams deduplicate correctly, no prints). 1 and 2 disable the duplicate-suppression gate so both the ghost and the real server event are visible on screen at the same time, for comparing timing and placement. 2 adds verbose per-frame diagnostic prints. 3 keeps suppression active AND prints classifier diagnostics (SUPPRESS:, HB_CLASS:, ammo gate blocks) so production-mode behaviour can be traced without losing dedup.
cl_predict_grenades0=no grenade launcher prediction / 1=predict grenade launcher muzzle (default)Predict grenade launcher projectile feedback (muzzle + sound). Grenade flight itself is not ghosted — the server projectile is authoritative — so only the fire-input latency is masked.
cl_predict_hand_grenades0=no hand grenade prediction / 1=predict hand-grenade throw feedback (default)Predict hand-grenade throw feedback: immediate pin-pull and throw sound on attack input, without waiting for the server to echo. The grenade entity itself remains server-authoritative.
cl_predict_hyperblaster0=no hyperblaster prediction / 1=predict hyperblaster local fire (default)Predict hyperblaster local fire feedback: per-tick ghost HB bolt with BSP-traced impact point (CL_GhostHBImpact). FIFO handoff matches server bolts by firing order so pairings are deterministic with ~10 bolts in flight. Server MZ_HYPERBLASTER suppressed via hb_mz_suppress_count.
cl_predict_machinegun0=no machinegun prediction / 1=predict machinegun local fire (default)Predict machinegun local fire feedback: per-tick ghost_mg_spawn with trace-driven bullet hits (ghost_cg_bullet reused for MG). Server muzzle flashes are suppressed via mg_mz_suppress_count matched to the number of predicted ticks.
cl_predict_move_modemodern=new Q2PRO/Q2PRO-X engine / legacy=q2pro-m/q2pro r1826 backendClient prediction backend. modern is the current new Q2PRO / Q2PRO-X prediction engine. legacy selects the old q2pro-m / q2pro r1826 behaviour — useful when a mod relies on the older prediction timing.
cl_predict_ping_dwell_sec0=instant gate flip / 1..30=seconds ping must hold before gate changes state (default 5)Dwell (hold) time in seconds that the ping must stay continuously on one side of the cl_predict_ping_min_ms threshold before the shared adaptive predict gate flips. The same gate governs both weapon predicts and player predict. A value of 0 means the gate flips instantly on any threshold crossing (useful for testing). The default of 5 seconds prevents rapid on/off thrash when ping oscillates around the threshold. Has no effect when cl_predict_ping_min_ms is 0.
cl_predict_ping_min_ms0=adaptive gate disabled (raw/master toggles only) / 1..200=minimum ping in ms required for predict admission (default 20)Minimum ping threshold in milliseconds for the shared adaptive predict gate. When 0, adaptive ping gating is disabled: weapon predicts are then governed only by cl_predict_weapons_enable plus the per-weapon toggles, and player predict is governed only by cl_predict_player. When > 0, the gate opens only after the measured ping (cls.measure.ping) has stayed at or above this value continuously for cl_predict_ping_dwell_sec seconds. The gate governs both weapon predicts (subject to cl_predict_weapons_enable and per-weapon toggles) and player predict (cl_predict_player). On a low-ping session the gate stays closed; on a high-ping session it opens after the dwell period. Closing the gate stops new weapon-predict admissions but does not wipe already-active in-flight ghosts — they drain normally.
cl_predict_player0=off / 1=local jump/fall prediction (gated by ping when min_ms>0) / 2=debug printsLocal player prediction mode for jump / fall motion. 0 disables player prediction entirely. 1 enables local jump and fall prediction (default). 2 adds debug prints showing predicted vs authoritative trajectories. When cl_predict_ping_min_ms > 0, player predict is additionally governed by the shared adaptive ping gate: it becomes effective only after ping has stayed at or above the threshold for the dwell period, and deactivates when ping drops below the threshold for the same period. This gate is independent of cl_predict_weapons_enable — turning off the weapon master does not suppress player predict. Set cl_predict_ping_min_ms to 0 to disable the adaptive gate and restore a raw always-on toggle.
cl_predict_player_debugdefault 0 / 0=silent / 1=print predicted and suppressed jump/fall events (session only) (diagnostic, current session only)Session-only diagnostic for the local jump/landing sound prediction (cl_predict_player). 1 prints one console line per event: each predicted landing class (EV_FALLSHORT / EV_FALL / EV_FALLFAR) with the computed fall delta and vertical speed, and every server-confirmed duplicate jump/fall sound the module suppressed. A live console cl_predict_player 2 still enables it for the current session (legacy spelling); the persisted value stays the 0/1 baseline. Never read from a config and never written by any config or preset writer; after a restart it is off again.
cl_predict_railgun0=no rail prediction, server copy only / 1=client-side ghost rail beam (default)Predict the rail beam instantly on fire with a client-side CL_GhostRailTrail. Duplicate server TE_RAILTRAIL is suppressed via GhostRail_ShouldSuppress. Rail fire and impact sounds always fire on the authoritative path.
cl_predict_rockets0=no rocket prediction, server copy only / 1=client-side ghost with handoff (default)Predict the local player's own rocket launcher projectile immediately on fire, rendering a client-side ghost rocket with a matching trail and light. The authoritative server rocket is suppressed on handoff so the player sees only one visible stream. Hides the RTT-ms gap between fire input and visible rocket.
cl_predict_rockets_explosion0=no predicted explosion / 1=predict rocket explosion at BSP hit point (default)Also predict the rocket impact explosion at the BSP-traced hit point the moment the ghost rocket reaches that distance. Fires particles + explosion sprite + dynamic light locally without waiting for the server TE_ROCKET_EXPLOSION. Requires cl_predict_rockets to have any effect.
cl_predict_shotgun0=no shotgun prediction / 1=predict shotgun muzzle + pellet hits (default)Predict shotgun muzzle and pellet hit visuals for the local player. Per-pellet BSP traces drive ghost_shotgun_pellet -> CL_GhostShotgunHit (particles + smoke for solid hits, fluid-colour splash for water). Legacy TE_SHOTGUN from the server is de-duplicated by GhostShotgun_ShouldSuppress.
cl_predict_super_shotgun0=no super shotgun prediction / 1=predict super shotgun muzzle + pellet hits (default)Predict super-shotgun muzzle and pellet hit visuals. Uses the same ghost pellet machinery as cl_predict_shotgun, just with the super-shotgun pellet count and spread.
cl_predict_weapons_enable0=all weapon predicts off (master disabled) / 1=weapon predict system active (default)Master switch for the entire weapon-predict system. When 0, all weapon predicts are disabled regardless of individual cl_predict_* toggles, weapon-side admissions are blocked, and weapon-predict telemetry disappears from the LAGHAX overlay. The shared adaptive ping gate itself still exists and may continue to govern player predict. When 1, the weapon system is active and admission is controlled by each per-weapon toggle plus the shared adaptive ping gate (cl_predict_ping_min_ms / cl_predict_ping_dwell_sec). Per-weapon settings are preserved when the master is off and resume immediately when it is turned back on.
cl_serverbrowser_alpha0..1Opacity of the modern server browser overlay window background.
cl_serverbrowser_compact0=full row spacing / 1=compact spacingUse compact row layout in the server list so more servers fit on screen at once.
cl_serverbrowser_custom_sourceURL / composite source stringURL for the 'Custom' source tab. Supports the same composite syntax as the internal favorites pipeline — e.g. 'favorites:// file:///servers.lst broadcast://' to override the default.
cl_serverbrowser_default_sortping / players / map / nameDefault sort column used when the browser opens. Changes take effect on the next open; click a column header to re-sort live.
cl_serverbrowser_default_source0=q2servers.com / 1=Favorites / 2=LAN / 3=Custom / 4=HistoryDefault source tab used on every browser open. Stable archived numeric IDs are preserved even though History is drawn after Favorites.
cl_serverbrowser_fullscreen0=compact window / 1=fullscreenExpand the browser overlay to fill the whole screen instead of the compact centred window.
cl_serverbrowser_hide_empty0=show empty servers / 1=hide empty serversHide servers that currently have zero human players (bots do not count as players for this filter).
cl_serverbrowser_hide_full0=show full servers / 1=hide full serversHide servers that are at capacity (current players >= max players, ignoring reserved slots).
cl_serverbrowser_max_ping0..999 (0 = no cap)Hide servers whose measured ping exceeds this threshold (in milliseconds). 0 disables the filter.
cl_serverbrowser_only_players0=show all servers / 1=only servers with humansOnly show servers that have at least one human player (excludes empty servers AND bot-only servers).
cl_serverbrowser_pillarbox_workspace0=clamp to content rect / 1=allow pillarbox barsAllow the browser overlay to be placed into the pillarbox side bars (aspect-fit free area). When off, the overlay is clamped to the content rect like any other HUD element.
cl_serverbrowser_row_colors0=uniform rows / 1=zebra stripesUse alternate row colouring (zebra stripes) for easier vertical scanning through long server lists.
cl_serverbrowser_scale0.5..3.0 (1.0 = default)Overlay font and UI scale multiplier. Match to your display DPI; 1.0 is default.
cl_serverbrowser_show_badges0=no badges / 1=show badgesShow game-mode / role / mod badges next to each server row (e.g. CTF, DM, OpenTDM, OpenFFA).
cl_serverbrowser_show_details0=hide detail panel / 1=show detail panelShow the expanded server detail panel on the right side of the browser (player list, rules, ruleset, mod info). Off collapses the browser to just the list for more scanning room.
cl_serverbrowser_show_down0=hide down servers / 1=show greyedShow unreachable / down servers greyed in the list instead of hiding them. Useful for spotting a favourite that just went offline.
cl_serverbrowser_show_passworded0=hide password-protected / 1=show password-protectedShow password-protected servers in the list (you can still join; you just need the password).
cl_serverbrowser_uimodern=Q2PRO-X overlay / legacy=classic q2pro browserPreferred UI variant. modern is the Q2PRO-X overlay added in this engine. legacy opens the classic q2pro address-book-driven browser (mostly for comparison).
cl_updaterate1..100Specifies the perferred update rate requested from Q2PRO servers. Only used when server is running in variable FPS mode, otherwise default rate of 10 packets per second is used. Specified rate should evenly divide native server frame rate. Default value is 0, which means to use the highest update rate available (that is, native server frame rate).
rate1000..1000000client bandwidth rate (bytes/sec)

aimfix0=stock (default) / 1=fixedGame library: fire from the exact view origin, fixing the stock aiming offset of weapon traces.

Remaining variables listed below are effective only when downloads are globally enabled. Default value is 1.
allow_download_maps0/1Enables downloading of files from maps/ subdirectory. Default value is 1.
allow_download_models0/1Enables automatic downloading of non-player models, sprites and skins. Default value is 1.
allow_download_others0/1Enables downloading of files from any subdirectory other than those listed above. Default value is 0.
allow_download_pics0/1Enables downloading of files from pics/ subdirectory. Default value is 1.
allow_download_players0/1Enables automatic downloading of player models, skins, sounds and icons. Default value is 1.
allow_download_sounds0/1Enables downloading of files from sound/ subdirectory. Default value is 1.
allow_download_textures0/1Enables automatic downloading of map textures. Default value is 1. Empty lines and lines starting with # or / characters are ignored.

cl_adjustfov0/1Specifies if horizontal field of view is automatically adjusted for screens with aspect ratio different from 4/3. Default value is 1 (enabled).

cl_altf4_exit0=swallow Alt+F4 / 1=Alt+F4 quits (default)Alt+F4 quits the game. When off, the OS close shortcut is swallowed so accidental Alt+F4 does not exit a running match. Intentionally defaults to on to match expected Windows behaviour.
cl_anglespeedkey0..5angle speed multiplier when +speed held
cl_autopause0/1Specifies if single player game or demo playback is automatically paused once client console or menu is opened. Default value is 1 (pause game).
cl_batchcmds0/1batch user commands per client frame
cl_beginmapcmdstringSpecifies command to be executed each time client enters a new map. Default value is empty.
cl_blend0/1apply screen blends (damage, picks)
cl_browser_font_mode0=legacy / 1=Iskra Cyrillic (default)Q2PRO-X browser/UI chrome typography. 0 = legacy 8x8 conchars + q2prox_cvar_font (cvar browser). 1 = Iskra Cyrillic Regular fixed-cell (default). Wired surfaces: server browser chrome, cvar browser cell draw (12x16), demo browser cell draw (8x8 base × user zoom), demo player overlay button/popup/timeline labels, modhelp local UI (title, search prompt, badges, scroll arrows, Cancel/Execute/Confirm). Cell stride is preserved per surface so selection / copy / column math / hitboxes are unchanged. Untrusted/raw byte streams stay on the legacy raw-byte path on every surface — server names, demo filenames, demo-recorded player names, configstring-derived chat etc. are intentionally NOT routed through Iskra. If the Iskra atlas fails to register, every wired surface falls back to its legacy renderer; failure is logged once.
cl_changemapcmdstringSpecifies command to be executed each time client begins loading a new map. Default value is empty.
cl_chat_filterbitmaskSpecifies if unprintable characters are filtered from incoming chat messages, to prevent common exploits like hiding player names. Default value is 0 (dont filter).
cl_chat_notify0/1Specifies whether to display chat lines in the notify area. Default value is 1 (enabled).
cl_chat_sound0=dont play chat sound / 1=play normal sound (misc/talk.wav) / 2=play alternative sound (misc/talk1.wav)Specifies sound effect to play each time chat message is received. Default value is 1.
cl_disable_explosions1=grenade explosions / 2=rocket explosionsDisables rendering of animated models for the following effects. This variable is a bitmask. Default value is 0.
cl_disable_particles1=grenade explosions / 2=grenade trails / 4=rocket explosions / 8=rocket trails / 16=blood splashes / 32=blaster trailsDisables rendering of particles for the following effects. This variable is a bitmask. Default value is 0.
cl_disconnectcmdstringSpecifies command to be executed each time client disconnects from the server. Default value is empty. See also trigger client command description.
cl_dlight_hacks1=make rocket projectile light red instead of yellow / 2=make rocket/grenade explosion light radius smaller / 4=disable muzzleflash lights for machinegun and chaingunToggles miscellaneous dynamic light effects options. This variable is a bitmask. Default value is 0.
cl_entities0/1draw world/map entities
cl_flares0/1Controls rendering of entities with RF_FLARE flag set. When using Q2PRO protocol, disabling this saves some bandwidth since the server stops sending these entities at all. Default value is 1 (enabled).
cl_footsteps0=footsteps disabled / 1=use custom footsteps per surface (if found) / 2=use default footstep soundControls footstep sounds. When using Q2PRO protocol, disabling this saves some bandwidth since the server stops sending footstep events at all. Default value is 1.
cl_forwardspeed1..400forward movement speed
cl_fragfeed_background0=off / 1=onCompact neutral gray background like chat.
cl_fragfeed_background_alpha0 1 0.05Opacity also follows HUD opacity.
cl_fragfeed_colorMenu paletteChoose an independent notification color from the named menu palette. Death uses a warm label.
cl_fragfeed_deaths0=off / 1=onShow who killed you until actual respawn. Off by default.
cl_fragfeed_highlight0=off / 1=onOnly the opponent in your confirmed kills/deaths. Chat keeps its current style.
cl_fragfeed_kills0=off / 1=onShow your confirmed kills below the crosshair. Off by default.
cl_fragfeed_lines1 3 1At most three recent events; no long queue.
cl_fragfeed_name_colorMenu paletteOpponent name color in the console and personal HUD notifications. Choose from the named menu palette.
cl_fragfeed_scale0.5 3 0.1Notification scale, multiplied by your HUD scale.
cl_fragfeed_time0.5 10 0.1Seconds including the final 0.4 second fade. Death stays until respawn.
cl_fragfeed_weapon0=off / 1=onOnly if the server message identifies it reliably.
cl_fragfeed_x-600 600 4HUD-scaled horizontal offset from screen center.
cl_fragfeed_y16 300 4Distance below the crosshair in HUD units.
cl_fuzzhack0/1Enables cl_maxpackets limit even if Q2PRO protocol is not in use by dropping packets. This is not a generally recommended thing to do, but can be enabled if nothing else helps to reduce ping. Default value is 0 (disabled).
cl_gibs0/1Controls rendering of entities with EF_GIB flag set. When using Q2PRO protocol, disabling this saves some bandwidth since the server stops sending these entities at all. Default value is 1 (enabled).
cl_gun0=dont draw gun / 1=draw gun depending on player handedness / 2=force right handed gun / 3=force left handed gunControls rendering of the players own gun model. When using R1Q2 or Q2PRO protocol, disabling this saves some bandwidth since the server stops sending gun updates at all. Default value is 1.
cl_gun_xany floatview weapon X offset
cl_gun_yany floatview weapon Y offset
cl_gun_zany floatSpecifies custom gun model offset. Default value is 0. These variables are for developers only. Non-zero values may cause certain gun effects to look misplaced.
cl_gunalpha0..1Specifies opacity level of the players own gun model. Default value is 1 (fully opaque).
cl_gunfov30..170Specifies custom FOV value for drawing players own gun model. Default value is 90. Set to 0 to draw with current FOV value.
cl_hit_markers0=hit marker effects disabled / 1=draw hit marker / 2=draw hit marker and play hit soundSpecifies if re-release hit marker effects are enabled. Default value is 2.
cl_ignore_stufftext0/1Enable filtering of commands server is allowed to stuff into client console. List of allowed wildcard patterns can be specified in stufftext-whitelist.txt file. Commands are matched raw, before macro expansion, but after splitting multi-line or semicolon separated commands. Internal client commands are always allowed. If whitelist file doesnt exist or is empty, cmd command (with arbitrary arguments) is allowed. This allows the server to query any console variable on the client. If there is at least one entry in whitelist, then cmd needs to be explicitly whitelisted. Q2PRO server will not allow the client in if it cant query version cvar, for example. When set to 2 and higher also issues a warning when stufftext command is ignored. Default value is 0 (dont filter stufftext commands). problems with mods/servers.
cl_input_debugdefault 0 / 0=off, >0=diagnostic (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: input subsystem diagnostic print. 0=off. Not archived, no menu; zero cost at 0.
cl_instantpacket0/1Specifies if important events such as pressing +attack or +use are sent to the server immediately, ignoring any rate limits. Default value is 1 (enabled).
cl_it0=off (default) / 1=onMaster switch for Q2PRO-X live multiplayer item respawn timers (manual + own-pickup countdowns on a HUD strip). Honest by design: no wallhack, no hidden server state, no demo pre-scan. Manual it_start/bind timers work on EVERY server; only AUTOMATIC own-pickup starts are authorized (see cl_it_auto_own). Mod-local.
cl_it_adr_color#RRGGBB / inherit (default)Accent color for Adrenaline: "#RRGGBB" overrides the item's own default colour, or "inherit" for the default.
cl_it_adr_hud0=hide / 1=showShow Adrenaline on the HUD strip (independent of tracking).
cl_it_adr_hud_s0..600 secondsHUD show window for Adrenaline: seconds before respawn to start showing its cell (unless cl_it_hud_show_all). 0 = use cl_it_warn_s.
cl_it_adr_s0..300 secondsFallback respawn interval (seconds) for Adrenaline; 0 = use the global default (cl_it_default_s). Mega Health instead uses cl_it_mh_fb_s, then dynamic health-decay timing when both fixed values are 0.
cl_it_adr_show0=off / 1=trackTrack Adrenaline on the live item-timer HUD.
cl_it_adr_snd0=off / 1=onEnable warning sounds for Adrenaline (needs cl_it_sound + cl_it_sound_mode).
cl_it_adr_snd_s0..600 secondsSound/critical window for Adrenaline: seconds before respawn to start sounds and turn the cell red. 0 = use cl_it_warn_s.
cl_it_auto_own0=off / 1=on (default)Auto-start a timer when the current local/observed POV picks up a PERMANENT map item. A type-only STAT_PICKUP_STRING must resolve within cl_it_own_touch_radius of a same-type BSP spawn; confirmed world touches use that same catalog. Dropped/corpse items without a nearby map spawn are ignored. A dropped quad (used at once, with its remaining life in STAT_TIMER) never restarts the quad countdown: the spawn near you, or the map's only quad spawn, counts from the original take (30 s minus the time left); otherwise no timer. Automatic starts are authorized per connection: local server always allows; a remote server's serverinfo sv_allow_timers 1/0 is final; otherwise the signed q2pro-x.com/quake2.pro site policy decides. This NEVER gates manual it_start/bind timers.

cl_it_hud0=off / 1=on (default)Draw the on-screen live-timer countdown strip. Respects scr_draw2d, HUD scale and common alpha. Menu-time visibility is controlled separately by cl_it_hud_in_menu.
cl_it_hud_alpha0..1 / default 1.0Live-timer strip opacity.
cl_it_hud_armor_x-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_widthArmor split-HUD X in HUD pixels; -1 = auto (right side, stacked below the strip above it). Only used when cl_it_hud_split is 1.
cl_it_hud_armor_y-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_heightArmor split-HUD Y in HUD pixels; -1 = auto stack. Only used when cl_it_hud_split is 1.
cl_it_hud_blink0=off (default) / 1=onSmoothly pulse (dimmer-style) each tile's colored border once its timer enters the warning window, speeding up as respawn nears (1 Hz at the window edge up to 5 Hz when ready), with a bloom glow that grows as the border dims. Common to all tiles.
cl_it_hud_border_run0=off (default) / 1=onIndependent of the blink: a bright comet of blocks runs clockwise around each tile's border inside the warning window, faster as respawn nears. Common to all tiles.
cl_it_hud_icon_pulse0=off (default) / 1=onIndependent of the border blink: smoothly pulse the item icon (dimmer-style, up to 5 Hz near respawn) with a bloom glow behind it that grows as the icon dims. Common to all tiles.
cl_it_hud_in_menu0=hide in menu / 1=show under menu (default)Keep live-timer HUD strips rendered underneath an open menu. The timer layer is composited before the menu, so cl_menu_alpha still applies naturally and a fully opaque menu covers it.
cl_it_hud_labels0=off (default) / 1=onDraw a short English item code (RL, RG, RA, Q, MH, ...) under each HUD icon.
cl_it_hud_max1..20 / default 8Maximum number of timer cells drawn at once (soonest-first).
cl_it_hud_misc_x-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_widthOther (misc + health) split-HUD X in HUD pixels; -1 = auto stack. Only used when cl_it_hud_split is 1.
cl_it_hud_misc_y-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_heightOther (misc + health) split-HUD Y in HUD pixels; -1 = auto stack. Only used when cl_it_hud_split is 1.
cl_it_hud_pow_x-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_widthPowerups split-HUD X in HUD pixels; -1 = auto stack. Only used when cl_it_hud_split is 1.
cl_it_hud_pow_y-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_heightPowerups split-HUD Y in HUD pixels; -1 = auto stack. Only used when cl_it_hud_split is 1.
cl_it_hud_scale0.3..4.0 / default 1.0Live-timer strip size multiplier.
cl_it_hud_show_all0=window only / 1=show all (default)Show every tracked timer on the HUD from the moment it starts, ignoring each item's HUD show window. Off = a cell appears only once its remaining time is within that item's cl_it_<id>_hud_s window.
cl_it_hud_split0=combined (default) / 1=split by classSplit the timer HUD into four separate strips by class: Armor, Powerups, Weapons, Other. Off = one combined strip (default). Scale, opacity, warning window and max cells stay common to all strips; each strip has its own position cvars (auto or fixed).
cl_it_hud_wpn_x-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_widthWeapons split-HUD X in HUD pixels; -1 = auto stack. Only used when cl_it_hud_split is 1.
cl_it_hud_wpn_y-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_heightWeapons split-HUD Y in HUD pixels; -1 = auto stack. Only used when cl_it_hud_split is 1.
cl_it_hud_x-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_widthHorizontal HUD position of the timer strip, in HUD pixels. -1 = auto (right-aligned, 8 px horizontal margin), clamped to the visible HUD rect.
cl_it_hud_y-1=auto (default) / 0..hud_heightVertical HUD position of the timer strip, in HUD pixels. -1 = auto (Y=80, below the OpenFFA/OpenTDM Frags/Rank/Time block), clamped to the visible HUD rect.
cl_it_instance_cluster_radius8..512 / default 64Merge radius (world units) for near-duplicate BSP spawn origins of the same item type when building the spawn catalog. The catalog is built per map; changing this value takes effect after a map/reload.
cl_it_inv_color#RRGGBB / inherit (default)Accent color for Invulnerability: "#RRGGBB" overrides the item's own default colour, or "inherit" for the default.

cl_it_learn0=off (default) / 1=on (needs cl_it_world_observe)Use per-instance respawn intervals learned from world observation: watching the SAME BSP spawn go hidden then visible again gives its real respawn time (session only, bounded 5-300 s). Requires cl_it_world_observe. Never learns from type-only own pickups. Dynamic Mega Health is excluded unless a fixed Mega override supplies a valid reference. Default off.

cl_it_mh_fb_s0=dynamic stock timing (default) / 1..300 seconds fixedFixed Mega Health fallback interval. 0 keeps the stock dynamic automatic path: after a trusted Mega pickup, wait at least five seconds and until POV health reaches 100, then start cl_it_mh_post_decay_s. A positive value overrides that behavior for mods with a fixed Mega interval.
cl_it_mh_hud0=hide / 1=showShow Mega Health on the HUD strip (independent of tracking).
cl_it_mh_hud_s0..600 secondsHUD show window for Mega Health: seconds before respawn to start showing its cell (unless cl_it_hud_show_all). 0 = use cl_it_warn_s.
cl_it_mh_post_decay_s1..300 seconds / default 20Automatic Mega Health respawn countdown after excess health has decayed/reached 100. Stock baseq2 schedules the hidden Mega 20 seconds after this transition. Used only by the dynamic automatic path; fixed per-item/fallback values and manual it_start remain fixed timers.
cl_it_mh_s0..300 secondsFallback respawn interval (seconds) for Mega Health; 0 = use the global default (cl_it_default_s). Mega Health instead uses cl_it_mh_fb_s, then dynamic health-decay timing when both fixed values are 0.
cl_it_mh_show0=off / 1=trackTrack Mega Health on the live item-timer HUD.
cl_it_mh_snd0=off / 1=onEnable warning sounds for Mega Health (needs cl_it_sound + cl_it_sound_mode).
cl_it_mh_snd_s0..600 secondsSound/critical window for Mega Health: seconds before respawn to start sounds and turn the cell red. 0 = use cl_it_warn_s.
cl_it_ordinals0=off / 1=on (default)Draw the BSP ordinal (1, 2, ...) on the HUD when the map has more than one instance of that item, so identical items are distinguishable.
cl_it_own_touch_radius16..128 / default 64Trust radius for an automatic own pickup. A type-only STAT_PICKUP_STRING must occur this close to a same-type BSP map spawn, which rejects ordinary dropped/corpse items. With cl_it_world_observe, the same radius decides whether a vanishing visible instance was taken by your current POV. This also lets identical map items time separately.

cl_it_pack_snd0=off / 1=onEnable warning sounds for Ammo Pack (needs cl_it_sound + cl_it_sound_mode).
cl_it_pack_snd_s0..600 secondsSound/critical window for Ammo Pack: seconds before respawn to start sounds and turn the cell red. 0 = use cl_it_warn_s.
cl_it_pickup_attach_radius16..2048 / default 200For the manual 'it_start <id> <seconds>' override: how close a BSP spawn must be to you for that manual timer to bind to the nearest concrete instance. Beyond it, the manual timer is class-level (no ordinal).

cl_it_sound0=off (default) / 1=onPlay an optional local warning sound when a timer enters the warning window. Code path only: the asset (sound/q2prox/it/warn.wav) is optional and playback silently skips if it is missing.
cl_it_sound_countdown0=off / 1=on (default)Play a per-second number cue (q2x/tm/num/<n>.wav) for each remaining second inside an item's sound window. Optional assets; silent if missing.
cl_it_sound_mode0=off / 1=generic (default) / 2=richSound mode: 0 off, 1 generic (shared soon/up/number cues), 2 rich (per-item voice files with fallback to generic). All sound assets are optional external WAVs under sound/q2x/tm/; missing files silently skip.
cl_it_sound_up0=off / 1=on (default)Play the 'item is up' cue (q2x/tm/sys/up.wav) when a timer reaches respawn. Optional asset; silent if missing.
cl_it_sound_vol0..1 / default 1.0Warning sound volume.

cl_it_unknown_policy0=hide (default) / 1=show '?'What to do with an item that has no known respawn interval: 0 hide it, 1 show a '?' cell. A default automatic Mega Health pickup is pending on its health-decay transition instead and does not create a fake unknown cell.
cl_it_warn_s0..60 seconds / default 3Warning window: seconds before respawn when a cell turns red and the optional warning sound fires.
cl_it_world_debug0=off (default) / 1=on (diagnostic, current session only)Verbose world-observation logging (BSP parse counts, ignored candidates).
cl_it_world_observe0=off (default) / 1=onUse only item entities already received in the current POV's normal snapshot/PVS plus the static BSP map-spawn catalog, so identical map instances can be timed separately. This does not search for items, reveal anything through walls, read hidden server state, or pre-scan future/demo data. An item merely appearing or disappearing never starts a timer: automatic start still requires a confirmed pickup by the current POV at a permanent map spawn and normal automatic-timer authorization. Per-instance learning, when enabled separately, may refine the interval only after that same confirmed spawn is seen returning. Opt-in.

cl_kickangles0/1apply server-driven view kick angles
cl_lerp_lightstyles0/1Enables interpolation of dynamic light styles. Default value is 0 (disabled).
cl_lights0/1render dynamic lights
cl_maxpackets10..1000Number of packets client sends per second. 0 means no particular limit. Unless connected using Q2PRO protocol, this variable is ignored and packets are sent in sync with client physics frame rate, controlled with cl_maxfps variable. Default value is 30.
cl_movement_feel_modeq2pro=Q2PRO default / r1q2-like=classic r1q2 standstill-start / jump feelMovement feel profile. q2pro is the default Q2PRO physics. r1q2-like restores the classic r1q2 standstill-start and jump feel that some competitive players prefer; selects a different ground-friction / jump-impulse combination.
cl_muzzleflashes0/1Specifies if re-release muzzleflash models are enabled. Does _not_ affect muzzleflash dynamic lights. Default value is 1.
cl_muzzlelight_time0..1000Lifetime, in milliseconds, of muzzleflash dynamic lights. Default value is 16.
cl_nobob0=items float / 1=items stay stillStops items lying on the floor from floating up and down. Nothing to do with your own view: your own walking bounce and running tilt are cl_viewbob (any server).
cl_nodelta0/1disable delta compression on commands
cl_noglow0=draw glow shells / 1=disable glow shells (local)Disable the player / weapon colour shell 'glow' effect (RF_SHELL_*) on the local scope. Removes the green/red/blue/yellow tint overlay applied to entities under quad/pent/invul/etc. without affecting the power-up state itself.
cl_nolerp0/1disable entity interpolation
cl_noskins0=no restrictions, if skins exists, it will be loaded / 1=do not allow any skins except of male/grunt / 2=do not allow any skins except of male/grunt and female/athenaRestricts which models and skins players can use. Default value is 0.
cl_otx_bot1_profileprofile name (default damiah)OpenTDM-X local bot match: play-style profile of bot 1 (a donor style such as damiah/purri/david/syanid, or god, human, mixedbot, noob...; otx profiles lists them).
cl_otx_bot1_seed0..4294967295 (default 1)OpenTDM-X local bot match: random seed of bot 1; the same seed repeats the same choices.
cl_otx_bot1_skill0..200 (default 100)OpenTDM-X local bot match: skill of bot 1 (0 = weakest, 200 = strongest).

cl_otx_bot2_seed0..4294967295 (default 2)OpenTDM-X local bot match: random seed of bot 2; the same seed repeats the same choices.
cl_otx_bot2_skill0..200 (default 75)OpenTDM-X local bot match: skill of bot 2 (0 = weakest, 200 = strongest).

cl_otx_bot3_skill0..200 (default 100)OpenTDM-X local bot match: skill of bot 3 (0 = weakest, 200 = strongest).

cl_otx_bot5_skill0..200 (default 50)OpenTDM-X local bot match: skill of bot 5 (0 = weakest, 200 = strongest).
cl_otx_grace0..86400 s (default 60)OpenTDM-X local bot match: seconds a disconnected human keeps his seat before a bot may take it.
cl_otx_idle0..86400 s (default 120)OpenTDM-X local bot match: seconds of human inactivity before the idle rule applies (pause / leave the seat).
cl_otx_mapsmap list (default q2duel5)OpenTDM-X local bot match: map rotation, map names separated by spaces (up to 8, at most 255 characters).
cl_otx_match1..86400 s (default 600)OpenTDM-X local bot match: match length in seconds.
cl_otx_mode1..5 bots (default 2)OpenTDM-X local bot match: how many bots otx_start_local starts (the launcher menu writes it; otx_apply stages it to the running server).
cl_otx_slotslot name (default duel)OpenTDM-X local bot match: name of the saved launcher session used by otx_save / otx_load.
cl_otx_warmup0..86400 s (default 30)OpenTDM-X local bot match: warmup seconds before the match starts on its own.
cl_own_blood0=hide own blood and ordinary armor-hit visuals / 1=show them (default)Client-side local filter for the local player's blood and ordinary armor-hit visuals (yellow sparks, spark light and bullet-impact smoke). Own blood uses a short health-drop window and proximity; ordinary armor also requires authoritative same-message STAT_FLASHES armor evidence and a close swept-player-position match. Enemy blood and world impacts remain visible; TE_GUNSHOT never enters this filter, and ambiguous candidates fail visible. Existing flesh/particle visibility gates still apply. Ricochet audio and AVFX reactions are preserved. Power Screen and Power Shield effects are unaffected because the standard protocol has no reliable local-owner marker.
cl_particle_armor_sparks_enable0=stop future particles of this family / 1=emit (default)Armor sparks: The small warm spark burst of TE_SPARKS / TE_BULLET_SPARKS on armor. Emit this family. Off stops only future particles of this exact family, before they are allocated or submitted; particles already in the air finish normally, and nothing else about the event changes. The broad Particles master and the legacy per-effect switches still apply on top. This is a global Q2PRO-X setting: it survives maps, mods, servers and ordinary AVFX or Player Contact preset changes.
cl_particle_barrel_smoke_enable0=stop future particles of this family / 1=emit (default)Exploding barrel smoke: The four-band smoke of an exploding barrel, emitted from six points around it; all four bands keep their stock brightness curve. Emit this family. Off stops only future particles of this exact family, before they are allocated or submitted; particles already in the air finish normally, and nothing else about the event changes. The broad Particles master and the legacy per-effect switches still apply on top. This is a global Q2PRO-X setting: it survives maps, mods, servers and ordinary AVFX or Player Contact preset changes.

cl_particles0/1render particle effects
cl_paused0/1 (readonly)client-side pause flag
cl_pitchspeed1..1000 (default 150)Keyboard look up/down rate, in degrees per second, for the +lookup / +lookdown binds (and for +forward / +back while +klook is held). The vertical twin of cl_yawspeed. NOT a cheat since 2026-08-19: it works on any server without cheats 1, because it gives a keyboard player nothing a mouse does not already give.
cl_protocol0=automatically select the highest protocol version supported / 34=use default Quake 2 protocol / 35=use enhanced R1Q2 protocol / 36=use enhanced Q2PRO protocolSpecifies preferred network protocol version to use when connecting to servers. If the server doesnt support the specified protocol, client will fall back to the previous supported version. Default value is 0.
cl_q2prox_cfg_autosave0=no autosave / 1=autosave on every change (default)Autosave Q2PRO-X config on menu / console changes. When on, any adjustment that flips a CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_GLOBAL or CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_LOCAL cvar is written after a 500 ms debounce to the correct target. Post-2026-04-25 storage split: GLOBAL cvars go to baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg (GLOBAL-only now); LOCAL cvars go to <gamedir>/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg when a mod is active, to baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.local.cfg when fs_game is empty, or to baseq2/q2pro-x/demo_visual/q2pro-x.demo.cfg while a .dm2/.mvd2 demo is playing. Every save goes through the atomic pipeline: write to .tmp, validate, rotate backups under backups/ (.bak/.bak.2/.bak.3), replace. Automatic writes additionally reject candidates that look like mass-reset / mass-bind-loss stamps (rejected candidates are kept under rejected/ as *.rejected-<ts> for diagnosis); explicit q2prox_cfg_defaults_* commands bypass that guard.
cl_q2prox_cfg_global_pref_audiodeprecated, ignored since schema 1.52DEPRECATED since Q2PRO-X config schema 1.52. It no longer gates anything: migration of your settings into the Q2PRO-X global and per-mod configs is automatic and mandatory, and ownership comes from one audited registry. The cvar stays registered only so an old config line still parses; its value is ignored, and a stale 0 can no longer disable migration. Use Q2PRO-X / Config & files / Unified Q2PRO-X settings for status and a manual re-sync.
