cl_q2prox_cfg_local_versionhistorical per-target marker (1.52=current LOCAL level; no automatic LOCAL migration)Historical Q2PRO-X LOCAL config schema marker. It remains target-local and is loaded for diagnostics, but safe legacy migration no longer creates, rebuilds or advances LOCAL targets: they are owned exclusively by the ordinary per-mod Q2PRO-X writer. The accepted LOCAL completion level remains 1.52 while GLOBAL can advance independently. Not a user preference and not exposed in the config menu.
cl_q2prox_cfg_versioninternal schema marker (0=pre-1.2 / 1.2=onboarding / 1.5=startup menu / 1.51=exact fullscreen default / 1.52=safe GLOBAL migration / 1.53=complete GL coverage)Internal Q2PRO-X GLOBAL config schema marker, read from the physical baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg rather than from the live cvar so a legacy config cannot spoof completion. Tracks which version-gated migrations were applied exactly once. Missing/0 receives the 1.2 onboarding preset; 1.5 enables the idle-start main menu; 1.51 migrates the former serialized desktop-fullscreen automatic margin to the new exact-size default; 1.52 completes safe add-only GLOBAL ownership migration; 1.53 extends the audited GL coverage to previously omitted user preferences such as gl_bloom_sigma. Existing records always win. The marker advances only after the GLOBAL target has been written and validated, and a newer marker from a future build is never downgraded. Not a user preference and not exposed in the config menu.
cl_q2prox_spark_dlightdefault 0 / 0=off (legacy), 1=onEmit a short-lived dynamic light (radius 150 wu, lifetime 250 ms) at impact spark temp entities so the surrounding floor / snow / water lights up while the sparks burn. Covers TE_GUNSHOT, TE_SPARKS, TE_BULLET_SPARKS, TE_SHOTGUN (orange), TE_SCREEN_SPARKS (yellow-green), TE_SHIELD_SPARKS (blue). Stock Q2 sparks emit only particles → at AVFX night the floor stays pitch black under a spark burst. This cvar adds a CL_AllocDlight that flows through the standard V_AddLight / gl_dynamic_local_* UBO path, so the spark color modulates whatever gl_dynamic_dark_boost / _radius / _softness / _alpha settings are active. Set to 0 to restore legacy stock-Q2 spark behavior (particles only, no dlight).
cl_q2px_rail_debugdefault 0 / 0=silent / 1=one RAILDBG line per rail beam (session only) (diagnostic, current session only)Session-only diagnostic for railgun beam events. 1 prints one RAILDBG console line per rail core created from the server's TE_RAILTRAIL event: the beam start and end points, the distance from the start point to the local view origin (small for your own shot, large for someone else's), and the current cl_predict value. Used as ownership evidence when verifying that a locally fired beam starts at the local view origin. Never read from a config and never written by any config or preset writer; after a restart it is off again.
cl_railcore_color#RRGGBBColor of the rail core beam. Default value is "red".
cl_railcore_width0..6Width of the rail core beam. Default value is 3.
cl_railspiral_color#RRGGBBColor of the rail spiral. Default value is "blue".
cl_railspiral_radius1..6Radius of the rail spiral. Default value is 3.
cl_railtrail_time0.1..3.0Time, in seconds, for the rail trail to be visible. Default value is 1.0.
cl_railtrail_type0=use original effect / 1=use alternative effect, draw rail core only / 2=use alternative effect, draw rail core and spiralDefines which type of rail trail effect to use. Default value is 0.
cl_reconnect_history_limit0=disabled and cleared / 1=last server only / 2..100=MRU history (default 10)Global across all mods: maximum number of unique successfully played remote servers retained for manual reconnect and the History browser tab. Changing it applies immediately. 0 clears and disables disk history; 1 keeps only the last server; 10 is the default; 100 is the hard maximum.
cl_reconnect_last_server_auto0=normal startup (default) / 1=auto-connect eligible last remote serverOn an otherwise idle cold start, automatically connect to the newest successfully played remote server only when the previous play context was remote multiplayer. Default off. Any explicit +map, +connect, demo, URL or alias startup action takes priority.
cl_rollhack0/1Default OpenGL renderer in Quake 2 contained a bug that caused roll angle of 3D models to be inverted during rotation. Due to this bug, player models did lean in the opposite direction when strafing. New Q2PRO renderer doesnt have this bug, but since many players got used to it, Q2PRO is able to simulate original behavior. This cvar chooses in which direction player models will lean. Default value is 1 (invert roll angle).

cl_translate_debugdefault 0 / 0=off, >0=diagnostic (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: string-translation subsystem diagnostic print. 0=off. Not archived, no menu; zero cost at 0.
cl_translate_deepl_urlURL (default https://api-free.deepl.com/v2/translate)DeepL API endpoint used by cl_translate_provider deepl (the free plan address by default).
cl_translate_google_urlURL (default https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2)Google Cloud Translation endpoint used by cl_translate_provider google.

cl_translate_providerq2prox (default) / google / deepl / azure / libre / customChat translation service. q2prox uses the Q2PRO-X hosted proxy (no key needed); google, deepl, azure, libre (LibreTranslate) and custom use their own URL and your key.
cl_translate_q2prox_urlURL (default https://q2pro-x.com/api/translate)Address of the Q2PRO-X translation proxy used by cl_translate_provider q2prox.
cl_translate_timeout_msmilliseconds (default 3000)How long a chat translation request may take before it is given up.
cl_translit_x_style0=kh (default) / 1=hLatin transliteration of the Cyrillic letter Х/х in chat and names typed with the Russian layout.
cl_upspeed1..400vertical (jump/crouch) speed
cl_viewbob0..1 (default 1)How much your view bounces up and down while you walk. 1 = normal, 0 = no bounce at all, values in between are weaker. Works on ANY server, including someone else's, because it takes the bounce out on your own machine. Not a cheat: it removes only what your own footsteps produce, and it reveals nothing. Measured on a remote server, an incoming bounce of 1.75 units comes out at 0.0005. It covers the whole movement effect: the up-and-down bounce in viewoffset, and the tilt that comes with running and strafing, which arrives separately inside kick_angles. Weapon recoil, damage kicks and landing kicks are never touched - those tell you something. On a server that sends no movement effect this setting does nothing, and says so in cl_viewbob_info. The diagnostic override cl_viewsway can force the tilt half on its own; it follows this setting by default.
cl_viewbob_trace0=off (default) / 1=model per server frame / 2=+ the vertical half / 3=+ the final camera, delta and jerk (diagnostic, current session only)Diagnostic. 1 prints one line per received server frame: the pitch and roll the server sent, what the movement model predicted for them, the forward and sideways speed it used and the reconstructed bob phase. 2 adds the eye height before and after the vertical removal, so the two halves can be told apart. 3 adds the FINAL camera on one timeline - rendered angles and origin, predicted origin, interpolation fraction, smoothed prediction error, time since the last server frame, frame time, and the per-frame camera delta and jerk - which is the only channel that shows what the player is actually looking at rather than what the filter thinks. The first sample after switching it on, after a map or server change, or after a gap longer than 250 ms is marked first=1 and its delta must be ignored. Noisy - console only, not saved.
cl_viewsway-1=follow cl_viewbob (default) / 0..1 force the tilt removalEXPERIMENTAL diagnostic override for the TILT half of cl_viewbob, the part that arrives inside kick_angles. -1, the default, means follow cl_viewbob. 0 forces the tilt to be left alone even at cl_viewbob 0; 0..1 forces how much of it to remove regardless of cl_viewbob. This exists so a build can be bisected without also losing the vertical removal - players never need it, and it is not in the menus. cl_viewbob_info reports what the tilt model measured, what is left after subtracting it, and which guard refused any samples.
cl_vwep0/1show visible weapons on other player models
cl_warn_on_fps_rounding0/1Print a warning if value specified for cl_maxfps or r_maxfps is inexact due to rounding. Default value is 1 (enabled).
cl_weapon_anim_debug0=no prints / 1=print weapon animation timeline on change (diagnostic, current session only)Print the weapon animation timeline on every change — logs each server vs predicted gun frame transition with timestamps, helpful for diagnosing animation lag or Option E switch-window issues.
cl_writeconfig_full0=bindings + archived cvars (default) / 1=same as -b -m -a (bindings + aliases + all modified cvars)Controls what a bare writeconfig <filename> writes when you give it no content flags. 0 (default) keeps the historical meaning: key bindings plus archived cvars. 1 makes the flagless form save everything the explicit -b -m -a form saves — all key bindings, all your command aliases, and every eligible cvar whose current (or latched) value differs from its default, including Q2PRO-X global (G) and mod-local (M) settings. Explicit flags are never touched: if you type -a, -b, -c or -m yourself, exactly that selection is written and this setting is ignored; -h still only prints help. The destination stays configs/<filename>.cfg and the config-readonly barrier still applies first. Note this is a manual legacy-style CFG export and NOT a replacement for Q2PRO-X global/local preset saving, which has its own storage. Saved to the global Q2PRO-X config, shared across all mods.

com_date_formatstrftimeDate format used by com_date macro. Default value is "%Y-%m-%d". See strftime(3) for syntax description.

con_height0..1Fraction of the screen in-game console occupies. Default value is 0.5.
con_history0..1024Specifies how many lines to save into console history file before exiting Q2PRO, to be reloaded on next startup. Maximum number of history lines is 128. Default value is 128.
con_notifylines0..CON_TIMESNumber of the last console lines displayed in the notification area in game. Default value is 4.
con_notifytime0..30in-game notify duration (sec)
con_scale0 = auto / manual 1.0..10.0 (menu step 0.1)Scaling factor of the console text. Default value is 0 = auto (engine picks based on resolution). Manual range 1.0..10.0 after R_ClampScale; menu step 0.1. Sub-1.0 values are silently clamped to 1.0 by the renderer, which is why the menu range starts at 1.0.
con_scroll1=when new command is entered / 2=when new lines are printedControls automatic scrolling of console text when some event occurs. This variable is a bitmask. Default value is 0.
con_timestamps0/1Specifies if console lines are prefixed with a timestamp. Default value is 0.
con_timestampscolorcolor index or nameText color used for console timestamps. Default value is "#aaa".
con_timestampsformatstrftimeFormat string for console timestamps. Default value is "%H:%M:%S ". See strftime(3) for syntax description.
console_prefixstringAnalogous to logfile_prefix, but for system console. Additionally, sequence <?>, if present at the beginning of prefix, is replaced with printk()-style severity level based on message type. This is intended for logging server stdout with systemd(1). Default value is empty (no prefix).

hqx_y0..2hq2x: Y channel weight
intensitydefault 2 / range 0..5 / step 0.05Primary renderer light intensity multiplier consumed by the shader uniforms (u_intensity / u_intensity2). Stock Q2PRO default is 2; lower values darken the level, higher values brighten it. When cl_q2prox_cfg_global_prefs 1 + cl_q2prox_cfg_global_pref_video 1 are enabled the value is owned by the unified Q2PRO-X global config (baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg). Independent from gl_brightness / gl_modulate, legacy texture-domain vid_gamma, and final-composite vid_display_gamma; these controls operate at separate renderer stages.
libdirpath (read-only after start)Directory searched for game libraries. Command-line only.
loc_dist0..4096Maximum distance to the location, in world units, for it to be considered by the location selection algorithm. Default value is 500.
loc_draw0/1Enables visualization of location positions. Default value is 0 (disabled).
loc_trace0/1When enabled, location must be directly visible from the given position (not obscured by solid map geometry) in order to be selected. Default value is 0, which means any closest location will satisfy, even if it is placed behind the wall.
logfile0=logging disabled / 1=logging enabled, overwrite previous file / 2=logging enabled, append to previous fileSpecifies if console logging to file is enabled. Default value is 0.
logfile_flush0=system default mode (block buffered) / 1=line buffered mode / 2=unbuffered modeSpecifies if log file data is buffered in memory or flushed to disk immediately. Default value is 0. See setvbuf(3) manual page for more details.
logfile_namestringSpecifies base name of the log file. Should not include any extension part or path components. logs/ prefix and .log suffix are automatically appended. Default value is console.
logfile_prefixstringSpecifies the time/date template each line of log file is prefixed with. Default value is [%Y-%m-%d %H:%M] . See strftime(3) manual page for syntax description. In addition, the first @ character in the template, if found, is replaced with a single character representing message type (T — talk, D — developer, W — warning, E — error, N — notice, A — default).
lookspring0/1spring view back on movement
lookstrafe0/1convert look to strafe when mouse-looking disabled
lrcon_passwordstringIf not empty, enables users of this password to execute limited set of rcon commands on the server. By default no commands are permitted. Permitted command prefixes can be added using addlrconcmd.
map_noareas0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)ignore BSP area portals
map_override_pathstringSpecifies the directory from which override files with extensions .ent or .bsp.override are loaded. Default value is empty (dont try to override entity strings). Typical value for this is maps, but can be customized per server port. Override files with .ent extension allow the entity string of the map being loaded to be replaced by a custom data supplied by server operator. This makes it possible to change the layout of entities on the map (thus creating a new version of the map) without requiring clients to download anything. Entity string can be dumped from the current map using dumpents server command and later changed with a text editor. Override files with .bsp.override extension are more complex: they are binary files that can replace map entity string or checksum. They can also create an alias for the map. How to create such files is out of scope of this manual (search the internet for r1q2 map override file generator).
map_visibility_patch0/1Attempt to patch miscalculated visibility data for some well-known maps (q2dm1, q2dm3 and q2dm8 are patched so far), fixing disappearing walls and entities. Default value is 1 (enabled).

maxclients1..256maximum client slots

maxspectatorsdefault 4Game library: maximum number of spectators.
msg0..3message level filter
mvd_admin_passwordstringMVD admin password
mvd_buffer_size16..16384Size of delay buffer, in multiplies of MAX_MSGLEN (32 KiB). Default value is 8. You may need to increase this when also increasing mvd_wait_delay.
mvd_chase_prefixstringSpecifies POV info string position on the screen. This should be a valid fragment of the Quake 2 layout script. Default value is "xv 0 yb -64".
mvd_default_mapstringSpecifies default map used for the Waiting Room channel. Default value is "q2dm1".
mvd_filter_version0/1filter outgoing MVD by protocol version
mvd_freeze_hack0/1freeze-hack workaround for MVD
mvd_part_filter0/1partial-frame MVD filter
mvd_passwordstringDefault password to use for outgoing GTV connections. Default value is empty.
mvd_shownet0/1/2 (diagnostic, current session only)print MVD network detail
mvd_snaps0..300Specifies time interval, in seconds, between saving snapshots in memory during MVD playback. Snapshots enable backward seeking in demo (see mvdseek command description), and speed up repeated forward seeks. Setting this variable to 0 disables snapshotting entirely. Default value is 10.
mvd_stats_hack0/1MVD stats-hack workaround
mvd_stats_score0=always zero / 1=MVD channel ID spectator is on / 2=score of the chase targetSpecifies what score stats field should contain for MVD observers. This field is externally visible to server browsers. Default value is 0.
mvd_suspend_time0..300GTV connections are suspended after this period of time, in minutes, counted from the last moment of MVD spectator(s) activity. Setting this to zero disables client side suspending entirely. Default value is 5.
mvd_timeout1..300Specifies MVD connection timeout value, in seconds. Default value is 90.
mvd_usernamestringDefault username to use for outgoing GTV connections. Default value is "unnamed".
mvd_wait_delay0..60Time, in seconds, for MVD channel to buffer data initially. This effectively specifies MVD stream delay seen by observers. Default value is 20.
mvd_wait_percent0..100Maximum inuse percentage of the delay buffer when MVD channel stops buffering data to prevent overrun, ignoring mvd_wait_delay value. Default value is 50.
namestringplayer name
needpass0..3 (read-only)Read-only: which passwords the server requires, published in serverinfo (1 = player password, 2 = spectator password, 3 = both).
net_chantype0/1Specifies if enhanced Q2PRO network channel implementation is enabled when connecting to Q2PRO servers. Q2PRO netchan supports application-level fragmentation of datagrams that results is better gamestate compression ratio and faster map load times. Default value is 1 (enabled).
net_clientport0..65535Specifies UDP port number client should use for outgoing connections (using IPv4 or IPv6). Default value is -1, which means that random port number is chosen at socket creation time.
net_dropsim0..100simulate packet drops (percent)
net_enable_ipv60=disable IPv6, use IPv4 only / 1=enable IPv6, but do not listen for incoming IPv6 connections and prefer IPv4 over IPv6 when resolving host names with multiple addresses / 2=enable IPv6, listen for incoming IPv6 connections and use normal address resolver priority configured by OSEnables IPv6 support. Default value is 1 on systems that support IPv6 and 0 otherwise.
net_ignore_icmp0/1On Win32 and Linux, server is able to receive ICMP destination-unreachable packets from clients. This enables intelligent detection of crashed clients, allowing the server to quickly re-use their slots. If this behavior is not wanted for some reason, then this variable can be used to turn it off. Default value is 0 (dont ignore ICMP packets).
net_ipipSpecifies network interface address server should listen on for UDP and TCP connections using IPv4. The same interface is also used for outgoing TCP connections (these include MVD/GTV and anticheat connections). Default value is empty, which means listening on all interfaces. accessible from multiple IP addresses. If you are running the server on multi-ip system and plan to use anticheat, you need to explicitly bind the server to one of your network interfaces using the net_ip cvar.
net_ip6ipv6Specifies network interface address server should listen on for UDP and TCP connections using IPv6. The same interface is also used for outgoing TCP connections (these include MVD/GTV connections). Default value is empty, which means listening on all interfaces. Has no effect unless net_enable_ipv6 is set to non-zero value.
net_log_enable0/1write a network log
net_log_flush0/1flush net log each write
net_log_namestringnet log filename
net_maxmsglen0..65535Specifies maximum server to client packet size client will request from servers. 0 means no hard limit. Default value is conservative 1390 bytes. It is nice to have this variable as close to your network link MTU as possible (accounting for headers). Thus for normal Ethernet MTU of 1500 bytes 1462 can be specified (10 bytes quake header, 8 bytes UDP header, 20 bytes IPv4 header). Higher values may cause IP fragmentation which is better to avoid. Servers will cap this variable to their own maximum values. Dont change this variable unless you know exactly what you are doing.
net_port0..65535Specifies port number server should listen on for UDP and TCP connections (using IPv4 or IPv6). Default value is 27910.
netgraph0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)enable network graph
passwordstringclient password for joining
portnumber (read-only)Read-only: the UDP port the server listens on (set it with net_port).
protocol34=standard Quake II server protocol / 36=extended Q2PRO server protocol (read-only)Read-only local Q2PRO server protocol identifier. It does not show the protocol negotiated for the current remote client connection; use cl_protocol for client selection.
public0/1server publicly advertised
q2prox_config_readonly0=normal (default) / 1=read-only (diagnostic, current session only)Process-wide config write barrier: nothing writes saved configs or preset files during this run. Command-line only (+set q2prox_config_readonly 1); used for tests.
q2prox_game_dll_active0/1 (read-only)Read-only state: 1 while the Q2PRO-X single-player game library runs a local game. Set by the engine; menus use it.

run_pitchdefault 0.002Game library: view pitch tilt while running forward/back.

scr_alpha0..1Opacity of the HUD elements. 0 is fully transparent, 1 is opaque. Default value is 1.
scr_centertime0..30centerprint duration (sec)
scr_chathud0=do not draw chat lines / 1=draw chat lines in normal color / 2=draw chat lines in alternative colorToggles drawing of the last chat lines on the screen. Default value is 0.
scr_chathud_lines1..32Specifies number of the last chat lines drawn on the screen. Default value is 4. Maximum value is 32.
scr_chathud_time0..60Specifies visibility time of each chat line, counted in seconds. Default value is 0 (lines never fade out).
scr_chathud_xintAbsolute value of this cvar specifies horizontal placement of the chat HUD, counted in pixels from the screen edge. Negative values align graph to the right edge of the screen instead of the left edge. Default value is 8.
scr_chathud_yintAbsolute value of this cvar specifies vertical placement of the chat HUD, counted in pixels from the screen edge. Negative values align graph to the bottom edge of the screen intead of the top edge. Default value is -64.
scr_conspeed100..10000console drop-down speed
scr_demobar0=do not draw demo bar / 1=draw demo bar and demo completion percentage / 2=draw demo bar, demo completion percentage and current demo timeToggles drawing of progress bar at the bottom of the screen during demo playback. Default value is 1.
scr_draw2d0=do not draw anything / 1=do not draw stats program / 2=draw everythingToggles drawing of 2D elements on the screen. Default value is 2.
scr_fontpathFont used for drawing HUD text. Default value is "conchars".
scr_hit_marker_time0..2000Hit marker visibility time in milliseconds. Hit marker is only visible if crosshair is visible. Default value is 500.
scr_lag_draw0=do not draw graph / 1=draw transparent graph / 2=overlay graph on gray backgroundToggles drawing of small (48x48 pixels) ping graph on the screen. Default value is 0.
scr_lag_max0..1000Specifies ping graph scale by defining the maximum value that can be displayed. Default value is 200.
scr_lag_min0..1000Specifies ping graph offset by defining the minimum value that can be displayed. Default value is 0.
scr_lag_xintAbsolute value of this cvar specifies horizontal placement of the ping graph, counted in pixels from the screen edge. Negative values align graph to the right edge of the screen instead of the left edge. Default value is -1.
scr_lag_yintAbsolute value of this cvar specifies vertical placement of the ping graph, counted in pixels from the screen edge. Negative values align graph to the bottom edge of the screen intead of the top edge. Default value is -1.
scr_printspeed0..1000centerprint per-character speed
scr_scale0 = auto / manual 1.0..10.0 (menu step 0.1)Scaling factor of the HUD elements. Default value is 0 = auto (engine picks based on resolution). Manual range 1.0..10.0 after R_ClampScale; menu step 0.1. Sub-1.0 values are silently clamped to 1.0 by the renderer.
scr_showpause0=do not draw pause indicator / 1=draw pic in center of the screen / 2=draw text in demo bar (visible only during demo playback)Toggles drawing of pause indicator on the screen. Default value is 1.
scr_showpmove0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)debug: show pmove state
scr_showstats0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)debug: show frame stats
scr_showturtle0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)Toggles drawing of various network error conditions at the lower left corner of the screen. Default value is 1 (draw all errors except of SUPPRESSED, CLIENTDROP and SERVERDROP). Values higher than 1 draw all errors. [horizontal] SERVERDROP:: Packets from server to client were dropped by the network. CLIENTDROP:: A few packets from client to server were dropped by the network. Server recovered players movement using backup commands. CLIENTPRED:: Many packets from client to server were dropped by the network. Server ran out of backup commands and had to predict players movement. NODELTA:: Server sent an uncompressed frame. Typically occurs during a heavy lag, when a lot of packets are dropped by the network. SUPPRESSED:: Server suppressed packets to client because rate limit was exceeded. BADFRAME:: Server sent an invalid delta compressed frame. OLDFRAME:: Server sent a delta compressed frame that is too old and cant be recovered. OLDENT:: Server sent a delta compressed frame whose entities are too old and cant be recovered.
sensitivity0.01..50mouse sensitivity
showclamp0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)debug: show command clamping
showdrop0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)debug: show dropped packets
showpackets0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)debug: show all packets

spectator_passwordstring (default empty)Password a client sends to join a passworded server as a spectator (sent in userinfo).
sv_airaccelerate0..10server airaccelerate (q2w/ctf)
sv_allow_map0=disallow map and print a warning unless there are pending latched cvars / 1=handle map command normally / 2=turn map into gamemap unless there are pending latched cvarsControls the map command behavior. map is often mistakingly used by server operators to change maps instead of the more lightweight gamemap. Thus, this variable exists to prevent misuse of map. Default value is 0 for dedicated servers, 1 otherwise.
sv_allow_nodelta0/1Enables automatic removal of clients that abuse the server with requests for too many nodelta (uncompressed) frames, hogging network resources. Default value is 1 (dont remove clients), since this may sometimes legitimately happen on very poor client connections.
sv_allow_unconnected_cmds0/1Controls whether client command strings are processed by the game mod even when the client is not fully spawned in game. Originally, Quake 2 server forwarded all commands to the game mod even for connecting clients, but this is known to cause problems with some (broken) mods that dont perform their own client state checks. Default value is 0 (ignore commands unless fully connected).
sv_anticheat_badfile_actionlog/kickaction on anticheat bad file
sv_anticheat_badfile_max0..100bad-file limit before action
sv_anticheat_badfile_messagestringmessage shown on bad file
sv_anticheat_client_disconnect_actionstringaction on client anticheat disconnect
sv_anticheat_disable_play0/1block play when anticheat disabled
sv_anticheat_error_actionstringaction on anticheat error
sv_anticheat_messagestringanticheat info message
sv_anticheat_required0/1require anticheat to play
sv_anticheat_server_addressip:portanticheat server address
sv_anticheat_show_violation_reason0/1broadcast violation reason
sv_auth_limit0..60Limits the rate of client connection attempts with invalid password. Default value is 1 invalid authentication attempt per second.
sv_calcpings_method0=disable ping calculation entirely / 1=use default ping calculation algorithm based on averaging / 2=use improved algorithm based on minimum round trip timesSpecifies the way client pings are calculated. Default ping calculation algorithm depends on client frame and packet rates, and may give inaccurate results, depending on client settings. Using improved algorithm is recommended as it should produce results more consistent with ping command line utility. Default value is 2.
sv_changemapcmdstringSpecifies command to be executed each time server finishes loading a new map. Default value is empty.
sv_cinematics0/1If set to 0, server will skip cinematics even if they exist. Default value is 1.
sv_debug0/1/2 (diagnostic, current session only)server debug level
sv_downloadserverurlSpecifies the initial portion of the URL compatible clients use for HTTP downloads. It must begin with http:// or https:// and should normally end with a slash. Default is empty (no download URL). The server operator must expose the matching game files through a compatible HTTP endpoint.
sv_enforcetime0/1/2enforce monotonic client time
sv_enhanced_setplayer0/1Enable partial client name matching for certain console commands like kick and stuff. Default value is 0 (use original matching algorithm).
sv_featuresbitmaskserver feature bits (readonly)
sv_force_reconnectstringWhen set to an address string, forces new clients to quickly reconnect to this address as an additional proxy protection measure. Default value is empty (do not enforce reconnection).
sv_fps10/20/40/100Specifies native server frame rate. Only used when game mod advertises support for variable server FPS. Specified rate should be a multiple of 10 (maximum rate is 60). Default value is 10 frames per second. Only clients that support Q2PRO protocol will be able to take advantage of higher FPS. Other clients will receive updates at default rate of 10 packets per second.
sv_ghostime0..60Maximum time, in seconds, before dropping clients which have passed initial challenge-response connection stage but have not yet sent any data over newly established connection. This also applies to MVD/GTV clients in request processing stage. Helps to avoid attacks flooding server with zombie clients, combined with sv_iplimit variable. Default value is 6.
sv_gravitydefault 800Game library: world gravity; a map can set its own.
sv_idlekick0..3600Time, in seconds, before dropping inactive clients. Default value is 0 (dont kick idling clients). Moving, pressing buttons while in game and issuing chat commands counts as activity. downloading or otherwise taking long time to enter the game.
sv_iplimit0..64Maximum number of simultaneous connections allowed from single IP address (per connection type, TCP and UDP client lists are separate). Setting this variable to 0 disables the limit. Default value is 3.
sv_lan_force_rate0/1When enabled, do not enforce any rate limits on clients whose IP is from private address space (127.x.x.x, 10.x.x.x, 192.168.x.x, 172.16.x.x). Default value is 0 (disabled).
sv_locked0/1Locks the server, preventing new clients from connecting. Default value is 0 (server unlocked).
sv_maplistmap list (default empty)Game library: deathmatch map rotation, map names separated by spaces (used when a map ends and no next map is set).
sv_max_download_size0..65535Maximum size of UDP download in bytes. Value of 0 disables the limit. Default value is 8388608 (8 MiB). on the server. Thus it is advisable to keep all data in .pkz for optimal download speeds.
sv_max_packet_entities0..128Maximum number of entities in client frame. Default value is 0, which is equivalent to 128 for non-extended servers and 512 for extended servers.
sv_max_rate0..1000000Server clamps maximum value of rate userinfo parameter to this value. Default value is 60000 bytes/sec.
sv_maxvelocitydefault 2000Game library: maximum entity velocity.
sv_min_rate0..1000000Server clamps minimum value of rate userinfo parameter to this value. Default value is 15000 bytes/sec. This parameter cant be greater than sv_max_rate value or less than 1500 bytes/sec.
sv_mvd_allow_stufftext0/1allow MVD stufftext
sv_mvd_autorecord0/1auto-record an MVD per map
sv_mvd_begincmdstringThis command is issued on behalf of dummy MVD observer as soon as it enters the game. Do whatever preparations are needed here to make sure MVD observer enters an appropriate observing mode, opens the scoreboard, etc. MVD observer has its own command buffer and each wait cycle lasts 100 ms there. Default value is "wait 50; putaway; wait 10; help;".
sv_mvd_bufsize16..16384MVD output buffer size (KB)
sv_mvd_capture_flagsbitmaskMVD capture bits
sv_mvd_disconnect_time0..60Dummy MVD observer is disconnected after this period of time, in minutes, counted from the moment last GTV client disconnects or becomes inactive. Setting this to zero makes dummy client persistent. Default value is 15.
sv_mvd_enable0=MVD server is disabled / 1=local MVD recording is allowed / 2=local MVD recording and remote GTV connections are allowedEnables MVD/GTV server functionality. Default value is 0.
sv_mvd_maxclients0..256Total number of MVD/GTV client slots on the server. Default value is 8.
sv_mvd_maxmaps0..1000Specifies number of map changes local MVD recording is stopped after. Default value is 1. Setting this to 0 disables the limit.
sv_mvd_maxsize0..8192Maximum size, in kB, of the locally recorded MVD. Default value is 0 (unlimited).
sv_mvd_maxtime0..1440Maximum duration, in minutes, of the locally recorded MVD. Default value is 0 (unlimited).
sv_mvd_noblend0/1Reduce bandwidth usage by filtering on-screen blend effects out of MVD stream. Default value is 0 (filtering disabled).
sv_mvd_nogun0/1Reduce bandwidth usage by filtering on-screen gun updates out of MVD stream. Default value is 0 (filtering disabled).
sv_mvd_nomsgs0/1When enabled, MVD/GTV spectators in chasecam mode will not receive any text messages routed to their chase targets (which are normally on a team), but will receive messages routed to the dummy MVD observer. Default value is 1 (enabled). This variable is only effective when dummy client is spawned, see sv_mvd_spawn_dummy variable description for more information.
sv_mvd_passwordstringIf not empty, allows only authenticated MVD/GTV clients to connect. Default value is empty (any neutral host can connect). whitelisted nor blacklisted (see addgtvhost and addgtvban commands description for more information).
sv_mvd_scorecmdstringThis command is issued on behalf of dummy MVD observer each time no layout updates are detected for more than 9 seconds. Useful for reopening the scoreboard if the game mod closes it for some reason. MVD observer has its own command buffer and each wait cycle lasts 100 ms there. Default value is "putaway; wait 10; help;".
sv_mvd_spawn_dummy0=never spawn dummy client / 1=only spawn if game mod advertises support for MVD / 2=always spawn dummy clientSpecifies if dummy MVD observer needs to be spawned. Default value is 1.
sv_mvd_suspend_time0..600GTV connections are suspended after this period of time, in minutes, counted from the moment last active player disconnects or becomes inactive. Setting this to zero disables server side suspending entirely. Default value is 5.
sv_namechange_limit0..60Limits the rate at which clients are permitted to change their name. Default value is 5 name changes per minute.
sv_noreload0/1do not reload savegame between deaths
sv_novis0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)disable server PVS culling
sv_packetdup_hack0/1packet-duplication compatibility hack
sv_pad_packets0/1pad packets to MTU
sv_passwordstringIf not empty, allows only authenticated clients to connect. Authenticated clients are allowed to occupy reserved slots, see below. Clients set their passwords via password userinfo variable. Default value is empty (no password). sv_password instead of going the game mod way and using password variable. The latter will prevent MVD/GTV features from working. Otherwise clients will be unable to connect.
sv_paused0/1server pause flag
sv_prioritize_entities0/1Sort entities by priority if number of entities in client frame exceeds sv_max_packet_entities limit, and throw out low priority entities. Default value is 0, which simply throws out entities with higher numbers that dont fit into frame. Sorting is potentially CPU intensive and thus disabled by default.
sv_qwmod0/1/2QuakeWorld compatibility level
sv_rcon_limit0..60Limits the rate at which server responds to invalid rcon commands. Default value is 1 invalid command per second.
sv_recycle0=handle gamemap command normally / 1=turn the next gamemap into map and reload the game module / 2=turn the next gamemap into recycle and reload entire serverTemporary variable useful for automatically upgrading the server at the next map change. Default value is 0.
sv_redirect_addressip:portWhen server becomes full, redirects new clients to the specified address. Default value is empty (dont redirect).
sv_reserved_passwordstringThe password to use for reserved slots. Default value is empty, which means no one is allowed to occupy reserved slot(s), except of dummy MVD observer. Clients set their passwords via password userinfo variable.
sv_reserved_slots0..256Number of client slots reserved for clients who know sv_reserved_password or sv_password. Must be less than maxclients value. Default value is 0 (dont reserve slots). sv_reserved_slots is automatically set to one to reserve a slot for dummy MVD observer. visible in the server info.
sv_rollangledegrees (default 2)Game library: view roll angle while strafing.
sv_rollspeeddefault 200Game library: strafe speed at which sv_rollangle is fully reached.
sv_running0/1 (readonly)server running flag (readonly)
sv_show_name_changes0=dont show name changes / 1=show name changes of players fully spawned in game / 2=show name changes of all players, including connecting playersBroadcast player name changes to everyone. Enable this unless game mod already shows name changes. Default value is 0.
sv_status_limit0..60Limits the rate at which server responds to status queries. Default value is 15 queries per second. Rate limiting is implemented as a simple token bucket filter. Full syntax for specifying rate limits is: <limit>[/<period>[sec/min/hour]][<burst>]. Only the _limit_ argument is mandatory. Zero _limit_ means rate is not limited. Default period is one second. Custom _period_ can be specified after a slash, with optional _sec_, _min_, or _hour_ suffix (default units are seconds). Default burst value is 5. Custom _burst_ can be specified after an asterisk. Burst specifies initial number of extra packets that are permitted even if they arrive at rate higher than allowed.
sv_status_show0=do not respond at all / 1=respond with server info only / 2=respond with server info and player listSpecifies how the server should respond to status queries. Default value is 2.
sv_strafejump_hack0/1/2Enables FPS-independent strafe jumping mode for clients using R1Q2 and Q2PRO protocols. Values higher than 1 will force this mode for all clients, regardless of their protocol version. Default value is 1 (enable strafe jumping hack only for compatible clients).
sv_timescale_kick0/1kick on sustained timescale violation
sv_timescale_time0..60timescale sample window (sec)
sv_timescale_warn0..2warn threshold for timescale
sv_trunc_packet_entities0/1When client frame is about to overflow, truncate packetentities instead of dropping client frame. This does not break delta compression and should be generally safe to use. Some negative effects like entities temporary freezing, or delayed spawning can be observed. Only relevant for legacy clients not using Q2PRO network channel implementation. Default value is 1 (enabled).
sv_uptime0=do not display uptime at all / 1=display uptime in compact format / 2=display uptime in verbose formatInclude uptime key/value pair in server info. Default value is 0.
sv_waterjump_hack0/1Makes underwater movement speed equal in all directions for clients using Q2PRO protocol. Values higher than 1 will force this mode for all clients, regardless of their protocol version. Default value is 1 (enabled). Quake 2 player movement code contains a bug that causes surfacing velocity produced by holding the jump button underwater to be severely limited, comparing to movement in other directions. Even worse, resulting velocity is calculated differently on client and server sides and that causes prediction errors and jerky movement. Q2PRO is able to work around this bug and make player movement speed equal in all directions underwater.
sys_allow_unsafe_savegames0/1allow unsafe savegame loading
sys_disablecrashdump0=write dumps (default) / 1=off (diagnostic, current session only)Do not write a crash dump file when the game crashes (Windows). Command-line only.
sys_exitonerror0=show the message (default) / 1=exit (diagnostic, current session only)Exit at once on a fatal error instead of showing the error message box (Windows).
sys_forcegamelibstringSpecifies the full path to the game library server should attempt to load first, before normal search paths are tried. Useful mainly for debugging or mod development. Default value is empty (use normal search paths).
sys_game32_bridge_debugdefault 0 / 0=off, >0=diagnostic (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: 32-bit game-DLL bridge diagnostic print. 0=off. Not archived, no menu; zero cost at 0.
sys_history0..1024Specifies how many lines to save into system console history file before exiting Q2PRO, to be reloaded on next startup. Maximum number of history lines is 128. Default value is 128. The following key bindings are available in Windows console and in TTY console when command line editing is enabled: HOME, Ctrl+A — move cursor to start of line END, Ctrl+E — move cursor to end of line Left arrow, Ctrl+B — move cursor one character left Right arrow, Ctrl+F — move cursor one character right Alt+B — move cursor one word left Alt+F — move cursor one word right DEL, Ctrl+D — delete character under cursor Backspace, Ctrl+H — delete character left of cursor Ctrl+W — delete word left of cursor Ctrl+U — delete all characters left of cursor Ctrl+K — delete all characters right of cursor Ctrl+L — erase screen Ctrl+C — quit Down arrow, Ctrl+N — next line in command history Up arrow, Ctrl+P — previous line in command history Ctrl+R — reverse search in command history Ctrl+S — forward search in command history Tab — complete command In Windows console additional key bindings are supported: PGUP — scroll console buffer up PGDN — scroll console buffer down Ctrl+PGUP — scroll to console top Ctrl+PGDN — scroll to console bottom
sys_viewlog0=hidden (default) / 1=show (diagnostic, current session only)Show the system console window next to the game (Windows). Command-line only.
timedemo0/1run demos as a benchmark
timegraph0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)enable frame-time graph
timelimit0..1440deathmatch time limit (min)
timeout1..3600connection timeout (sec)
timescale0..100game timescale multiplier
uf1=auto screenshot at end of match / 2=auto record demo at beginning of match / 4=prefer user FOV over chased player FOV / 8=mute player chat / 16=mute observer chat / 32=mute other messages / 64=prefer chased player FOV over user FOVUser flags variable, automatically exported to game mod in userinfo. Meaning and level of support of individual flags is game mod dependent. Default value is empty. Commonly supported flags are reproduced below. Flags 4 and 64 are supported during local demo playback. Flags 4-64 are supported in MVD/GTV client mode.
ui_colorservers0/1Enables highlighting of entries in server browser with different colors. This option draws entries with low RTT in green and grays out password protected and anticheat enforced servers. Default value is 0 (disabled).
ui_debug0/1 (diagnostic, current session only)UI debug prints
ui_listalldemos0/1List all demos, including demos in packs and demos in base directories. Default value is 0 (limit the search to physical files within the current game directory).
ui_open0/1Open the existing Q2PRO-X main game menu with its logo on an ordinary idle full launch, instead of leaving the full-screen console visible. Default 1. Direct map/server/demo startup actions retain authority. The setting applies on the next process launch; 0 keeps console startup and ESC still opens the same menu.
ui_pingrate0..60Specifies the server pinging rate used by server browser, in packets per second. Default value is 0, which estimates the default pinging rate based on rate client variable.
ui_scale0 = auto / manual 1.0..10.0 (menu step 0.1)Scaling factor of the UI widgets. Default value is 0 = auto (engine picks based on resolution). Manual range 1.0..10.0 after R_ClampScale; menu step 0.1. Sub-1.0 values are silently clamped to 1.0 by the renderer. cl_menu_modern_autoscale only kicks in when ui_scale is 0.
ui_sortdemos0=dont sort / 1=sort by name / 2=sort by date / 3=sort by size / 4=sort by map / 5=sort by POVSpecifies default sorting order of entries in demo browser. Default value is 1. Negate the values for descending sorting order instead of ascending.
ui_sortservers0=dont sort / 1=sort by hostname / 2=sort by mod / 3=sort by map / 4=sort by players / 5=sort by RTTSpecifies default sorting order of entries in server browser. Default value is 0. Negate the values for descending sorting order instead of ascending.
usefog0/1enable client-side fog
vc_autojoin0=manual join only (default) / 1=autojoin on server connectAutomatically join the voice room when entering a game server. Requires vc_enable 1 and vc_room_mode "server". Triggers on CL_Connected. Leaves room automatically on disconnect.
vc_deafen0=normal (default) / 1=deafen all incomingMute all incoming voice participants. When 1, audio frames from all room participants are discarded at playback — useful for focus or streaming. Microphone capture and transmission continue normally while deafened, so other participants can still hear you.
vc_display_namestring (default empty = use player name)Display name shown to other voice room participants. If empty (default), the game player name (cvar "name") is used. Useful to set a different visible identity in the voice room without changing the in-game name.
vc_enable0=disabled (default) / 1=enabledMaster switch for the Q2PRO-X voice chat subsystem. 0 (default) = feature is completely off — no capture, no connection, no cvar side-effects. Set to 1 to activate the voice system. Both voice transmit and receive require the OpenAL sound backend.
vc_input_gain0.0..10.0 float (default 1.0)Microphone input gain multiplier applied before transmission. 1.0 = unity gain (default), up to 10.0 = 10x boost. Values above 1.0 amplify the captured signal; values below 1.0 attenuate it. Output is clipped to [-1.0, 1.0] after gain; above 3-4x expect audible saturation on loud sounds.
vc_mic_devicestring, "(default)" or exact device nameCapture (microphone) device to use. Value "(default)" (default) follows the current Windows default microphone selection. Set to an exact device name from /voice_mic_list to pin to a specific physical microphone. Saved globally, applied on next vc_mic_enable 1 / voice_join.
vc_mic_device_listquoted device names (read-only)Read-only list of the microphones voice chat found; the menu offers these for vc_mic_device.
vc_mic_enable0=mic off (default) / 1=mic enabledAllow microphone capture. 0 (default) = no audio captured or transmitted even if connected. 1 = capture is opened when joining a room. Requires OpenAL sound backend (s_enable openal) and a working capture device. Status string shows why mic is unavailable if conditions are not met — no silent degradation.
vc_ptt_mode0=VAD (voice activity) / 1=push-to-talk (default)Transmit gating mode. 1 (default) = push-to-talk: audio is sent only while the +voiceptt bind is held. 0 = voice activity detection (VAD): audio is sent automatically when RMS level exceeds vc_vad_threshold. PTT is recommended to avoid background noise leakage.
vc_receive_volume0.0..10.0 float (default 1.0)Volume multiplier for incoming voice from other participants. Independent of s_volume and s_voice_volume. 0.0 = silent, 1.0 = unity (default), 10.0 = 10x amplified. Applied per-participant at playback. Participant playback also requires the OpenAL backend. Use vc_deafen to mute all participants simultaneously.
vc_relayURL string (default empty = use control-plane response)Override relay (LiveKit media server) URL. If non-empty, the client uses this URL instead of the relay_url returned by the control-plane /voice/prepare response. Useful for local testing or self-hosted LiveKit.
vc_room_mode"server"=room per game server (default) / "manual"=room from vc_room_nameDetermines how the voice room name is computed. "server" (default): room is tied to the current game server (host:port hash). Requires an active game server connection. "manual": room name is taken from vc_room_name — allows joining any named room regardless of game server.
vc_room_namestring (default empty)Voice room name when vc_room_mode is set to "manual". Has no effect in "server" mode. Must be non-empty when using manual mode.
vc_serverURL string (default "https://voice-api.q2pro-x.com")URL of the Q2PRO-X voice control-plane service. This endpoint is called via HTTP POST /voice/prepare to obtain a LiveKit room token. Default: official Q2PRO-X hosted control-plane. Can be overridden for self-hosted deployments.
vc_vad_threshold0.0..1.0 float (default 0.02)Voice activity detection threshold. Active only when vc_ptt_mode 0. If the RMS amplitude of a captured frame is below this value, the frame is not transmitted. Lower = more sensitive (picks up quiet sounds); higher = less sensitive (requires louder speech).
versionstring (readonly)build version string (readonly)
viewsize30..120legacy viewport size
win_alwaysontop0=off (default) / 1=onKeep the game window above other windows (windowed mode).
win_disablewinkey0=off (default) / 1=onBlock the Windows key while the game window is active.
win_noalttab0=off (default) / 1=onBlock Alt-Tab while the game window is active.
win_noborder0=off (default) / 1=onDraw the game window without a border (windowed mode).
win_noresize0=off (default) / 1=onDo not let the game window be resized with the mouse (windowed mode).
win_notitle0=off (default) / 1=onDraw the game window without a title bar (windowed mode).
z_perturb0..255 (diagnostic, current session only)memory allocator perturbation pattern (debug)
zombietime0..300zombie client keep time (sec)

Single player and experiments

Variables in this section: 53.

VariableAccepted valuesDescription
cl_sp_free_worlddefault 0 / 0=stock (monsters wait) / 1=idle monsters walk aroundFree World: in local single player, a monster with nothing to fight WALKS around the level instead of standing still until it sees you. It walks and never runs, goes wherever it happens to be facing, and turns every few seconds or when something blocks the way. There are no level-design exemptions: an ambush monster, a path-corner patrol and a combat-point monster all wander too, because the point of the feature is that the level stops being the same every time. A monster stays where it is only while it has a real reason to: it is fighting someone, it is walking towards a noise it heard, it cannot walk at all, it flies or swims, or it is off the ground. Being pulled into someone ELSE's fight is a separate thing and still respects combat points, good guys and a combattarget. Off by default. No effect in deathmatch or coop. sv q2px_free_world_info prints the wander counters.
cl_sp_geo_deform0=original world (default) / 1=visually deformed worldVisual level-geometry deformation for local single player. Works only with deathmatch 0, coop 0, and a local one-player server. The drawn world mesh can become uneven or rounded, while movement, collision, savegames, PVS and server logic keep using the original BSP.
cl_sp_geo_deform_noise0..2 (preset-controlled by default)Manual fine visual roughness. Higher values add more small-scale irregularity. Usually controlled by the main strength setting.
cl_sp_geo_deform_preset0=off / 1=subtle / 2=uneven / 3=rough / 4=random subtle / 5..100=stronger variationMain deformation strength. 0 disables the feature. Higher values make the level shape more visibly uneven; changing the value live rebuilds the visible world and refreshes AVFX visual anchors.
cl_sp_geo_deform_seed0..999999 practical menu range; any integer acceptedRepeatable variation seed. Same map, seed and strength produce the same visible geometry. Changing the seed live rerolls the level look. Collision and server state are not affected.
cl_sp_geo_deform_strength0..8 wu (preset-controlled by default)Manual broad displacement amount in world units. Usually controlled by the main strength setting; manual edits are allowed and rebuild the visible world live. Does not affect collision.
cl_sp_geo_deform_tilt0..5 degrees (preset-controlled by default)Manual surface tilt amount in degrees. Higher values make surfaces lean more strongly. Usually controlled by the main strength setting.
cl_sp_geo_round_edges0=off (default) / 1=round vertical wall cornersAdds visual rounding to suitable static wall corners in local single player. Requires geometry deformation to be enabled. Moving platforms, liquids, sky, transparent surfaces and horizontal ledges are skipped. Collision and movement stay original.
cl_sp_geo_round_edges_amount0..100 percentCorner rounding amount in percent. 0 hides rounded surfaces even if the feature is enabled; 100 uses the full selected radius. Changing it live rebuilds the visible world.
cl_sp_geo_round_edges_angle_threshold30..170 degrees (default 30)Minimum angle sharpness needed for corner rounding. Higher values affect fewer, sharper corners.
cl_sp_geo_round_edges_radius0..32 wu (default 8)Requested corner rounding radius in world units before amount scaling. Short edges are limited automatically.
cl_sp_geo_round_edges_segments1..8 segmentsSmoothness of rounded corners. Higher values look smoother but add more geometry.
cl_sp_monster_skill_speed0=off (default) / 1=apply campaign skill speedMaster toggle for SP campaign skill-based monster speed. When ON, ordinary single-player monsters scale with the game skill cvar using the same DM-training table (skill 0 -> 1.0x, 1 -> 1.5x, 2 -> 3.0x, 3 -> 5.0x). Local single-player only — no effect in deathmatch, coop, demo playback, or while DM-training is active (DM-training uses its own speed system; the campaign path eagerly restores any cached scales when DM-training takes over). Stock baseq2/gamex86_64.dll untouched; the Q2PRO-X game DLL reads this cvar.
cl_sp_monster_skill_speed_scaledefault 1.0 / range 0.10..3.00 / step 0.05Intensity multiplier on top of the SP campaign skill speed table. The effective monster multiplier is 1.0 + (table - 1.0) * scale where table comes from the game skill. Default 1.0 means exactly the P1d table. 0.5 halves the added speed (skill 3 becomes 3.0x instead of 5.0x); 2.0 doubles it. Clamped to 0.10..3.00. Has no effect when the master toggle is off.
cl_sp_monster_variant_apply_bosses0=skip bosses (default) / 1=apply variants to bossesWhether to apply variants to boss-class monsters (boss1/boss2/boss3/supertank/jorg/makron/boss5). Default off because bosses are designed to look distinct as-is. Set to 1 for experimentation.
cl_sp_monster_variant_asymmetrydefault 15 / range 0..100Strength of per-monster left/right asymmetric lean in percent (P2M-B). Adds a small Y-axis lean that scales with vertical position (no effect at feet, max at head) and a sign deterministic per monster instance. Subtle by default; values above 50 look obviously crooked. Render-only — no hitbox/collision/AI changes.
cl_sp_monster_variant_auto_scale1=auto size on (default) / 0=no size variationEnable automatic per-monster overall size variation within the [scale_min, scale_max] range, with feet kept planted on the floor via real alias-model bounds. Toggles independently from color variation.
cl_sp_monster_variant_colordefault 30 / range 0..100Strength of per-monster color tint variation in percent. 0 disables tint; default 30 applies a subtle ±15% per-channel deviation at default strength=35; values above 60 look stylized and reduce readability.
cl_sp_monster_variant_scale_maxdefault 1.20 / range 0.10..10.00Largest monster size as a multiplier of the original alias model. Default 1.20 means up to 20% bigger. Values above 2.0 or below 0.5 are experimental and visually noisy. If max < min the runtime swaps them safely.
cl_sp_monster_variant_scale_mindefault 0.85 / range 0.10..10.00Smallest monster size as a multiplier of the original alias model. Default 0.85 means up to 15% smaller. Values below 0.5 or above 2.0 are experimental and visually noisy.
cl_sp_monster_variant_seeddefault 0 (= random per map load) / non-zero = reproducibleVariation seed. Same map + seed + settings produce the same set of monster appearances. Value 0 generates a fresh per-map-load random seed so the visual layout reshuffles on every map load.
cl_sp_monster_variant_shapedefault 25 / range 0..100Strength of per-monster body proportion variation in percent (P2M-B). Mildly varies torso / head / leg radial width per monster instance. Local single-player only; render-only — no hitbox/collision/AI/savegame changes. MD2/alias models get full deformation; MD5 skeletal models also get the same post-skinning local-space deformation. Bypasses the GPU lerp / GPU skeleton pipeline ONLY for shape-active monsters; all other entities keep the optimized GPU path. Values above 60 are stylized; extreme values are clamped.
cl_sp_monster_variant_strengthdefault 35 / range 0..100Overall strength of variant deviation in percent. 0 disables all variation; 100 uses the full configured min/max scale range and the full color magnitude. Acts as a master multiplier on per-monster random offsets from the default.
cl_sp_monster_variants0=off (default) / 1=apply variants while in local SPMaster toggle for monster visual variants in local single player. Makes repeated monster instances look like different individuals (overall size and color tint variation). Render-only — no gameplay, hitbox, collision, AI, damage, savegame or pathing changes. Gated to local SP only (deathmatch=0, cl.maxclients<=1, no demo playback). Stock baseq2/gamex86_64.dll untouched.
cl_sp_mutate_allow_bosses0=keep bosses untouched (default) / 1=bosses are in the poolAllows boss monsters in the randomizer pool. This can sharply increase difficulty and may affect map progression.
cl_sp_mutate_allow_linked_entities0=skip connected entities (default, safe) / 1=allow replacementWhen enabled, the randomizer may also replace scripted or connected items and monsters. Leave disabled for normal play so map progression stays safe.
cl_sp_mutate_debug0=off (default) / 1=on (diagnostic, current session only)Single-player spawn mutator diagnostics: print each per-entity mutation decision to the game log. Session tool for narrowing a map-specific problem.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_allow_bosses0=no bosses (default) / 1=bosses allowed in training poolAllows boss monsters in the DM-training monster pool. This is independent from the broader randomizer boss setting.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_allow_heavy0=light + medium only (default) / 1=heavy monsters allowedAllows heavy monsters such as gladiator and tank in the DM-training monster pool.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_countdefault 8 / range 1..32 (clamped to spawn point count)Desired number of training monsters on a DM map. The final number can be limited by available spawn points.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_custom_mapmap name (alphanumeric / underscore / subdir-slash); empty = no mapMap name used by the DM-training map picker. Type a DM map name here or through the menu field and run sp_dm_start_training.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_min_monster_distdefault 128 / wuMinimum distance between two live training monsters. Spawn points too close to another live monster are skipped.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_min_player_distdefault 384 / wuMinimum distance between the player and a training-monster spawn point. Closer points are skipped for initial spawn and respawn.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_respawn1=MP-style respawn loop (default) / 0=no respawn (finite kill set)Respawns dead training monsters after the configured delay. Respawn tries to use a free point away from the player and other live monsters.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_respawn_delaydefault 15 / minimum 1Seconds between a training monster's death and its respawn. Effective only when respawn is enabled.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_respawn_items1=respawn items (default) / 0=permanent pickups (SP vanilla)When SP DM-training is active, weapons / armor / health / ammo / powerups respawn at their original pickup points using vanilla DM-style timing (like in multiplayer). Keys, dropped items and scripted progression items are never respawned. No effect outside cl_sp_mutate_dm_training 1 + local SP. Vanilla DM (deathmatch 1) behavior is unaffected.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_score0=off (default) / 1=enable scoring roundEnables scoring for DM-map training. Killing monsters gives points, monster damage subtracts points, reaching the target wins the round, and player death ends it as defeat.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_score_damage_scaledefault 1.0 / 0.0=no damage penaltyMultiplier for score penalty from monster damage. Use 0.0 to disable damage penalty entirely; kills still award points.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_score_hud1=draw HUD (default) / 0=hidden (use sv sp_mutator_info instead)Draws the small training score HUD in the top-left corner during a scoring round. It respects scr_alpha automatically. Disable to play without the visible score.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_score_hud_xdefault 4 / negative = anchor from right edgeX position of the training score HUD in pixels. Negative values anchor from the right edge.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_score_hud_ydefault 4 / negative = anchor from bottom edgeY position of the training score HUD in pixels. Negative values anchor from the bottom edge.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_score_limitdefault 500 / minimum 1Score target that ends the training round as victory. Lower values make short rounds; higher values make longer sessions.
cl_sp_mutate_dm_training0=off (default) / 1=enable DM-map SP trainingMaster toggle for DM-map training. When enabled in local single player, suitable multiplayer maps are populated with monsters at deathmatch spawn points. Campaign maps are left alone.
cl_sp_mutate_item_cats31=all (default) / 1=armor / 2=ammo / 4=weapon / 8=powerup / 16=health / combine via bitwise ORItem category mask for the randomizer: 1 armor, 2 ammo, 4 weapons, 8 powerups, 16 health. Combine values to choose several categories; 31 means all.
cl_sp_mutate_item_mode0=off / 1=same category (default) / 2=combat set / 3=chaosReplacement scope for items. Same category keeps item families separate; combat set allows weapons and ammo to mix; chaos can replace any non-key item.
cl_sp_mutate_items0=off (default) / 1=replace items at map load in SPSingle-player item randomizer. At map load with deathmatch 0, replaces item pickups with random alternatives within the selected mode/category rules. Keys are never replaced. Scripted or connected items are protected by default. Seed 0 gives a fresh layout every map load; non-zero seed repeats the same layout. No effect in multiplayer or on remote servers.
cl_sp_mutate_lava_to_water0=off (default) / 1=lava becomes waterSP liquid swap: replace LAVA with WATER in local single player. The swap is real: former lava deals no lava damage, uses water physics/watertype, renders with the water material (enhanced water shader when cl_avfx 1), and contacts use water effects. Off by default. Local single-player only — no effect in deathmatch, coop, demo, or remote multiplayer. If both swap toggles are 1, real BSP water still becomes lava and real BSP lava becomes water independently. Game DLL + client + renderer read this cvar; stock baseq2/gamex86_64.dll is untouched.
cl_sp_mutate_liquid_swap_debug0=off (default) / 1=print swap diagnostics (diagnostic, current session only)SP liquid swap: print one diagnostic line when a liquid-swap cvar changes. For testing only; leave off in normal play. See sv sp_mutator_info for the full liquid-swap status block.
cl_sp_mutate_liquid_swap_visuals1=swap visuals (default) / 0=keep original textureSP liquid swap: master for the VISUAL material swap. When ON (default), a swapped liquid renders with the effective material (former water shows the lava texture; former lava shows water). When OFF, the swap still changes damage/physics/contents but the surface keeps its original texture. The full enhanced visual requires cl_avfx 1; with cl_avfx 0 the surface still shows the swapped texture (slightly less bright). Local single-player only.
cl_sp_mutate_monster_mode0=off / 1=same strength (default) / 2=nearby strength / 3=chaosReplacement scope for monsters. Same strength keeps weak/medium/heavy monsters within their own group; nearby strength allows neighboring groups; chaos can use any non-boss monster unless bosses are enabled separately.
cl_sp_mutate_monsters0=off (default) / 1=replace monsters at map load in SPSingle-player monster randomizer. At map load with deathmatch 0, replaces monster classes with random alternatives within the selected strength rules. Bosses and scripted monsters are protected unless explicitly allowed. No effect in multiplayer.
cl_sp_mutate_seed0=random every map load (default) / 1..9999=fixed reproducible layoutSeed for item and monster randomization. 0 gives a fresh random layout every map load. 1..9999 repeats the same layout for testing or sharing.
cl_sp_mutate_water_to_lava0=off (default) / 1=water becomes lavaSP liquid swap: replace WATER with LAVA in local single player. The swap is real, not cosmetic: water volumes deal lava damage, use lava physics/watertype, render with the lava material, and weapon/rain/snow contacts use lava effects. Off by default. Local single-player only — no effect in deathmatch, coop, demo playback, or remote multiplayer. If water_to_lava and lava_to_water are both 1, each direction applies independently to the original BSP liquid class: real water becomes lava and real lava becomes water. The renderer draws former-water surfaces with a real lava texture (the map's own lava texture if present, otherwise a canonical Q2 lava texture); the full enhanced look needs cl_avfx 1. Game DLL + client + renderer read this cvar; stock baseq2/gamex86_64.dll is untouched.

Startup intro and menu

Variables in this section: 28.

VariableAccepted valuesDescription
cl_console_font_mode0=legacy conchars / 1=San Francisco UI Text (default)Q2PRO-X console typography. 0 = legacy conchars (whatever con_font selects, default "conchars"). 1 = San Francisco UI Text Regular, rendered through a fixed 8-px cell into the existing console grid (default). Console-only — game menu (cl_menu_font_mode) and browsers/HUD use their own font cvars. This keeps the cell at CONCHAR_WIDTH / CONCHAR_HEIGHT so column count / scrollback / prompt cursor math don't change; the SF atlas is rendered at 16-px source then bilinear-downsampled to the legacy cell size, giving smoother glyph shapes than 8x8 conchars. Cyrillic glyphs come from the same atlas (CP1251 byte indices). If the SF atlas fails to register, the per-byte path silently falls back to legacy R_DrawChar so legacy high-byte content stays readable.
cl_console_utf8_ru-1=auto (default — on for Russian Windows) / 0=off / English / 1=on / RussianQ2PRO-X Russian display-localization baseline (tri-state). -1 (auto, default) turns ON automatically when Windows UI language is Russian and OFF otherwise. 0 forces English / legacy behavior regardless of OS locale. 1 forces Russian display. When effectively on: the console and menu draw paths dispatch per-byte — ASCII keeps rendering through stock conchars 1:1 (classic look preserved) while UTF-8 Cyrillic / CP1251-mappable codepoints are routed through the supplementary q2prox_console_font atlas, so Russian console output and Russian device / status text become readable without sacrificing ASCII-log readability; Q2PRO-X menu bottom status/help lines prefer Russian translations when present; console inline /cvarname help prefers Russian desc_ru / values_ru metadata when the entry carries a translation. Display-only — this does NOT enable Russian console input, Unicode editing, or any command parser change. Invalid high-byte legacy content is not force-decoded.
cl_cvar_browser_alpha0..1 (default 0.92)Opacity of the in-game Cvar Reference Overlay window background. Independent from scr_alpha: the browser keeps its own background opacity policy. When OLED UI breathing is enabled, the final alpha is modulated only by SCR_OledGetUiAlpha().
cl_cvar_browser_fullscreen0=window (default) / 1=fullscreenOpen the Cvar Browser over the whole screen instead of the framed window. The [F]/[W] button in the browser header toggles it.
cl_cvar_browser_lang(legacy, no effect; see cl_console_utf8_ru)LEGACY. The cvar browser now follows the unified Russian display-localization mode (cl_console_utf8_ru) so Russian mode -> Russian UI, English mode -> English UI coherently across console, menu hints, voice picker, and the cvar browser. This cvar is still registered so existing user configs don't error, but its value is no longer read. Use cl_console_utf8_ru instead.
cl_cvar_browser_last_taball / favorites / demo / visual / audio / input / network / gameplay / ui / server / system (default "all")Internal archived cvar that holds the last opened cvar browser tab as a stable string name ("all", "favorites", "demo", "visual", "audio", "input", "network", "gameplay", "ui", "server", "system"). Read on browser open when cl_cvar_browser_remember_tab is on, written on every tab switch. Unknown stored values fall back to "all".
cl_cvar_browser_remember_tab0=always start on All / 1=restore last tab (default)Restore the last opened cvar browser tab (All / Favorites / Demo / Visual / Audio / Input / Network / Gameplay / HUD/UI / Server / System) on next session. When off, the browser always starts on All. The current tab is recorded in cl_cvar_browser_last_tab whenever you switch tabs.
cl_cvar_browser_scale0.1..4.0 (default 1.0)Browser-local text and chrome scale multiplier for the in-game Cvar Reference Overlay. Controls browser readability independently from scr_scale: higher values make the browser font, row heights, header/search bar, and text-driven button chrome larger, without scaling the whole window as one widget.
cl_menu_alpha0..1classic menu background alpha
cl_menu_font_mode0=legacy conchars / 1=Jost Medieval (default)Q2PRO-X game menu typography. 0 = legacy stock conchars 8x8 atlas (chunky pixel-art look used by classic Q2). 1 = Jost Medieval Bold proportional smooth font, sourced from the bundled TTF and rendered via a separate menu text path (default). The Jost path is menu-only — console, HUD, server browser, demo browser, and cvar browser keep their own typography regardless of this setting. UI_ALTCOLOR / focused-row highlight, slider bar pieces, cursor, and other monospaced control glyphs always come from the legacy atlas so layout / hitbox math stays consistent. If the Jost atlas / metrics fail to load, the renderer silently falls back to legacy. Live — toggle takes effect on the next menu draw with no restart needed.
cl_menu_modern_autoscale0=off / 1=fit modern menu when ui_scale is auto (default)Responsive autoscale for the modern game menu renderer. Active only when cl_menu_visual_style = 1 (modern) AND ui_scale = 0 (auto). Picks the largest scale from {4x, 3x, 2x, 1.5x, 1x} that fits the active menu into the current content rect (≤82% wide, ≤78% tall — the headroom leaves room for the bottom menu hint band so the panel rim doesn't have to fight it), so menus do not crop on small resolutions or look tiny on 4K, and Russian labels do not force manual ui_scale edits. Explicit ui_scale > 0 always wins — autoscale never overrides a manual scale. Capped at two layout passes per menu init to avoid relayout loops.
cl_menu_utf8_ru-1=inherit global (default) / 0=English / 1=RussianQ2PRO-X game menu Russian localization override (tri-state). -1 (default) inherits cl_console_utf8_ru / global Russian display-localization. 0 forces menu English regardless of global state. 1 forces menu Russian regardless of global state. Affects menu titles, item labels, value labels, bottom hints/status, and keybind capture prompts only. Live — switching while a menu is open updates labels without restart. Does NOT enable Russian console input, change command parsing, file paths, or browser overlay language gates.
cl_menu_visual_style0=legacy renderer / 1=modern Q2PRO-X renderer (default)Visual renderer for script-based game menus. 0 = legacy keeps the classic Q2/Q2PRO text-and-bitmap renderer. 1 = modern (default) draws the same menu graph through the Q2PRO-X modern chrome: dark translucent panels, focus strip with left accent rail, modern slider track + handle, focused field box, soft shadows, Q2PRO-X wordmark/logo on the top-level main menu, and responsive layout helpers. Live switch — does not change menu mode (cl_q2prox_menu_mode), does not reload menu files, does not touch cl_menu_font_mode (typography). Legacy renderer remains fully behavior-compatible if you flip back. This controls ONLY the visual renderer/chrome, NOT the menu content path: in Q2PRO-X 1.6 Beta 5 the normal content path is always guided/standalone, classic content appears only as an emergency fallback if q2pro-x.menu2 is unavailable, and changing the visual style never re-enables classic content.
cl_q2prox_menu_badges0=hide Q2PRO-X badges (default) / 1=show green (X) on --q2prox rowsShow small green (X) markers near guided / standalone Q2PRO-X menu rows that the .menu script tagged --q2prox. Off by default (per TZ 2026-05-14 — when most rows are Q2PRO-X-specific, marking every one of them as such turns into visual noise rather than helpful signal). 1 = badges are drawn on every --q2prox row in the guided menu mode. The --q2prox markup itself is metadata and stays in the .menu files regardless; the cvar only gates the badge rendering. Live switch — toggles without menu/client restart. The emergency classic fallback never shows badges (gated by uis.guided_mode_active). Does not affect hitbox / item->rect, sliders, value columns, keyboard navigation, mouse selection, or panel layout aside from a tighter right-edge padding when the optional widening for badge clearance is unneeded.
cl_q2prox_menu_bottom_hint1=show the bottom hint band (default) / 0=hide itShow the bottom menu hint band for the currently selected row. Default ON. Turning it off hides both the text and its background and releases the reserved footer height immediately; floating mouse-hover tooltips remain independently controlled by cl_q2prox_menu_hover_hints. Live, saved in the global Q2PRO-X config.
cl_q2prox_menu_global_badges0=hide (G) badges (default) / 1=show (G) on rows bound to a globally-saved cvar (static flag OR active migration candidate)Show small (G) markers near guided / standalone Q2PRO-X menu rows whose bound cvar is saved into the global Q2PRO-X config (baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg) and shared across mods. Off by default. Since config schema 1.52 eligibility has exactly one source: the cvar carries CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_GLOBAL, either from its own registration or from the mandatory ownership registry that stamps the derived scope after the global target has migrated. The badge therefore always reflects the ACTUAL current save scope. Rows with no bound cvar (actions, submenus, separators, labels) never receive this badge. If a cvar carries both CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_GLOBAL and CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_LOCAL, the row is eligible for both (G) and (M) and they coexist. Coexists with cl_q2prox_menu_badges (X) and cl_q2prox_menu_mod_badges (M) in the recommended order (X) (G) (M). Live switch - toggles without menu/client restart. The emergency classic fallback never shows badges (gated by uis.guided_mode_active). Does not affect hitbox, sliders, value columns, navigation, or layout aside from the modern panel right-edge clearance which automatically accounts for whichever badge types are enabled and eligible.
cl_q2prox_menu_hover_hint_alphadefault 0.8 / range 0.0..1.0 (background only, not text)Background opacity of the floating hover tooltip window (cl_q2prox_menu_hover_hints): 1 = fully opaque background, 0 = fully transparent background (the tooltip text stays visible either way). The 1px frame fades with it. Does not affect the text or the bottom hint band. Default 0.8. Range 0.0..1.0 (clamped). Independent from cl_menu_alpha. Live, saved in the global Q2PRO-X config.
cl_q2prox_menu_hover_hint_delaydefault 1.5 / range 0.1..2.0 secondsSeconds the mouse cursor must rest on a guided-menu row's label/name text area before the first floating hover tooltip (cl_q2prox_menu_hover_hints) appears. Default 1.5. Range 0.1..2.0 (clamped). Once a tooltip is already visible, moving to another row's label updates it instantly; after leaving all labels for more than the short grace window, the delay applies again. Does not affect the bottom hint band or keyboard selection. Live, saved in the global Q2PRO-X config.
cl_q2prox_menu_hover_hints1=show hover tooltips (default) / 0=disableShow a floating tooltip near the mouse cursor duplicating the bottom hint band's text for the guided-menu row whose visible label the cursor rests on. ON by default. Mouse-hover only: it never changes keyboard/controller focus, the selected/highlighted row, or the bottom hint band. Appears after cl_q2prox_menu_hover_hint_delay seconds, measured from when the cursor enters the row's label/name text area (not the value/slider/bind column). Works in both legacy and modern menu visual styles. Live, saved in the global Q2PRO-X config.
cl_q2prox_menu_logo_light0=ordinary static menu logo (default) / 1=persistent animated logo light and spotlightsPersistent Q2PRO-X logo-light master for the top-level Guided menu in its modern visual style. Default OFF. When enabled, the accepted smooth logo brightness/bloom pulse, downward light field and matching menu shadows continue after the one-shot startup Intro finishes; if no Intro runs, they begin whenever the exact top-level Guided menu with the modern visual style active is visible. This does not enable fireworks, ships, meteors, comets, music or lightning. Live; no restart required. Stored in the global Q2PRO-X config.
cl_q2prox_menu_logo_lightning0=no persistent logo lightning (default) / 1=persistent animated electrical dischargesPersistent Q2PRO-X logo-lightning master for the top-level Guided menu in its modern visual style. Default OFF. When enabled, the accepted animated electrical tracers and branching discharges around the wordmark continue after the startup Intro; if no Intro runs, they begin whenever the exact top-level Guided menu with the modern visual style active is visible. Independent of cl_q2prox_menu_logo_light and does not enable any other Intro scene element or audio. Live; no restart required. Stored in the global Q2PRO-X config.
