cl_q2prox_menu_mod_badges0=hide (M) badges (default) / 1=show (M) on rows bound to a CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_LOCAL cvarShow small (M) markers near guided / standalone Q2PRO-X menu rows whose bound cvar has the CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_LOCAL flag, i.e. is saved into the current mod-local Q2PRO-X config (<gamedir>/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg). Off by default (TZ 2026-05-16). Eligibility is derived automatically from the bound cvar's flags at draw time — no manual menu markup needed and no name-prefix heuristics. Rows with no bound cvar (actions, submenus, separators, labels) never receive this badge. If a cvar carries BOTH CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_GLOBAL and CVAR_Q2PROXCFG_LOCAL, the row is eligible for both (G) and (M) and they coexist. Coexists with cl_q2prox_menu_badges (X) and cl_q2prox_menu_global_badges (G) in the recommended order (X) (G) (M). Live switch — toggles without menu/client restart. The emergency classic fallback never shows badges (gated by uis.guided_mode_active). Does not affect hitbox, sliders, value columns, navigation, or layout aside from the modern panel right-edge clearance which automatically accounts for whichever badge types are enabled and eligible.
cl_q2prox_menu_modedeprecated — Guided is always enforced; 0 is ignored and migrated to 1 (classic = emergency fallback only)DEPRECATED legacy compatibility cvar. Q2PRO-X 1.6 Beta 5 FORCES guided/standalone menu mode: the loader always loads ONLY baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.menu2 (the Q2PRO-X-native menu graph) and IGNORES this cvar's value — an archived 0 (classic) from an old config no longer selects the classic menu. Any stale non-1 value is normalized to 1 at startup with a one-line console message, so rewritten configs stop carrying it. The classic files (q2pro.menu + baseq2/q2pro-x/*.menu overlays + inject) remain on disk only as an AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY fallback if q2pro-x.menu2 is missing/unreadable — never as a user-selectable mode. The -q2proxmenu2 launch flag is accepted as a harmless no-op (guided is already the default).
cl_q2prox_menu_profilefull=complete menu (default) / multiplayer=shorter multiplayer-focused menuSelects which standalone Q2PRO-X menu graph the loader parses at startup / menu reload. "full" (default) keeps the complete Q2PRO-X menu (baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.menu2). "multiplayer" loads a shorter multiplayer-focused root menu (baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x-mp.menu2) that surfaces server join/setup, prediction, item timers, visibility, player setup, demos, sound/video and the full Config screen. If the multiplayer file is missing or unreadable the loader warns once and falls back to the full guided menu, then to the emergency classic menu only if the full guided file is also unavailable. Both profiles stay in guided/standalone mode and keep the full Config menu, so you can always switch back. Any unrecognized value is treated as "full". Applies immediately — the standalone menu graph reloads automatically, no vid_restart / restart needed. Saved to the global Q2PRO-X config, shared across all mods.
cl_q2prox_modscan0=no scan (Mods menu shows only baseq2) / 1=scan mod folders (default)Scan first-level mod folders at startup for a Quake II game DLL and cache the result, feeding the guided "Mods..." menu. For each folder it prefers a native 64-bit game DLL (gamex86_64.dll) and otherwise accepts a legacy 32-bit gamex86.dll, which the menu marks (bridge) since it runs through the Win64->Win32 bridge. The PE machine word is read off disk only (never LoadLibrary, never the bridge helper) and results are cached in baseq2/q2pro-x/mods_cache.dat with a size+mtime fast path so repeated startups don't rehash unchanged DLLs. 1 = scan on startup / when the Mods menu opens (default). 0 = no automatic scanning; the Mods menu then shows only baseq2 (local). Diagnostics: modscan_info, modscan_refresh. Archived in the global Q2PRO-X config.
cl_q2prox_startup_intro0=no startup intro / 1=one-shot intro on eligible cold launch (default)Permit the separate Q2PRO-X FLAC intro to play once on an eligible cold idle process launch into the menu/console. Default ON. It is a startup event, not ordinary game music: ogg_enable and ogg_volume do not gate or attenuate it; the normal master sound/backend gain still applies. Any explicit direct map/server/demo/cinematic startup action suppresses decoder work before playback. Beginning any map load stops and consumes an active intro for the rest of the process. Turning this OFF while it plays stops it immediately; turning it ON arms only the next eligible full launch. Never loops.
cl_q2prox_startup_intro_tracedefault 0 / 0=off, 1=trace first 120 successful presents (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: record named stage hashes (intro composite, restore, menu, presented buffer) for the first 120 successful presents; report via startup_intro_trace_info. Session-only. 0=off; zero cost at 0.
cl_q2prox_startup_intro_trace_reddefault 0 / 0=off, 1=skip the restore (controlled RED) (diagnostic, current session only)Developer-only: deliberately SKIP the intro compositor's GL state restore so the trace must catch the resulting corrupted/black frame (controlled RED). Session-only. 0=off; zero cost at 0.


Complete client command reference

Internal commands are included for reference, not as a recommendation to execute them.

CommandSyntaxDescription
+attack+attackHeld action for key bindings: fires the weapon while the key is held. With cl_instantpacket on, the press is sent to the server at once.
+back+backHeld action for key bindings: moves backward while the key is held (with +klook held it tilts the view down instead).
+demo_seek_back+demo_seek_backHeld action for key bindings: during demo playback jumps back by cl_demoplayer_overlay_seek_step_sec seconds and repeats every second while held; with Ctrl and an active playlist goes to the previous item. Does nothing outside a demo.
+demo_seek_forward+demo_seek_forwardHeld action for key bindings: during demo playback jumps forward by cl_demoplayer_overlay_seek_step_sec seconds and repeats every second while held; with Ctrl and an active playlist goes to the next item. Does nothing outside a demo.
+dropw+dropwHeld modifier for key bindings: while held, a "use <weapon>" command drops that weapon instead, together with its ammo (the Blaster has none).
+forward+forwardHeld action for key bindings: moves forward while the key is held (with +klook held it tilts the view up instead).
+it_mod+it_modHeld modifier for key bindings: while held, it_start cancels the item's timer instead of starting it.
+klook+klookHeld action for key bindings: keyboard look. While held, the forward and back keys tilt the view up and down instead of moving.
+left+leftHeld action for key bindings: turns left while the key is held (strafes left instead while +strafe is held).
+lookdown+lookdownHeld action for key bindings: tilts the view down at cl_pitchspeed while the key is held.
+lookup+lookupHeld action for key bindings: tilts the view up at cl_pitchspeed while the key is held.
+mlook+mlookHeld action for key bindings: mouse look while held. On release, if freelook is off and lookspring is on, the view recenters.
+movedown+movedownHeld action for key bindings: crouches, or swims down in water, while the key is held.
+moveleft+moveleftHeld action for key bindings: strafes left while the key is held.
+moveright+moverightHeld action for key bindings: strafes right while the key is held.
+moveup+moveupHeld action for key bindings: jumps, or swims up in water, while the key is held.
+right+rightHeld action for key bindings: turns right while the key is held (strafes right instead while +strafe is held).
+speed+speedHeld action for key bindings: switches between running and walking while held (the opposite of the cl_run setting); also speeds up keyboard turning.
+strafe+strafeHeld action for key bindings: while held, the turn keys and sideways mouse movement strafe instead of turning.
+use+useHeld action for key bindings: holds the game's use button while the key is held. With cl_instantpacket on, the press is sent to the server at once.
+voiceptt+voicepttHeld action for key bindings: push-to-talk. Opens the microphone while held; works only when connected to voice chat.
+zoom+zoomHeld action for key bindings: zooms in to cl_zoom_fov while held (never wider than your normal FOV). With cl_zoom_walk 1 it also holds +speed while zoomed.
-attack-attackRelease half of +attack: stops firing.
-back-backRelease half of +back: stops moving backward.
-demo_seek_back-demo_seek_backRelease half of +demo_seek_back: stops the repeated backward seek.
-demo_seek_forward-demo_seek_forwardRelease half of +demo_seek_forward: stops the repeated forward seek.
-dropw-dropwRelease half of +dropw: "use <weapon>" selects weapons normally again.
-forward-forwardRelease half of +forward: stops moving forward.
-it_mod-it_modRelease half of +it_mod: it_start starts timers again.
-klook-klookRelease half of +klook: forward and back keys move again.
-left-leftRelease half of +left: stops turning left.
-lookdown-lookdownRelease half of +lookdown: stops tilting the view down.
-lookup-lookupRelease half of +lookup: stops tilting the view up.
-mlook-mlookRelease half of +mlook: ends mouse look; if freelook is off and lookspring is on, the view recenters.
-movedown-movedownRelease half of +movedown: stops crouching or swimming down.
-moveleft-moveleftRelease half of +moveleft: stops strafing left.
-moveright-moverightRelease half of +moveright: stops strafing right.
-moveup-moveupRelease half of +moveup: stops jumping or swimming up.
-right-rightRelease half of +right: stops turning right.
-speed-speedRelease half of +speed: returns to the movement speed set by cl_run.
-strafe-strafeRelease half of +strafe: turn keys and the mouse turn again.
-use-useRelease half of +use: releases the game's use button.
-voiceptt-voicepttRelease half of +voiceptt: mutes the microphone again.
-zoom-zoomRelease half of +zoom: returns to your normal FOV and releases the +speed that zoom held.
_echo_echo [-e] [-n] [-c color] [-l level] [text]Extended echo for scripts: prints text to the console with options for backslash escapes (-e), no trailing newline (-n), color (-c) and message level (-l).
_ui_layout_info_ui_layout_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints the active menu, screen size and menu scale; changes nothing.
_ui_reload_menu_profile_ui_reload_menu_profileInternal command: rebuilds the menus for the current cl_q2prox_menu_profile. Queued automatically when that setting changes.
_ui_setcursor_ui_setcursor <index>Internal menu command: moves the cursor of the open menu to the item with the given number.
aadumpaadumpPrints the current status bar and scoreboard as plain text into the console. Works only while in a level.
aashotaashot [name]Saves the status bar and scoreboard as a text file in scoreshots/: under the given name, or the next free quakeNNN.txt. Works only while in a level.
addbanaddban <address[/mask]> [comment]Adds an address or subnet to the local server's ban list so players from it cannot connect. The optional comment is shown by listbans.
addblackholeaddblackhole <address[/mask]> [comment]Adds an address or subnet to the blackhole list: the local server silently ignores its out-of-game packets such as connect, status and rcon.
addcvarbanaddcvarban <cvar> <match> [log / print / stuff / kick] [comment]Makes the local server check a client cvar: when a player's value matches, the action runs (log by default; or print, stuff, kick). The comment is an optional message.
addfiltercmdaddfiltercmd <command> [ignore / log / print / stuff / kick] [comment]Blocks a client command on the local server: when a player sends it, the chosen action runs instead (ignore by default; or log, print, stuff, kick).
addgtvbanaddgtvban <address[/mask]> [comment]Adds an address or subnet to the GTV deny list: those hosts cannot connect to the server's MVD/GTV stream.
addgtvhostaddgtvhost <address[/mask]> [comment]Adds an address or subnet to the GTV allow list: those hosts connect to the server's MVD/GTV stream without the password.
addlrconcmdaddlrconcmd <command>Allows a command for limited rcon users (sv_lrcon_password): any rcon line that starts with this text is accepted.
addstuffcmdaddstuffcmd <connect / begin> <command>Adds a console command that the local server sends to every client when it connects (connect list) or enters the game (begin list).
adduserinfobanadduserinfoban <cvar> <match> [log / print / stuff / kick] [comment]Makes the local server check a player's userinfo key: when its value matches, the action runs (log by default; or print, stuff, kick). The comment is an optional message.
aliasalias [name [command]]With no arguments prints every user alias. With a name and a command line, binds that name to the command line so it can be used as a command.
autosaveautosaveSaves the single-player game into the save1 slot, replacing what was there. Refused in deathmatch, while dead, or when no game is running.
avfx_blackhole_infoavfx_blackhole_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints the Black Hole effect state and its GPU timings; not for players.
avfx_conform_infoavfx_conform_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints counters showing how AVFX snow follows the tessellated surface relief.
avfx_contact_fixtureavfx_contact_fixture [case / all] [keep]Developer test fixture for automated checks of Player Contact Effects; not for players.
avfx_contact_infoavfx_contact_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints the internal queues, counters and reset history of Player Contact Effects.
avfx_contact_resetavfx_contact_resetClears all current Player Contact Effects: blood drops, stains, decals, wounds, vapor and debris. Settings are not changed.
avfx_coverings_infoavfx_coverings_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints the internal state of the AVFX surface covering layers.
avfx_flashlight_toggleavfx_flashlight_toggleTurns the player flashlight (cl_avfx_flashlight) on or off. Handy to bind to a key.
avfx_freeze_trace_markavfx_freeze_trace_mark <text>Developer trace marker: writes a MARK line with the text into the AVFX freeze trace; works only while cl_avfx_freeze_trace is on.
avfx_overlay_texture_fixtureavfx_overlay_texture_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of AVFX overlay texture binding; not for players.
avfx_preset_generator_fixtureavfx_preset_generator_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of the AVFX Preset Generator; not for players.
avfx_preset_generator_hashavfx_preset_generator_hashDeveloper marker: prints a hash of the effective AVFX Preset Generator settings.
avfx_preset_generator_roundtrip_beginavfx_preset_generator_roundtrip_begin [seed / current]Developer round-trip probe, first half: generates settings, writes them to a test file and queues it for loading. Not for players.
avfx_preset_generator_roundtrip_endavfx_preset_generator_roundtrip_endDeveloper round-trip probe, second half: checks that the loaded settings match the generated ones and prints PASS or FAIL.
avfx_puddle_conform_infoavfx_puddle_conform_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints counters and timings of how AVFX puddles follow the tessellated surface relief.
avfx_rain_flow_resetavfx_rain_flow_resetClears the current rain runoff streams and the downstream puddles they made. Settings are not changed.
avfx_resetavfx_resetClears all live AVFX effect state (ripples, splashes, puddles, footprints, stains, meteors, comets, ships, grass, sky caches) and stops effect sounds. Settings stay; AVFX preset files run it on load.
avfx_snake_water_fixtureavfx_snake_water_fixture [x y z]Developer test fixture for automated checks of snake blood in map water; not for players.
avfx_state_dumpavfx_state_dump <tag>Developer dump: writes AVFX settings and renderer state to q2pro-x/diag/avfx_state_dump_<tag>_<time>.txt.
avfx_surface_drawing_clear_all_mapsavfx_surface_drawing_clear_all_maps [confirm]Without confirm, shows how many maps, layers and strokes would be erased. With confirm, empties the Surface Drawing data for all maps; materials and preset slots stay, and one undo is offered.
avfx_surface_drawing_clear_all_maps_undoavfx_surface_drawing_clear_all_maps_undoRestores the Surface Drawing data erased by avfx_surface_drawing_clear_all_maps. Available once, until the data changes again.
avfx_surface_drawing_clear_mapavfx_surface_drawing_clear_mapRemoves all Surface Drawing strokes and layers on the current map. Undo in the editor brings them back.
avfx_surface_drawing_editoravfx_surface_drawing_editorOpens or closes the Surface Drawing editor for painting on the walls and floors of the current map.
avfx_surface_drawing_fixtureavfx_surface_drawing_fixture [case]Developer test fixture for automated checks of Surface Drawing; not for players.
avfx_surface_drawing_infoavfx_surface_drawing_infoPrints Surface Drawing status: whether it is on, the saved data size (maps, layers, strokes), whether an all-map undo is available, and the editor panel size.
avfx_surface_drawing_panel_resetavfx_surface_drawing_panel_resetReturns the Surface Drawing editor panel to its default position, size, scale and opacity. Drawings are not touched.
avfx_surface_drawing_saveavfx_surface_drawing_saveSaves the current map's drawings to disk now. Reports when no document is open or there is nothing new to save.
avfx_surface_foliage_infoavfx_surface_foliage_infoPrints AVFX surface foliage status for each kind: whether it is on, how many plants are placed, builds and failures.
avfx_surface_grass_infoavfx_surface_grass_infoPrints AVFX surface objects status: whether grass is active and why not, its quality and lighting switches, plus the foliage report.
avfx_surface_materials_infoavfx_surface_materials_infoPrints AVFX surface materials status: which material families are requested and loaded, missing asset files, the failure reason and readiness.
avfx_surface_mirror_benchavfx_surface_mirror_benchDeveloper benchmark: times the mirror surface modes at the current view over a series of frames; turns gl_gpu_timers on. Needs mirrors active in a running map.
avfx_surface_mirror_infoavfx_surface_mirror_infoPrints AVFX mirror surfaces status: whether mirrors are set up and active, floors and walls, eligible surfaces, quality and distance.
avfx_surface_volumes_clear_all_mapsavfx_surface_volumes_clear_all_maps [confirm]Without confirm, shows how many maps and areas would be erased. With confirm, empties the steam and smoke data for all maps; the shape library and preset slots stay, and one undo is offered.
avfx_surface_volumes_clear_all_maps_undoavfx_surface_volumes_clear_all_maps_undoRestores the steam and smoke data erased by avfx_surface_volumes_clear_all_maps. Available once, until the data changes again.
avfx_surface_volumes_clear_mapavfx_surface_volumes_clear_mapRemoves all steam and smoke areas on the current map; undo can bring them back. Says so if the map is already empty.
avfx_surface_volumes_editoravfx_surface_volumes_editorOpens or closes the Surface Volumes editor for placing steam and smoke areas on the current map.
avfx_surface_volumes_fixtureavfx_surface_volumes_fixture [case]Developer test fixture for automated checks of Surface Volumes; not for players.
avfx_surface_volumes_infoavfx_surface_volumes_info [areas]Prints Surface Volumes status: switches, quality, the current map, saved data size and renderer counts. A number adds details for that many areas (up to 64).
avfx_surface_volumes_revertavfx_surface_volumes_revertDiscards unsaved steam and smoke edits on this map and reloads the last save.
avfx_surface_volumes_saveavfx_surface_volumes_saveSaves this map's steam and smoke areas; they come back the next time you enter the map. The save is postponed while shapes are still being processed or config writing is blocked.
bindbind <key> [command]With a key only, prints what that key currently does. With a key and a command, makes the key run that command.
bindlistbindlistPrints every key that currently has a command bound to it.
bsp_tess_infobsp_tess_info [verify]Prints the state of map surface tessellation: requested or not, active or why not, hardware limits, quality and distance LOD. With verify it adds pass/fail self-checks.
bsplistbsplist [verbose]Lists the map files (BSP) held in memory with their size and reference count, plus the total. Add any argument for detailed statistics of each map.
centerviewcenterviewInstantly returns your view pitch to level (looking straight ahead). Usually bound to a key.
checkcvarbanscheckcvarbansAsks every player in the game to report again the cvars on the server's cvar-ban list, so the bans' actions apply to them now. Works only while a local server is running and some cvar bans exist.
cl_avfx_blackhole_capture_fixturecl_avfx_blackhole_capture_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of black hole object capture; not for players.
cl_avfx_blackhole_impact_capture_fixturecl_avfx_blackhole_impact_capture_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of black hole capture of impact meteors; not for players.
cl_avfx_contact_defaultscl_avfx_contact_defaultsResets all Player Contact Effects settings to their defaults and clears the contact effects currently shown. Ordinary AVFX weather, sky and water settings are not touched.
cl_avfx_contact_preset_load_factorycl_avfx_contact_preset_load_factory <balanced / cinematic_extra / bloody_world>Applies one of the shipped Player Contact Effects presets: balanced, cinematic_extra or bloody_world. Without an argument prints the list.
cl_avfx_contact_preset_load_global_customcl_avfx_contact_preset_load_global_custom <1..12>Loads your saved Player Contact Effects preset from slot 1-12; settings the slot lacks get their defaults. An empty slot or one holding only a name changes nothing.
cl_avfx_contact_preset_save_global_customcl_avfx_contact_preset_save_global_custom <1..12>Saves the current Player Contact Effects settings into slot 1-12 (file q2pro-x/contact_fx/cf_global_user_N.cfg). From the console an existing slot is overwritten without asking.
cl_avfx_contact_preset_schema_dumpcl_avfx_contact_preset_schema_dump [offset] [count]Developer schema dump: prints every Player Contact Effects setting with its default, current value and range, optionally from an offset with a limit.
cl_avfx_contact_preset_set_global_custom_namecl_avfx_contact_preset_set_global_custom_name <1..12> "name"Sets the name of Player Contact Effects slot 1-12 and writes it into the slot file; for an empty slot a name-only file is created. Stored values are not changed.
cl_avfx_defaultscl_avfx_defaultsResets every AVFX setting (including single-player AVFX and contact effects) to defaults, keeps custom preset names, switches authored surface volumes and drawings to an empty set and restarts running effects.
cl_avfx_defaults_ash_dust_mistcl_avfx_defaults_ash_dust_mistResets the Ash/Dust/Mist variety settings to defaults: ash glow lights and embers, dust and mist shapes, size variation and colours. The weather preset, density and size stay as they are.
cl_avfx_defaults_audiocl_avfx_defaults_audioResets all AVFX sound settings to defaults: master and volume, wind, rain, snow, water, lava steam, thunder, impacts, meteors, footstep sounds, spaceship and black hole sounds, wildlife hiss and flies.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackholecl_avfx_defaults_blackholeResets every black hole setting to defaults, including its on/off switch, position, disk, streams, colours, quality, consumption, sounds and object capture.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_capturecl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_captureResets the black hole object-capture settings to defaults: which objects it pulls in (meteors, comets, spaceships, impact meteors), capture radius, speed, spiral and dissolve.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_colorscl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_colorsResets the black hole colours and glow to defaults: inner, outer, stream, photon ring, jet and shadow colours, brightness, bloom, god rays and cloud occlusion.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumptioncl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumptionResets the black hole consumption settings to defaults: on/off, intensity, reach, quality, and whether it consumes celestial bodies and their reflections in mirrors, water and puddles.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumption_audiocl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumption_audioResets the black hole consumption sound settings to defaults: the sound and its volume and focus, and the event sounds and their volume.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumption_earthcl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumption_earthResets the black hole's pull on Earth matter to defaults: its on/off switch and strength.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumption_mooncl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumption_moonResets the black hole's Moon dust stream to defaults: on/off, strength, stream density, width, speed and turbulence.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumption_suncl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_consumption_sunResets the black hole's pull on Sun plasma to defaults: its on/off switch and strength.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_diskcl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_diskResets the accretion disk settings to defaults: on/off, radii, thickness, opacity, brightness, density, turbulence, detail, rotation speed and the Doppler effect.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_lensingcl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_lensingResets the black hole light-bending settings to defaults: lensing strength, radius and falloff, the shadow, and the photon ring.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_positioncl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_positionResets the black hole position settings to defaults: position mode, azimuth and elevation, drift, disk tilt, precession, animation speed and seed.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_qualitycl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_qualityResets the black hole quality settings to defaults: quality level, render scale, antialiasing and temporal stability.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_streamscl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_streamsResets the black hole matter streams and jets to defaults: on/off, density, width, length, contrast, speed, and jet brightness, turbulence and pulse.
cl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_surface_liftcl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_surface_liftResets the settings for dust, clumps and rocks lifted off the map toward the black hole: on/off for each, minimum angle, overhead cone, density, speed, turbulence and rock size.
cl_avfx_defaults_cometscl_avfx_defaults_cometsResets the comet settings to defaults: on/off, rate, brightness, size, speed, tail length and width, ion and dust tails, cloud occlusion, bloom and colour.
cl_avfx_defaults_earthcl_avfx_defaults_earthResets all settings of Earth in the sky to defaults, including its on/off switch and rotation.
cl_avfx_defaults_flashlightcl_avfx_defaults_flashlightResets the flashlight settings to defaults: on/off, intensity, range, angle, softness, colour, dynamic light, flicker, battery and beam. Shadow settings are separate.
cl_avfx_defaults_flashlight_shadowscl_avfx_defaults_flashlight_shadowsResets the flashlight shadow settings to defaults: on/off, quality, strength, softness, bias, caster limit, which objects cast shadows, and shadow offsets.
cl_avfx_defaults_lava_steamcl_avfx_defaults_lava_steamResets the lava steam settings to defaults: on/off, density, height, speed, edge radius, size and transparency.
cl_avfx_defaults_lightning_dischargescl_avfx_defaults_lightning_dischargesResets lightning discharge settings to defaults: arcs over surfaces, water reaction, arcs and effects on monsters, and single-player lightning damage.
cl_avfx_defaults_lightning_settingscl_avfx_defaults_lightning_settingsResets the lightning bolt settings to defaults: on/off, frequency, duration, screen flash, impact, width, glow, branches and bloom. Sky flash and discharges are separate.
cl_avfx_defaults_meteor_impactcl_avfx_defaults_meteor_impactResets all settings of meteors that fall and hit the map to defaults, including their tails and shattering.
cl_avfx_defaults_meteor_impact_damagecl_avfx_defaults_meteor_impact_damageResets single-player meteor impact damage settings to defaults: on/off, amount, radius, knockback, falloff, line-of-sight check and breakable objects.
cl_avfx_defaults_meteorscl_avfx_defaults_meteorsResets sky meteor settings to defaults, including the meteors-and-comets switch: rate, brightness, size, speed, trail, fragmentation, burn-up and colour. Impact meteors are separate.
cl_avfx_defaults_monster_contactscl_avfx_defaults_monster_contactsResets single-player monster contact effects to defaults: snow footprints, puddle and landing splashes, sound, amount, maximum distance and per-frame limit.
cl_avfx_defaults_mooncl_avfx_defaults_moonResets all Moon settings to their defaults, including its on/off switch.
cl_avfx_defaults_puddle_reflectionscl_avfx_defaults_puddle_reflectionsResets puddle reflection settings to defaults: scene reflection and its strength and quality, reflected models by category, and reflection distortion.
cl_avfx_defaults_puddlescl_avfx_defaults_puddlesResets puddle settings to defaults: density, size, count, fill rate, step splashes, rings, runoff, dust, rain contact with water and specular shine. Reflections are separate.
cl_avfx_defaults_raincl_avfx_defaults_rainResets rain settings to defaults: realistic rain, drops, ripples on water, splashes and rain on the eyes. Puddles are separate.
cl_avfx_defaults_sky_bluecl_avfx_defaults_sky_blueResets the blue sky settings to defaults: intensity, saturation, horizon fade, cloud preservation and storm transition.
cl_avfx_defaults_snowcl_avfx_defaults_snowResets snow settings to defaults: snow patches on water (density, size, lifetime, drift) and snow quality, noise, relief and glitter.
cl_avfx_defaults_snow_covercl_avfx_defaults_snow_coverResets snow cover settings to defaults: snow material and style, transparency, coverage and prefill, accumulation (rate, density, size, count) and the snow field.
cl_avfx_defaults_snow_cover_lightingcl_avfx_defaults_snow_cover_lightingResets snow cover lighting to defaults: sun and moon lighting, night tint, glitter, how snow responds to the flashlight, and dynamic light headroom.
cl_avfx_defaults_snow_cover_shapecl_avfx_defaults_snow_cover_shapeResets snow cover shape to defaults: edge feathering and noise, relief depth, clumpy edges, edge fade, and snow smeared on walls.
cl_avfx_defaults_snow_cover_volumecl_avfx_defaults_snow_cover_volumeResets snow footprints and snow volume to defaults: footprint size, depth, strength and fade, and snow height, growth, near distance and texture scale.
cl_avfx_defaults_snowflakescl_avfx_defaults_snowflakesResets 3D snowflake settings to defaults: on/off, quality, count, size, crossed shape, tumbling and near distance. Realistic flake shapes are separate.
cl_avfx_defaults_snowflakes_fractalcl_avfx_defaults_snowflakes_fractalResets only the realistic snowflake shape settings to defaults: on/off, number of forms, tiling and size limits. Flake count and size stay as they are.
cl_avfx_defaults_spaceshipscl_avfx_defaults_spaceshipsResets the sky spaceship settings to defaults: on/off, rate, count, model, speed, size, altitude, flight arc, colour, sound, rolls, weaving and horizon clipping.
cl_avfx_defaults_starscl_avfx_defaults_starsResets the main star settings to defaults: on/off, background mode and brightness. Other star pages have their own reset.
cl_avfx_defaults_stars_bloom_orientationcl_avfx_defaults_stars_bloom_orientationResets star bloom (on/off, intensity, threshold) and the star sky orientation (mode, yaw, pitch, roll, automatic rotation speed and time) to defaults.
cl_avfx_defaults_stars_catalogcl_avfx_defaults_stars_catalogResets the real star catalogue and procedural star settings to defaults: count, brightness, size, colour, god rays and large or bright stars.
cl_avfx_defaults_stars_colorcl_avfx_defaults_stars_colorResets coloured stars and twinkling to defaults: on/off, share and intensity of coloured stars, twinkle speed and depth, and white star twinkle share.
cl_avfx_defaults_stars_constellationscl_avfx_defaults_stars_constellationsResets constellation settings to defaults: constellation lines and their transparency, and real constellations (mode, count, transparency).
cl_avfx_defaults_stars_milky_waycl_avfx_defaults_stars_milky_wayResets the Milky Way settings to defaults: on/off, brightness, width and contrast.
cl_avfx_defaults_stars_planetscl_avfx_defaults_stars_planetsResets planet settings to defaults: on/off, brightness, size, glow, real positions, and the manual sky positions of Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn.
cl_avfx_defaults_stars_visibilitycl_avfx_defaults_stars_visibilityResets star visibility settings to defaults: hiding behind clouds, fading by day and near the Moon, and clipping at the horizon.
cl_avfx_defaults_storm_settingscl_avfx_defaults_storm_settingsResets the storm on/off switch and storm density to defaults.
cl_avfx_defaults_storm_skycl_avfx_defaults_storm_skyResets the storm sky to defaults: sky override, darkness, tint, clouds and fog, lightning glow in clouds, sky flashes and local surface light from lightning.
cl_avfx_defaults_suncl_avfx_defaults_sunResets all Sun settings to defaults, including its on/off switch, position and time of day, halo, lighting, god rays and sunbeams through clouds.
cl_avfx_defaults_sun_cloud_beamscl_avfx_defaults_sun_cloud_beamsResets the sunbeams through cloud gaps to defaults: on/off, intensity, gap sharpness, presence and softness.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materialscl_avfx_defaults_surface_materialsResets Surface Materials to defaults: master, quality, distance, seed and the mold, wall water, greenery, cracks, brick and wildlife families. Coverings and drawing are separate.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_brickcl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_brickResets the brick surface material to defaults: on/off, walls and floors, variant, transparency, coverage, scale, relief, mortar, irregularity and chipping.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_coveringscl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_coveringsResets both covering layers, Floor Surfaces and Wall Surfaces, to defaults, and their drawing order.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_crackscl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_cracksResets the cracks surface material to defaults: on/off, walls and floors, variant, transparency, density, scale, width, depth, branching, chipping and edge softness.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_crawlerscl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_crawlersResets the Wildlife family (creatures on surfaces) to defaults: on/off, walls and floors, look and motion, sounds, reactions, puddle wakes, grass interaction and blood.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_drawingcl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_drawingResets the surface drawing display (on/off, walls, floors) and the editor panel's transparency, scale, position and size. Saved drawings are not touched.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_floor_surfacescl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_floor_surfacesResets the Floor Surfaces covering layer to defaults: on/off, material, where it applies, look, distribution, relief, metal and motion settings.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_greenerycl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_greeneryResets the greenery surface material to defaults: on/off, walls and floors, variant, transparency, coverage, scale, thickness, damp bias, foliage motion and colour.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_moldcl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_moldResets the mold surface material to defaults: on/off, walls and floors, transparency, coverage, variant, colour, scale and spread on walls.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_wall_surfacescl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_wall_surfacesResets the Wall Surfaces covering layer to defaults: on/off, material, where it applies, look, distribution, relief, metal and motion settings.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_wall_watercl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_wall_waterResets the water-on-walls material to defaults: on/off, variant, transparency, coverage, scale, wetness, speed, trail length, droplets and spread on walls.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_mirrorcl_avfx_defaults_surface_mirrorResets mirror surface settings to defaults: on/off, floors and walls, slope limit, scene reflection, roughness, reflected models by category and distance.
cl_avfx_defaults_surface_objectscl_avfx_defaults_surface_objectsResets Surface Objects to defaults: the master switch, grass (density, size, colour, lighting, wind, interaction with players and monsters) and the other foliage kinds.
cl_avfx_defaults_volcloudscl_avfx_defaults_volcloudsResets the main volumetric cloud settings to defaults: on/off, quality, noise source, render scale and ray steps. Shape, detail, lighting and layers have their own reset.
cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_detailcl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_detailResets volumetric cloud detail to defaults: shape and detail scale, erosion, fluffiness, turbulence, wind direction and speed, and evolution speed.
cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_layer1cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_layer1Resets cloud layer 1 to defaults: on/off, coverage, density, opacity, height, thickness, scale, detail, erosion, wind and evolution speed.
cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_layer2cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_layer2Resets cloud layer 2 to defaults: on/off, coverage, density, opacity, height, thickness, scale, detail, erosion, wind and evolution speed.
cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_layer3cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_layer3Resets cloud layer 3 to defaults: on/off, coverage, density, opacity, height, thickness, scale, detail, erosion, wind and evolution speed.
cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_layerscl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_layersResets the cloud layers switch and the number of layers to defaults. Each layer's own settings have separate resets.
cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_lightingcl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_lightingResets volumetric cloud lighting to defaults: sun and moon light, silver lining, ambient, storm darkening, sun occlusion, world shadow, local lightning glow and the debug view.
cl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_shapecl_avfx_defaults_volclouds_shapeResets volumetric cloud shape to defaults: base height, thickness, horizon fade, coverage, density, opacity, count, size and its variation, randomness and seed.
cl_avfx_defaults_volfogcl_avfx_defaults_volfogResets the main volumetric fog settings to defaults: on/off, quality, render scale and ray steps. Shape, look and lighting have their own reset.
cl_avfx_defaults_volfog_lightingcl_avfx_defaults_volfog_lightingResets volumetric fog lighting to defaults: light scattering from the sun, moon, lightning and flashlight, flashlight fog transparency, and the debug view.
cl_avfx_defaults_volfog_lookcl_avfx_defaults_volfog_lookResets volumetric fog look to defaults: density, opacity, extinction, anisotropy, noise and its scale, patchiness, seed, wind, evolution speed and colour.
cl_avfx_defaults_volfog_shapecl_avfx_defaults_volfog_shapeResets volumetric fog shape to defaults: view distance, start distance, near fade, base height, height, falloff and ground hugging.
cl_avfx_defaults_watercl_avfx_defaults_waterResets the main water settings to defaults: on/off, quality, strength, colour, surface style and speed, ripples, foam, sun and moon lighting, and realistic water.
cl_avfx_defaults_water_color_depthcl_avfx_defaults_water_color_depthResets water depth colouring to defaults: depth colour and its strength, clarity, extinction with depth, and shore and deep water mix.
cl_avfx_defaults_water_foam_shorecl_avfx_defaults_water_foam_shoreResets shore foam to defaults: on/off, range, intensity, noise, size, transparency and speed.
cl_avfx_defaults_water_reflectcl_avfx_defaults_water_reflectResets water surface reflectance to defaults: Fresnel strength and power, specular highlights and sky reflection.
cl_avfx_defaults_water_reflectionscl_avfx_defaults_water_reflectionsResets water reflection settings to defaults: scene reflection and its strength, reflected models (strength, quality, categories) and reflection distortion.
cl_avfx_defaults_water_surfacecl_avfx_defaults_water_surfaceResets the realistic water surface to defaults: wave scale and speed, normal strength and wind coupling.
cl_avfx_defaults_weapon_impactscl_avfx_defaults_weapon_impactsResets weapon impact effects on water to defaults: the master switch and each weapon's switch, plus the weapon-impacts-on-snow switch.
cl_avfx_defaults_weapon_snow_impactscl_avfx_defaults_weapon_snow_impactsResets weapon impact effects on snow to defaults: on/off, fade rate, each weapon's switch, and the snow dust particles and their colour.
cl_avfx_infocl_avfx_infoPrints a detailed report of the AVFX effects: whether the master switch is effectively on, and the state and counters of each effect family (weather, sky, water, snow, surfaces and more).
cl_avfx_perf_resetcl_avfx_perf_resetDeveloper performance telemetry: clears the AVFX timing and counter window so a fresh measurement starts now.
cl_avfx_perf_snapshotcl_avfx_perf_snapshotDeveloper performance telemetry: prints a one-shot AVFX timing and counter report. Counters accumulate only while cl_avfx_perf is 1.
cl_avfx_preset_generatecl_avfx_preset_generate [seed]Builds a random AVFX look from the generator choices in the menu (cl_avfxgen_* settings) and applies it to the AVFX settings. An optional number repeats a look exactly; an impossible fixed combination changes nothing.
cl_avfx_preset_load_customcl_avfx_preset_load_custom <1..12>Loads your saved AVFX preset from slot 1-12 of the current mod (q2pro-x/visual_presets/v_p_user_N.cfg) and turns AVFX on. An empty slot or a slot with only a name changes nothing.
cl_avfx_preset_load_global_customcl_avfx_preset_load_global_custom <1..12>Loads your saved global AVFX preset from slot 1-12 (q2pro-x/visual_presets/v_p_global_user_N.cfg in the base folder, shared by all mods) and turns AVFX on. An empty slot changes nothing.
cl_avfx_preset_load_global_music_customcl_avfx_preset_load_global_music_custom <1..6>Loads your saved global musical AVFX preset from slot 1-6 (q2pro-x/visual_presets/v_p_global_music_user_N.cfg in the base folder) and turns AVFX on. An empty slot changes nothing.
cl_avfx_preset_load_music_customcl_avfx_preset_load_music_custom <1..6>Loads your saved musical AVFX preset from slot 1-6 of the current mod (q2pro-x/visual_presets/v_p_music_user_N.cfg) and turns AVFX on. An empty slot changes nothing.
cl_avfx_preset_save_customcl_avfx_preset_save_custom <1..12>Saves all current AVFX settings to slot 1-12 of the current mod (q2pro-x/visual_presets/v_p_user_N.cfg). Overwrites the slot without the menu's confirmation; refused if the slot's name is already used by another slot.
cl_avfx_preset_save_global_customcl_avfx_preset_save_global_custom <1..12>Saves all current AVFX settings to global slot 1-12 (q2pro-x/visual_presets/v_p_global_user_N.cfg in the base folder, shared by all mods). Overwrites the slot without the menu's confirmation.
cl_avfx_preset_schema_dumpcl_avfx_preset_schema_dump [offset] [count]Developer schema dump: prints every setting an AVFX preset stores, with its default, in a machine-readable list for automated checks; not for players.
cl_avfx_preset_set_custom_namecl_avfx_preset_set_custom_name <1..12> [name]Sets the display name of mod AVFX preset slot 1-12; the name can contain spaces, and an empty name returns the default. The file itself is not rewritten; the name is stored on the next save.
cl_avfx_preset_set_global_custom_namecl_avfx_preset_set_global_custom_name <1..12> [name]Sets the display name of global AVFX preset slot 1-12; the name can contain spaces, and an empty name returns the default. The file is not rewritten; the name is stored on the next save.
cl_avfx_preset_set_global_music_custom_namecl_avfx_preset_set_global_music_custom_name <1..6> [name]Sets the display name of global musical AVFX preset slot 1-6; the name can contain spaces, and an empty name returns the default. The file is not rewritten by this command.
cl_avfx_preset_set_music_custom_namecl_avfx_preset_set_music_custom_name <1..6> [name]Sets the display name of the current mod's musical AVFX preset slot 1-6; the name can contain spaces, and an empty name returns the default. The file is not rewritten by this command.
cl_gamedir_fixturecl_gamedir_fixture <gamedir>Developer test fixture for automated checks: pretends a server switched the game folder to the given mod; not for players.
cl_gamedir_fixture_leavecl_gamedir_fixture_leave [reconnect]Developer test fixture for automated checks: runs the disconnect rule that returns the game folder to the player's own choice; not for players.
cl_lighting_preset_dumpcl_lighting_preset_dumpPrints every setting of the lighting preset with its current value, as set lines you can copy into a config. Saves nothing; use condump to keep the output.
cl_lighting_preset_load_factorycl_lighting_preset_load_factory <factory_id>Applies a factory lighting preset from q2pro-x/lighting_presets/factory/lp_<id>.cfg, e.g. cl_lighting_preset_load_factory bright. The id uses only a-z, 0-9 and underscore; a missing or invalid file changes nothing.
cl_lighting_preset_load_global_customcl_lighting_preset_load_global_custom <1..4>Applies your saved lighting preset from slot 1-4 (q2pro-x/lighting_presets/lp_user_N.cfg in the base folder). A missing or invalid slot file changes nothing.
cl_lighting_preset_save_global_customcl_lighting_preset_save_global_custom <1..4>Saves the current lighting settings to slot 1-4 (q2pro-x/lighting_presets/lp_user_N.cfg in the base folder). Overwrites the slot without the menu's confirmation.
cl_lighting_preset_set_global_custom_namecl_lighting_preset_set_global_custom_name <1..4> "name"Names lighting preset slot 1-4 and writes the name into the slot file at once; an empty slot gets a file holding only the name. A name already used by another slot is refused.
cl_music_buttons_infocl_music_buttons_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints how many times the main-menu music buttons were drawn and clicked, their positions and the mute state; not for players.
cl_music_buttons_mute_probecl_music_buttons_mute_probeDeveloper test probe for automated checks: verifies that muted menu music stays silent through a map-load fade; not for players.
cl_music_buttons_testcl_music_buttons_test <intro-sound / intro-stop / online-sound>Developer test command: presses a main-menu music button the same way a mouse click does, to check its hit area; not for players.
cl_q2px_rail_clearcl_q2px_rail_clearDeveloper test command: instantly removes all rail trails and laser beams currently on screen, for repeatable test shots; not for players.
cl_q2px_setpitchcl_q2px_setpitch <degrees>Developer test command: sets the exact vertical view angle in degrees (clamped to -89..89) for repeatable automated checks; not for players.
cl_q2px_setyawcl_q2px_setyaw <degrees>Developer test command: sets the exact horizontal view angle in degrees for repeatable automated checks; not for players.
cl_sp_avfx_snake_combat_defaultscl_sp_avfx_snake_combat_defaultsResets every AVFX snake combat setting (health, bites on monsters and on you, monster attacks on snakes and their damage, chances and intervals) to defaults. Other settings are not touched.
cl_sync_infocl_sync_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints the current frame-timing mode, frame intervals and the recent history of mode changes; not intended for players.
cl_viewbob_infocl_viewbob_infoReports how much running camera bob the server sends and whether cl_viewbob already removes it; run for a couple of seconds first. Also shows the measured camera tilt from movement.
cl_vis_items_infocl_vis_items_infoPrints the item highlighting settings (cl_vis_enable, cl_vis_items, style, single-player) and whether highlighting is active right now.
cl_vis_player_model_colorcl_vis_player_model_color <model> <#RRGGBB / preset-name / reset>Sets the highlight color of a player model, e.g. cl_vis_player_model_color male #ff0000; accepts #RRGGBB or a preset name. reset returns the model to the automatic palette; with no arguments lists presets.
cl_vis_player_model_colors_resetcl_vis_player_model_colors_resetClears every per-model highlight color you set, so all player models go back to the automatic palette.
cl_vis_player_models_infocl_vis_player_models_infoLists every installed player model with its highlight color and whether it is your override or automatic, plus saved colors for models that are not installed.
cl_visibility_preset_dumpcl_visibility_preset_dumpPrints every setting of the visibility preset, including per-model colors, with current values as set lines you can copy into a config. Saves nothing; use condump to keep the output.
cl_visibility_preset_generatecl_visibility_preset_generateTurns the visibility highlights on and applies random colors and strengths to them, including random colors for player models (male, female, cyborg at least). Nothing is saved to a slot.
cl_visibility_preset_load_factorycl_visibility_preset_load_factory <factory_id>Applies a factory visibility preset from q2pro-x/visibility_presets/factory/vp_<id>.cfg, e.g. cl_visibility_preset_load_factory ffa_auto. The id uses only a-z, 0-9 and underscore; a missing file changes nothing.
cl_visibility_preset_load_global_customcl_visibility_preset_load_global_custom <1..4>Applies your saved visibility preset from slot 1-4 (q2pro-x/visibility_presets/vp_user_N.cfg in the base folder). A missing or invalid slot file changes nothing.
cl_visibility_preset_save_global_customcl_visibility_preset_save_global_custom <1..4>Saves the current visibility settings, including per-model colors, to slot 1-4 (q2pro-x/visibility_presets/vp_user_N.cfg in the base folder). Overwrites the slot without the menu's confirmation.
cl_visibility_preset_set_global_custom_namecl_visibility_preset_set_global_custom_name <1..4> "name"Names visibility preset slot 1-4 and writes the name into the slot file at once; an empty slot gets a file holding only the name. A name already used by another slot is refused.
clearclearErases the console text buffer. Nothing on disk is touched.
clearchathudclearchathudRemoves all chat lines currently shown in the on-screen chat HUD. The console history is not touched.
clearnotifyclearnotifyImmediately removes the console lines that are drawn over the game view.
cmdcmd <command> [arguments]Sends the rest of the line to the server as a command, e.g. cmd players. Works only when connected; does nothing during demo playback.
cmdlistcmdlist [wildcard]Prints every command currently registered in the engine, optionally filtered by a wildcard pattern.
completecomplete <command>Registers a name as a server command so Tab completion knows it; typing it later sends it to the server. Refused if a setting has that name; does nothing if the command already exists.
condumpcondump <filename>Writes the current console scrollback into a text file so it can be read or attached to a bug report.
connectconnect <server>Leaves the current game and connects to the given server address.
connect_autoportconnect_autoport <server>Connects to a server, first probing several local client ports and keeping the one with the fastest reply. Leaves the current game or local server; quake2:// links are accepted.
cvar_browsercvar_browserOpens the Cvar Browser, where you can search, read and change settings and commands.
cvar_browser_avfx_doc_auditcvar_browser_avfx_doc_auditDeveloper audit for automated checks: verifies that every AVFX setting is listed, searchable and described in both languages in the Cvar Browser; not for players.
cvar_browser_closecvar_browser_closeCloses the Cvar Browser if it is open.
cvar_browser_favorites_infocvar_browser_favorites_infoPrints how many settings are in the Cvar Browser favorites, the file they are kept in (q2pro-x/cvar_browser_state.txt) and the first 32 names.
cvar_browser_favorites_prunecvar_browser_favorites_pruneRemoves from the Cvar Browser favorites every setting that does not exist in this build and saves the favorites file.
cvar_browser_fixturecvar_browser_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of the Cvar Browser; not for players.
cvar_browser_opencvar_browser_openOpens the Cvar Browser; same as cvar_browser.
cvar_browser_resumecvar_browser_resumeInternal: reopens the Cvar Browser on the same tab, search and selection after a menu it launched is closed.
cvar_browser_togglecvar_browser_toggleOpens the Cvar Browser if it is closed, closes it if it is open. Handy for a key bind.
cvar_helpcvar_helpOpens the Cvar Browser with descriptions of settings and commands; same as cvar_browser. Arguments are ignored.
cvar_session_only_infocvar_session_only_infoDeveloper diagnostic: counts the session-only diagnostic settings, checks that none of them is saved to configs, and lists attempts to set them from configs that were refused.
cvarlistcvarlist [-acfhlmnrstuv] [wildcard]Prints console variables, optionally filtered by flags. The Cvar Browser is the searchable version of this with descriptions.
decdec <variable> [value]Subtracts the given amount from a numeric variable (1 if omitted).
delbandelban <address[/mask] / id / all>Removes an address ban from the local server's ban list by address/mask or by its number from listbans; all clears the whole list.
delblackholedelblackhole <address[/mask] / id / all>Removes an address from the local server's blackhole list (addresses whose packets are ignored) by address/mask or number from listblackholes; all clears the list.
delcvarbandelcvarban <id / var / all>Removes bans on client setting values from the local server by number from listcvarbans or by setting name (all bans for that name); all clears the list.
delfiltercmddelfiltercmd <id / cmd / all>Removes a client command filter from the local server by number from listfiltercmds or by command name; all clears the list.
delgtvbandelgtvban <address[/mask] / id / all>Removes an address from the server's GTV (MVD relay) ban list by address/mask or number from listgtvbans; all clears the list.
delgtvhostdelgtvhost <address[/mask] / id / all>Removes an address from the GTV (MVD relay) trusted list, whose hosts connect without the password, by address/mask or number from listgtvhosts; all clears the list.
dellrconcmddellrconcmd <id / cmd / all>Removes a command from the local server's limited rcon list by number from listlrconcmds or by its text; all clears the list.
delstuffcmddelstuffcmd <connect / begin> <id / cmd / all>Removes a command the local server sends to clients on connect or on begin, by number from liststuffcmds or by its text; all clears that list.
deluserinfobandeluserinfoban <id / var / all>Removes bans on client userinfo values from the local server by number from listuserinfobans or by key name (all bans for that key); all clears the list.
demodemo [--mod <mod>] [mod/]<filename> [compat]Searches the current mod, baseq2, then other local mod folders. Use mod/filename or --mod to choose one mod; duplicate matches are reported.
demo_analytics_infodemo_analytics_infoPrints the demo analytics state for the demo being watched: source, mode, how many positions, frags and pickups were collected and the map bounds. Works only during demo playback.
demo_analytics_rescandemo_analytics_rescanDiscards the collected analytics and scans the currently playing MVD demo again. Works only while an MVD demo is playing.
demo_browser_closedemo_browser_closeCloses the demo browser if it is open.
demo_browser_favorites_infodemo_browser_favorites_infoPrints how many demos are in the demo browser favorites, the file they are kept in (q2pro-x/demo_browser_state.txt) and the first 32 entries.
demo_browser_favorites_prunedemo_browser_favorites_pruneRemoves from the demo browser favorites every demo that is no longer in the demo index and saves the favorites file.
demo_browser_fixturedemo_browser_fixture <op> [value]Developer test fixture for automated checks of the demo browser; not for players.
demo_browser_opendemo_browser_openOpens the demo browser, where you can find, sort and play your demos.
demo_browser_toggledemo_browser_toggleOpens the demo browser if it is closed, closes it if it is open. Handy for a key bind.
demo_director_cycledemo_director_cycleSwitches the MVD demo auto-camera to the next mode (off, next frag, quad, invulnerability, leader) and prints the new mode.
demo_director_offdemo_director_offTurns off the automatic camera in MVD demos, so the view stays on the player you choose.
demo_director_setdemo_director_set <off / next_frag / quad / penta / leader>Sets the automatic camera mode for MVD demos: off, next_frag, quad, penta (invulnerability) or leader, e.g. demo_director_set leader. With no argument prints the current mode.
demo_index_rebuilddemo_index_rebuildRescans all demos from scratch in the background and refreshes the demo browser list; the demo library cache file is rewritten. The game is not blocked.
demo_index_refreshdemo_index_refreshPicks up new, changed or removed demos in the background and refreshes the demo browser list; the demo library cache file may be updated. The game is not blocked.
demo_item_timers_infodemo_item_timers_infoLists the items found for item timers in the demo being watched, with respawn intervals and which are shown or filtered. Works only during demo playback; .dm2 demos have no timer data.
demo_item_timers_strip_editdemo_item_timers_strip_editTurns on or off edit mode for the demo item-timer strip: drag it with the left mouse button, Enter or Escape to finish. While editing, keys do not reach the game.
demo_item_timers_strip_resetdemo_item_timers_strip_resetReturns the demo item-timer strip to its default position.
demo_pause_toggledemo_pause_togglePauses or resumes the demo being played. Does nothing outside demo playback, so it is safe to bind to a key used in the game.
demo_player_closedemo_player_closeHides the demo player panel; the demo keeps playing.
demo_player_indexdemo_player_indexDeveloper diagnostic: prints which demo list entry the demo player matched to the playing demo; not for players.
demo_player_opendemo_player_openShows the demo player panel and frees the mouse cursor for it; closes the console. The panel appears only while a demo is playing.
demo_player_toggledemo_player_toggleShows the demo player panel if it is hidden, hides it if it is shown. Handy for a key bind.
demo_playlist_cleardemo_playlist_clearEmpties the demo playlist queue; the current demo is not stopped, but no next demo will follow.
demo_playlist_nextdemo_playlist_nextStarts the next demo in the playlist queue. Does nothing on the last item or without a queue.
demo_playlist_prevdemo_playlist_prevStarts the previous demo in the playlist queue. Does nothing on the first item or without a queue.
demomapdemomap <mapname>Loads a map, cinematic (.cin) or picture (.pcx) on the local server like map, but without wiping single-player saves; a .dm2 name is played as a demo instead.
dirdir <directory> [.extension]Lists the contents of a virtual game directory, optionally limited to one extension.
disconnectdisconnectDrops the connection to the server and returns to the menu.
dnsdns <address>Resolves a host name through DNS and prints its canonical name and IP addresses; a :port suffix is ignored. IPv6 results only when net_enable_ipv6 is on.
downloaddownload <filename>Asks the connected server for a file you do not have and saves it into the game folder, e.g. download maps/q2dm1.bsp. Requires a connection; not possible when downloads are disabled (allow_download -1).
drawdraw <name> <x> <y> [color]Shows a setting or macro value on screen at x y, e.g. draw cl_fps 10 10; negative x aligns to the right, color can be a color, alt or none. Without arguments lists what is drawn.
dropdrop <item>Game command sent to the server: drops the named item from your inventory, e.g. drop rockets. Whether it works depends on the game mod; Tab completes item names.
dumpclientsdumpclientsPrints the slot number and name of every player known in the current game. Works only while in a level.
dumpentsdumpents <filename>Writes the entity text of the map loaded on the local server to entdumps/<filename>.ent. Requires a running local map.
dumplayoutdumplayout <filename>Writes the layout program the server sent last (scoreboard, inventory and similar) to layouts/<filename>.txt. Works only in a level and when a layout exists.
dumpstatusbardumpstatusbar <filename>Writes the status bar program sent by the server to layouts/<filename>.txt. Works only while in a level.
dumpuserdumpuser <userid>Prints the userinfo and extra connection details of a player on the local server, chosen by id or name. Requires a running server.
echoecho <text>Prints its arguments back to the console. Mostly useful inside aliases and config scripts to report what they are doing.
emissive_lights_infoemissive_lights_infoPrints the state of lighting from glowing map surfaces and spawn markers: settings, how many sources the map has, and how many were lit or skipped in the last frame.
enen [-team] <Russian text>Sends Russian text to the configured online translator and puts the English result into the console or chat prompt for you to send with Enter; -team targets team chat. Nothing is sent automatically.
execexec <filename>Reads a .cfg file and executes every line in it as a console command.
fdirfdir <filter>Searches the whole search path for files matching a wildcard filter.
fogfog <r g b density> [sky_factor]Sets your own global fog: color r g b and density from 0 to 1, plus optional sky factor, e.g. fog 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.05; it replaces the map's fog. Without arguments prints the current fog.
followipfollowip [index]Connects to the most recent server address seen in chat; a number picks an older one (0 is the latest). Prints a notice if there is none.
forcemenuoffforcemenuoffCloses every open menu at once and returns input to the game.
fragfeed_previewfragfeed_previewShows a sample frag feed for about 6 seconds so you can check its position, size and colours.
fragfeed_resetfragfeed_resetResets all frag feed settings (cl_fragfeed_*) to their defaults.
frame_spike_infoframe_spike_infoPrints frame time statistics (average and percentiles) and a list of recent slow frames above r_frame_spike_threshold_ms with a breakdown by render stage.
frame_spike_resetframe_spike_resetClears the collected frame time statistics and the list of slow frames shown by frame_spike_info.
fs_restartfs_restartTears down and rebuilds the whole file system: the search path is rescanned and every cached game file handle is dropped. Heavy, and normally only needed after changing game directories or adding PAK files while running.
game_stats_cache_cleargame_stats_cache_clearDeletes the match results stored in the Game Statistics demo cache and rewrites the cache file. The list of demo files and your settings are kept.
game_stats_closegame_stats_closeCloses the Game Statistics window and remembers its position and size.
game_stats_fixturegame_stats_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of Game Statistics; not for players.
game_stats_infogame_stats_infoPrints the state of the demo library behind Game Statistics: cache file, scanned folders, demo counts, timings and whether a background scan is running.
game_stats_layout_resetgame_stats_layout_resetResets the panel layout of the Game Statistics window to its default.
game_stats_opengame_stats_openOpens the Game Statistics window with your results collected from recorded demos.
game_stats_rebuildgame_stats_rebuildReads all demos in the current date window again from scratch in the background and updates the statistics cache file.
game_stats_refreshgame_stats_refreshLooks for new or changed demos in the background and updates Game Statistics and its cache file; unchanged demos are not read again.
game_stats_resultsgame_stats_resultsPrints wins, losses and draws for your tracked names (name and cl_game_stats_names) over cl_game_stats_days, with opponents and the demo file behind each result.
game_stats_togglegame_stats_toggleOpens the Game Statistics window, or closes it if it is already open.
gamemapgamemap <mapname>Changes the map on the running local server without a full restart; in single player the state of visited levels is kept. A name starting with * clears saved levels.
ghost_hg_fixtureghost_hg_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of hand grenade prediction; not for players.
givegive <item / all / health / weapons / ammo / armor> [amount]Asks the game server to give you an item, e.g. give railgun, give all, give health 100. In the standard game deathmatch and co-op allow it only when the server runs with cheats 1.
gl_capabilitiesgl_capabilitiesPrints the graphics driver vendor, OpenGL and shader versions and which renderer features your card supports.
gl_hdr_infogl_hdr_infoPrints the HDR state: graphics API level, the gl_hdr setting, the scene format that would be used and the Windows HDR switch status.
gl_hdr_transition_infogl_hdr_transition_infoPrints the state of the Windows HDR display switch done by the game: requested and actual mode, the display and the last step. Prints nothing in builds without this feature.
gl_postfx_infogl_postfx_infoPrints the post-process filter settings (gl_postfx mode, strength, pixel and CRT options) and whether the filter is actually active.
gl_render_scale_infogl_render_scale_infoPrints the requested and applied render scale, the method in use, internal and output resolutions and the limits of your graphics card.
gl_visual_fx_infogl_visual_fx_infoPrints bloom, colour grading and sharpening settings, showing the requested value next to the value actually applied.
godgodAsks the game server to toggle god mode (you take no damage). In the standard game deathmatch and co-op allow it only when the server runs with cheats 1.
gun_modelgun_model [name]Developer tool: replaces the view weapon model with models/<name>/tris.md2; with no argument the normal model returns.
gun_nextgun_nextDeveloper tool: moves the forced animation frame of the view weapon one step forward and prints its number.
gun_prevgun_prevDeveloper tool: moves the forced animation frame of the view weapon one step back (not below 0) and prints its number.
heartbeatheartbeatMakes the local server send a heartbeat to its master servers right away, so it appears in server lists sooner.
ifif <expr> <op> <expr> [then] <command> [else <command>]For scripts and binds: compares two values with ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, isin, isini, eq or ne and runs the command after then, or the one after else.
ignorenickignorenick [nick]Hides chat from players whose name matches the pattern. With no arguments, prints the current filters.
ignoretextignoretext [match]Hides incoming chat lines that match the given text pattern. With no arguments, prints the current filters.
imagelistimagelistPrints every image the renderer has loaded, with size and format. Useful for tracking texture memory.
impulseimpulse <number>Sends an impulse number to the game with the next movement command; mods use impulses for their own actions.
in_restartin_restartReinitialises keyboard and mouse input. Use it after plugging in a device or when input settings need to be re-applied.
incinc <variable> [value]Adds the given amount to a numeric variable (1 if omitted).
infoinfoSends the info command to the game server; only some mods use it. The standard game has no such command and treats the text as a chat message.
invdropinvdropAsks the game server to drop the item selected in your inventory.
inveninvenAsks the game server to show the inventory panel, or hide it if it is shown.
invnextinvnextAsks the game server to select the next item in your inventory.
invprevinvprevAsks the game server to select the previous item in your inventory.
invuseinvuseAsks the game server to use the item selected in your inventory.
it_cancelit_cancel <id / all> [ordinal]Cancels running timers for an item, e.g. it_cancel ra. Add a spawn number to cancel only that spawn, or use it_cancel all to cancel every timer.
it_infoit_info [active / world]Prints item timer settings and the item list with ids (ga, ya, ra, mh, quad...). it_info active lists running timers, it_info world lists item spawns on this map.
it_menuit_menuOpens the live item timers settings menu.
it_resetit_resetCancels all running item timers and forgets the respawn intervals learned on this map.
it_startit_start <id> [seconds / ordinal / nearest]Starts a respawn timer for an item without picking it up, e.g. it_start ra. The optional second argument is seconds (up to 600), the spawn number or nearest. While +it_mod is held it cancels instead.
kickkick <userid>Disconnects a player from your local server. Give the player's number from status or the name. Works only while a server is running.
kickbankickban <userid>Disconnects a player from your local server and adds their IP address to the ban list for the rest of the server session.
killkillAsks the game server to kill your player (suicide). The standard game ignores it during the first 5 seconds after respawn.
killserverkillserverShuts down the running local server and disconnects all players.
laghax_ah_probelaghax_ah_probe <net_stress> [expect_hidden] / resultDeveloper probe of the network HUD auto-hide logic with a made-up network load value; not for players.
laghax_hud_editlaghax_hud_editTurns edit mode for the network (laghax) HUD on or off: drag it with the left mouse button, press Enter or Escape to finish.
laghax_hud_resetlaghax_hud_resetReturns the network (laghax) HUD to its default position in the top right corner.
laghax_stats_fixturelaghax_stats_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of the network HUD statistics; not for players.
lasterrorlasterrorPrints the last operating-system error the engine recorded — the first thing to check when a file or socket operation failed silently.
linklink [name target]Creates a path link so requests for one virtual game path are served from another. Affects READING only and lasts for this session; it does not move or modify anything on disk. With no arguments it lists existing links.
listbanslistbansLists IP addresses banned on the local server (addban, kickban) with hit counts and comments.
listblackholeslistblackholesLists blackhole addresses whose packets the local server ignores completely (addblackhole).
listcvarbanslistcvarbansLists cvar bans of the local server: which client variable values are checked and what action is taken.
listfiltercmdslistfiltercmdsLists client commands filtered by the local server and the action for each (ignore, log, print, stuff, kick).
listgtvbanslistgtvbansLists addresses banned from connecting to the local server as GTV relays (addgtvban).
listgtvhostslistgtvhostsLists addresses allowed to connect to the local server as GTV relays (addgtvhost).
listlrconcmdslistlrconcmdsLists commands allowed through the limited remote console (lrcon) of the local server.
listmasterslistmastersLists the master servers the local server reports to, with the time of the last reply from each.
liststuffcmdsliststuffcmds <connect / begin>Lists commands the local server sends to each client when it connects (connect) or enters the game (begin).
listuserinfobanslistuserinfobansLists userinfo bans of the local server: which values in player info are checked and what action is taken.
loadload <directory>Loads a single player save from save/<name>. The current game's working save is wiped and replaced, so unsaved progress is lost.
locloc <add / del / set / list / save>Edits named map locations used in chat: loc add <name> at your position, loc del or loc set <name> for the nearest one, loc list, loc save [name] writes locs/<map>.loc. Only in a level.
macrolistmacrolist [wildcard]Prints the $macro names the console can expand inside a command line, such as $health or $mapname.
mapmap <mapname> [force]Starts a local server on the map with a full restart. If a game is already running it only warns and suggests gamemap, unless you add force or set sv_allow_map.
messagemodemessagemodeOpens the one-line chat prompt for a message to everyone. Normally bound to a key rather than typed.
messagemode2messagemode2Opens the one-line chat prompt for a team message.
modellistmodellistPrints every model currently loaded, with its memory footprint.
modhelp_nextmodhelp_nextGoes to the next page of the mod help overlay. Does nothing while the overlay is closed.
modhelp_pagemodhelp_page <number>Jumps to the given page of the mod help overlay, counting from 0. Does nothing while the overlay is closed.
modhelp_prevmodhelp_prevGoes to the previous page of the mod help overlay. Does nothing while the overlay is closed.
modhelp_reloadmodhelp_reloadReloads the mod help command lists from the q2pro.modhelp files; closes the overlay if the current mod is no longer supported.
modhelp_scrolldownmodhelp_scrolldownScrolls the mod help overlay down one line while it is open.
modhelp_scrollupmodhelp_scrollupScrolls the mod help overlay up one line while it is open.
modhelp_searchmodhelp_searchOpens the search field across all pages of the mod help overlay. Works only while the overlay is open.
modhelp_togglemodhelp_toggleOpens or closes the mod help overlay with clickable commands for the current mod (OpenTDM, OpenFFA). Prints a message if no supported mod is running.
modscan_infomodscan_infoPrints the game mods found in mod folders (folders with a game DLL), whether each runs natively in 64-bit or through the 32-bit bridge, and the scan cache.
modscan_refreshmodscan_refreshScans the mod folders again and saves the result to the cache file. If cl_q2prox_modscan is 0 it clears the mod list instead.
movementfeel_infomovementfeel_infoPrints the movement feel mode (cl_movement_feel_mode), which timing path is actually used, whether cl_fixedmove applies, and the prediction and step smoothing modes.
mso_statusmso_statusPrints the mod skin override settings for yourself and other players and which model and skin are currently loaded for each.
music_health_ambient_infomusic_health_ambient_infoPrints the state of the health-based ambient music: status, game scope and the armor and power values it reacts to.
music_health_ambient_resetmusic_health_ambient_resetTurns the health-based ambient music off and resets its volume, transition, profile and health thresholds to defaults.
music_online_closemusic_online_closeCloses the online music window; playback is not stopped.
music_online_end_modemusic_online_end_mode <stop / repeat_all / repeat_one>Sets what happens after the last track: stop, repeat_all or repeat_one (or 0-2). The current mode is printed only when cl_music_online_console_status is 1.
music_online_fixturemusic_online_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of the online music window; not for players.
music_online_genremusic_online_genre <slug>Adds a genre to the current genre selection or removes it, then opens the window and loads tracks from PROMODJ. The saved preferred genres are not changed.
music_online_genresmusic_online_genresOpens the online music window and downloads the list of genres from PROMODJ.
music_online_infomusic_online_infoPrints the online music state: whether it is on, the stream state and current track, autoplay, volume, queue modes, genres and window settings.
music_online_load_genresmusic_online_load_genresOpens the window and loads tracks from PROMODJ for the selected genres, or the general list when genre mode is off.
music_online_luckymusic_online_luckyOpens the window and plays a random track; cl_music_online_lucky_scope decides whether it comes from the current results, a random genre or all music.
music_online_nextmusic_online_nextPlays the next track from the results; if nothing has been played yet, starts the results.
music_online_openmusic_online_openOpens the online music window. If online music was off (cl_music_online_enable 0), it is turned on.
music_online_open_track_pagemusic_online_open_track_pageOpens the PROMODJ page of the current track in your web browser.
music_online_pausemusic_online_pausePauses online music, or resumes it if it is paused.
music_online_playmusic_online_play [url]With a PROMODJ track page link or pdj.cc short link, finds the stream and plays it; with no argument resumes paused music. Requires cl_music_online_enable 1.
music_online_play_resultsmusic_online_play_resultsPlays the current search or genre results from the first track, or from a random one in roulette queue mode.
music_online_prevmusic_online_prevPlays the previous track from the results.
music_online_probemusic_online_probeDeveloper network check of the PROMODJ catalog (genres, listing, search, stream link); starts no playback. Requires cl_music_online_enable 1.
music_online_probe_trackmusic_online_probe_track <track_page_url>Developer check of one PROMODJ track link: prints its artist, title, styles and stream address. Requires cl_music_online_enable 1.
music_online_queue_modemusic_online_queue_mode <sequential / roulette>Sets the order of tracks: sequential or roulette (or 0-1). The current mode is printed only when cl_music_online_console_status is 1.
music_online_refreshmusic_online_refreshOpens the window and repeats the last search, or reloads the genre tracks if there is no search text.
music_online_searchmusic_online_search <query>Opens the online music window and searches PROMODJ for tracks matching the text.
music_online_seekmusic_online_seek <seconds>Jumps to the given second of the current online track.
music_online_stopmusic_online_stopStops online music playback and cancels any track that is still being loaded.
music_online_togglemusic_online_toggleOpens the online music window, or closes it if it is open. Opening turns online music on if it was off.
music_online_volumemusic_online_volume [value]Sets the online music volume (cl_music_online_volume, default 0.70); s_volume stays the master volume. With no value it only reports the current one, and only when online music console status is enabled.
mvdchannelsmvdchannels [recordings]Lists the local server's MVD channels: id, name, map, spectators, players, state and address. With an argument starting with r it lists their MVD recordings instead.
mvdconnectmvdconnect [--name <name>] [--user <user>] [--pass <password>] <address[:port]>Opens a new relay connection from the local server to a remote MVD/GTV server. Options: --name for the channel name, --user and --pass for login. A second connection to the same address is refused.
mvdcontrolmvdcontrol [--name <name>] [--loop <number>] [chanid]Changes attributes of an existing MVD channel. In this build only --name (rename) has an effect; the --loop option is accepted but ignored.
mvdisconnectmvdisconnect [--all] [conn_id]Destroys the given MVD/GTV server connection of the local server, or all of them with --all.
mvdkillmvdkill [chanid]Destroys the given MVD channel on the local server (the current one if no id is given).
mvdpausemvdpause [chanid]Pauses or resumes playback of an MVD channel. Works only on channels that play a demo file, not on live relays.
mvdplaymvdplay [--mod <mod>] [--name <name>] [--loop <number>] [--replace <chanid>] [mod/]<filename> [...]Creates a new MVD channel on the local server and plays one or more demos/<name>.mvd2 files as a playlist. --mod picks the mod folder, --name names the channel, --replace swaps the playlist of an existing channel.
mvdrecordmvdrecord [-z] <filename>Starts recording the local server's game to demos/<filename>.mvd2 (-z compresses it with gzip). Needs a running server; when the server is relaying an MVD channel, that channel is recorded instead.
mvdseekmvdseek [+-]<timespec / percent>[%] [chanid]Jumps to a time or percentage in an MVD demo channel: an absolute time, +/- for relative, or a value with % for a file position. Works only on demo channels and not while that channel is being recorded.
mvdserversmvdserversLists the local server's MVD/GTV connections with id, name, state, compression ratio, time since the last message and address.
