mvdskipmvdskip [chanid] [count]Skips the given number of maps (default 1) in an MVD demo channel. Works only on demo channels.
mvdspawnmvdspawnShuts down the current local game and starts the local server in MVD relay mode, with spectators placed in the waiting room until a channel is available.
mvdstopmvdstop [chanid]Stops the local MVD recording started with mvdrecord; on a server relaying MVD it stops recording of the given channel.
mvdstuffmvdstuff <command>Runs a command on behalf of the server's hidden MVD observer client. Works only while that observer is active; otherwise it reports that it is not.
net_restartnet_restartCloses and reopens the network sockets so changed network settings take effect. An active connection is lost.
net_statsnet_statsPrints packet and byte counters for the network layer.
network_god_applynetwork_god_apply <plan id>Confirms the current frozen Network God recommendation by its plan id; the change applies to this session and Undo stays available. Requires Guided or Automatic mode; an outdated id is refused.
network_god_diagnosenetwork_god_diagnoseRe-evaluates the connection right now and prints the full Network God report. Does nothing useful while Network God is off, because nothing is collected then.
network_god_guardian_cancelnetwork_god_guardian_cancelCancels the connection recovery that Network God has open. If no recovery is open, it just says so.
network_god_hud_editnetwork_god_hud_editTurns HUD edit mode on or off: the overlay window and menu close and the strip can be dragged with the left mouse button; Enter or Escape leaves. Refuses if the HUD is not being drawn.
network_god_hud_resetnetwork_god_hud_resetResets the Network God HUD layout to defaults: bottom-right, no offset, scale 1.0, opacity 0.90, horizontal. What the HUD shows is not changed.
network_god_infonetwork_god_infoPrints the Network God report: connection health, ping, loss, send rate, local stalls, other traffic on the computer, active changes, diagnoses and plans. When off or not connected it prints only a short status.
network_god_keepnetwork_god_keepOpens a confirmation dialog to keep the current Network God change permanently. Only a verified improvement that can be saved qualifies; the setting is written only after you press OK.
network_god_opennetwork_god_openOpens the Network God window on the Summary tab. If a menu is open, it closes so the window is visible.
network_god_open_modulesnetwork_god_open_modulesOpens the Network God window on the Modules tab. If a menu is open, it closes so the window is visible.
network_god_report_copynetwork_god_report_copyCopies the current Network God text report to the clipboard. Needs a published snapshot (Network God on and connected).
network_god_report_savenetwork_god_report_saveSaves the current Network God report as .txt and .json files in q2pro-x/network-god/reports/, named by date, time and server. Needs a published snapshot.
network_god_reset_sessionnetwork_god_reset_sessionClears Network God's session baseline and history and removes its active changes, bringing back your own values.
network_god_togglenetwork_god_toggleOpens or closes the Network God window; the open state is remembered. Opening frees the mouse cursor over the window.
network_god_traffic_checknetwork_god_traffic_checkStarts a 30-second check: pause the suspected download or stream right away and Network God reports whether the connection improved. Needs Network God on, continuous traffic monitoring and an active game.
network_god_undonetwork_god_undoRemoves the change Network God applied for this session, bringing back your own values. If none is active, it says so.
network_god_waitinfonetwork_god_waitinfoDeveloper diagnostic: dumps Network God's internal recommendation queue and guidance state to the console. Not needed by players.
network_lab_confirmnetwork_lab_confirmConsole equivalent of pressing OK in the Network Lab start dialog: arms the synthetic delay, loss and reorder if the request is still valid. Does nothing when no start is awaiting confirmation.
network_lab_infonetwork_lab_infoPrints whether Network Lab is armed, its delay, jitter, loss, reorder and bandwidth settings, and per-direction packet counts and queue sizes.
network_lab_startnetwork_lab_startAsks to start Network Lab, which deliberately adds synthetic delay, loss and reorder for training. Needs Network God in Diagnosis mode or higher and an active connection; a remote server needs cl_network_lab_allow_remote 1. Opens a confirmation dialog.
network_lab_stopnetwork_lab_stopStops Network Lab: held packets are released in their original order and ping adaptation resumes.
noclipnoclipGame command sent to the server: toggles flying through walls. In the standard game it works in single player, or in deathmatch/coop only when the server runs with cheats 1. Needs a connection.
notargetnotargetGame command sent to the server: toggles notarget, so monsters do not notice you. In the standard game it works in single player, or in deathmatch/coop only with cheats 1 on the server. Needs a connection.
oggogg <info / play <track> [soft] / stop / next / pause [0 / 1]>Controls the music player: info shows the current track, play <track> [soft] plays a track, stop stops, next plays the next track, pause [0 / 1] pauses or resumes. Not available during cinematics.
opentdm_team_hud_editopentdm_team_hud_editTurns drag-to-move mode for the OpenTDM Team HUD on or off. Works only while the HUD is active: enabled, in an OpenTDM game, on a known team and not spectating; otherwise it says why.
opentdm_team_hud_resetopentdm_team_hud_resetMoves the OpenTDM Team HUD back to its default position.
opentdm_team_hud_toggleopentdm_team_hud_toggleTurns the OpenTDM Team HUD on or off (cl_opentdm_team_hud). When turned on but not yet visible, it says why, for example not on an OpenTDM server.
otxotx <help / status / profiles / start <1..5> / stop / pause / resume / reload / bot <1..5> <skill 0..200> <profile> <seed> / timing <warmup> <grace> <idle> <match> / maps <map> [map ...] / save <slot> / load <slot>>Controls an OpenTDM-X bot match: status, profiles, start <1..5 bots>, stop, pause, resume, reload, bot, timing, maps, save/load <slot>; otx help shows syntax. On a remote server changes go through rcon and need rcon_password.
otx_applyotx_applySends the bot match settings from the OpenTDM-X launcher (cl_otx_* values) to the running OpenTDM-X server. Needs a compatible server; a remote one is reached through rcon.
otx_loadotx_loadLoads the OpenTDM-X session saved under the slot named in cl_otx_slot and applies it to the running server. If loading fails, the active settings are kept.
otx_menuotx_menuOpens the OpenTDM-X bot match menu.
otx_saveotx_saveSaves the running server's OpenTDM-X session settings to bots/sessions/<slot>.otxc in the mod folder, using the slot name from cl_otx_slot.
otx_start_localotx_start_localStarts a local OpenTDM-X bot match with the launcher settings: disconnects, switches to the opentdm-x mod, loads the first map of the list and applies the settings. Needs the native OpenTDM-X mod installed.
passivepassivePuts the client into passive mode, where it waits to be contacted by a server instead of connecting out. Used behind restrictive NAT.
pathpathPrints the current search path: which directories and PAK/PKZ files the engine reads game data from, in priority order.
pausepausePauses or resumes the game. It really stops time only when you are alone on your own local server (single player) or watching a demo; on a server relaying an MVD demo it pauses that channel.
perf_hud_editperf_hud_editTurns edit mode for the performance HUD on or off: drag it with the left mouse button, Enter or Escape leaves.
perf_hud_infoperf_hud_infoPrints the performance HUD state: whether it is on and visible, interval, opacity, scale, selected sections and groups, and its measurement counters.
perf_hud_reset_positionperf_hud_reset_positionMoves the performance HUD back to its default position.
perf_hud_toggleperf_hud_toggleTurns the performance and budget HUD on or off (cl_perf_hud).
pickclientpickclient <address:port>Sends a connect invitation from the local server to a client waiting in passive mode at the given address; the port must be given. Needs a running multiplayer server.
ping_adapt_infoping_adapt_infoPrints the ping adaptation state: requested mode, what it is doing now, your real ping and the added delay.
ping_adapt_resetping_adapt_resetResets the ping adaptation controller; packets it was holding are sent in order.
pingserverspingserversBroadcasts status requests to find and measure servers. The Q2PRO-X server browser does this with a list and filters.
playplay <sound> [...]Plays one or more sound files from the game data — handy for checking that a sound exists and how it sounds.
popmenupopmenuCloses the topmost open menu page, going back one level. Does nothing when no menu is open.
post_avfx_perf_capturepost_avfx_perf_capture <scenario_name> <seconds> [condump_name] [next_command] [warmup_seconds]Developer benchmark: measures frame times for the given seconds, then prints a report, runs diagnostic dumps and can save a console dump. Not for players.
post_avfx_perf_resetpost_avfx_perf_resetDeveloper benchmark helper: zeroes the frame-time sampler used by post_avfx_perf_capture. Not for players.
post_avfx_perf_snapshotpost_avfx_perf_snapshotDeveloper benchmark helper: prints the frame-time report gathered so far. Not for players.
post_reflection_abpost_reflection_ab <warmup_seconds> <segment_seconds> <pairs> <condump>Developer A/B benchmark: alternates reflections on and off, compares frame times, saves a console dump and then quits the game. Not for players.
printallprintall <text>Prints the given text to every client connected to the local server. Needs a running server.
progprogLegacy game command name kept only for completion; it is forwarded to the server. The standard game has no such command and treats it as a chat message.
protocol_infoprotocol_infoPrints the cl_protocol preference and the protocol actually negotiated for the current connection. It does not modify the connection or serverinfo.
pushmenupushmenu <menu>Opens the named menu page on top of the current ones. pushmenu demos opens the demo browser instead of the old demos menu.
q2prox_bind_fallbackq2prox_bind_fallback <key> <command>Internal line format from old generated config files; it is still accepted so those files load quietly, but its binding is ignored. Not for players.
q2prox_cfg_defaultsq2prox_cfg_defaultsResets all Q2PRO-X settings and binds, global and local, to defaults and immediately writes both config files; the previous files are kept in backups/.
q2prox_cfg_defaults_demo_visualq2prox_cfg_defaults_demo_visualResets the local visual settings to defaults, keeping binds. During demo playback the demo visual profile is then saved; outside playback follow up with q2prox_cfg_save_demo_visual.
q2prox_cfg_defaults_globalq2prox_cfg_defaults_globalResets the global Q2PRO-X settings and binds to defaults and immediately writes the global config file; the previous file is kept in backups/.
q2prox_cfg_defaults_localq2prox_cfg_defaults_localResets the mod-local Q2PRO-X settings and binds to defaults. During demo playback only the settings are reset (binds kept) and the change goes to the demo visual profile.
q2prox_cfg_fault_fixtureq2prox_cfg_fault_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of config saving under write failures; not for players.
q2prox_cfg_global_prefs_infoq2prox_cfg_global_prefs_infoPrints the state of the unified Q2PRO-X configuration: schema version, the global config file, its version marker and what is stored where.
q2prox_cfg_global_prefs_migrateq2prox_cfg_global_prefs_migrateAdds missing global settings to baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg. Values already stored and all key binds are left untouched; nothing is written when configs are read-only.
q2prox_cfg_preset_applyq2prox_cfg_preset_applyInternal helper used by presets: marks the next config save as intended, so a preset that changes many settings at once is not rejected as an accidental mass reset. Changes nothing by itself.
q2prox_cfg_saveq2prox_cfg_saveWrites the binds and global settings plus the local settings of the current mod (or of baseq2 with no mod). During demo playback the demo visual profile is written instead of the local file.
q2prox_cfg_save_demo_visualq2prox_cfg_save_demo_visualWrites the current local visual settings to baseq2/q2pro-x/demo_visual/q2pro-x.demo.cfg; this profile is applied automatically on the next .dm2/.mvd2 playback. Works outside playback too.
q2prox_cfg_save_globalq2prox_cfg_save_globalWrites the key binds and the global Q2PRO-X settings to their config files.
q2prox_cfg_save_localq2prox_cfg_save_localWrites the local settings of the current mod, or of baseq2 when no mod is active. During demo playback it writes the demo visual profile instead.
q2prox_cfg_setq2prox_cfg_set <cvar> <value>Internal line format of generated config files: sets a variable whose value had to be escaped (for example it contains a double quote). Not meant to be typed.
q2prox_dynamic_lighting_defaultsq2prox_dynamic_lighting_defaultsResets dynamic light, emissive light and shadow settings (gl_dynamic*, gl_emissive_lights*, gl_shadows*, cl_q2prox_spark_dlight) to their defaults.
q2prox_lightning_monster_hitq2prox_lightning_monster_hit <entity> [killed]Internal message from the local Q2PRO-X game: draws lightning arcs around a monster hit by the lightning gun in single player. Not meant to be typed.
q2prox_modcfg_activate_startupq2prox_modcfg_activate_startupInternal startup step: loads the default mod config preset once at launch. Running it again does nothing.
q2prox_modcfg_infoq2prox_modcfg_infoPrints the mod config presets from q2pro-x/mod_config_presets.cfg: the current mod, default and configured slots for baseq2, opentdm and openffa, and the preset currently applied.
q2prox_modcfg_loadq2prox_modcfg_load <baseq2 / opentdm / openffa> <1..8>Applies the mod config preset from the given slot. The mod must be the one currently active; preset values are not written into your saved config.
q2prox_particle_fixtureq2prox_particle_fixture [case / dump]Developer test fixture for automated checks of particle families; not for players.
q2prox_particle_resetq2prox_particle_reset <all / page <page> / family <family> / avfx <family> / color family <family> / color avfx <family>>Resets particle family settings to defaults: all standard families, one menu page, one family, one AVFX family, or only the colour of a family.
q2prox_scope_fixtureq2prox_scope_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of where config writers store settings; not for players.
q2prox_session_fixtureq2prox_session_fixture <mode>Developer test fixture for automated checks of session-only settings; not for players.
q2prox_singleplayerq2prox_singleplayerStarts a new single-player game (skill 1, one player) in the currently active mod. If a remote server had switched your mod, your own mod choice is restored first.
quitquitShuts the game down and returns to the desktop immediately. Unsaved single-player progress is lost.
r_reloadr_reloadRestarts the renderer without recreating the window: flushes caches and reloads all models, textures and menus. Sounds playing at that moment stop.
rconrcon <command>Sends an administrative command to a server, authenticated by the rcon password cvar. It runs on the SERVER, not on your client, and only works if you are the server's administrator.
reconnectreconnectConnects again to the current process server, or after a new launch to the newest successfully played remote server retained in global history.
reconnect_historyreconnect_historyPrints the global history authority, limit, last play context and retained servers with mod and UTC time.
reconnect_history_clearreconnect_history_clearClears the global recent-server history without changing its configured limit. Server-originated use is refused.
reconnect_history_fixturereconnect_history_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of the reconnect history storage; not for players.
reconnect_startup_probereconnect_startup_probeDeveloper probe for automated checks: prints the startup state of auto-reconnect, the open menu and the intro. Not for players.
recordrecord [-zes] <filename>Records the current game into demos/<filename>.dm2 until stop.
remotemoderemotemode <address> <password>Switches the console to remote mode for the given server and rcon password: lines you type there are sent to that server as remote commands. Opens the console if it is closed.
resetreset <variable>Restores a single console variable to its built-in default value.
resetallresetallRestores ALL console variables to their built-in defaults at once. Your current settings are lost unless they were saved to a file first.
resumeresumeContinues writing frames into a demo that was suspended.
rocketdiagrocketdiag <start / mark / stop>Diagnostic trace for developers: start writes a rocket event log to logs/ (stops by itself after 10 minutes or 16 MB), mark adds a marker, stop saves it. Prediction settings are not changed.
s_gain_infos_gain_infoPrints how the final sound volume is formed: s_volume, the demo volume multiplier (when a demo plays) and the runtime gain (idle fade or mute while the window is inactive), and the result.
s_q2px_fade_fixtures_q2px_fade_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of the sound fade during map loading; not for players.
savesave <directory>Saves the current single-player game into the named save directory, replacing what was there. Not possible in deathmatch, while dead, or when the game does not support saves.
saysay <text>Sends the rest of the line to every player on the server.
say_teamsay_team <text>Sends the rest of the line to your team only, in mods that have teams.
screenshotscreenshot [format]Saves a screenshot into screenshots/, numbering the file automatically. The format follows the optional argument, otherwise the screenshot format cvar. Format-specific variants exist as separate commands.
screenshotjpgscreenshotjpg [name] [quality]Saves a JPEG screenshot. The optional second argument is the quality.
screenshotjxrscreenshotjxr [name]Saves a high-dynamic-range screenshot in JPEG XR, which keeps HDR brightness that ordinary formats clip away.
screenshotjxr_atswapscreenshotjxr_atswapDeveloper HDR diagnostic (Windows): captures the next frame exactly as presented into a .jxr file, for comparing brightness with a normal capture. Not for players.
screenshotjxr_rawscreenshotjxr_raw [name]Developer HDR capture (Windows): saves a .jxr screenshot of the raw game output without the SDR white-level adjustment. Not for players.
screenshotpngscreenshotpng [name] [compression]Saves a lossless PNG screenshot. The optional second argument is the compression level.
screenshottgascreenshottga [name]Saves an uncompressed TGA screenshot. Largest files, no quality loss.
seekseek [+-]<timespec / percent>[%]Moves demo playback to an absolute time or percentage, or by a relative offset when the value starts with + or -.
serverbrowser_connectserverbrowser_connectConnects to the server selected in the server browser and closes the browser. Does nothing if no server is selected or it is marked as failed.
serverbrowser_copyaddrserverbrowser_copyaddrCopies the address of the server selected in the server browser to the clipboard. Does nothing if no server is selected.
serverbrowser_history_fixtureserverbrowser_history_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of the server browser history; not for players.
serverbrowser_migration_fixtureserverbrowser_migration_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of server browser data migration; not for players.
serverbrowser_network_godserverbrowser_network_godHides the server browser if it is open and opens the Network God overlay, which then takes the keyboard and mouse.
serverbrowser_openserverbrowser_openOpens the server browser on the source set in cl_serverbrowser_default_source; if the list is empty or the source changed, it queries the servers. With cl_serverbrowser_ui 0 it opens the classic servers menu instead.
serverbrowser_open_legacyserverbrowser_open_legacyOpens the classic built-in servers menu instead of the new server browser, whatever cl_serverbrowser_ui is set to.
serverbrowser_open_modernserverbrowser_open_modernAlways opens the new server browser, ignoring cl_serverbrowser_ui. If the list is empty or the source changed, it queries the servers.
serverbrowser_refreshserverbrowser_refreshRe-queries every server of the current browser source (master list, favorites, custom source or play history).
serverbrowser_refresh_selectedserverbrowser_refresh_selectedRe-queries only the server selected in the browser and updates its ping and info. Does nothing if no row is selected.
serverbrowser_setrconserverbrowser_setrconSets rcon_address to the address of the server selected in the browser and reminds you to set rcon_password and then use rcon. Does nothing if no reachable server is selected.
serverbrowser_stop_fixtureserverbrowser_stop_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of the server browser's stop button; not for players.
serverbrowser_toggleserverbrowser_toggleHides the new server browser if it is open, otherwise opens it; on opening it queries the servers if the list is empty or the source changed. Handy for a key bind.
serverinfoserverinfoPrints all settings that this game shares as server info (map, game mode, limits and so on) as key and value pairs.
serverstatusserverstatus [address]Asks a server for its settings and player list. With no address, asks the server you are connected to.
setset <variable> <value> [u / s]Assigns a value to a console variable, creating it if it does not exist. The optional trailing flag marks the new variable as userinfo (u) or serverinfo (s).
setaseta <variable> <value>Like set, but also marks the variable as archived so it is saved into written configuration files.
setmastersetmaster [address ...]Dedicated server only: replaces the master server list with the given addresses, turns public on and sends a heartbeat soon. In the normal client it only prints that masters are for dedicated servers.
setssets <variable> <value>Sets a console variable, creating it if needed, and marks it as server info so it is shown to players querying the server, e.g. sets admin Bob.
setusetu <variable> <value>Sets a variable and marks it USERINFO: its value is part of the player info string sent to the server, so servers and other players can see it. Use it for things a server must know about you (name, skin, rate) — not for ordinary local settings.
shader_cache_clearshader_cache_clearDeletes the saved compiled shader files and resets the cache counters. Shaders are then compiled again from source as they are needed, which can cause short stutters at first.
shader_cache_infoshader_cache_infoPrints whether the saved shader cache is supported and enabled, its folder, and how many shaders were loaded from it, compiled from source or saved, plus the last error.
shader_prewarm_dump_longestshader_prewarm_dump_longestDeveloper diagnostic: writes the source of the slowest shader from the last prewarm pass to a file for analysis; not for players.
shader_prewarm_infoshader_prewarm_infoPrints the shader prewarm mode, why the last run was skipped if it was, when and how long it last ran, and how many shaders were compiled, already cached or failed.
shader_prewarm_longest_infoshader_prewarm_longest_infoDeveloper diagnostic: lists the slowest shaders compiled in the last prewarm pass with their timings and state flags; not for players.
shader_prewarm_nowshader_prewarm_nowSchedules a shader prewarm on the next suitable frame so effects do not stutter on first use. Follows gl_shader_prewarm: if prewarm is off or not needed, it prints why and does nothing.
showipshowipPrints this computer's host name and the local IP addresses it resolves to (IPv6 too when net_enable_ipv6 allows it).
sizedownsizedownLowers viewsize by 10, making the game view smaller. Meant for a key bind.
sizeupsizeupRaises viewsize by 10, making the game view larger. Meant for a key bind.
skinsskinsReloads the model and skin of every player on the level and prints which model and skin each one got. Works only while on a level.
skysky <basename> [rotate] [axis x y z]Replaces the sky on the current map, with optional rotation speed and axis, e.g. sky unit1_ 10. An empty name "" restores the map's own sky. Needs a loaded map.
snd_restartsnd_restartReinitialises audio so latched sound settings and a changed output device take effect.
snd_retract_fixturesnd_retract_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks: verifies that a queued weapon sound can be withdrawn before it plays. Needs started sound; not for players.
softlinksoftlink [name target]Creates a symbolic link between virtual quake paths, effective for reading only. With no arguments it lists existing symbolic links.
softunlinksoftunlink <name>Removes a link created by softlink. No file on disk is deleted.
soundactivesoundactivePrints the sound channels playing now: reserved AVFX ambience layers, audible one-shot sounds and looping sounds. Useful when rain, wind or snow ambience seems stuck. Needs started sound.
soundinfosoundinfoPrints the active sound backend, output rate, channel count and buffer layout.
soundlistsoundlistPrints the sounds currently loaded into memory with their format details.
sp_avfx_snake_combat_infosp_avfx_snake_combat_infoDeveloper diagnostic for snake combat in local single player: prints gate state, session and renderer counters; not for players.
sp_dm_start_trainingsp_dm_start_trainingStarts a local DM training game on the map named in cl_sp_mutate_dm_custom_map: turns off deathmatch and coop, enables training and scoring, then loads the map. Refuses an empty or suspicious map name.
sp_geo_deform_applysp_geo_deform_applyRebuilds the map's visible surfaces with the current geometry deform settings. If deform is off or not allowed (only local single player), it rebuilds the normal map. Needs a loaded map; collisions are not changed.
sp_geo_deform_infosp_geo_deform_info [verify]Prints the world geometry deform settings, whether it is allowed right now and why, and the last rebuild results. With verify it also checks that the last build was untouched when deform was off.
sp_monster_avfx_contacts_infosp_monster_avfx_contacts_infoPrints whether monster contact effects (snow, puddles and so on) are on and allowed now, how many monsters are tracked, and contact counts for the last frame and in total. Works only in local single player.
sp_monster_variants_infosp_monster_variants_infoPrints the monster variant settings (size range, color, shape and asymmetry strength, bosses) and whether variants are allowed right now and why.
startup_intro_infostartup_intro_infoPrints the state of the startup intro: whether it can play on this start, why it stopped, which clip and language were chosen, whether its file is valid and whether music plays.
startup_intro_trace_infostartup_intro_trace_infoDeveloper diagnostic: prints the recorded frame trace of the startup intro used to investigate black-screen reports; not for players.
statusstatus [d / l / p / s / t / v]Prints the current map and the players on the local server. A letter shows other tables: d downloads, l lag, p protocols, s settings, t time, v versions. Needs a running server.
stopstopFinishes the demo being recorded and closes its file.
stopsoundstopsoundSilences every currently playing sound channel at once.
stringsstrings [ext]Prints the OpenGL vendor, renderer, version, texture limits and pixel format. With any extra argument it also lists all OpenGL extensions.
stuffstuff <userid> <raw text>Sends raw command text to one player's client to run on their side, e.g. stuff 2 echo hi. Needs a running local server.
stuffallstuffall <raw text>Sends raw command text to every connected player's client to run on their side. Needs a running local server.
stuffcvarstuffcvar <userid> <variable> [...]Asks one player's client to report the values of the listed console variables back to the server. Needs a running local server.
suspendsuspendTemporarily stops writing frames into the demo without closing it.
svsv <command> [args]Passes the arguments to the loaded game module's server commands, e.g. sv addip, sv listip; sv writeip saves the IP filter list to a file. Needs a loaded game.
texttext <commands>Inserts the rest of the line into the command buffer right away, so it runs as commands next. Useful in scripts and aliases.
timerefreshtimerefresh [noflip]Renderer benchmark: spins the view a full circle over 128 frames and prints the time and frame rate. With any argument it renders without page flipping. Needs a loaded map.
toggletoggle <variable> [values]Flips a variable between 0 and 1, or cycles it through an explicit list of values given after the name. Made for binds.
toggleconsoletoggleconsoleShows the console if it is hidden and hides it if it is shown. This is what the tilde key is bound to by default.
togglemenutogglemenuActs like Escape: closes the console, the open menu or chat input; otherwise opens the in-game menu, or the main menu when not in a game.
translate_reloadtranslate_reloadRe-reads the translation keys file baseq2/q2pro-x/translate.local used by the chat translation command.
translate_statustranslate_statusPrints the chat translation provider, its address, whether an API key is configured and whether the keys file is loaded; also notes providers that are only stubs in this build.
triggertrigger [<command> <match>]Runs a command whenever an incoming message matches the pattern (wildcards allowed), e.g. trigger "say gg" "*wins*". With no arguments lists current triggers.
ui_avfx_contact_load_global_customui_avfx_contact_load_global_custom <slot>Menu button helper: loads the player contact effects preset from the given global slot, or shows a dialog if the slot is empty.
ui_avfx_contact_rename_global_customui_avfx_contact_rename_global_custom <slot>Menu button helper: starts renaming the player contact effects preset in the given global slot.
ui_avfx_contact_save_global_customui_avfx_contact_save_global_custom <slot>Menu button helper: saves the current player contact effects to the given global slot, asking first if it would overwrite or duplicate a name.
ui_avfx_load_customui_avfx_load_custom <slot>Menu button helper: loads the AVFX preset from the given slot of the current mod, or shows a dialog if the slot is empty.
ui_avfx_load_global_customui_avfx_load_global_custom <slot>Menu button helper: loads the AVFX preset from the given global slot, or shows a dialog if the slot is empty.
ui_avfx_load_global_music_customui_avfx_load_global_music_custom <slot>Menu button helper: loads the music AVFX preset from the given global slot, or shows a dialog if the slot is empty.
ui_avfx_load_music_customui_avfx_load_music_custom <slot>Menu button helper: loads the music AVFX preset from the given slot of the current mod, or shows a dialog if the slot is empty.
ui_avfx_rename_customui_avfx_rename_custom <slot>Menu button helper: starts renaming the AVFX preset in the given slot of the current mod.
ui_avfx_rename_global_customui_avfx_rename_global_custom <slot>Menu button helper: starts renaming the AVFX preset in the given global slot.
ui_avfx_rename_global_music_customui_avfx_rename_global_music_custom <slot>Menu button helper: starts renaming the music AVFX preset in the given global slot.
ui_avfx_rename_music_customui_avfx_rename_music_custom <slot>Menu button helper: starts renaming the music AVFX preset in the given slot of the current mod.
ui_avfx_save_customui_avfx_save_custom <slot>Menu button helper: saves the current AVFX settings to the given slot of the current mod, asking first if it would overwrite or duplicate a name.
ui_avfx_save_global_customui_avfx_save_global_custom <slot>Menu button helper: saves the current AVFX settings to the given global slot, asking first if it would overwrite or duplicate a name.
ui_avfx_save_global_music_customui_avfx_save_global_music_custom <slot>Menu button helper: opens the music link dialog to save a music AVFX preset to the given global slot.
ui_avfx_save_music_customui_avfx_save_music_custom <slot>Menu button helper: opens the music link dialog to save a music AVFX preset to the given slot of the current mod.
ui_lighting_load_customui_lighting_load_custom <slot>Menu button helper: loads the lighting preset from the given slot, or shows a dialog if the slot is empty.
ui_lighting_rename_customui_lighting_rename_custom <slot>Menu button helper: starts renaming the lighting preset in the given slot.
ui_lighting_save_customui_lighting_save_custom <slot>Menu button helper: saves the current lighting settings to the given slot, asking first if it would overwrite or duplicate a name.
ui_network_god_auto_confirmui_network_god_auto_confirmMenu helper: opens the confirmation dialog for switching Network God to Automatic mode; Cancel returns to the current mode.
ui_network_god_keep_confirmui_network_god_keep_confirmMenu helper: opens the confirmation dialog for keeping a Network God setting permanently; only OK saves it.
ui_network_god_lab_confirmui_network_god_lab_confirmMenu helper: opens the confirmation dialog before starting the Network God lab; only OK starts it.
ui_visibility_load_customui_visibility_load_custom <slot>Menu button helper: loads the visibility preset from the given slot, or shows a dialog if the slot is empty.
ui_visibility_rename_customui_visibility_rename_custom <slot>Menu button helper: starts renaming the visibility preset in the given slot.
ui_visibility_save_customui_visibility_save_custom <slot>Menu button helper: saves the current visibility settings to the given slot, asking first if it would overwrite or duplicate a name.
unaliasunalias <name>Removes a previously created alias.
unbindunbind <key>Clears the command bound to a single key.
unbindallunbindallClears every key binding at once, including movement and weapon keys. The game becomes unplayable until keys are bound again or a config is loaded.
undrawundraw <name>Removes an on-screen item added with draw, by its name; undraw all removes every one.
unignorenickunignorenick <nick>Removes a filter previously added with ignorenick.
unignoretextunignoretext <match>Removes a filter previously added with ignoretext.
unlinkunlink <name>Removes a link created by link. Nothing on disk is deleted — despite the name, this is not a file deletion command.
untriggeruntrigger [all / <command> <match>]Removes a trigger added with trigger, given the same command and pattern; untrigger all removes every trigger. With no arguments lists current triggers.
useuse <item>Asks the server to use or switch to the named item, e.g. use Super Shotgun. The client also notes the switch so the weapon change can be predicted.
userinfouserinfoPrints your userinfo string — the settings servers and other players can see, such as name, skin and rate.
vid_oled_infovid_oled_infoPrints whether OLED screen protection is on, whether bar and idle protection apply right now and why not, their current phase and bar color.
vid_restartvid_restartDestroys and recreates the render context so latched video settings take effect. The screen goes black for a moment and every renderer resource is reloaded.
viewposviewposPrints your current view position (x y z) and facing direction in degrees.
vis_perfvis_perfDeveloper performance snapshot of item highlighting: prints its gates, overlay settings and accumulated timing counters; not for players.
vis_perf_resetvis_perf_resetDeveloper helper: resets the item highlighting performance counters shown by vis_perf; not for players.
voice_deafen_togglevoice_deafen_toggleSwitches vc_deafen on or off: while on you hear nothing from voice chat. Prints the new state.
voice_defaultsvoice_defaultsResets the voice chat settings to defaults; this also turns voice chat off and ends any active voice session. vc_relay is left as is.
voice_joinvoice_joinConnects to the voice chat room. Needs vc_enable 1, otherwise it only prints that voice is disabled.
voice_leavevoice_leaveDisconnects from the voice chat room. Does nothing if you are not connected.
voice_lifecycle_fixturevoice_lifecycle_fixtureDeveloper test fixture for automated checks of voice chat connection handling, run offline; not for players. Refused while a voice session is active.
voice_mic_listvoice_mic_listPrints the selected microphone, the Windows default one and all available capture devices with numbers for voice_mic_pick.
voice_mic_pickvoice_mic_pick <index>Selects the voice chat microphone by its number from voice_mic_list; 0 follows the Windows default. Without a number it shows the list.
voice_mic_togglevoice_mic_toggleSwitches vc_mic_enable on or off and, when connected, opens or closes the microphone right away. Prints the new state.
voice_reconnectvoice_reconnectEnds the current voice session, if any, and joins voice chat again from scratch. Needs vc_enable 1.
voice_statusvoice_statusPrints the voice chat state, room and game server, microphone settings and talk mode, the participants with who is speaking or muted, and the last error.
voice_togglevoice_toggleLeaves voice chat if you are connected or connecting, otherwise joins it (needs vc_enable 1).
waitwait [frames]Delays the rest of the command buffer by the given number of client frames (1 if omitted). Used inside aliases to sequence commands that must not run in the same frame.
wavewave <0-4>Asks the server to play a player gesture: 0 flipoff, 1 salute, 2 taunt, 3 wave, 4 point. In the standard game it does not work while crouching.
weapnextweapnextAsks the server to switch to the next weapon you have. The client also notes the switch for weapon change prediction.
weaponfx_infoweaponfx_infoPrints which weapon effect parts are shown: own and other players' shots, muzzle flashes, trails, impacts, explosions and hit markers, plus the older settings that still apply. Sounds are not affected.
weapprevweapprevAsks the server to switch to the previous weapon you have. The client also notes the switch for weapon change prediction.
whereiswhereis <path> [all]Reports which directory or PAK file actually provides a given game path — the answer to "why am I getting the wrong texture".
win32_input_lifecycle_fixturewin32_input_lifecycle_fixture [mode]Developer test fixture for automated checks of Windows window and input handling; not for players.
writeconfigwriteconfig [-a / --aliases] [-b / --bindings] [-c / --cvars] [-m / --modified] <filename>Writes the current configuration into configs/<filename>.cfg. With no content flags what it saves depends on cl_writeconfig_full: 0 (the default) saves key bindings and archived cvars, as it always has; 1 saves the same thing as an explicit -b -m -a, meaning every binding, every alias of yours and every cvar whose value differs from its default. Explicit flags always win: if you write -a, -b, -c or -m yourself you get exactly that, and the setting is ignored. This is a manual, legacy-style CFG export — it is NOT the same thing as Q2PRO-X global/local preset persistence, which has its own storage.
writeconfig_fixturewriteconfig_fixture [-a] [-b] [-c] [-m] <filename>Developer test fixture: runs the same export as writeconfig into a separate test file, for automated checks; not for players.
z_statsz_statsPrints how much memory the engine has allocated, in bytes and blocks, for each kind of data, plus the total.
zoom_infozoom_infoPrints the current zoom state: whether zoom is held and how far it has ramped, base and zoomed field of view, sensitivity scaling and walk-while-zoomed settings.
